original_sentence: What do soccer players and magicians have in common? Both do hat-tricks!
readingExamples: What do soccer players and magicians have in common? Both do hat-tricks!
Why can't Cinderella play soccer? Because she's always running away from the ball.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a game played by two teams of eleven players, using a round ball that players kick up and down the field (called football in British English)
(2) n. (informal) an occasion when this game is played; a match of this sport

posExamples.sentence: The moment the whistle blew, the boy who had been laughed at for his limp tore down the wing, and the whole crowd rose to their feet — for the first time, soccer had made him someone worth watching. （读后续写·励志逆袭）
On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to warmly invite you to join our inter-class soccer tournament, where teamwork matters far more than the final score. （应用文·邀请信）
Far from being a mere pastime, soccer teaches the young that individual brilliance means little unless it is woven into the collective effort of the team. （议论文·体育与品格）

wordForms.other: footballer / soccer player (踢球者)；构词法·soccer 由 association football（协会足球）缩写变体而来，是美式常用词，故拼写固定、无动词/形容词形式，表"踢"的动作要借动词 play。

collocations.translation: 足球运动员上演帽子戏法（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: What do soccer players and magicians have in common? Both do hat-tricks! 足球运动员和魔术师有什么共同点？都会"变戏法（帽子戏法）"！（课文原句）
Every Saturday, the retired teacher would play soccer with the children. 每周六，退休教师都会和孩子们踢足球。
The soccer match ended in a dramatic penalty shoot-out. 那场足球赛以戏剧性的点球大战收场。
Being chosen for the school soccer team was his proudest moment. 入选校足球队是他最自豪的时刻。
Under the floodlights, the empty soccer field seemed to stretch on forever. 泛光灯下，空荡的足球场仿佛无限延伸。
As a lifelong soccer fan, my grandfather recalled every final he had watched. 作为终身球迷，爷爷记得他看过的每一场决赛。
The soccer World Cup unites billions of viewers across every continent. 足球世界杯让各大洲数十亿观众团结在一起。
After months of dawn practice, she finally made the soccer team. 经过数月的清晨训练，她终于入选了足球队。

synonyms.example: In most of the world, the game is simply called football. 在世界大部分地区，这项运动就叫football。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：英式英语中 football = soccer（足球）；美式英语中 football 指"橄榄球"，soccer 才指"足球"。句法/搭配：二者均为不可数名词，指运动本身时不加冠词（play soccer / play football），面向国际读者用 soccer 可避免歧义。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·踢足球（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: play soccer = have a game of soccer = kick a ball around
advancedExpressions.example: After class the boys would kick a ball around on the dusty ground until the sky turned dark. 放学后男孩们会在尘土飞扬的场地上踢球，直到天黑。

advancedExpressions.expression: make/join the soccer team · a soccer match/game · a soccer fan · the soccer World Cup
advancedExpressions.example: As a devoted soccer fan, he never missed a single match of the soccer World Cup. 作为铁杆球迷，他从不错过世界杯的任何一场比赛。

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment the whistle blew, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the whistle blew, the entire stadium erupted, and thirty thousand voices merged into a single, deafening wave of joy. （以关键动作为时间锚点,瞬间点燃画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to invite you to join our ... , where ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to invite you to join our charity soccer match, where every ticket sold will help a child in need return to the classroom. （邀请信句式 + where 定语从句点明意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being a mere ..., ... teaches us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being a mere game, soccer teaches us that discipline and cooperation triumph where raw talent alone falls short. （先破后立句式,提升论证层次）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was happy to play soccer with his friends.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the ball rolled to his feet and his friends' cheers rang across the pitch, a warmth spread through his chest that no words could capture — this, he realized, was where he truly belonged. （读后续写·心理+环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作触发(the ball rolled to his feet) + 感官环境(cheers rang across) + 心理顿悟(this was where he belonged) + 破折号收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Soccer is good for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that soccer, by weaving together physical fitness, teamwork and resilience, offers students a lesson no textbook could ever teach. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...主观点句 + by doing 状语列举三重价值(fitness, teamwork, resilience) + no...could ever 比较级强化

classPractice.question: Every weekend the boys get together to play ____ on the school pitch.
classPractice.note: play + 球类运动前不加冠词；soccer 不可数

classPractice.question: In American English, "football" means rugby, so to talk about the game you kick with a round ball you should say ____ (soccer / football).
classPractice.note: 美式 football=橄榄球，soccer 才=足球；辨析地域用词

classPractice.question: 经过数月清晨训练，她终于入选了校足球队。After months of dawn practice, she finally ____ the school ____ team.
classPractice.note: make the team 入选球队；soccer team 足球队

original_sentence: What animal is best at hitting baseballs? A bat!
readingExamples: What animal is best at hitting baseballs? A bat!
definitionEn:
(1) n. a small animal like a mouse with wings that flies and hunts at night
(2) n. a specially shaped wooden stick used for hitting the ball in games such as baseball, cricket or table tennis
(3) v. to hit a ball with a bat, or to take a turn at hitting in cricket or baseball

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 蝙蝠（一种夜行、有翼、似鼠的哺乳动物）
uncommonMeanings.example: As dusk deepened, a single bat swept out of the shadows, its silent wings tracing an eerie arc. 暮色渐浓，一只蝙蝠从阴影中掠出，无声的翅膀划出诡异的弧线。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 球棒，球拍（棒球、板球、乒乓球等所用的平板/棍状击球器）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please remember to bring your own bat to Saturday's baseball club. 请记得周六棒球社自带球棒。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 击球；轮到击球（板球、棒球中）
uncommonMeanings.example: With two runs needed, the youngest player stepped up to bat. 还差两分时，最年轻的球员上场击球。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 眨（眼）；扇动（睫毛）——常用于 not bat an eyelid/eye 结构，意为“毫不动容、面不改色”
uncommonMeanings.example: When the examiner announced the impossible question, she did not bat an eyelid, calmly picking up her pen as though she had rehearsed this very moment for years. （读后续写·临危不乱·心理刻画）

posExamples.sentence: As dusk deepened over the ruined tower, a single bat swept out of the shadows, its silent wings tracing an eerie arc against the blood-red sky. （读后续写·悬疑环境描写）
Please remember to bring your own bat and a pair of trainers to Saturday's baseball club, as our equipment is limited this term. （应用文·社团通知）
With two runs needed and the crowd holding its breath, the youngest player stepped up to bat, gripping the handle so tightly his knuckles turned white. （读后续写·比赛紧张时刻）
That bats are among the very few mammals capable of true flight is a fact that never fails to astonish students in a biology lecture. （议论文/说明文·自然科普）

wordForms.other: batsman/batter (击球员); batting (击球)；特例·bat 一词三义（蝙蝠 n. / 球棒 n. / 击球 v.）互不相干，属同形异义；作动词 bat 的现在分词/过去式双写 t：batting / batted。

idioms.translation: 眼睛都不眨一下；面不改色，毫不惊慌
idioms.example: When accused before the whole class, he did not bat an eye, and his icy composure told everyone that he had nothing to hide. （读后续写·沉着人物）

idioms.translation: 凭自己的努力；主动地（英式口语）
idioms.example: Entirely off her own bat, the girl organised a clothing drive for the flood victims, without waiting for anyone to tell her what to do. （读后续写·主动担当）
Right off the bat, the new coach made it clear that effort mattered to him more than talent. （读后续写·人物登场）

collocations.phrase: best at hitting baseballs — a bat
collocations.translation: 最擅长击打棒球的——蝙蝠（bat 双关：蝙蝠/球棒）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: What animal is best at hitting baseballs? A bat! 什么动物最擅长击打棒球？蝙蝠（bat 亦指"球棒"）！（课文原句）
He swung the baseball bat with all his might. 他用尽全力挥动棒球棒。
She gripped the bat so tightly that her knuckles turned white. 她把球棒握得指节发白。

collocations.translation: 凭自己的努力；主动地（熟词僻义·英式口语）
collocations.example: Entirely off her own bat, she organised a clothing drive for the victims. 她完全主动地为灾民组织了一次捐衣活动。
Deep in the cave, thousands of fruit bats hung motionless. 洞穴深处，成千上万只果蝠一动不动地倒挂着。
At sunset, a vast cloud of bats poured out of the cave mouth. 日落时分，一大群蝙蝠从洞口涌出。
She batted her eyelashes innocently, but the mischief in her eyes gave her away. 她天真地眨着睫毛，可眼里的顽皮出卖了她。

collocations.translation: 眼睛都不眨一下；面不改色
collocations.example: When accused before the class, he did not bat an eye. 当着全班被指控时，他连眼睛都没眨一下。

collocations.phrase: be as blind as a bat
collocations.example: Without his glasses, Grandpa was as blind as a bat. 没有眼镜，爷爷几乎什么都看不见。

synonyms.example: She adjusted her grip on the racket and prepared for the final serve. 她调整了握拍的姿势，准备最后一记发球。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：racket 指网球/羽毛球/壁球等带网面的球拍；bat 指棒球、板球、乒乓球所用的平板球棒/球拍。搭配/句法：均为可数名词，swing a bat / hold a racket，二者不可混用。

synonyms.example: The golfer selected a club with the care of a surgeon choosing an instrument. 高尔夫球手挑选球杆时，谨慎得像外科医生挑选器械。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：club 泛指高尔夫球杆或作武器的粗棍；与击球用的 bat 形制、运动皆不同。搭配：a golf club / swing a club。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·bat 熟词僻义与习语
advancedExpressions.expression: off one's own bat 主动地 · not bat an eye/eyelid 面不改色 · right off the bat 立刻 · (as) blind as a bat 眼力极差
advancedExpressions.example: Right off the bat the new coach made it clear that, entirely off his own bat, he would rebuild the team, and he did not bat an eye at the doubters. 新教练一上来就表明，他要完全主动地重建球队，面对质疑者眼睛都不眨一下。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·毫不动容（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: not bat an eye/eyelid = remain unmoved = keep a straight face = show no reaction
advancedExpressions.example: Even as the accusation thundered across the room, she remained utterly unmoved. 即便指控声在屋里炸响，她也丝毫不为所动。

advancedExpressions.expression: as dusk deepened, a single ... swept out of the shadows
advancedExpressions.example: As dusk deepened, a single bat swept out of the shadows, and an inexplicable chill crept down my spine. （以自然意象暗示情绪转折,制造悬念）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. did not bat an eye, ...
advancedExpressions.example: He did not bat an eye; instead, he folded his arms and met the accusation with a quiet, unshakeable calm. （用习语刻画临危不乱,配 instead 转折加深对比）

advancedExpressions.type: 议论文/说明文·自然科普
advancedExpressions.expression: that ... is a fact that never fails to astonish ...
advancedExpressions.example: That bats navigate flawlessly in total darkness by echolocation is a fact that never fails to astonish us and remind us how much nature still has to teach. （主语从句 + never fail to 双重强调）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He hit the ball with the bat.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He drew back the bat, held his breath for one endless heartbeat, and then swung — the ball soaring over the fence as the crowd exploded into a roar he would never forget. （读后续写·动作分解+高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作三段分解(drew back / held his breath / swung) + one endless heartbeat 慢镜头 + 破折号引出结果 + 感官高潮(exploded into a roar)

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was not afraid when the teacher scolded her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Even as the teacher's voice thundered across the silent classroom, she did not bat an eyelid, her steady gaze betraying a courage that left everyone, teacher included, quietly impressed. （读后续写·沉着人物）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Even as 让步状语营造压力 + 习语 not bat an eyelid 刻画镇定 + 独立主格(her steady gaze betraying...)补充神态 + teacher included 插入语强化效果

classPractice.question: For the table-tennis match, you need a ____ (bat / racket); for the tennis match, you need a ____ (bat / racket).
classPractice.note: 乒乓球用 bat（平板拍），网球用 racket（网面拍）

classPractice.question: No one told her to do it; she started the whole charity project off her own ____.
classPractice.note: off one's own bat 主动地、凭自己努力（熟词僻义）

classPractice.question: 面对突如其来的指控，他面不改色。Faced with the sudden accusation, he ____ ____ ____ an eyelid.
classPractice.note: not bat an eyelid 面不改色、毫不动容

original_sentence: What is the hardest part about skydiving? The ground!
readingExamples: What is the hardest part about skydiving? The ground!
definitionEn:
(1) n. the sport of jumping out of a plane and falling freely through the air before opening a parachute to land safely
(2) n. the activity of free-falling from a great height as a form of recreation or extreme sport

posExamples.sentence: As the plane door slid open and the roaring wind tore at her clothes, she realized that skydiving was not about conquering the sky, but about conquering the fear that had ruled her for years. （读后续写·突破自我）
Our Outdoor Adventure Club is organising a beginners' skydiving experience next month, and I sincerely encourage anyone eager to test their courage to sign up before Friday. （应用文·社团招募）
Skydiving may strike the timid as reckless, yet it embodies a truth worth defending: real growth begins the very instant we step beyond the boundary of comfort. （议论文·冒险与成长）

wordForms.other: 构词法·合成词 skydiving = sky（天空）+ diving（跳水/俯冲），字面"在天空中跳跃"，即高空跳伞运动；同类合成运动词：skateboarding 滑板、windsurfing 帆板。作运动名称时不可数，前不加冠词（go skydiving）。

collocations.phrase: the hardest part about skydiving — the ground
collocations.translation: 跳伞最难的部分——落地（谐趣双关）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: What is the hardest part about skydiving? The ground! 跳伞最难的部分是什么？地面（落地）！（课文原句）
On her eighteenth birthday, she decided to go skydiving. 十八岁生日那天，她决定去跳伞。

collocations.translation: 尝试 / 开始跳伞（爱好）
collocations.example: After surviving the accident, he took up skydiving. 从事故中幸存后，他开始迷上跳伞。
The skydiving instructor gave her a reassuring nod. 跳伞教练向她安心地点了点头。
The skydiving experience left a deep imprint on his memory. 这次跳伞体验在他记忆里留下了深深的印记。
For those first breathless seconds of free-fall, the whole world fell silent. 自由落体的最初几秒屏息之间，整个世界都寂静了。

synonyms.example: Parachuting had once been purely a military skill. 跳伞曾经纯粹是一项军事技能。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：parachuting 强调整个伞降过程（含开伞后滑翔）；skydiving 更突出开伞前的自由落体与刺激感。搭配：go parachuting / go skydiving，写极限运动首选 skydiving。

synonyms.translation: 定点跳伞（从固定物体跳下）
synonyms.example: Base jumping carries risks that make even seasoned skydivers hesitate. 定点跳伞的风险大到连老练的跳伞者都会犹豫。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：base jumping 从悬崖、高楼等固定物跳下，高度低、风险更大；skydiving 从飞机跳下，是相对入门的极限运动。搭配：go base jumping。

advancedExpressions.expression: sky（天空）+ diving（俯冲/跳水）→ skydiving 高空跳伞
advancedExpressions.example: Like windsurfing and snowboarding, skydiving is a compound word that names an extreme sport by fusing its setting and its action. 和帆板、单板滑雪一样，skydiving 也是把"场景+动作"融合来命名极限运动的合成词。

advancedExpressions.expression: go/try/take up skydiving · a skydiving instructor · free-fall during skydiving · a skydiving experience
advancedExpressions.example: Encouraged by her skydiving instructor, she decided to try skydiving and treasure that free-fall experience forever. 在跳伞教练的鼓励下，她决定尝试跳伞，并永远珍藏那次自由落体的体验。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. realized that ... was not about ..., but about ...
advancedExpressions.example: She realized that skydiving was not about defying gravity, but about defying the doubt that had chained her for so long. （not about...but about 句式,由外在动作升华到内在成长）

advancedExpressions.expression: I sincerely encourage anyone eager to ... to sign up before ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely encourage anyone eager to embrace a new challenge to sign up for our skydiving experience before the end of the week. （招募/倡议标准句式 + eager to 定语精准锁定读者）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... may strike the timid as reckless, yet it embodies a truth: ...
advancedExpressions.example: Extreme sports may strike the timid as reckless, yet they embody a truth we too often forget: courage is a muscle that grows only when tested. （让步转折 + 冒号引出格言式论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She jumped out of the plane and felt excited.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant she flung herself out of the aircraft, the earth spun far below and the wind screamed in her ears, yet beneath the terror surged a wild, intoxicating joy she had never dreamed she could feel. （读后续写·感官+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant 引导瞬时状语 + 环境动词化(the earth spun / the wind screamed) + yet 转折 + beneath the terror surged...倒装凸显心理层次

sentenceUpgrade.original: Skydiving helps people become braver.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By hurling us into the very heart of our fears, skydiving forges a courage that no comfortable classroom could ever cultivate — proof that we grow most where the ground feels least secure. （议论文·观点升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: By doing 状语开篇 + forge/cultivate 动词升级 + no...could ever 强化对比 + 破折号引出格言式收束

classPractice.question: On her gap year she decided to go ____ (skydive) for the very first time.
classPractice.note: go + 运动名词ing 形式；go skydiving 去跳伞

classPractice.question: skydiving 由 sky 和 diving 两个词合成。The word "skydiving" is made up of "sky" and "____".
classPractice.note: 考构词法：合成词 sky+diving

classPractice.question: 经过多年恐高，他终于鼓起勇气尝试跳伞。After years of fearing heights, he finally plucked up the courage to ____ ____.
classPractice.note: try (doing) skydiving 尝试跳伞；skydiving 作动名词宾语

original_sentence: You want to start doing exercise? Congratulations! You have just taken your first step towards a new and improved you!
readingExamples: You want to start doing exercise? Congratulations! You have just taken your first step towards a new and improved you!
definitionEn:
(1) n. (congratulations) words that express how pleased you are about someone's success, good luck or happy event
(2) n. the act of telling someone that you are happy about their achievement or good fortune

posExamples.sentence: When her name was finally read out as the winner, a storm of congratulations swept over her, yet all she could see was her mother's tear-streaked face beaming from the back row. （读后续写·荣耀时刻）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to offer my heartfelt congratulations on your admission to your dream university. （应用文·祝贺信）
A word of sincere congratulation costs nothing, yet it can rekindle the confidence of someone who has struggled quietly and long. （议论文·鼓励的力量）

wordForms.other: 特例/小贴士·表"道贺"时几乎总用复数 Congratulations!；动词搭配 congratulate sb on (doing) sth（介词用 on，不用 for/about）；名词搭配对应 congratulations on sth。构词法·congratulate(v.) → congratulation(n.) → congratulatory(adj.)。

collocations.phrase: congratulations on sth / on doing sth
collocations.example: Congratulations on your exam results! 祝贺你考出好成绩！（课件 Reading）
Please send my congratulations to your sister on her graduation. 请代我向你姐姐的毕业致以祝贺。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】贺信（此处 congratulation 为不可数）
collocations.example: The mayor wrote a letter of congratulation to the winning team. 市长给夺冠的队伍写了一封贺信。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】为某事向某人祝贺（动词 congratulate 的宾语是 sb 不是 sth）
collocations.example: I congratulated him on his new job. 我祝贺他找到了新工作。（课件 Reading·补全句子）

collocations.translation: 【课件】感到自豪；暗自庆幸；为自己高兴
collocations.example: I was congratulating myself on my narrow escape when disaster struck. 我正庆幸自己侥幸逃脱，灾难却降临了。（课件 Reading·补全句子）

collocations.phrase: Congratulations! You have taken your first step
collocations.translation: 恭喜！你已迈出第一步（课文原句词块，感叹用复数 Congratulations）
collocations.example: You want to start doing exercise? Congratulations! You have just taken your first step towards a new and improved you! 你想开始运动？恭喜你！你刚刚朝着更好的自己迈出了第一步！（课文原句）
Congratulations on passing the exam with flying colours! 祝贺你以优异成绩通过考试！
I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on your win. 我写信向你的胜利致以最热烈的祝贺。
Please accept my heartfelt congratulations. 请接受我衷心的祝贺。
A short letter of congratulation from his teacher meant more than any prize. 老师一封简短的贺信比任何奖品都珍贵。
Everyone who finished the marathon deserves our warmest congratulations. 每个跑完马拉松的人都值得我们最热烈的祝贺。
Congratulations and best wishes for every triumph ahead. 祝贺你，并祝愿你前程中每一次成功。
As messages poured in, she received congratulations from friends she had not spoken to in years. 消息纷至沓来，她收到了多年未联系的朋友们的祝贺。

synonyms.example: Her sincere compliment on his handwriting made the shy boy blush. 她对他书法的真诚赞美让害羞的男孩脸红了。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：compliment 是对人品质、外表、能力的当面称赞；congratulation 专用于对方取得成功或喜事时道喜。搭配：pay sb a compliment / offer congratulations，场合不同。

synonyms.example: The coach's public praise gave the struggling player courage. 教练当众的表扬给了苦苦挣扎的球员勇气。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：praise 侧重对表现、成就的肯定与表彰，可正式可日常；congratulation 特指为对方的好事、成功道贺。搭配：praise sb for sth / congratulate sb on sth。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·congratulate 的用法（TIP·宾语是 sb 不是 sth）
advancedExpressions.expression: congratulate sb on (doing) sth：宾语只能是人（sb），不能是事（sth）；该动词后不接不定式的复合结构，也不接 that 从句。表"就某事"一律用介词 on。
advancedExpressions.example: √ I congratulated him on his success. ×I congratulated his success. ×I congratulated him to have succeeded. ×I congratulated him that he had succeeded. （课件 TIP：只有 congratulate sb on sth 成立）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·祝贺（应用文高频）
advancedExpressions.expression: congratulations on (doing) sth · offer/extend one's warmest congratulations · a letter of congratulation · congratulate sb on sth
advancedExpressions.example: On behalf of the whole class, I extend my warmest congratulations on your admission and congratulate you on years of hard work. 我谨代表全班，为你被录取致以最热烈的祝贺，并祝贺你多年的努力。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·congratulate sb on 与 congratulations on
advancedExpressions.expression: congratulate sb on (doing) sth = offer sb congratulations on sth（介词恒用 on）
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to congratulate you on winning the prize = I would like to offer you my congratulations on winning the prize. 我想祝贺你获奖（两种表达等价，介词都用 on）。

advancedExpressions.expression: a storm of congratulations swept over sb., yet all sb. could see was ...
advancedExpressions.example: A storm of congratulations swept over him, yet all he could see was the empty seat where his father should have been. （用祝贺的喧闹反衬内心的孤寂,以乐景写哀）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to extend my warmest congratulations on your remarkable victory, which has brought honour to our entire school. （祝贺信标准开头 + which 非限定从句拔高意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: a word of sincere congratulation ... , yet it can ...
advancedExpressions.example: A word of sincere congratulation costs the giver nothing, yet it can restore hope to a heart on the verge of giving up. （costs nothing...yet 对比结构,论证小善举的大力量）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone congratulated her and she was happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As congratulations rained down from every corner of the hall, a warmth she had never known bloomed in her chest — for in that shining moment, all the sleepless nights and silent tears had finally proved worthwhile. （读后续写·心理+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: rained down 比喻(祝贺如雨) + bloomed in her chest 情感具象化 + 破折号引出因果升华 + 三名词并列(sleepless nights and silent tears)回望艰辛

sentenceUpgrade.original: I want to congratulate you on your success.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On behalf of the entire student body, I would like to offer you my most heartfelt congratulations on this well-earned success, a triumph that will inspire us all for years to come. （应用文·祝贺信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: On behalf of 代表句式提升正式度 + offer...heartfelt congratulations 惯用搭配 + well-earned 形容词点明实至名归 + a triumph that...同位语从句升华意义

classPractice.question: We ____________________________ (祝贺他找到新工作).
classPractice.answer: congratulated him on his new job
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】congratulate sb on sth；宾语是 sb（him）不是 sth，用介词 on。

classPractice.question: I ____________________________ (对你的成功致以最热烈的祝贺).
classPractice.answer: send you my warmest congratulations on your success
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】send sb my (warmest) congratulations on sth；名词搭配同样用 on。

classPractice.question: I ____________________________ (正庆幸自己侥幸逃脱) when disaster struck.
classPractice.answer: was congratulating myself on my narrow escape
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】congratulate oneself on sth 暗自庆幸；when 从句表"正当……时"，主句用过去进行时。

classPractice.question: I'd like to offer my warmest congratulations ____ your admission to your dream university.
classPractice.note: congratulations on (doing) sth，介词固定用 on

classPractice.question: You passed the driving test on your first try? ____ (congratulation)!
classPractice.note: 表道贺时用复数感叹 Congratulations!

classPractice.question: 我谨代表全班祝贺你获奖。On behalf of the class, I ____ you ____ winning the prize.
classPractice.note: congratulate sb on (doing) sth 祝贺某人某事

original_sentence: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
readingExamples: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
However, some people assume that if some exercise is good, more is always better.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to think that something is true or probably true without having proof or certain knowledge of it
(2) v. to take or begin to have power, control or responsibility for something
(3) v. (formal) to take on or start to show a particular quality, appearance or manner
(4) v. to pretend to have a feeling, attitude or identity that is not real

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 假定，认为（未经证实地想当然）——assume that + 从句
uncommonMeanings.example: She assumed that the thick, gold-edged letter must carry good news. 她想当然地以为那封厚厚的、镶金边的信一定是好消息。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 承担，就任（责任、职务、控制权）——assume responsibility/control/office
uncommonMeanings.example: As the new monitor, I hereby assume full responsibility for our reading sessions. 作为新班长，我在此承担起组织阅读活动的全部责任。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 呈现，具有（某种外观、性质或形态）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the last light drained from the sky, the familiar garden assumed a strange and menacing air, its shadows lengthening into shapes she no longer recognised. （读后续写·环境突变·由熟悉转陌生）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 装出，佯装（某种情绪或神态）
uncommonMeanings.example: He assumed an air of complete indifference, though the trembling of his hands betrayed just how much the news had shaken him. （读后续写·外冷内热·心理反差）

posExamples.sentence: She assumed that the letter, thick and edged in gold, must carry good news, and so she was utterly unprepared for the single grim line that awaited her inside. （读后续写·预期落空·情节反转）
As the new class monitor, I hereby assume full responsibility for organising our weekly reading sessions and ensuring that every voice is heard. （应用文·竞选演讲/职责说明）
We must never assume that silence signals agreement, for the quietest person in the room may well be the one who disagrees most profoundly. （议论文·独立思考）
It is dangerous to assume that hard work alone guarantees success; without direction, even the most tireless effort may lead nowhere. （议论文·努力与方法）

wordForms.noun: assumption (假设，设想); assumer (承担者，较少用)
wordForms.other: 全家桶·assume(v.) → assumption(n. 假设) → assumed(adj. 假定的/假装的，如 an assumed name 假名)。构词法·词根 sume=take（拿、取），as-(=ad- 向)+sume→"取过来"→引申为"承担/认定"；同根 presume 推测、consume 消耗、resume 恢复。

collocations.translation: 【课件】假定，认为……（未经证实地想当然）
collocations.example: It is generally assumed that stress is caused by too much work. 普遍认为，紧张是工作过重所致。（课件 Reading）
I had assumed him to be a Belgian. 我本以为他是比利时人。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】普遍/长久认为……（it 作形式主语）
collocations.example: It is generally assumed that stress is caused by too much work. 普遍认为，紧张是工作过重所致。（课件 Reading）
Don't always assume the worst. 别总往最坏处想。（课件 Reading）

collocations.phrase: assume responsibility (to do sth / for sth)
collocations.example: They appoint you as the boss, so you will assume responsibility. 他们任命你为老板，所以你得承担责任。（课件 Reading）
He assumed an air of concern. 他装出关心的样子。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……作出假定/设想（assumption n. 假定；设想）
collocations.example: We should not make assumptions about people we have never met. 我们不应对素未谋面的人妄加揣测。（课件 Reading·拓展）
We are working on the assumption that everyone invited will turn up. 我们假定每一个人都会应邀出席，并正就此作出安排。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】假设……（引导条件状语从句）
collocations.example: Assuming that he's still alive, how old would he be now? 假定他还活着，现在有多大年纪了？（课件 Reading）

collocations.phrase: assume that regular exercise does wonders
collocations.translation: 认为规律运动大有裨益（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind. 大多数人认为规律运动对身心大有裨益。（课文原句）
I wrongly assumed that she had already left. 我错误地以为她已经离开了。
The moment his father fell ill, the boy quietly assumed responsibility for the family. 父亲一病倒，男孩便默默扛起了全家的责任。

collocations.translation: 掌控 / 掌权 / 就职
collocations.example: When she assumed control of the failing club, few believed she could save it. 当她接管那家濒临破产的俱乐部时，没几个人相信她能挽救它。
He checked into the hotel under an assumed name. 他用假名登记入住了旅馆。
In the crisis, ordinary volunteers assumed the role of leaders. 危机中，普通志愿者担起了领导者的角色。

collocations.phrase: it is (safe / reasonable / wrong) to assume that ...
collocations.translation: ……的假设是（稳妥的/合理的/错误的）
collocations.example: It is reasonable to assume that regular reading broadens the mind. 认为经常阅读能开阔心智，这一假设是合理的。
Hearing no reply for days, she began to assume the worst. 好几天没有回音，她开始往最坏处想。
He assumed an air of calm, but the tightness around his eyes gave his fear away. 他装出镇定的样子，但眼角的紧绷出卖了他的恐惧。

synonyms.translation: 推测，假定（更正式，含较强把握）
synonyms.example: I presume you have already read the notice, so I shall not repeat it. 我想你已读过通知，所以就不重复了。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：presume 比 assume 更正式，常带基于合理依据的推断，略显自信甚至冒昧；assume 更中性、日常，单纯指"未经证实地认为"。句法：二者都接 that 从句或复合宾语（presume/assume sb to be...）。

synonyms.example: Suppose you were in her position — would you have made a different choice? 假设你处在她的位置——你会做出不同的选择吗？
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：suppose 更口语、语气更弱，常用于礼貌请求或设问；assume 强调"想当然地认定"，常暗含缺乏证据。句法：suppose 可作让步/条件连词引导从句，assume 一般只作及物动词。

synonyms.translation: 承担；呈现（相当于 assume 的“承担/呈现”义）
synonyms.example: She took on far more work than anyone had asked of her. 她揽下的活儿远比任何人要求的都多。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：take on 更口语，可替代 assume 的"承担责任/职务"与"呈现某种样貌"两义；但 assume 更书面正式，议论文与应用文中更佳。搭配：take on responsibility / take on a new look。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·assume 一词多义（课件归纳：认定/承担/装出）
advancedExpressions.expression: assume that... 假定，认为 · assume sb/sth to be... 认为某人(事)是… · assume responsibility 承担责任 · assume an air of... 装出…神态 · it is (generally/long) assumed that... 普遍/长久认为… · don't assume the worst 别往最坏处想
advancedExpressions.example: Newly in charge, she assumed full responsibility, assumed an air of calm, yet refused to assume that the crisis would pass on its own. 刚一掌权，她便扛起全部责任，摆出从容的姿态，却绝不想当然地以为危机会自行过去。（课件三义合一）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·assumption 的三大搭配（课件拓展）
advancedExpressions.expression: make assumptions about sth 对…作假定 · on the assumption that... 在…的前提下 · assuming (that)... 假设…（conj. 引导条件状语从句）
advancedExpressions.example: We are working on the assumption that everyone invited will turn up, always assuming that the weather holds. 我们假定每位受邀者都会到场，当然前提是天气不变。（课件 assumption 派生搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·assume 一词多义搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: assume that... 认定 · assume responsibility/control/office 承担/接管/就任 · assume an air of... 装出…神态 · assume a new look 呈现新面貌 · an assumed name 假名
advancedExpressions.example: Newly in charge, she assumed full responsibility, assumed an air of calm authority, and refused to assume that the crisis would pass on its own. 刚一掌权，她便扛起全部责任，摆出一副从容而权威的姿态，绝不想当然地以为危机会自行过去。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·想当然地认为（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: assume that = take it for granted that = presume that = jump to the conclusion that
advancedExpressions.example: We too easily take it for granted that hard work alone guarantees success. 我们太容易想当然地以为，光靠努力就能保证成功。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. assumed ..., and so sb. was utterly unprepared for ...
advancedExpressions.example: She assumed the worst was behind her, and so she was utterly unprepared for the phone call that would shatter her fragile peace. （用错误预设铺垫,再以突转制造戏剧张力）

advancedExpressions.expression: I hereby assume full responsibility for ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the newly elected representative, I hereby assume full responsibility for voicing every classmate's concerns to the school. （hereby 增强正式庄重感,竞选/承诺类应用文适用）

advancedExpressions.expression: we must never assume that ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must never assume that a popular opinion is necessarily a correct one, for history is littered with truths that the majority once dismissed. （否定祈使 + for 引出理由,凸显思辨深度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He thought the news was good, but it wasn't.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He had assumed, with the easy confidence of one who had never known real misfortune, that the news could only be good — and so the blow, when it came, struck him all the harder. （读后续写·预期落空）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: assume with the confidence of...插入语勾勒心态 + em-dash 引出转折 + the blow, when it came 插入语延宕节奏 + all the harder 比较级强化打击

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should not think something is true without proof.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To assume a claim is true merely because it is widely repeated is to surrender one's judgement; genuine wisdom begins the moment we dare to ask, 'But is it really so?' （议论文·思辨升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: To do...is to do 定义式判断句 + merely because 状语揭示谬误根源 + 分号平行结构 + 引语设问收束,启发读者

classPractice.type: 按要求完成句子（用所给词的适当形式）
classPractice.question: His actions were based on a false ____ (assume).
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】assume(v.) → assumption(n. 假定，设想)；a false assumption 错误的假设。

classPractice.type: 按要求完成句子（用 assuming that... 改写）
classPractice.question: If there wasn't the hard work of the dustman, what can you imagine our environment will be like? → ____________________, what can you imagine our environment will be like?
classPractice.answer: Assuming that there wasn't the hard work of the dustman
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】assuming (that)... 引导条件状语从句，等价于 if 从句。

classPractice.type: 按要求完成句子（用 it 作形式主语改写）
classPractice.question: People assume that what they do has little effect on the environment. → ____________________________________.
classPractice.answer: It is assumed that what people do has little effect on the environment
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】it is assumed that... 用 it 作形式主语，that 从句为真正主语，主动变被动。

classPractice.question: 认为这座墓建于汉代似乎有道理。
classPractice.answer: It seems reasonable to assume that the tomb was built in the Han Dynasty.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】It seems reasonable to assume that...；it 作形式主语，真正主语为 to assume 不定式。

classPractice.question: Most people ____ (assume) that regular exercise does wonders, yet few truly understand why.
classPractice.note: 课文原句结构；assume that + 从句，一般现在时表普遍看法

classPractice.question: When his father fell ill, the young man had to ____ responsibility ____ the whole family.
classPractice.note: assume responsibility for sth 承担……的责任

classPractice.question: The fugitive travelled under an ____ (assumed / assuming) name to avoid the police.
classPractice.note: assumed adj. 假的、化名的；an assumed name 假名

classPractice.question: 我们绝不能想当然地认为沉默就代表同意。We must never ____ ____ silence signals agreement.
classPractice.note: assume that + 从句，考"想当然地认为"义

translation: 创造奇迹，产生神奇效果
original_sentence: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
readingExamples: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind – but what exactly are its health benefits?
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to have a very good effect on someone or something; to produce excellent or almost magical results
(2) phr. to greatly improve a situation, condition, mood or appearance in a remarkable way

posExamples.sentence: A single word of encouragement from her old teacher did wonders for the girl's shattered confidence, and the very next morning she walked into the exam hall with her head held high. （读后续写·鼓励的魔力）
In my experience, half an hour of morning jogging can do wonders for your concentration, so I strongly recommend fitting it into your daily routine. （应用文·建议信）
A culture of genuine praise, rather than constant criticism, does wonders for a team's morale and unlocks a creativity that fear could never inspire. （议论文·激励与团队）

idioms.translation: 创造奇迹；产生神奇效果；大有裨益（课文习语）
idioms.example: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind. 大多数人认为规律运动对身心大有裨益。（课文原句）

idioms.translation: 创造奇迹，产生神奇效果
idioms.example: A good night's sleep can work wonders, turning yesterday's despair into today's fresh resolve. （读后续写·状态逆转）

collocations.phrase: do wonders for sb / sth (= have a good effect on ...)
collocations.translation: 【课件】对……产生奇效；大有裨益（课件明确等同 have a good effect on）
collocations.example: Sometimes a bit of give-and-take would do wonders. 有时彼此迁就一下就会有奇效。（课件 Reading）

collocations.phrase: regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind
collocations.translation: 规律运动对身心大有裨益（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Most people assume that regular exercise does wonders for the body and mind. 大多数人认为规律运动对身心大有裨益。（课文原句）
A month by the sea did wonders for his health. 在海边住了一个月，他的健康大为好转。

collocations.translation: 在（做某事）方面创造奇迹
collocations.example: Patience and kindness do wonders in winning over stubborn hearts. 耐心与善意在打动顽固的心方面能创造奇迹。

collocations.translation: 一个微笑就能创造奇迹
collocations.example: In the tense waiting room, a stranger's warm smile did wonders. 在气氛紧张的候诊室里，一个陌生人温暖的微笑起了奇效。

collocations.phrase: do wonders to boost / improve sth
collocations.example: Reading widely does wonders to improve your writing. 广泛阅读对提高写作大有裨益。

synonyms.synonym: have a good effect on sth
synonyms.translation: 【课件】对……有良好效果（课件给出的 do wonders 释义等价短语）
synonyms.example: Regular exercise has a good effect on both body and mind. 规律运动对身心都有良好效果。（课件：do wonders for = have a good effect on）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：have a good effect on 是中性直白的表达，指"产生良好效果"；do wonders 更形象、带"奇效"色彩，程度更强。搭配：have a good effect on sb/sth = do wonders for sb/sth。

synonyms.example: With little more than patience and love, the old gardener worked miracles. 仅凭耐心与爱心，老园丁便创造了奇迹。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：work wonders 与 do wonders 几乎完全同义、可互换；work miracles 语气更强，近乎"化不可能为可能"。搭配：do/work wonders for sb/sth，程度稍缓、更日常。

synonyms.example: Students benefit greatly from learning to manage their own time. 学会自己管理时间让学生受益匪浅。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：benefit greatly 是中性正式的直白表达，议论文常用；do wonders 更形象生动、带"奇效"色彩，读后续写与应用文中更出彩。句法：benefit from sth；do wonders for sth。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·大有裨益/产生奇效（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: do wonders for = work wonders for = work miracles for = do sb/sth a world of good = benefit sb greatly
advancedExpressions.example: A short holiday in the mountains did her a world of good, and the fresh air worked wonders for her frayed nerves. 山间短暂的假期让她大为受益，清新的空气对她紧绷的神经起了奇效。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·do wonders 高频搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: do wonders for sb/sth · do wonders to improve/boost sth · a smile/a kind word can do wonders
advancedExpressions.example: In my experience, a single kind word can do wonders for a discouraged classmate and do wonders to boost the whole class's morale. 依我的经验，一句善言就能对灰心的同学大有裨益，并极大提振全班的士气。

advancedExpressions.expression: a single ... did wonders for ..., and the very next ...
advancedExpressions.example: A single note of encouragement did wonders for his courage, and the very next day he raised his hand for the first time in years. （以小因引大果,配 the very next 强调转变之快）

advancedExpressions.expression: in my experience, ... can do wonders for ..., so I recommend ...
advancedExpressions.example: In my experience, keeping a gratitude journal can do wonders for a troubled mind, so I sincerely recommend that you give it a try. （现身说法 + do wonders + 建议句式,亲切有说服力）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., rather than ..., does wonders for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Encouragement, rather than punishment, does wonders for a child's willingness to learn, for confidence blossoms only where fear has been driven out. （rather than 对比 + for 引出论据,论证有力）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The teacher's kind words made her feel much better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The teacher's few kind words did wonders for her wounded spirit; where doubt had darkened her every step, hope now flickered, faint at first, then steady and bright. （读后续写·心理转变+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: do wonders 替换平淡的 make...better + 分号衔接 + where...从句对照今昔 + 光的意象递进(flickered, faint...then steady and bright)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise is good for your body and mind.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere physical routine, regular exercise does wonders for both body and mind, sharpening our focus by day and steadying our sleep by night. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being 先破后立开篇 + do wonders for both...and 强调双重益处 + 两个 by-短语平行(by day/by night)使论证工整有节奏

classPractice.question: Most people assume that regular exercise ____ ____ for both the body and the mind.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；do wonders for sth 对……大有裨益，主语第三人称单数用 does

classPractice.question: A good night's sleep can work wonders for a tired mind. → A good night's sleep can ____ ____ for a tired mind.
classPractice.note: do wonders = work wonders，可互换

classPractice.question: 老师一句鼓励的话对她受损的自信心起了奇效。A single word of encouragement from the teacher ____ ____ for her shattered confidence.
classPractice.note: do wonders for sth；叙述过去用 did

original_sentence: To start with, physical activity increases the efficiency of your heart and lungs.
readingExamples: To start with, physical activity increases the efficiency of your heart and lungs.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of the two organs inside your chest that fill with air when you breathe in and let it out when you breathe out
(2) n. (usually plural) the organs used for breathing, regarded as a measure of one's shouting or crying power
(3) n. (in compounds) a device or space that supplies fresh air, e.g. the green lungs of a city

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数，比喻）城市的“绿肺”；供氧的绿地
uncommonMeanings.example: The old citizens fought fiercely to save the riverside woods, for that patch of green was the last lung of a city choking on its own smoke. （议论文·城市环保·比喻）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数，喻嗓门）喊叫/哭喊的肺活量、嗓门——如 at the top of one's lungs 声嘶力竭
uncommonMeanings.example: "Well, at least there is nothing wrong with his lungs," his tired mother sighed as the toddler screamed. "起码他嗓门没毛病，"疲惫的母亲看着尖叫的幼儿叹道。

posExamples.sentence: As she sprinted the final hundred metres, her lungs burned like fire and every breath tore at her chest, yet the roar of the crowd pushed her legs onward until the tape snapped across her heaving body. （读后续写·运动会冲刺）

I am writing to remind every member that regular aerobic exercise strengthens the heart and lungs, so I sincerely hope you will join our morning-run club and breathe your way to a healthier campus life. （应用文·倡议书）

Medical research has repeatedly demonstrated that long-term exposure to polluted air damages the lungs, which is precisely why any responsible government must place clean-air policies at the very heart of its agenda. （议论文·环境与健康）
When the toddler let out a scream that filled the whole supermarket, his exhausted mother could only sigh, 'Well, at least there is nothing wrong with his lungs.' （读后续写·家庭生活·幽默）

wordForms.other: lung capacity（肺活量）；小贴士·lung 通常成对出现、多用复数 lungs（人有两片肺）；构词搭配·lung cancer 肺癌、lung disease 肺病、iron lung 铁肺（人工呼吸器）；习语 at the top of one's lungs 声嘶力竭。

idioms.idiom: at the top of one's lungs
idioms.translation: 扯着嗓子；用尽全力地（喊）
idioms.example: The moment the rescue helicopter appeared over the ridge, the stranded hikers waved their jackets and shouted at the top of their lungs, tears of relief streaming down their frozen faces. （读后续写·脱险呼救）

collocations.phrase: increase the efficiency of your heart and lungs
collocations.translation: 提高你的心肺效率（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: To start with, physical activity increases the efficiency of your heart and lungs. 首先，体育活动能提高你心肺的效率。（课文原句）
Sustained physical activity increases the efficiency of your heart and lungs. 持续的体育活动能提高你心肺的效率。

collocations.phrase: at the top of one's lungs
collocations.translation: 扯着嗓子；用尽全力地（喊）
collocations.example: The stranded hikers shouted at the top of their lungs. 被困的徒步者们扯着嗓子大喊。
Swimming steadily builds lung capacity while placing little strain on the joints. 游泳能稳步增大肺活量，同时几乎不给关节增加负担。
Decades of smoking left the old miner with a chronic lung disease. 数十年的吸烟让老矿工患上了慢性肺病。
Reaching the summit at dawn, she filled her lungs with the crisp air. 黎明登顶时，她把清冽的空气吸满肺腔。

collocations.phrase: gasp for air / breath (into the lungs)
collocations.example: He surfaced at last, gasping as his lungs dragged in air. 他终于浮出水面，肺部拼命吸气，大口喘着。

collocations.phrase: the green lungs of a city
collocations.example: Urban planners regard parks as the green lungs of a city. 城市规划者把公园视作城市的绿肺。

collocations.phrase: collapse a lung / a collapsed lung
collocations.example: The doctors explained that the accident had collapsed one of his lungs, and he would need weeks of rest before returning to the pitch. 医生解释说事故使他一侧肺萎陷，重返赛场前他需要休养数周。

synonyms.example: She took a deep breath to steady her racing heart. 她深吸一口气，让狂跳的心平静下来。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：breath 指"呼吸的动作或一口气"，是可数的行为；lung 是进行呼吸的器官本身。搭配：take a deep breath / out of breath；描写紧张、平复情绪多用 breath。

synonyms.example: The textbook illustrates how respiration in the lungs exchanges oxygen for carbon dioxide. 课本图解了肺部的呼吸作用如何用氧气交换二氧化碳。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：respiration 是正式、书面的"呼吸作用"，多见于生物、医学语境；日常口语和记叙文几乎不用，普通场景用 breathe/breath 即可。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·lung 高频搭配与习语
advancedExpressions.expression: heart and lungs 心肺 · lung capacity 肺活量 · at the top of one's lungs 声嘶力竭 · fill one's lungs with 吸满 · the green lungs of a city 城市绿肺
advancedExpressions.example: Standing on the summit, he filled his lungs with mountain air and, at the top of his lungs, shouted his joy across the valley. 站在山巅，他把山间的空气吸满肺腔，扯着嗓子朝山谷喊出满心的喜悦。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·声嘶力竭地喊（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: shout at the top of one's lungs = shout/scream at the top of one's voice = yell one's head off
advancedExpressions.example: The fans screamed at the top of their voices as their team scored in the final minute. 球迷们扯着嗓子尖叫，因为球队在最后一分钟破门。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. filled one's lungs with ... and felt ...
advancedExpressions.example: He filled his lungs with the salty sea breeze and felt, for the first time in months, utterly, wonderfully free. （感官动词+情感落点，续写放松/释然的收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: not only does ... strengthen the heart and lungs, but it also ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not only does daily jogging strengthen the heart and lungs, but it also clears the mind and lifts the spirits — reason enough for all of us to lace up our shoes. （倒装强调+双重益处，倡议信论点）

advancedExpressions.expression: regard ... as the lungs of ..., without which ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must regard our forests as the lungs of the planet, without which no economic growth, however dazzling, can ever be sustained. （比喻+without which定语从句，环保论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She ran hard and could not breathe well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She drove her legs forward with everything she had left, her lungs screaming for air and her heart hammering against her ribs, yet she refused to slow — the finish line was too close now to surrender. （读后续写·极限冲刺）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化器官描写(lungs screaming, heart hammering) + 连续动作短语 + 破折号补充心理，把“跑得喘不上气”升级为有画面、有意志力的冲刺场景

sentenceUpgrade.original: Trees are good for a city's air.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The sprawling woodland on the city's edge serves as its green lungs, silently filtering the air that millions breathe and reminding us that true prosperity can never be measured in concrete alone. （议论文·环保）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 比喻(green lungs) + serve as正式谓语 + 现在分词状语(filtering, reminding)延伸 + 尾句升华价值观

classPractice.question: Regular physical activity increases the efficiency of your heart and ____ (lung).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；人有两片肺，与 heart 并列时用复数 lungs

classPractice.question: The lost child stood in the crowded station and cried for his mother at the top of his ____.
classPractice.note: at the top of one's lungs 声嘶力竭地（喊）；固定用复数

classPractice.question: 游泳能稳步增大肺活量。Swimming steadily builds your ____ ____.
classPractice.note: lung capacity 肺活量；lung 作定语用单数

original_sentence: This extra effort makes them grow stronger over the long term.
readingExamples: This extra effort makes them grow stronger over the long term.
Habits like these put stress on the body, and if they are maintained over the long term, can become a serious health risk.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. over a long period of time; when considered across an extended future period rather than the immediate present
(2) phr. in the long run; taking into account eventual rather than short-term effects
(3) phr. (contrasted with over the short term) referring to results, benefits or risks that only become clear after considerable time

posExamples.sentence: As the weeks of patient practice piled up, the notes that had once tangled under her fingers began to flow, and she understood at last that talent counts for little over the long term without quiet, stubborn discipline. （读后续写·坚持练琴）
I would like to assure all members that although recycling may seem troublesome at first, the habit will benefit both our campus and the planet over the long term. （应用文·倡议书）
Cramming may boost a single test score, but over the long term it is genuine curiosity, not last-minute panic, that shapes a truly educated mind. （议论文·学习方法）

The extra effort you invest in your muscles each day may go unnoticed at first, yet it makes them grow stronger over the long term, rewarding your persistence in ways you cannot immediately see. （读后续写·励志成长）

collocations.phrase: grow stronger over the long term
collocations.translation: 长期来看变得更强（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: This extra effort makes them grow stronger over the long term. 这份额外的付出让它们长期来看变得更强壮。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: maintain sth over the long term
collocations.translation: 长期保持某事（课文词块）
collocations.example: Habits like these put stress on the body, and if they are maintained over the long term, can become a serious health risk. 这类习惯会给身体带来压力，若长期维持，可能成为严重的健康隐患。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: benefit sb. over the long term
collocations.example: Reading widely will benefit you over the long term. 广泛阅读长期来看会让你受益。
Over the long term, a balanced diet will do more for your health than any supplement. 长远来看，均衡饮食对健康的作用胜过任何补品。
A study plan that leaves no time for rest is rarely sustainable over the long term. 一份不留休息时间的学习计划很难长期坚持下去。

collocations.phrase: pay off over the long term
collocations.example: The countless dawns she spent training finally paid off over the long term. 她耗费的无数清晨训练，长期来看终于有了回报。

synonyms.example: It may be tempting to take shortcuts, but in the long run, honesty always wins trust. 走捷径或许诱人，但长远来看，诚实总能赢得信任。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：in the long run 更口语、更常用，强调"最终结果"；over the long term 稍正式，常见于健康、经济、规划类书面语。多数场合可互换。

synonyms.example: Cutting the education budget might save money today, but in the long term it will cost dearly. 削减教育经费今天或许省钱，但长期来看代价高昂。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：in the long term 与 over the long term 意义几乎相同，介词 in 更常见于英式书面语；over 略带"贯穿整段时间"的过程感。反义均为 in/over the short term。

synonyms.example: She rewrote the essay six times, and eventually produced her finest piece. 她把文章改了六遍，最终写出了她最好的作品。
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：eventually 指"经过一段过程后终于发生"，落在"某一时刻"；over the long term 强调"贯穿长期"的整体趋势，不指某个具体时点。句法：eventually 作副词，位置灵活。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·over the long term vs in the short term
advancedExpressions.expression: over the long term 长期来看 ↔ in/over the short term 短期来看（常成对对比出现）
advancedExpressions.example: In the short term the diet felt harsh, but over the long term it reshaped both her body and her discipline. 短期来看这种饮食很苦，但长期来看它重塑了她的身体，也重塑了她的自律。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·长远来看（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: over the long term = in the long term = in the long run = over time = down the road
advancedExpressions.example: Small daily savings may seem trivial, but over time they add up to real financial freedom. 每天一点点的节省看似微不足道，但随时间累积终将换来真正的财务自由。

advancedExpressions.expression: what seemed ... at first would, over the long term, prove ...
advancedExpressions.example: What seemed a pointless routine at first would, over the long term, prove the very foundation on which her dreams were built. （对比转折+插入状语，续写点题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: though ... may seem ... now, it will pay off over the long term
advancedExpressions.example: Though setting aside twenty minutes for exercise may seem a burden now, I assure you it will pay off over the long term in energy and focus. （让步+承诺句式，建议信说服读者）

advancedExpressions.expression: over the long term, it is ... rather than ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Over the long term, it is steady perseverance rather than fleeting inspiration that separates the accomplished from the merely gifted. （强调句it is...that + rather than对比，议论文核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: If you keep exercising, your body will get stronger.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Each drop of sweat may feel wasted in the moment, but this quiet, unglamorous effort is exactly what makes the body grow stronger over the long term, rewarding those patient enough to wait. （读后续写·励志）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步铺垫(may feel wasted) + this...effort指代衔接 + over the long term时间状语 + 现在分词收尾(rewarding)升华主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Saving energy is good for the earth.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While switching off a single light seems trivial, such small acts, multiplied across millions of households and sustained over the long term, hold the power to reshape the future of our planet. （议论文·环保）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步状语从句(While...) + 后置分词(multiplied, sustained)扩展 + hold the power to升级谓语 + 小切口引大主题的论证逻辑

classPractice.question: 这份额外的努力让它们长期来看变得更强壮。This extra effort makes them grow stronger ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；over the long term 长期来看

classPractice.question: 填入 short 或 long：Cramming may help ____ the short term, but real understanding only grows over the ____ term.
classPractice.note: in the short term 短期↔over the long term 长期，成对对比

classPractice.question: In the long run, perseverance matters more than talent. → ____ ____ ____ ____, perseverance matters more than talent.
classPractice.note: in the long run = over the long term，长远来看

original_sentence: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases.
readingExamples: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases.
However, some people assume that if some exercise is good, more is always better, so they tend to exercise for a long time without stopping.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to be likely to do or happen in a particular way; to regularly behave in a certain manner
(2) v. to take care of someone or something; to look after and attend to
(3) v. (tend towards sth) to be more likely to have or develop a particular quality
(4) v. (tend to sb.) to give one's attention to and deal with a person's needs

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 照料；照看；护理
uncommonMeanings.example: Every evening the old shepherd climbed the misty hillside to tend his flock, murmuring to the lambs as though they were the grandchildren he had never had. （读后续写·孤独老人·温情）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 照看（生意/机器/病人）；守着
uncommonMeanings.example: For thirty years she had tended the little corner shop, and its worn wooden counter still bore the marks of every coin her patient hands had counted. （读后续写·小店岁月）

posExamples.sentence: Whenever the classroom fell silent before an exam, she tended to bite the end of her pen — a small, unconscious habit that betrayed just how anxious the confident-looking girl really was. （读后续写·人物刻画）
I have noticed that many classmates tend to skip breakfast before morning classes, so I am writing to suggest that our canteen open half an hour earlier. （应用文·建议信）

Research shows that active people tend to have stronger immune systems and lower rates of disease, which powerfully suggests that regular exercise is one of the wisest investments we can make in ourselves. （议论文·健康论证）
Kneeling in the mud, she gently tended the wounded bird, cupping her hands around its trembling body until its frantic heartbeat slowed against her palms. （读后续写·救助动物）

wordForms.other: 构词提示：动词 tend + 名词后缀 -ency → tendency（倾向）；attend（v. 照料，出席）; a tendency to do sth 有做某事的倾向

collocations.translation: 【课件】常常会做某事，往往会做某事（= be more likely to do sth）
collocations.example: Readers also tend to share articles that are exciting or funny. 读者们也往往分享让人激动或有趣的文章。（课件 Reading·填空原题）
His views tend towards the extreme. 他的观点趋于偏激。（课件 Reading）
Ambulance crews were tending (to) the injured. 救护车上的救护人员在照料受伤者。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】精心照料的花园（tend 照料义的过去分词作定语）
collocations.example: Neat hedges and well-tended gardens lined the quiet street. 修剪整齐的树篱和精心照料的花园排列在静谧的街道两旁。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 往往拥有（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems. （课文原句：运动者往往免疫力更好）
Some people assume more exercise is always better, so they tend to work out for hours. （议论文·常见误区）
Students who plan their revision tend to be far calmer in the exam hall. （议论文·学习方法）
As the debate wore on, his tone tended towards impatience. （读后续写·情绪变化）

collocations.translation: 照料某人；照顾某人的需求（熟词僻义）
collocations.example: Throughout the night, the young nurse tended to the wounded soldiers. （读后续写·战地救护）
The old doctor patiently tended the sick, staying by their beds until dawn. （读后续写·仁心）
Retirement suited him; he spent his mornings tending the garden. （读后续写·晚年生活）

collocations.phrase: tend a shop / a machine / a fire
collocations.example: The old innkeeper tended the fire late into the night. （读后续写·旅店）
A good teacher must patiently tend to the needs of every student, not merely lecture to the brightest few. （议论文·教育）

synonyms.example: When criticised, he was inclined to fall silent rather than argue, a quiet dignity that his classmates gradually came to respect. （读后续写·性格）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：be inclined to 更强调“个人主观意愿/性情上的倾向”，略正式；tend to 更中性，可指人也可指事物的“客观规律性倾向”，用途更广。

synonyms.example: Tired and hungry, travellers are apt to make careless mistakes, so always double-check your belongings before leaving. （应用文·出行提示）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：be apt to 常暗示“容易出现（不好的）情况”，带轻微警示意味；tend to 中性得多，不必然含贬义。

synonyms.example: While their parents worked abroad, the eldest sister looked after the two younger children with a maturity far beyond her years. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：表“照料”义时，look after 是最口语、最常用的说法；tend（照料）偏书面、略古雅，多用于照看牲畜、庄稼、病人或店铺等具体对象。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·tend 三义与 tendency（课件归纳/拓展）
advancedExpressions.expression: tend to do sth 常常会做/往往会做 · tend to / towards sth 趋向,倾向 · tend (to) sb/sth (= look after) 照顾,照料 · 【拓展】tendency n. 倾向,趋势：have a tendency to do sth / have a tendency to (towards) sth
advancedExpressions.example: Active people tend to have stronger immune systems, and anyone who tends to overtrain has a tendency towards injury. 爱运动的人往往免疫力更强，而任何倾向于过度训练的人都有受伤的倾向。（课件三义 + tendency 派生）

advancedExpressions.expression: tend to do sth / tend to be / tend towards sth / tend to sb.（照料）
advancedExpressions.example: Active people tend to have stronger immune systems, while a good nurse also knows how to tend to every patient's needs. （一句串起"倾向于"与"照料"两义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示"倾向于"
advancedExpressions.expression: tend to do = be inclined to do = be apt to do = be prone to do = have a tendency to do
advancedExpressions.example: Tired students tend to / are inclined to / are apt to skip breakfast, which harms their focus. （四种表"往往会"的可替换说法）

advancedExpressions.expression: tend (v.) → tendency (n.) 倾向；后接 to do / towards sth
advancedExpressions.example: He has a tendency to underestimate himself, a tendency that holds him back. （tend 的名词形式，注意搭配 a tendency to do）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. tended to ..., a habit that betrayed ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whenever nervous, he tended to tap his foot beneath the desk, a small habit that betrayed the storm behind his calm face. （tend to+同位语揭示内心，续写刻画人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: since many of us tend to ..., I would suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Since many of us tend to stare at screens late into the night, I would strongly suggest a device-free hour before bed. （tend to描述普遍现象+建议，建议信过渡自然）

advancedExpressions.expression: research shows that those who ... tend to ..., which suggests ...

translation: 有免疫力的；不受影响的
original_sentence: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases.
readingExamples: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. protected against a particular disease by particular substances in the blood; unable to be affected by an illness
(2) adj. not affected or influenced by something; safe from something unpleasant
(3) adj. (immune from sth) protected from a duty, punishment or unpleasant consequence; exempt
(4) adj. relating to the body's immune system

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不受（批评/影响/诱惑等）影响的；无动于衷的
uncommonMeanings.example: Years of harsh reviews had not made him immune to criticism; each unkind word still lodged in his heart like a thorn he could never quite remove. （读后续写·艺术家的敏感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （immune from）免受……的；被豁免的
uncommonMeanings.example: No one, however powerful, should be immune from the law, for justice loses all meaning the moment it bows to rank and wealth. （议论文·法治·公平）

posExamples.sentence: As the whole class dissolved into laughter at the clumsy prank, she alone remained immune to the joke, her tight-lipped silence hinting that something was troubling her deeply. （读后续写·情绪反差）
I am writing to remind fellow students that no one is immune to the harm of staying up late, and I therefore urge everyone to make sufficient sleep a firm priority. （应用文·倡议书）

It has been well established that physically active people tend to have more immune systems and are therefore at lower risk of disease, a fact that alone should convince us to exercise regularly. （议论文·健康论证）
However rich a nation becomes, it is never entirely immune from economic storms, which is precisely why prudence and preparation must never be abandoned in times of plenty. （议论文·经济与远见）

wordForms.noun: immunity（免疫力；豁免）; immunisation（免疫接种）
wordForms.adjective: immune（有免疫力的；不受影响的）
wordForms.other: 构词提示：immune (adj.) → immunity (n.) → immunise (v.)；固定短语 the immune system（免疫系统）; be immune to sth（对…免疫/不受影响）; be immune from sth（免于…）

collocations.translation: 免疫系统（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems. （课文原句：运动者往往免疫系统更好）
Once you have had chickenpox, your body is usually immune to it for life. （应用文·健康知识）
The whistle-blower was promised she would be immune from any punishment. （议论文·正义）

collocations.translation: 不受批评/压力/诱惑影响
collocations.example: The wise leader was not immune to criticism, yet she listened to every complaint patiently. （读后续写·领袖气度）
Vaccines work by triggering an immune response, teaching the body to fight a disease. （议论文·科普说明）
A balanced diet rich in vitamins can strengthen your immunity. （应用文·健康建议）
No one is immune to the pull of a comfortable sofa, but those who resist are rewarded. （议论文·自律）

synonyms.example: Years of hardship had made the old fisherman resistant to fear; the wildest storm could no longer shake the calm in his weathered eyes. （读后续写·坚韧）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：resistant 强调“主动抵抗、不易被攻破”，可指材料、细菌、人；immune 强调“完全不受影响、天生/获得的免疫”，程度更彻底。

synonyms.example: Students who won first prize were exempt from the final examination, a reward that spurred everyone to try their hardest. （应用文·规则说明）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：exempt 侧重“正式免除某项义务/规定”（如考试、纳税、兵役），是制度性豁免；immune from 也可表豁免，但更强调“不受伤害或惩罚的影响”。

synonyms.translation: 不受影响的；无动于衷的
synonyms.example: Amid the panic sweeping the trading floor, he alone stood unaffected, his steady gaze fixed on the numbers as though the chaos simply did not exist. （读后续写·镇定）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：unaffected 是最普通的“不受影响”，中性且范围广；immune (to) 带“天生/获得的、彻底的抵抗力”之意，比喻用法更有力度。

advancedExpressions.expression: the immune system / be immune to sth / be immune from sth / immune response
advancedExpressions.example: A strong immune system makes you immune to many viruses, though no one is immune from the effects of a sleepless night. （一句串起 immune 的核心搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示"不受影响的"
advancedExpressions.expression: be immune to = be unaffected by = be resistant to = be untouched by
advancedExpressions.example: She remained immune to / unaffected by / resistant to the gossip, letting every cruel word slide off her. （三种表"不受…影响"的可替换说法）

advancedExpressions.expression: immune (adj.) → immunity (n.) 免疫力/豁免权 → immunise (v.) 使免疫
advancedExpressions.example: Exercise builds immunity, immunising us against many common illnesses. （immune 的名词与动词形式）

advancedExpressions.expression: years of ... had not made sb. immune to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Years of applause had not made her immune to stage fright; her hands still trembled as the curtain rose. （否定+immune to揭示人物脆弱面，续写立体刻画）

advancedExpressions.expression: no one is immune to ..., so it is vital that ...
advancedExpressions.example: No one is immune to the dangers of a sedentary lifestyle, so it is vital that we build movement into every ordinary day. （no one is immune to普遍化+倡议）

advancedExpressions.expression: however ..., sb./sth. is never entirely immune from ...
advancedExpressions.example: However advanced our technology grows, human society is never entirely immune from the consequences of neglecting nature. （让步+never entirely immune from，辩证论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: People who exercise get sick less often.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It has been repeatedly proven that active people tend to develop stronger immune systems and thus fall ill far less often — a quiet reward that a single hour of daily movement can bring. （议论文·健康）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 被动客观句(It has been proven) + tend to+stronger immune systems学术表达 + 破折号引出评论 + a quiet reward拟人化收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: She did not care about what others said.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She had trained herself, over many bruising years, to remain immune to the whispers behind her back, letting each cruel remark slide off her like rain off a polished stone. （读后续写·坚强）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: immune to比喻用法 + over many bruising years插入状语交代成因 + 现在分词状语(letting) + 明喻(like rain off a stone)增强画面

classPractice.note: 考点：be immune to sth=对…有免疫力/不受…影响；表"免于惩罚/义务"才用 immune from。

classPractice.question: A balanced diet and regular exercise can greatly strengthen one's ____ (immune), helping the body fight off disease.
classPractice.note: 考点：形容词 immune → 名词 immunity（免疫力），此处作 strengthen 的宾语需名词。

classPractice.answer: No one is immune to the harm of staying up late.

original_sentence: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases.
readingExamples: It has also been proven that active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an illness affecting humans, animals or plants, often caused by infection, that has a specific set of symptoms
(2) n. (medical) a particular named disorder of the body or mind with characteristic causes and effects
(3) n. (figurative) something regarded as a harmful or corrupting condition in society, thought or behaviour

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）社会/精神上的“病症”、恶习、弊端
uncommonMeanings.example: Indifference, he argued, is a disease more dangerous than any virus, for it quietly kills a society's conscience while leaving its body untouched. （议论文·社会批判·比喻）

posExamples.sentence: When the doctor finally named the rare disease that had drained the colour from her father's face, the whole family fell into a silence so heavy that even the ticking clock seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·家庭变故）
I am writing to invite you to our charity walk, whose proceeds will fund research into childhood diseases and bring hope to families who need it most. （应用文·邀请信）

It has been firmly established that physically active people tend to have stronger immune systems and are at lower risk of disease, which is reason enough to make exercise a lifelong habit. （议论文·健康论证）
Prevention, as every wise doctor knows, is always better than cure, for it is far easier to keep a disease away than to drive it out once it has taken hold. （议论文·预防胜于治疗）

wordForms.other: 构词提示：dis-（否定）+ ease（安逸）→ disease（不适 → 疾病）；disease-free（无病的）; heart disease（心脏病）。辨析：disease 侧重有明确病名/病因的具体疾病（可数），illness 侧重生病的状态（可轻可重），sickness 更口语、常指恶心/身体不适。

collocations.translation: （较低的）患病风险（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Active people tend to have better immune systems and are at lower risk of diseases. （课文原句：运动者患病风险更低）
Doctors warn that a diet high in salt and fat increases the danger of heart disease. （应用文·健康提醒）
Travelling through the flooded villages, she feared she might contract a disease. （读后续写·志愿者）
Vaccines have helped humanity prevent countless diseases that once wiped out communities. （议论文·科学进步）
Simple habits such as washing your hands can stop many diseases from spreading. （应用文·卫生倡议）
During the outbreak of the infectious disease, the whole town pulled together. （读后续写·患难与共）
Her grandmother had suffered from a chronic disease for years, yet greeted every morning with a smile. （读后续写·乐观）

synonyms.example: A sudden illness kept him in bed for a fortnight, but the get-well cards from his classmates warmed him more than any medicine. （读后续写·同学情）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：illness 泛指“生病、不适的状态”，强调主观感受，可轻可重；disease 多指“有明确名称、病因的具体疾病”，更医学、更客观。

synonyms.example: The doctor explained that his heart condition would require careful monitoring but need not stop him from living a full life. （应用文·就医说明）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：condition 委婉、正式，常指“需长期管理的慢性病症”（heart condition, skin condition），语气比 disease 柔和，不显严重可怕。

synonyms.example: Sleep disorders are increasingly common among students who scroll on their phones deep into the night. （议论文·作息）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：disorder 侧重“身体或心理机能的失调、紊乱”（如 eating disorder, sleep disorder），未必由感染引起；disease 更常指有病原、可传播的疾病。

advancedExpressions.expression: at risk of disease / catch (contract) a disease / prevent (cure) a disease / suffer from a disease
advancedExpressions.example: Those who exercise are at lower risk of disease and less likely to catch the diseases that plague the inactive. （一句串起 disease 的核心搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示"疾病"（辨析枚举）
advancedExpressions.expression: disease（具体病名/病因）≈ illness（生病状态）≈ sickness（口语·不适）≈ condition（婉指慢性病）≈ disorder（机能失调）
advancedExpressions.example: He was diagnosed with a heart disease, but for weeks he had simply called it a mild illness. （据语境在 disease/illness 等中择词）

advancedExpressions.expression: disease (n.) → diseased (adj.) 患病的；dis-（否定）+ ease（安逸）的构词理据
advancedExpressions.example: The vet gently removed the diseased branch of the old orchard to save the healthy trees. （disease 的形容词形式）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... disease had ..., and ...
advancedExpressions.example: The relentless disease had stolen the strength from his once-powerful hands, yet it could never touch the light in his eyes. （拟人disease had stolen+转折yet，续写渲染坚韧）

advancedExpressions.expression: to raise awareness of / funds for ... disease, we sincerely invite ...
advancedExpressions.example: To raise funds for research into childhood diseases, we sincerely invite you to join our weekend charity run. （不定式目的状语+invite，邀请/倡议信标准开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as ... prevents disease of the body, ... guards against the diseases of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as exercise prevents diseases of the body, wide reading guards against the diseases of a narrow and prejudiced mind. （类比+disease比喻用法，议论文升华论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Her grandfather was very ill and the family was sad.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The doctor's quiet diagnosis of the disease fell over the family like a shadow, and for a long moment no one dared to speak, as if silence alone could hold the dreaded word at bay. （读后续写·家庭）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: diagnosis of the disease专业措辞 + 明喻(like a shadow) + as if虚拟延伸心理 + 环境化的沉默描写增强张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise helps people avoid diseases.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beyond building a stronger heart and lungs, regular exercise lowers the risk of countless diseases, offering us a form of protection that no pill on any pharmacy shelf can rival. （议论文·健康）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Beyond doing介词状语拉开层次 + lowers the risk of diseases学术表达 + 现在分词状语(offering) + no pill...can rival对比升华价值

classPractice.question: 研究证明，好动的人患病风险更低。Studies prove that active people are ____ ____ ____ ____ disease.
classPractice.note: 考点：be at (lower) risk of disease "处于（较低的）患病风险"，源自课文原句词块。

classPractice.question: 选 disease / illness：The doctor finally named the rare heart ____ that had troubled him for years.
classPractice.note: 考点：有明确病名/病因的具体疾病用 disease；泛指"生病的状态"才用 illness。

classPractice.question: Regular hand-washing can effectively stop many diseases from ____ (传播) through a crowded school.
classPractice.note: 考点：stop sth from doing；disease 常搭配 spread/transmit（传播），此处用动名词 spreading。

original_sentence: Moreover, exercise is good for your mental health.
readingExamples: Moreover, exercise is good for your mental health.
Moreover, it will ensure that the exercise you do has a positive effect on your physical health.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. (formal) used to add a further, often more important, point to something that has just been said; in addition; besides
(2) adv. used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce supporting information that reinforces a previous statement or argument

posExamples.sentence: The old house was cold and damp; moreover, every creak of its ancient stairs seemed to whisper warnings that made the children huddle closer together in the dark. （读后续写·悬疑氛围）
Our proposed reading club would enrich students' free time; moreover, it would cost the school almost nothing, since the books can be donated by graduates and parents. （应用文·建议信）
Exercise strengthens the body and sharpens the mind; moreover, it teaches the discipline and resilience that no textbook could ever hope to instil. （议论文·运动价值）
Moreover, choosing an activity you truly enjoy will ensure that the exercise you do has a lasting, positive effect on your physical and mental health. （议论文·健康建议）

wordForms.other: 构词提示：more（更多）+ over（超出）→ moreover（更进一层，此外）。用法：只作副词，多置于句首并用逗号隔开，引出"更重要的补充"；正式书面，议论文/应用文的递进衔接词。

collocations.translation: 此外；而且（引出更重要的一点，课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Moreover, exercise is good for your mental health. （课文原句：而且，锻炼有益心理健康）
Moreover, it will ensure that the exercise you do has a positive effect on your physical health. （应用文·健身建议·仿写）
The plan is affordable, and moreover, it can be launched within a single week. （应用文·方案说明）
Moreover, there is growing evidence that green spaces reduce stress in students. （议论文·环境与心理）
Moreover, not only does the programme raise money, but it also brings the community together. （应用文·活动总结）

synonyms.example: The new library extends its opening hours until ten; furthermore, it now offers a quiet zone reserved entirely for exam revision. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：furthermore 与 moreover 几乎完全同义，都用于书面递进补充；furthermore 略更正式、更强调“进一步、更进一层”，议论文里可与 moreover 交替使用避免重复。

synonyms.example: In addition to raising funds, the charity concert gave shy students a rare chance to shine on stage. （应用文·活动介绍）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in addition 更中性、更常用，可加 to sth 构成短语（in addition to）；moreover 只作副词、放句首，语气更“郑重地补充一个重要论点”。

synonyms.example: I don't want to go out in this storm; besides, I still have a mountain of homework to finish. （读后续写·日常对话）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：besides 偏口语，常用于对话中补充一个“额外理由”，语气随意；moreover 正式、书面，适合议论文和应用文的严谨递进。

advancedExpressions.expression: Moreover, ... / and moreover, ... / Moreover, not only ... but also ...
advancedExpressions.example: The idea costs almost nothing; moreover, not only does it help students, but it also relieves the teachers. （moreover 引出更有分量的补充论据）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·递进衔接（只枚举可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: moreover = furthermore = in addition = what's more = besides = on top of that = additionally
advancedExpressions.example: Exercise strengthens the body; moreover / furthermore / in addition / what's more / besides, it lifts the mood. （七种表"此外/而且"的递进衔接词，可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: more + over → moreover（在原有基础上"更进一步"）；对照 however / whatever / whenever 的合成规律
advancedExpressions.example: The task is simple; moreover, it is enjoyable. （理解 moreover 的构词有助记忆同类衔接副词）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., moreover, every ... seemed to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The forest was silent; moreover, every shadow seemed to shift the moment she turned her head. （分号+moreover层层加码，续写堆叠悬疑气氛）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., moreover, it would ..., which makes it an ideal choice
advancedExpressions.example: The scheme is easy to run; moreover, it would benefit every year group, which makes it an ideal choice for our school. （moreover递进+which makes定语从句收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: not only ...; moreover, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Reading not only broadens the mind; moreover, it cultivates the empathy that binds a society together. （not only与moreover配合，议论文双论据递进升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The house was old and it also made scary noises.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The house was old and forbidding; moreover, its warped floorboards groaned with every cautious step, as though the building itself resented the intrusion of the living. （读后续写·悬疑）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号连接两句 + moreover正式递进 + 拟人(the building resented) + as though虚拟从句渲染阴森氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise makes you healthy. It also makes you happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Regular exercise fortifies the body against disease; moreover, it releases the tension of a demanding day, leaving the mind clearer and the spirit lighter. （议论文·健康）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号+moreover连接双重益处 + fortifies against disease学术措辞 + 现在分词状语(leaving) + 形容词比较级收尾(clearer, lighter)升华

classPractice.question: 从 moreover / however 中选填：Exercise builds physical strength. ____, it is good for your mental health.
classPractice.note: 考点：前后为同向递进（都是好处）用 moreover "此外/而且"；若为转折才用 however。

classPractice.question: 用 furthermore 替换保持句意：Exercise strengthens the body; moreover, it releases the day's tension. → Exercise strengthens the body; ____, it releases the day's tension.
classPractice.note: 考点：moreover 与 furthermore 同为正式递进衔接词，可互换以避免重复。

classPractice.answer: Moreover, exercise is good for your mental health. / Moreover, exercise benefits your mental health.
