original_sentence: Working out can help you reduce stress and get over negative feelings.
readingExamples: Working out can help you reduce stress and get over negative feelings.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to make something smaller or less in amount, size, degree or number
(2) v. to force someone or something into a specified worse or weaker state or condition
(3) v. to boil a liquid such as a sauce so that it becomes thicker and more concentrated (in cooking)
(4) v. to change a substance to a simpler or more basic form; (in maths) to simplify an expression or fraction

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使沦落到（某种更糟的状态）；使陷入（贫困、泪水等）
uncommonMeanings.example: One heartless remark was enough to reduce the confident girl to tears, and she fled the classroom before anyone could see her trembling shoulders. （读后续写·校园·情感崩溃）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （烹饪）把（汤汁）熬浓、收干
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandma stirred the broth patiently, reducing it over a low flame until the whole kitchen filled with a fragrance that meant home. （读后续写·亲情·厨房记忆）

posExamples.sentence: After weeks of anxious revision, Tom finally discovered that a morning run could reduce the pressure gnawing at him, and he stepped into each exam calmer than ever before. （读后续写·备考·心理疏解）
I am writing to suggest that our school reduce the use of disposable plastic in the canteen, as this small change would greatly lessen the waste we leave behind each day. （应用文·建议信·环保）
Cutting down on screen time will not, by itself, reduce a student's stress; only when we address the real fear of failure behind that stress can genuine relief begin. （议论文·健康与心理·驳论）
Regular aerobic exercise reduces the risk of heart disease and, just as importantly, chases away the low moods that so often shadow a demanding term. （议论文·运动与健康·因果论证）

wordForms.noun: reduction（减少，降低）; reducer（还原剂；缩减装置）
wordForms.adjective: reduced（减少的，降价的）; reducible（可减少的，可简化的）; reductive（简化的，还原的）
wordForms.other: 构词提示：reduce (v.) → reduction (n.)，注意拼写 -duce → -duction（对照 produce→production, introduce→introduction）；固定短语 be reduced to doing sth（沦落到做某事）; reduce sb to tears（使某人落泪）; a reduction in sth（…的下降）

idioms.idiom: reduce sb to tears / silence / despair
idioms.translation: 使某人落泪／沉默／陷入绝望
idioms.example: The dying soldier's last letter, read aloud in the crowded hall, reduced even the sternest officers to silence. （读后续写·战争·情感高潮）

idioms.idiom: reduce sth to ashes / ruins / rubble
idioms.example: In a single night the fire reduced the old library to ashes, yet the townsfolk vowed to rebuild it stone by stone. （读后续写·灾难·坚韧重建）
Once a respected merchant, he was now reduced to begging at the very gate where he had once given alms. （读后续写·命运反转·人物落魄）

collocations.example: Working out can help you reduce stress and get over negative feelings. 健身有助于你减轻压力、克服负面情绪。（课件 Reading·课文原句）
Giving up smoking reduces the risk of heart disease. 戒烟会降低患心脏病的风险。（课件 Reading）
The number of employees was reduced from 40 to 25. 雇员人数从 40 人减少到了 25 人。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】沦落到（做）某事；陷入更坏的境地
collocations.example: They were reduced to begging in the streets. 他们沦落到沿街乞讨。（课件 Reading）
She was reduced to tears by their criticisms. 他们的批评使她流下了眼泪。（课件 Reading）

collocations.phrase: a reduction from ... to ... / a reduction in sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】（数量的）从……到……的下降；……的减少（reduction n.）
collocations.example: There is a reduction from 40 to 25 in the number of employees. 雇员人数出现了从 40 到 25 的下降。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 【课件】减少；（价格上的）优惠、打折
collocations.example: There are reductions for children sharing a room with two adults. 孩子和两个大人合住一间房可以打折。（课件 Reading）

collocations.translation: 减轻压力（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Working out can help you reduce stress and get over negative feelings. （课文原句：健身有助于减压）
Doctors agree that a balanced diet reduces the risk of countless illnesses. （议论文·健康生活）

collocations.translation: 把……减少了（by）／减少到（to）某数值
collocations.example: The new energy-saving lamps reduced the school's electricity bill by nearly a third. （应用文·调查报告）
Wearing a helmet significantly reduces the chance of serious injury. （议论文·安全意识）

collocations.phrase: reduce the number / amount of sth
collocations.example: By cycling to school, we can each reduce the amount of carbon we send into the air. （应用文·环保）
Simple habits, such as reusing paper, can reduce waste far more than most of us imagine. （议论文·可持续生活）
The volunteers found clever ways to reduce costs without lowering quality. （应用文·活动方案）
Ten minutes of deep breathing before bed can noticeably reduce the anxiety that keeps so many students staring at the ceiling at midnight. （应用文·健康建议·倡议）
Rather than starving herself, she chose to reduce weight the healthy way, pairing steady jogging with sensible meals. （读后续写·健康·自律成长）

synonyms.example: As the volunteers worked on, the mountain of litter on the beach steadily decreased until the golden sand shone once more. （读后续写·公益·渐进变化）
synonyms.usage: decrease 多指数量或程度自然、渐进地下降，可及物也可不及物；reduce 更强调"人为使之变小"，主动性、目的性更强

synonyms.example: Please lower your voice, she whispered, glancing anxiously at the sleeping baby in the next room. （读后续写·细节·紧张氛围）
synonyms.usage: lower 侧重降低某个"水平／高度／声音"，具体可感；reduce 泛指减少数量或程度，用法更广、更抽象

synonyms.example: The doctor advised him to cut down on salt and late nights if he truly wished to see his grandchildren grow up. （应用文·健康建议·口语化）
synonyms.usage: cut down (on) 为口语短语动词，多指减少某种习惯性的消耗（吃、花、抽等）；reduce 更正式、书面，适用范围更广

synonyms.example: Careful planning helped the organisers minimize the disruption caused by the sudden change of venue. （应用文·活动通知）
synonyms.usage: minimize 强调"降到最低限度"，程度上比 reduce 更极致，常用于风险、影响、损失等语境

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·reduce 核心搭配与熟词僻义（课件归纳）
advancedExpressions.expression: reduce / ease stress 减压 · reduce the risk of sth 降低…风险 · reduce sth from... to... 从…减到… · be reduced to (doing) sth 沦落到做某事 · be reduced to tears 落泪(被弄哭)
advancedExpressions.example: Regular exercise reduces stress and reduces the risk of disease, yet ruthless criticism can reduce even a strong person to tears. 规律运动减压又降低患病风险，但无情的批评却能把坚强的人也弄哭。（课件搭配 + be reduced to tears 僻义）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·reduction 的两大搭配（课件拓展）
advancedExpressions.expression: a reduction from ... to ... （…到…的下降）· a reduction in sth （…的减少）· reductions for sb （给…的优惠/折扣）
advancedExpressions.example: There is a reduction from 40 to 25 in the number of employees, a 37.5% reduction in the workforce. 雇员人数从 40 减到 25，员工总数减少了 37.5%。（课件 reduction 搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: reduce stress / reduce the risk of sth / reduce sth by (to) a figure / be reduced to doing sth / reduce sb to tears
advancedExpressions.example: Working out reduces stress and reduces the risk of disease, though overtraining can reduce even a strong athlete to exhaustion. （一句串起 reduce 的核心搭配与僻义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示"减少/降低"（只枚举可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: reduce = decrease = lower = cut down (on) = minimize = bring down
advancedExpressions.example: Exercise can reduce / decrease / lower / cut down / minimize the stress that weighs on students. （六种表"减少"的可替换说法）

advancedExpressions.expression: reduce (v.) → reduction (n.)；-duce 结尾的动词变名词多为 -duction（produce→production）
advancedExpressions.example: A steady reduction in screen time led to a real reduction in his anxiety. （reduce 的名词形式 reduction, a reduction in sth）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth. reduced sb. to ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: The crushing news reduced her to a trembling heap on the floor; yet somewhere deep within, a stubborn spark refused to be put out. （"先崩溃后重燃"的情感弧线，用 yet 制造转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: By doing ..., we can effectively reduce ... and thereby ...
advancedExpressions.example: By sorting our rubbish each day, we can effectively reduce the burden on the environment and thereby leave a cleaner city for those who come after us. （by 引导手段+thereby 引出意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is not ... that reduces ...; rather, it is ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the volume of homework that reduces genuine learning; rather, it is the fear of mistakes that quietly stifles a student's curiosity. （"否定表面原因+揭示深层原因"驳论结构）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise can reduce stress.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There is something almost magical in the way a long run melts away the day's tension: with every pounding step the knots inside slowly loosen, until the stress that once felt unbearable is quietly reduced to a distant hum. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There is something ... in the way 引出感悟 + with every ... 伴随状语渲染过程 + melt away／loosen 动词化比喻 + reduced to a distant hum 收束点明变化

translation: 常规，惯例；一套固定流程
original_sentence: When you plan an exercise routine, the first thing to consider is what you expect to improve: heart and lung efficiency, muscle strength or flexibility.
readingExamples: When you plan an exercise routine, the first thing to consider is what you expect to improve: heart and lung efficiency, muscle strength or flexibility.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the usual, regular and often fixed order and way in which you do things
(2) n. a set sequence of movements, steps or actions that form a performance, such as in dance, gymnastics or comedy
(3) adj. done or happening as a normal and regular part of a job or process; ordinary and not special
(4) n. a fixed set of instructions that performs a particular task within a computer program

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】乏味、单调的生活（不可数，= boredom；a break from routine 摆脱乏味）
uncommonMeanings.example: She needed a break from routine. 她需要摆脱乏味的生活。（PPT原句，此处 routine 不可数，意为“乏味”）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】日常的；例行的；乏味无聊的（routine enquiries / routine tasks / become routine）
uncommonMeanings.example: This type of work rapidly becomes routine. 这种工作很快就变得乏味无聊。（PPT原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （舞蹈、体操、喜剧等的）一套固定动作／表演程式
uncommonMeanings.example: The moment the music began, years of quiet practice took over, and she moved through the difficult routine as effortlessly as water flowing downhill. （读后续写·舞台·厚积薄发）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 例行的，常规的（不带感情、程序化的）
uncommonMeanings.example: What the nurse called a routine check-up turned, in a single heartbeat, into the most frightening afternoon of the old man's life. （读后续写·医院·平静被打破）

posExamples.sentence: Every morning before dawn, the old fisherman followed the same unhurried routine — mending his nets, brewing bitter tea, and greeting the sea as one greets an old, unpredictable friend. （读后续写·人物·质朴日常）
I would suggest that every member work out a simple daily routine of reading and exercise, so that the long summer holiday does not slip away unnoticed. （应用文·建议信·假期规划）
A well-planned routine is not a cage that traps our freedom; on the contrary, it is the quiet scaffolding upon which every great achievement is patiently built. （议论文·自律与成功·比喻论证）
It was during a routine inspection that the young engineer noticed the tiny crack others had overlooked — a moment of care that would later save a hundred lives. （读后续写·细节·平凡中的英雄）

wordForms.noun: routine（常规，惯例；一套固定流程）
wordForms.other: 构词提示：routine (n./adj.) → routinely (adv.)；同形词 routine 既作名词（惯例）又作形容词（例行的）。固定短语 daily routine（日常作息）; as a matter of routine（照惯例）; a routine check（例行检查）

idioms.translation: 养成（形成）一套固定的作息或做法
idioms.example: Within a fortnight the new boarding students had fallen into a comfortable routine, and homesickness began, at last, to loosen its grip. （读后续写·成长·适应新生活）

idioms.translation: 打破常规，改变一成不变的生活
idioms.example: Longing to break the dull routine of city life, the family packed their bags and set off for a village where time seemed to move more gently. （读后续写·转折·追寻新生活）
No matter how tired he felt, the marathon runner stuck to his training routine, believing that discipline mattered most on the days he least wanted it. （读后续写·励志·自律）

collocations.translation: 【课件】日常作息，每日惯例（Make exercise a part of your daily routine.）
collocations.example: Make exercise a part of your daily routine. 让健身成为你日常的一部分。（PPT原句）

collocations.phrase: get sb into a routine for (doing) sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】让某人养成……的规律（作息）
collocations.example: We are trying to get the baby into a routine for feeding and sleeping. 我们试着让婴儿按时进食和睡觉。（PPT原句）
We do the safety check as a matter of routine. 我们把这项安全检查作为例行公事定期进行。（PPT语境）

collocations.translation: 【课件】摆脱乏味的生活（此处 routine 不可数，= boredom）
collocations.example: She needed a break from routine. 她需要摆脱乏味的生活。（PPT原句，routine=boredom 乏味）

collocations.translation: 【课件】日常的询问／乏味例行的工作（routine 作形容词）
collocations.example: You mustn't worry. These are just routine enquiries. 你别担心，这些只是日常的询问。Routine tasks such as washing up also need to be done. 像洗碗这样乏味的例行事务也得做。（PPT原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】变得乏味无聊、一成不变
collocations.example: This type of work rapidly becomes routine. 这种工作很快就变得乏味无聊。（PPT原句，routine 作表语形容词）

collocations.translation: 一套锻炼计划／流程（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: When you plan an exercise routine, the first thing to consider is what you expect to improve. （课文原句：制定锻炼计划时首先要考虑…）
Building exercise into your daily routine is far easier than it sounds. （应用文·健康倡议）
A calming bedtime routine can do more for a restless mind than any sleeping pill. （议论文·健康作息）
The counsellor encouraged the anxious boy to establish a steady routine. （应用文·心理辅导）
The volunteers checked every lifebuoy on the beach as a matter of routine. （读后续写·伏笔）
When you plan an exercise routine, begin with what your body can honestly manage, then let it grow week by week. （应用文·健身指南·仿课文语境）

collocations.phrase: a change of routine / break from routine
collocations.translation: 换换生活方式，打破日常
collocations.example: A short trip to the countryside offered the exhausted teacher a welcome break from routine and a chance to rediscover why she once loved to teach. （读后续写·治愈·重拾初心）
What looked like a routine task quickly became a test of courage when the fire alarm suddenly shattered the calm. （读后续写·突发·紧张）
Reading a page of English aloud each morning has become such a natural part of my routine that a day without it feels strangely empty. （读后续写·习惯·自我成长）
Trapped in the same old routine, he began to wonder whether life held anything beyond timetables and to-do lists. （读后续写·迷茫·渴望改变）

synonyms.translation: 习惯（个人反复形成的行为）
synonyms.example: The habit of jotting down three good things each night gradually taught the pessimistic girl to notice the light in her own days. （读后续写·成长·积极心态）
synonyms.usage: habit 指个人下意识、反复养成的单个行为；routine 指一整套有先后顺序、成体系的固定安排，范围更大、更结构化

synonyms.example: Her packed schedule left no gap for rest, and only when she fainted at her desk did she finally admit that even ambition needs sleep. （读后续写·警示·过度劳累）
synonyms.usage: schedule 强调带具体时间点的"日程表／时间安排"，可临时调整；routine 强调惯常、重复的"做事流程与方式"，更稳定

synonyms.example: It is common practice in our school to greet teachers with a small bow, a gesture that keeps respect alive in everyday life. （议论文·文化礼仪）
synonyms.usage: practice 多指群体或社会"约定俗成的惯常做法"，含文化、制度色彩；routine 更偏个人或工作中"重复性的固定流程"

synonyms.translation: （养生、训练的）规定制度，养生法
synonyms.example: Under the coach's strict regimen of diet and drills, the once-frail teenager transformed into the fittest player on the team. （读后续写·蜕变·自律）
synonyms.usage: regimen 为较正式书面词，专指为健康或训练而制定的"规定性制度"（饮食、锻炼、作息）；routine 更中性、更口语化

advancedExpressions.expression: daily routine / an exercise routine / establish (fall into) a routine / break the routine / as a matter of routine
advancedExpressions.example: Once you establish a daily exercise routine, it becomes as natural as breathing, and breaking it feels almost wrong. （一句串起 routine 的核心搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示"惯例/固定安排"（辨析枚举）
advancedExpressions.expression: routine（成体系的固定流程）≈ habit（单个反复行为）≈ schedule（带时间点的日程）≈ practice（约定俗成的惯例）≈ regimen（养生/训练制度）
advancedExpressions.example: A morning exercise routine soon becomes a habit, and once it is fixed in your schedule, skipping it feels strange. （据语境在 routine/habit/schedule 中择词）

advancedExpressions.expression: routine (n./adj.) → routinely (adv.) 例行地；一词两性（名词"惯例"/形容词"例行的"）
advancedExpressions.example: Doctors routinely check patients' blood pressure as part of their routine. （routinely 副词 + routine 名词同现，辨清词性）

advancedExpressions.expression: There was a comforting rhythm to sb's routine: ..., ..., and ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was a comforting rhythm to Grandpa's routine: the creak of the gate at dawn, the whisper of the broom on stone, and the low tune he hummed to the waking birds. （三件小事并列铺陈日常温情）

advancedExpressions.expression: I strongly recommend that you build ... into your daily routine, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I strongly recommend that you build half an hour of reading into your daily routine, for the habits we form now quietly shape the people we will become. （recommend that 从句用虚拟+for 引出理由）

advancedExpressions.expression: Far from being ..., a well-designed routine is what ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being the enemy of creativity, a well-designed routine is precisely what frees the mind to soar, sparing it the daily burden of trivial decisions. （"far from"否定俗见+破除误解，展现思辨层次）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He did the same things every day.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Day after day he moved through the same unchanging routine, so that his mornings blurred into one another like beads sliding along a single grey thread — until the day a stray letter arrived and quietly cut that thread in two. （读后续写·叙事+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Day after day 时间副词强化单调 + like beads on a grey thread 比喻具象化乏味 + until 制造转折埋伏笔 + cut that thread in two 呼应比喻收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good routine helps us succeed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is no exaggeration to say that a thoughtfully built routine is the invisible foundation of success, for while inspiration comes and goes like the tide, it is our steady daily habits that carry us, unnoticed, towards the shore. （议论文·比喻论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is no exaggeration to say 增强语气 + invisible foundation 隐喻 + for 引出论证 + while ... it is ... that 让步+强调句对比灵感与习惯 + towards the shore 意象收束

classPractice.answer: 形容词，意为“日常的、例行的”
classPractice.note: 【课件】PPT原句；routine 作形容词修饰 enquiries，表“日常的、例行的”。

classPractice.note: 考点：an exercise routine "一套锻炼计划"，此处 routine 作可数名词（源自课文原句）。

classPractice.question: 选 routine / habit：Getting into a regular exercise ____ — warming up, running, then stretching — kept him fit all year.
classPractice.note: 考点：一整套有先后顺序的固定流程用 routine；单个反复行为才用 habit。

classPractice.question: 我强烈建议你把半小时阅读纳入日常作息。I strongly recommend that you build half an hour of reading ____ your daily ____.
classPractice.note: 考点：build sth into one's daily routine "把…纳入日常作息"；daily routine 固定搭配。

original_sentence: When you plan an exercise routine, the first thing to consider is what you expect to improve: heart and lung efficiency, muscle strength or flexibility.
readingExamples: When you plan an exercise routine, the first thing to consider is what you expect to improve: heart and lung efficiency, muscle strength or flexibility.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of the pieces of elastic tissue in the body that can tighten and relax to produce movement
(2) n. physical strength and power of the body
(3) n. power, influence or force, especially of a political, financial or organizational kind
(4) v. (usually muscle in / muscle one's way) to force your way somewhere or into something by using strength or pressure

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （组织、集团等的）势力，影响力，实力
uncommonMeanings.example: The small charity had heart in plenty but little financial muscle, and so its brave dream depended entirely on the kindness of strangers. （读后续写·公益·力量对比）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （muscle in）强行挤入，硬闯
uncommonMeanings.example: Just as the exhausted runners neared the line, a latecomer tried to muscle in, and a wave of angry murmurs rippled through the crowd. （读后续写·比赛·冲突）

posExamples.sentence: By the final lap every muscle in his legs screamed for him to stop, yet the memory of his little sister cheering in the stands pushed him one agonising step further. （读后续写·长跑·意志力）
When you plan an exercise routine, remember that building muscle takes patience, and that a body worth having is never made in a single week. （应用文·健身指南·仿课文语境）
Strength of muscle may win a single contest, but it is strength of character that decides who rises again after every defeat. （议论文·体育精神·对比论证）
Weeks of training had turned the frail newcomer's arms into firm, capable muscle, and with the new strength came a quiet confidence he had never known before. （读后续写·蜕变·身体与自信）

wordForms.noun: muscle（肌肉；实力）; muscularity（肌肉发达；强健）
wordForms.adjective: muscular（肌肉的；强壮的）; muscled（有肌肉的，健壮的）
wordForms.other: 构词提示：muscle (n.) → muscular (adj.) 强壮的/肌肉的（注意去 e 加 -ular）；muscleman（肌肉发达的男子）。发音特例：muscle 中的 c 不发音 /ˈmʌsl/。固定短语 build muscle（增肌）; muscle strength（肌肉力量）

idioms.example: Eager to flex his muscles before the new team, the young captain volunteered for the hardest task of the whole expedition. （读后续写·人物·急于证明自己）
The deer stood frozen at the forest's edge, not moving a muscle, its dark eyes fixed on the silent hunter beyond the trees. （读后续写·自然·紧张对峙）

collocations.translation: 肌肉力量（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: You expect to improve heart and lung efficiency, muscle strength or flexibility. （课文原句：锻炼旨在提升肌肉力量等）
Lifting weights three times a week helped the skinny boy build muscle. （读后续写·健身·自信成长）
By the end of the summer camp he had put on real muscle. （读后续写·夏令营·成长）
In his hurry to impress the coach, he pulled a muscle on the very first sprint. （读后续写·操之过急）
Take a slow breath and relax the muscles in your shoulders. （应用文·心理疏导）
The next morning her aching muscles reminded her of every metre she had climbed. （读后续写·登山·收获感）
As people age, they gradually lose muscle mass, which is why regular exercise matters more. （议论文·健康与衰老）
Before the long journey the hikers paused to stretch their muscles. （读后续写·出发前）

synonyms.example: Summoning the last of her strength, she heaved the fallen branch aside and reached the trapped kitten at last. （读后续写·救援·奋力一搏）
synonyms.usage: strength 是抽象名词，泛指身体或精神上的"力量、力气"；muscle 具体指身体的"肌肉"，作"实力"讲时偏口语、偏组织势力

synonyms.example: There is a quiet power in kindness that no muscle can match, for it can move hearts that force could never touch. （议论文·善良的力量）
synonyms.usage: power 侧重"作用于外界的力量、能量或权力"，抽象且范围广；muscle 具体、生理，仅在"实力/势力"义上与 power 部分重合

synonyms.translation: （尤指与脑力相对的）体力，蛮力
synonyms.example: The job demanded brawn as much as brains, and the wiry old workman surprised them all with both. （读后续写·劳作·出人意料）
synonyms.usage: brawn 特指与脑力(brains)相对的"肌肉力气、体力"，常带"有力无谋"的意味；muscle 中性，可指肌肉本身或身体力量

advancedExpressions.expression: muscle strength / build (develop, put on) muscle / pull a muscle / aching muscles / flex one's muscles
advancedExpressions.example: To gain real muscle strength you must build muscle slowly, or you will only pull a muscle and be left with aching arms. （一句串起 muscle 的核心搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示"力量/体力"（辨析枚举）
advancedExpressions.expression: muscle（肌肉/生理力量·口语指实力）≈ strength（抽象力量·力气）≈ power（作用于外界的力量/权力）≈ brawn（与脑力相对的蛮力）
advancedExpressions.example: The job demanded brawn as much as brains, yet true strength lay not in his muscles but in his patience. （据语境在 muscle/strength/power/brawn 中择词）

advancedExpressions.expression: muscle (n.) → muscular (adj.) 肌肉的/强壮的；对照 circle→circular, table→tabular 的 -ular 规律
advancedExpressions.example: Years of rowing gave him a muscular build that turned heads on the beach. （muscle 的形容词形式 muscular）

advancedExpressions.expression: every muscle in sb's body ... as ...
advancedExpressions.example: Every muscle in his body tightened like a drawn bowstring as the whistle rose to his lips and the whole stadium held its breath. （用"绷紧的弓弦"比喻蓄势待发的身体，续写高潮前的动作特写）

advancedExpressions.expression: To strengthen ... and build muscle, one need only ...
advancedExpressions.example: To strengthen your heart and build muscle, one need only start small: a daily walk today can become a confident jog by spring. （"need only"降低门槛，倡议信鼓励行动）

advancedExpressions.expression: It is not ... muscle but ... that truly ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the muscle in our arms but the resilience in our spirit that truly carries us through life's steepest climbs. （"not ... but ..."对比结构，由身体升华至品格）

sentenceUpgrade.original: His muscles were tired after the race.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When at last he crossed the line, every muscle in his aching body seemed to dissolve into water, and he sank to the track, drained yet strangely, wonderfully at peace. （读后续写·冲线+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: every muscle ... seemed to dissolve into water 夸张比喻 + sank to the track 动作细节 + drained yet ... at peace 用矛盾并置(yet)写身体与心理的反差

sentenceUpgrade.original: Exercise helps you get stronger muscles.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Consistent training does far more than sculpt visible muscle; it quietly forges the discipline, patience and self-belief that will serve us long after the last workout is done. （议论文·递进升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: does far more than 递进句式 + sculpt/forge 动词化比喻 + 三名词并列(discipline, patience, self-belief) + long after ... 拉长时间维度点明深层价值

classPractice.question: When you plan an exercise routine, you may want to improve heart and lung efficiency, ____ (muscle 名词) strength or flexibility.
classPractice.note: 考点：muscle strength "肌肉力量"，muscle 作定语用单数名词（源自课文原句）。

classPractice.question: Lifting weights regularly is one of the best ways to ____ ____ and grow stronger. （增长肌肉）
classPractice.answer: build muscle / develop muscle / put on muscle
classPractice.note: 考点：build/develop/put on muscle 均表"增肌"，muscle 此处作不可数名词。

classPractice.question: Years of rowing gave him a ____ (muscle) build that turned heads on the beach.
classPractice.note: 考点：名词 muscle → 形容词 muscular（强壮的/肌肉的），修饰名词 build。

original_sentence: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.
readingExamples: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. (of exercise) intended to strengthen the heart and lungs by increasing the intake of oxygen and quickening the breathing
(2) adj. relating to or requiring free oxygen; (of a living organism or process) able to live or occur only in the presence of oxygen
(3) adj. relating to aerobics, the popular form of energetic physical exercise done to music

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生物学）需氧的，好氧的（只能在有氧环境中生存或进行的）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the clear mountain stream, aerobic bacteria quietly broke down the fallen leaves, keeping the water pure long before any human hand thought to protect it. （读后续写·自然·生态之美）

posExamples.sentence: As the morning light spilled over the park, rows of elderly neighbours moved through their gentle aerobic routine, proof that a beating heart is never too old to grow stronger. （读后续写·社区·晨练温情）
I would recommend that our class try aerobic activities such as jogging and swimming, since they strengthen the heart and lungs while lifting our spirits after long hours of study. （应用文·建议信·课外活动）
Regular aerobic exercise does more than trim the waistline; by feeding the brain with fresh oxygen, it sharpens the very mind that classrooms work so hard to train. （议论文·运动与学习·因果论证）
Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs, laying the quiet foundation on which every other kind of fitness is built. （议论文·健康基础·仿课文语境）

wordForms.noun: aerobics（有氧健身操，有氧运动）; aerobe（需氧生物）
wordForms.other: anaerobic（无氧的，反义词）

collocations.translation: 有氧活动（课文原句：Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.）
collocations.example: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs. 有氧活动，如慢跑、游泳和滑雪，能强健你的心肺。（课文原句）
Thirty minutes of aerobic exercise a day can chase away the low moods. 每天三十分钟有氧运动能赶走坏情绪。

collocations.translation: 做有氧健身操（aerobics 名词，注意 -s 结尾，作运动名仍视为单数）
collocations.example: Every evening the retired teachers gathered to do aerobics. 每晚退休教师们聚在一起做有氧操。

collocations.translation: 有氧与无氧运动（anaerobic 为 aerobic 的反义词）
collocations.example: A good plan blends aerobic and anaerobic exercise. 好的计划把有氧与无氧运动结合起来。
Months of running had built up her aerobic fitness. 数月的跑步练出了她的有氧耐力。
A brisk aerobic workout left him glowing with energy. 一次轻快的有氧锻炼让他浑身充满活力。
Even a daily walk can improve a teenager's aerobic health. 每天步行也能改善青少年的心肺健康。

synonyms.translation: 心血管的（关于心肺循环的）
synonyms.example: Doctors praised the programme for its clear cardiovascular benefits, noting that stronger hearts today mean fewer regrets tomorrow. （议论文·健康预防）
synonyms.usage: cardiovascular 为医学书面词，强调对"心脏与血管系统"的作用；aerobic 侧重"依靠氧气的运动类型"，两者常在健身语境交叉，aerobic 更贴近日常

synonyms.example: She squeezed in twenty minutes of cardio before class, convinced that a racing heart woke up her sleepy brain. （读后续写·日常·口语化）
synonyms.usage: cardio 是 aerobic exercise 的口语简称，年轻、随意，多用于健身房日常交流；aerobic 更正式、书面，也可作生物学术语

advancedExpressions.expression: aer(o)-（空气/氧）+ -ic → aerobic 有氧的；an-（无）+ aerobic → anaerobic 无氧的
advancedExpressions.example: Aerobic exercise uses oxygen, while anaerobic exercise, like sprinting, does not. 有氧运动靠氧气，无氧运动（如短跑）则不靠。（前缀 an- 表"无"，一并记 aerobic/anaerobic 一对反义词）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·有氧运动（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: aerobic exercise ≈ cardio ≈ cardiovascular exercise（三者都指有氧/心肺锻炼，可互换）
advancedExpressions.example: Doctors call it aerobic exercise; gym-goers just say cardio. 医生叫它有氧运动，健身的人只说 cardio。（cardio 口语，cardiovascular 书面，aerobic 中性）

advancedExpressions.expression: as sb. eased into the aerobic rhythm of ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: As she eased into the steady aerobic rhythm of her morning run, the worries that had kept her awake began, one by one, to fall behind her like autumn leaves. （运动节奏与心理释放交织，比喻收束，续写疗愈段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: By making aerobic exercise a daily habit, we can ..., which in turn ...
advancedExpressions.example: By making aerobic exercise a daily habit, we can strengthen not only our lungs but our will, which in turn spills its energy into every corner of school life. （by 引导手段+which in turn 引出连锁效益，倡议信递进句）

advancedExpressions.expression: The value of aerobic exercise lies not merely in ..., but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The value of aerobic exercise lies not merely in a healthier body, but in the quiet resilience it builds — the daily proof that we can push a little further than yesterday. （"not merely ... but ..."由表及里，升华运动的精神意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Aerobic exercise is good for your health.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Few habits reward us so richly as aerobic exercise: with every early-morning run the heart grows steadier, the mind grows clearer, and the whole day seems to open up like a window flung wide to the sun. （读后续写／记叙升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Few habits reward us so richly as 比较级引出评价 + with every ... 伴随状语铺陈过程 + 三平行分句(heart/mind/day) + like a window flung wide 比喻收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should do more aerobic exercise.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that schools wove regular aerobic exercise into the very fabric of the timetable, for a nation of clear minds must first be a nation of strong and steady hearts. （议论文·呼吁升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 虚拟语气(wove) 表急切 + wove ... into the fabric 隐喻融入制度 + for 引出论证 + 由"clear minds"到"strong hearts"的因果递进立意

classPractice.question: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, ____ (develop) your heart and lungs.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；主语 Aerobic activities 为复数，谓语用原形 develop（一般现在时陈述常理）

classPractice.question: 填 aerobic 或 anaerobic：Long-distance running is a typical ____ exercise, whereas lifting heavy weights is mainly ____.
classPractice.note: 长跑靠氧气=aerobic，举重瞬间爆发=anaerobic；an- 前缀表"无"

classPractice.question: 医生建议我们每天做有氧运动。The doctor advised us to ____ ____ ____ every day.
classPractice.note: do aerobic exercise 做有氧运动；exercise 此处不可数，不加 -s

original_sentence: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.
readingExamples: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.
For example, some people go jogging for several hours at a time because of the step-counting smartphone apps.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the activity of running at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of physical exercise
(2) n. (from 'jog') the act of running gently over a distance for fitness or pleasure

posExamples.sentence: Every dawn, rain or shine, the old man's jogging carried him past our gate, and the soft rhythm of his footsteps became the quiet clock by which our whole street woke. （读后续写·社区·恒常之美）
I would like to suggest jogging as our club's weekly activity, for it costs nothing, welcomes everyone, and sends us back to our books with clearer heads. （应用文·建议信·社团活动）

Jogging may look humble beside grander sports, yet its steady, patient nature teaches a lesson the fastest sprinter often misses: that endurance, not speed, wins the longest races of life. （议论文·运动与人生·类比论证）
After weeks of jogging together at daybreak, the two once-shy classmates found that shared silence and shared effort had quietly grown into a friendship neither had expected. （读后续写·校园·运动结缘）

wordForms.noun: jogging（慢跑）; jog（慢跑；轻推）; jogger（慢跑者）

idioms.example: Whenever the weight of revision grew too heavy, she would go jogging by the river, letting the water carry her worries away, stroke by silver stroke. （读后续写·减压·自然疗愈）

idioms.translation: 唤起某人的记忆（jog 的固定搭配）
idioms.example: The faded photograph on the mantelpiece jogged the old sailor's memory, and suddenly the whole roar of the ocean came flooding back. （读后续写·回忆·触景生情）

collocations.translation: 像慢跑（这样的）（课文原句：Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.）
collocations.example: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs. 有氧活动，如慢跑、游泳和滑雪，能强健你的心肺。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 去慢跑（课文原句：... some people go jogging for several hours at a time ...）
collocations.example: Some people go jogging for several hours at a time because of the step-counting smartphone apps. 有些人因为计步手机应用而一次慢跑好几个小时。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 去慢跑（jog 作可数名词，go for a + n.）
collocations.example: Before sunrise, father and son went for a jog together. 日出前，父子俩一起去慢跑。
On the doctor's advice, Grandpa took up jogging at sixty. 遵医嘱，爷爷六十岁开始慢跑。
Morning jogging soon became the anchor of her day. 晨跑很快成了她一天的支点。
Sticking to a jogging routine taught the boy that daily effort is its own reward. 坚持慢跑让男孩明白每日的努力本身就是回报。
The new jogging trail through the park has drawn neighbours of every age. 穿过公园的新慢跑道吸引了各年龄段的邻居。
There is a special peace in jogging in the park at first light, when the world belongs, for a little while, only to you and the waking birds. （读后续写·清晨·静谧）

synonyms.example: Running had always frightened her — until a patient friend taught her to slow down, breathe, and simply enjoy the ground rushing beneath her feet. （读后续写·突破·克服畏惧）
synonyms.usage: running 泛指各种速度的"跑步"，可快可慢，可竞技可休闲；jogging 专指"慢速、匀速的健身跑"，强度更低、更休闲

synonyms.example: The little pony came trotting across the meadow the moment it heard the child's familiar call. （读后续写·自然·亲切画面）
synonyms.usage: trotting 原指马等动物的"小跑"，用于人时略带轻快、俏皮色彩，非正式健身用语；jogging 才是描述人"健身慢跑"的标准词

synonyms.example: For those whose knees ache at every jog, power walking offers all the joy of movement with none of the pain. （议论文·科学锻炼·替代方案）
synonyms.usage: power walking 指"快步健走"，无腾空阶段，对关节冲击更小，适合替代 jogging；jogging 有短暂腾空，强度略高

advancedExpressions.expression: jog（v. 慢跑）+ -ing → jogging（n. 慢跑）；重读闭音节双写辅音 g：jog→jogged→jogged→jogging
advancedExpressions.example: She jogs every day; jogging keeps her fit. 她每天慢跑，慢跑让她保持健康。（动词 jog 单音节短元音，加 -ing/-ed 要双写 g）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·go + doing 运动表达
advancedExpressions.expression: go jogging / go swimming / go skiing / go shopping（go + v-ing 表示"去做某项活动"）
advancedExpressions.example: We often go jogging in the morning and go swimming at weekends. 我们常常早上去慢跑，周末去游泳。（go doing 是高频运动/娱乐句型）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·慢跑/跑步（可替换，程度有别）
advancedExpressions.expression: go jogging ≈ go for a jog ≈ go running（都表"去跑步"，jogging 强调慢而匀速）
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than go running fast, she prefers to go jogging at an easy pace. 她不喜欢快跑，更喜欢用轻松的速度慢跑。

advancedExpressions.expression: With each step of the jog, ...
advancedExpressions.example: With each step of the jog, the tangled knot in her chest loosened a little more, until at last, somewhere near the end of the road, she could breathe freely again. （用慢跑的节奏外化心理松解的过程，续写情绪转折段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: Let us begin with something as simple as jogging, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us begin with something as simple as jogging, and watch how a single healthy habit can quietly reshape the rhythm of our whole school day. （"let us"号召+by 展示以小见大的效果，倡议书煽动性收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: There is a quiet wisdom in jogging: it reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is a quiet wisdom in jogging: it reminds us that lasting progress is rarely dramatic, but is instead the sum of countless unremarkable, faithful steps. （由具体运动引申出人生哲理，议论文过渡与升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She went jogging every morning to feel better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every morning she laced up her worn running shoes and set off jogging along the misty riverbank, and mile by mile the heaviness she carried seemed to lift, dissolving into the cool grey air like breath on a winter's day. （读后续写·细节+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: laced up her worn shoes 动作细节铺垫 + set off jogging 画面感 + mile by mile 渐进副词 + dissolving into ... like breath 比喻收束心理变化

sentenceUpgrade.original: Jogging is a good way to stay healthy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Of all the paths to a healthier life, few are as generous as jogging: it asks for no membership, no equipment and no talent — only a pair of willing feet and the humble courage to begin. （议论文·排比升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Of all the paths ..., few are as generous as 比较级引出评价 + 三重否定排比(no ...) + only ... 转折点明门槛之低 + humble courage to begin 立意升华

classPractice.question: Some people go ____ (jog) for several hours at a time because of the step-counting apps.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；go + v-ing 表"去做某活动"，jog 双写 g 再加 -ing

classPractice.question: 用 go 的正确形式补全：Whenever the pressure grew too heavy, she ____ ____ by the river to relax.
classPractice.note: go jogging 去慢跑；由 grew 判断用一般过去时 went

original_sentence: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.
readingExamples: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the sport or activity of moving over snow on skis, especially down mountains or snow-covered slopes
(2) n. the act of travelling on skis, either for sport, recreation or as a means of getting about in snowy country

posExamples.sentence: At the top of the glittering slope, fear and thrill fought inside her; then, drawing one deep breath, she pushed off, and skiing became the freest, most fearless moment of her whole timid life. （读后续写·滑雪·突破自我）
I am writing to recommend skiing for our winter camp, since it not only builds courage and balance but also lets us marvel at the quiet beauty of the snow-covered mountains. （应用文·推荐信·冬令营）
Skiing teaches a truth that reaches far beyond the slopes: that we cannot avoid the fall, but we can always choose to rise, brush off the snow, and try the run once more. （议论文·挫折教育·类比论证）

Aerobic activities such as jogging, swimming and skiing develop the heart and lungs, and few of them fill the spirit with such pure, breathless joy as a swift descent through fresh snow. （议论文·运动益处·仿课文语境）

wordForms.noun: skiing（滑雪运动）; ski（滑雪板）; skier（滑雪者）
wordForms.other: ski resort（滑雪度假胜地）; ski slope（滑雪道）

collocations.translation: 以及滑雪（课文原句：Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs.）
collocations.example: Aerobic activities, like jogging, swimming and skiing, develop your heart and lungs. 有氧活动，如慢跑、游泳和滑雪，能强健你的心肺。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 去滑雪（go + v-ing 表活动）
collocations.example: The whole family went skiing over the holiday. 全家假期去滑雪了。

collocations.phrase: learn to ski / take up skiing
collocations.example: It took her a dozen tumbles to learn to ski. 她摔了十几跤才学会滑雪。
The skiing trip our class had dreamed of finally arrived. 我们班盼望已久的滑雪之旅终于来了。

collocations.translation: 滑雪度假胜地（ski 作定语，注意不加 -ing）
collocations.example: The little ski resort glowed with warm lights among the pines. 松林间的小滑雪度假村亮着温暖的灯光。

collocations.translation: 高山（速降）滑雪／越野滑雪
collocations.example: Cross-country skiing rewards the patient with silence and endless white horizons. 越野滑雪回馈耐心的人以宁静和无尽的雪白天际。
Heart pounding, he skied down the steepest slope at last. 心跳如鼓，他终于滑下了最陡的斜坡。

synonyms.example: Her younger brother preferred snowboarding, carving bold curves down the mountain while she traced her careful, elegant lines beside him. （读后续写·手足·各展所长）
synonyms.usage: snowboarding 指双脚固定于一块滑雪板上的"单板滑雪"，动作风格更自由奔放；skiing 用两块窄板、双杖，姿态更平稳传统

synonyms.example: For the youngest children, sledding down the gentle white hill brought shrieks of delight that echoed across the whole valley. （读后续写·童趣·冬日欢闹）
synonyms.usage: sledding 指坐在雪橇上被动滑下，简单、安全，适合幼童娱乐；skiing 需站立操控滑雪板，技巧性、运动性都更强

advancedExpressions.expression: ski（v. 滑雪 / n. 滑雪板）+ -ing → skiing（n. 滑雪运动，双 i）；skier 滑雪者；ski→skied→skied
advancedExpressions.example: A skier who loves skiing will ski whenever it snows. 热爱滑雪运动的滑雪者一下雪就会去滑雪。（注意 skiing 有两个 i，别漏写）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·go + doing 冬季运动
advancedExpressions.expression: go skiing / go skating / go snowboarding / go sledding（go + v-ing 表"去做某冬季运动"）
advancedExpressions.example: In winter we go skiing in the north and go skating on the frozen lake. 冬天我们去北方滑雪，去结冰的湖上滑冰。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·雪上运动（可替换，器材有别）
advancedExpressions.expression: skiing（双板）≈ snowboarding（单板）≈ sledding（乘雪橇）——均为雪上运动，可视语境替换
advancedExpressions.example: Some prefer skiing on two boards, others love snowboarding on one. 有人喜欢双板滑雪，有人爱单板滑雪。

advancedExpressions.expression: The moment sb. pushed off, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment she pushed off, the fear that had rooted her to the spot melted into the rushing wind, and for the first time in her life she felt utterly, gloriously free. （用滑雪起步的瞬间外化"恐惧化为自由"的心理飞跃，续写高潮段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: Skiing offers not only ... but also ..., making it an ideal ...
advancedExpressions.example: Skiing offers not only healthy exercise but also unforgettable moments of courage and beauty, making it an ideal choice for our winter camp. （"not only ... but also"并列卖点+making 分词收束，推荐信高分句）

advancedExpressions.expression: Like skiing, life demands that we ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like skiing, life demands that we lean bravely into the very slope we fear, for it is only by risking the fall that we ever taste the thrill of the descent. （由滑雪类比人生冒险，议论文借物说理，立意深远）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was afraid, but she went skiing and enjoyed it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: At the crest of the slope her knees trembled and her breath came in short, frightened gasps; yet the instant she surrendered to the pull of the mountain and went skiing, terror dissolved into pure exhilaration, and she flew down the white world laughing at her own past fears. （读后续写·心理转折+动作）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: knees trembled / breath in gasps 生理细节写恐惧 + yet the instant 转折引出突破 + surrendered to the pull of the mountain 拟人化山势 + terror dissolved into exhilaration 情绪反转 + laughing at her own past fears 回望收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Skiing helps us learn to face difficulties.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Perhaps no sport teaches courage quite like skiing, for it hands us the same choice life offers again and again: to shrink back in fear at the edge, or to lean forward, trust ourselves, and let the fall become flight. （议论文·类比升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Perhaps no sport ... quite like 最高级式评价 + for 引出论证 + the same choice life offers 类比人生 + to shrink back or to lean forward 二元对照 + let the fall become flight 头韵+意象化收束点题

original_sentence: Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development.
readingExamples: Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an exercise in which you hang from a bar and pull your whole body up until your chin is above it, working the arms and back
(2) n. (chiefly BrE) a place beside a road where drivers can stop, or the act of pulling up / stopping a vehicle

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英式）路边停车处；停车这一动作
uncommonMeanings.example: The delivery van made a sudden pull-up at the kerb, and out jumped a breathless boy clutching the parcel that would change everything. （读后续写·情节转折·关键包裹）

posExamples.sentence: Gritting his teeth, Tom hauled himself up for one last pull-up; his arms trembled like taut wires, yet the cheer that erupted below drowned out the fire burning in his shoulders. （读后续写·体育励志·突破极限）
To help beginners build upper-body strength safely, I strongly recommend starting with assisted pull-ups on a resistance band before attempting the full movement. （应用文·健身指南）

Some argue that mastering a single pull-up is trivial, yet it perfectly embodies a deeper truth: real progress in any field is won not by leaps but by one deliberate, hard-earned repetition after another. （议论文·坚持与积累）

wordForms.noun: pull-up（引体向上，合成名词，复数 pull-ups）
wordForms.other: pull up (v. phr. 停车；把……拉近)；合成构词：动词短语 pull up → 加连字符名词化 pull-up；同类 chin-up 引体（反握）、sit-up 仰卧起坐、push-up 俯卧撑、warm-up 热身

collocations.phrase: such as pull-ups（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 例如引体向上（课文原句：Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development.）
collocations.example: Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development. 力量训练，例如引体向上和举重，能增强肌肉力量并促进骨骼发育。（课文原句）
At first she could not do a single pull-up. 起初她一个引体向上都做不了。
The coach suggested an assisted pull-up for newcomers. 教练建议新手先做辅助引体向上。
In the corner of the gym hung a battered pull-up bar. 健身房角落里挂着一根用旧的引体向上单杠。
He knocked out a set of pull-ups every morning before dawn. 他每天黎明前做一组引体向上。

collocations.translation: 完成（做出）多个引体向上
collocations.example: By the end of camp, even the smallest camper could crank out ten pull-ups. 夏令营结束时，连最小的营员也能一口气做十个引体向上。

collocations.translation: 宽握距／窄握距引体向上
collocations.example: Switching to a wide-grip pull-up shifts more of the load onto your back muscles, the trainer explained to the attentive class. （应用文·训练讲解）

synonyms.example: Whereas a pull-up uses an overhand grip, a chin-up turns the palms toward you and calls more on the biceps. （应用文·动作辨析）
synonyms.usage: chin-up 特指掌心朝向自己（反握）的引体，更多用肱二头肌；pull-up 一般指正握，是更宽泛、更常用的说法

advancedExpressions.expression: 动词短语 pull up（拉起）→ 加连字符 → pull-up（引体向上，名词）；同类合成：sit-up 仰卧起坐 / push-up 俯卧撑 / warm-up 热身
advancedExpressions.example: "Pull up" is a verb, but "a pull-up" is a noun you can count. "pull up"是动词，而"a pull-up"是可数名词。（动词短语加连字符→合成名词，是常见构词法）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·引体向上（可替换，握法有别）
advancedExpressions.expression: pull-up（正握，练背）≈ chin-up（反握，练二头肌）——都指"引体向上"，可视握法替换
advancedExpressions.example: A pull-up uses an overhand grip, while a chin-up turns the palms toward you. 引体向上用正握，反握引体则手心朝向自己。

advancedExpressions.expression: with every pull-up, sb. hauled not just his body but his doubts up over the bar
advancedExpressions.example: With every pull-up, he hauled not just his body but a lifetime of doubts up over that cold steel bar, until at last both fell away beneath him. （比喻+一词多义 haul，续写高潮段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: if you can manage only a partial pull-up at first, ..., for ...
advancedExpressions.example: If you can manage only a partial pull-up at first, do not be discouraged, for strength is built not in a day but through patient, repeated effort. （建议信鼓励句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as no one masters the pull-up overnight, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as no one masters the pull-up overnight, no worthwhile achievement is ever reached without the humble accumulation of countless small, unglamorous efforts.

sentenceUpgrade.original: He did a pull-up and felt proud.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As his chin finally cleared the bar for the very first time, a wave of fierce pride surged through him — the sweetest reward, he realized, is not the one handed to you, but the one your own aching arms tear from the sky. （读后续写·动作+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 引导时间状语营造画面 + 破折号补充升华 + not...but... 对比点题 + 比喻（tear from the sky）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Pull-ups help you get stronger.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Regularly incorporating pull-ups into your routine not only strengthens the upper body but also cultivates the resilience of mind that carries over into every other challenge you face. （应用文·健身指南）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not only...but also 递进 + incorporating...into 正式动词短语 + carries over into 迁移表达升华意义

original_sentence: Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development.
readingExamples: Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of the hard parts that form the frame (skeleton) inside a human or animal body
(2) n. the hard substance that bones are made of, used in phrases about health and structure
(3) vt. to remove the bones from meat or fish before cooking

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 剔除（肉、鱼）的骨头
uncommonMeanings.example: Her grandmother's weathered hands boned the fish with such practised ease that the children watched as if witnessing a small, sacred magic. （读后续写·亲情·手艺传承）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （作强调副词）极其，彻底地（如 bone-dry, bone-tired）
uncommonMeanings.example: After the twelve-hour rescue, the volunteers were bone-tired, yet not one of them left the shelter until the last stray had been fed. （读后续写·奉献精神）

posExamples.sentence: The old man limped toward the fire, feeling the ache settle deep in his bones — a cold that no blanket could reach, only the memory of a warmth long lost. （读后续写·孤独老人·环境心理）
Regular weight-bearing exercise and a calcium-rich diet are essential for building strong bones, especially during the crucial teenage years. （应用文·健康倡议）
Some dismiss physical labour as beneath them, yet it is often such honest, bone-wearying work that forges the strongest character and the deepest sense of dignity. （议论文·劳动的价值）

wordForms.noun: bone（骨头，骨骼）; bone marrow（骨髓）
wordForms.adjective: bony（瘦骨嶙峋的）; bone-dry（干透的）; bone-tired（累垮的）
wordForms.other: boneless (adj. 无骨的)；构词/贴士：bone- 作强调副词构成合成词 bone-dry 干透、bone-tired 累瘫、bone-idle 懒透；backbone 脊梁/骨气；注意 bone 作"骨头"可数，作"骨质/成分"时不可数

idioms.translation: 对某事直言不讳，毫不掩饰
idioms.example: The headmaster made no bones about his disappointment, yet his honest words stung less than a false smile would have. （读后续写·师生·坦诚）

idioms.translation: 争论的焦点，引发争执的问题
idioms.example: The unfair distribution of chores had long been a bone of contention between the two roommates. （议论文/记叙·矛盾）
She could not explain it, but she felt it in her bones that her brother would walk through that door before nightfall. （读后续写·亲情·预感）

idioms.idiom: work one's fingers to the bone
idioms.translation: 拼命干活，累得筋疲力尽
idioms.example: For thirty years his mother worked her fingers to the bone so that he might one day sit in a university lecture hall. （读后续写·母爱·牺牲）
Chilled to the bone by the mountain wind, the hikers pressed on, drawn forward by the faint glow of a cabin in the distance. （读后续写·环境描写）

collocations.phrase: encourages bone development（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 促进骨骼发育（课文原句：Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development.）
collocations.example: Strength training, such as pull-ups and weightlifting, increases muscle strength and encourages bone development. 力量训练，例如引体向上和举重，能增强肌肉力量并促进骨骼发育。（课文原句）
Adequate sunlight and calcium are vital for healthy bone development. 充足的阳光和钙对健康的骨骼发育至关重要。
He broke a bone in his left wrist during the match. 比赛中他左手腕骨折了。
Regular strength training improves bone density and reduces fractures. 规律的力量训练能提高骨密度、减少骨折。
A stranger's bone marrow donation gave the little girl a second chance at life. 一位陌生人的骨髓捐献给了小女孩第二次生命。
She sketched the bare bones of the plan in her opening paragraph. 她在开头段勾勒出计划的基本框架。
His remark about her laziness cut a little too close to the bone. 他说她懒的那句话有点触到痛处。
The small charity had cut its costs to the bone so that every donated yuan could reach the children it served. （应用文·公益报告）

synonyms.example: The museum's centrepiece was the towering skeleton of a dinosaur, its bones bleached white by a hundred million years. （读后续写·博物馆场景）
synonyms.usage: skeleton 指全身骨骼构成的整体框架；bone 指单块或作为物质的骨头，也可比喻成本、要点

synonyms.example: Illness had reduced the once-sturdy man to a frail frame, yet his eyes still burned with unbroken determination. （读后续写·人物）
synonyms.usage: frame 指人的整体身躯／体格（也指结构框架），较文学化；bone 更具体，且常用于健康、比喻语境

advancedExpressions.expression: make no bones about sth 直言不讳 / a bone of contention 争端焦点 / feel it in one's bones 凭直觉确信 / work one's fingers to the bone 拼命干活
advancedExpressions.example: She made no bones about the fact that the money had long been a bone of contention. 她直言不讳地承认，这笔钱早已是争执的焦点。（一组 bone 习语连用，记忆更牢）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·bone- 强调合成词
advancedExpressions.expression: bone- 加形容词构成"极其……"：bone-dry 干透 / bone-tired 累瘫 / bone-idle 懒透
advancedExpressions.example: After the twelve-hour rescue, the volunteers were bone-tired. 十二小时救援后，志愿者们累得散了架。（bone- 作强调，相当于 extremely）

advancedExpressions.expression: the cold seeped into her very bones, and with it a fear she dared not name
advancedExpressions.example: The cold seeped into her very bones, and with it a fear she dared not name — the fear that this time, no one was coming. （感官内化情感，续写渲染绝境）

advancedExpressions.expression: to keep one's bones strong, it is advisable to ...
advancedExpressions.example: To keep our bones strong throughout life, it is advisable to combine regular exercise with a balanced, calcium-rich diet from an early age. （倡议句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: strip away the ..., and the bare bones of the matter reveal that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Strip away the fashionable jargon, and the bare bones of the matter reveal that success still rests on the oldest virtues: diligence, honesty and perseverance.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was very cold and tired.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Chilled to the bone and bone-tired from the endless climb, she nonetheless forced one trembling foot in front of the other, unwilling to let the mountain claim the last of her spirit. （读后续写·环境+意志）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: chilled to the bone 与 bone-tired 双关联动 + nonetheless 转折 + one trembling foot in front of the other 具象化坚持

definitionEn:

(2) n. (figurative, usually with a modifier) impressively clever or complicated activity, e.g. mental / verbal gymnastics

We warmly invite all students to join our after-school gymnastics club, where you can improve your flexibility, balance and confidence in a friendly, supportive atmosphere. （应用文·社团招募）

definitionEn:

(2) vi. & vt. to reach out a part of your body to its full length, or to extend your arms and legs to relax the muscles
(3) vi. to spread over a large area or a long period of time
(4) n. an area of land or water, or a continuous period of time; (also) an act of stretching the body

(4) vi. to vary between two particular limits; to include a variety of different things

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 范围，幅度，区间（可变动的限度；数值/种类/距离所覆盖的幅度）
uncommonMeanings.example: This price is beyond my range. 这个价格超出了我的承受范围。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一系列，各种（a range of + 复数名词，常搭配 a wide / broad range of）
uncommonMeanings.example: The shop sells a wide range of sportswear. 这家店出售各种各样的运动服。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 山脉，一连串的山
uncommonMeanings.example: As dawn broke, the entire mountain range blazed gold, and for a breathless moment the weary climbers forgot every ache in their legs. （读后续写·登山·壮景）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （在一定范围内）变动，变化于……之间（常用 range from...to...；不及物，无被动）
uncommonMeanings.example: The opinions in the class ranged from cautious doubt to wild enthusiasm, yet not a single student remained indifferent. （议论文·观点分布）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 射程；（视力、听力等的）可及范围
uncommonMeanings.example: The lost hiker screamed until her voice gave out, but the rescue team was still far beyond hearing range. （读后续写·求救·绝境）

posExamples.sentence: Flexibility training helps stretch your muscles and gradually widen your body's range of movement, so that everyday actions feel lighter and freer. （应用文·健身科普）
Our school library offers a remarkable range of books, from timeless classics to the latest science journals, waiting to open new worlds to every curious reader. （应用文·图书馆介绍）
The volunteers' ages ranged from restless teenagers to silver-haired retirees, yet a shared warmth bound them into one tireless, smiling team. （读后续写·公益·群像）
A truly well-rounded education should expose students to a wide range of disciplines, for it is the breadth of one's learning that nurtures the flexibility of one's thinking. （议论文·全面教育）

wordForms.other: ranger (n. 护林员；管理员)。小贴士：①a range of + 复数名词，谓语动词与该复数名词一致；②range 作动词时多为不及物，range from A to B 无被动，切忌写成 be ranged from；③mountain range = a chain of mountains，'一连串的山'

idioms.example: The exhibition displayed a dazzling range of student projects, each one glowing with imagination and hard-won effort. （应用文·活动报道）

idioms.translation: 在（可及）范围内／超出范围
idioms.example: Only when the ship drifted within range of the lighthouse did the exhausted sailors dare to believe they might survive the night. （读后续写·脱险）
Seen at close range, the champion's medal was scratched and worn — a quiet record of every battle it had witnessed. （读后续写·细节·象征）

collocations.phrase: in the age range / in the range of ... / in the price range
collocations.translation: 【课件】在……范围／区间内（义项1 limits 变动或浮动的范围）
collocations.example: Most of the students are in the 17–20 age range. 学生大多在17-20岁年龄范围内。There will be an increase in the range of 0 to 3 per cent. 将有0到3个百分点的涨幅。（PPT原句）

collocations.phrase: within range / outside (beyond / out of) the range of
collocations.translation: 【课件】在（可及）范围内／超出……的范围（义项1 limits）
collocations.example: He shouted angrily at anyone within range. 他看见谁就对谁吼叫。This was outside the range of his experience. 这超出了他的经验范围。（PPT原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】各种各样的，范围广泛的（义项2 variety 种类）
collocations.example: The hotel offers a wide / full range of facilities. 这家酒店提供各种各样的设施。（PPT原句）
the great mountain range of the Alps 阿尔卑斯山脉（PPT原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（在……之间）变化、变动；所涉范围很广（不及物动词）
collocations.example: She has had a number of different jobs, ranging from chef to swimming instructor. 她做过许多不同的工作，从厨师到游泳教练。The conversation ranged widely. 谈话所涉及的范围很广。（PPT原句）

collocations.translation: 身体的活动范围（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Flexibility training, including gymnastics and tai chi, helps stretch your muscles and improve your body's range of movement. 柔韧性训练能拉伸肌肉、改善身体的活动范围。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一系列，各种各样的（+复数名词，谓语随后接名词的数）
collocations.example: The gym offers a range of classes. 健身房提供各种各样的课程。

collocations.translation: 从……到……不等（作不及物动词，无被动）
collocations.example: The members' ages range from six to sixty. 会员年龄从六岁到六十岁不等。

collocations.translation: 范围广泛的，各种各样的
collocations.example: The festival offered a wide range of activities, from calligraphy workshops to lively folk dances, drawing visitors of every age. （应用文·活动介绍）
Regular stretching noticeably improves your range of movement, making both sport and daily life far more comfortable. （应用文·科普）
Beyond the village rose a snow-capped mountain range, ancient and unmoving, a silent witness to a thousand generations. （读后续写·环境·象征）
The reading club welcomes a broad age range, proving that curiosity knows no birthday. （应用文·社团招募）
The charity sale offered handmade crafts across a modest price range, so that no kind-hearted student was left out. （应用文·义卖）
Faced with a wide range of career options, she reminded herself that the best path is the one that stirs genuine passion. （议论文·选择）
By the time help arrived, the drifting raft had floated well beyond range of the searchlights. （读后续写·营救）

synonyms.example: The volunteers brought a wonderful variety of talents, and together they turned a bare classroom into a place of colour and laughter. （读后续写·公益）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：variety 强调'多样、丰富的种类'本身，句法上常用 a variety of + 复数名词；range 强调从一端到另一端所覆盖的'幅度／区间'，常搭配 wide/broad，也可作 vi. 表变动

synonyms.example: The new policy greatly broadened the scope of the volunteer programme, allowing far more communities to benefit. （议论文/应用文·范围）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：scope 侧重活动、研究、影响所涉及的范围与余地，较抽象，多不可数（the scope of sth）；range 更常指数值、种类或距离的变动幅度，可数（a range of）

synonyms.example: Across the full spectrum of opinion, one belief remained constant: that every child deserved a fair chance at school. （议论文·观点谱系）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：spectrum 形象地指从一个极端到另一极端连续分布的整个范围（尤指观点、类型），句法多为 the ... spectrum；range 更中性、更口语常用

advancedExpressions.expression: a (wide / broad) range of 各种各样的 / range from ... to ... 从……到……不等 / range of movement 活动幅度 / a mountain range 山脉 / within range / out of range 在（超出）范围内
advancedExpressions.example: Our courses range from beginner tai chi to advanced gymnastics, covering a wide range of interests. 我们的课程从初级太极到高级体操不等，涵盖各种兴趣。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·range from A to B（不及物，无被动）
advancedExpressions.expression: sth range(s) from A to B = sth 在 A 到 B 之间变动。range 此处为不及物动词，不可用被动，也不加 to be；主语为复数时动词用复数。
advancedExpressions.example: The prices range from 20 to 200 yuan. 价格从20元到200元不等。（× are ranged from）

advancedExpressions.expression: before them stretched a vast mountain range, and their small troubles seemed to shrink against its grandeur
advancedExpressions.example: Before them stretched a vast mountain range bathed in morning gold, and against such timeless grandeur their small troubles seemed suddenly, mercifully, to shrink. （情景交融，续写以景收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: our ... offers a wide range of ..., catering to every ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our summer camp offers a wide range of engaging activities, catering to every interest and ensuring that no participant ever feels left out. （宣传句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: exposure to a wide range of ... broadens ... and cultivates ...
advancedExpressions.example: Exposure to a wide range of subjects and cultures not only broadens the mind but also cultivates the tolerance on which a harmonious society depends.

sentenceUpgrade.original: There were many kinds of books in the library.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The library housed a remarkable range of books — from yellowed classics that smelled of another century to gleaming new volumes on distant galaxies — each one a silent door waiting to be opened. （读后续写·场景+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: a remarkable range of 升级 many kinds + 破折号插入具象细节 + a silent door 比喻收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should learn many different subjects.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that students should be exposed to as wide a range of subjects as possible, for a mind stretched by diverse knowledge never truly returns to its original narrow dimensions. （议论文·全面发展）

original_sentence: Flexibility training, including gymnastics and tai chi, helps stretch your muscles and improve your body's range of movement.
readingExamples: Flexibility training, including gymnastics and tai chi, helps stretch your muscles and improve your body's range of movement.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an act of changing physical location or position, or of having this changed
(2) n. a group of people who share the same ideas or aims and work together to achieve a social, political or artistic goal
(3) n. the process of developing or changing over a period of time; a general tendency
(4) n. one of the main divisions of a longer piece of music such as a symphony

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 运动，活动；动作（身体位置的改变；具体动作可数，泛指运动多不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: A sudden movement caught her eye. 一个突然的动作引起了她的注意。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （有共同目标的）社会/政治/艺术运动
uncommonMeanings.example: She joined the environmental movement. 她加入了环保运动。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （乐曲的）乐章
uncommonMeanings.example: As the final movement of the symphony swelled to its climax, the old conductor's hands trembled, and a single tear traced its way down his weathered cheek. （读后续写·音乐会·艺术感动）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （钟表等的）机件，机芯
uncommonMeanings.example: The watchmaker held the delicate movement up to the light, marvelling at how hundreds of tiny gears could measure out a human life second by second. （读后续写·匠人·细节特写）

posExamples.sentence: A sudden movement in the bushes made her freeze; heart pounding, she strained her eyes into the darkness, half expecting the fox she had been feeding all winter to emerge at last. （读后续写·紧张时刻·环境描写）

I am writing to invite you to join our school's tree-planting movement, an initiative through which hundreds of students are working together to make our campus greener and our planet healthier. （应用文·邀请信）
The environmental movement of recent decades has taught us a vital lesson: lasting change is never the work of one hero, but the accumulated effort of countless ordinary people. （议论文·社会变革）
Flexibility training helps improve your body's range of movement, allowing you to bend, stretch and twist with far greater ease as the years go by. （应用文·健康科普）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：①泛指'运动、移动'时 movement 多不可数（freedom of movement）；指'一个具体动作'或'一场运动/一个乐章'时可数（a sudden movement / a social movement / the second movement）。②move v. → movement n.（动作/运动）→ moving adj.（动人的）→ movingly adv.

collocations.translation: 身体的活动范围（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Flexibility training, including gymnastics and tai chi, helps stretch your muscles and improve your body's range of movement. 柔韧性训练能拉伸肌肉、改善身体的活动范围。（课文原句）
Weeks of daily stretching gradually restored the full range of movement in her injured shoulder, and she wept with relief the first time she could reach the top shelf again. （读后续写·康复·励志）
The anti-plastic social movement gained momentum overnight after a viral video exposed the devastating impact of waste on marine life. （议论文·环保）
The bulky spacesuit severely limited the astronaut's freedom of movement, turning even the simplest task into an exhausting struggle. （读后续写·太空·困境）
He made a slight movement towards the door, and instantly every eye in the silent courtroom turned to follow him. （读后续写·法庭·悬念）
The civil rights movement reminds us that justice, once demanded loudly enough by enough people, cannot be denied forever. （议论文·公平正义）

collocations.translation: 军队 / 交通的调动、流动
collocations.example: Satellite images revealed unusual troop movement along the border, prompting an emergency meeting of world leaders. （应用文·新闻报道）

collocations.translation: 优雅的 / 突然的 / 生硬的动作
collocations.example: With one graceful movement, the dancer swept across the stage, and the audience held its collective breath. （读后续写·舞蹈·画面感）

collocations.phrase: the movement towards / away from sth
collocations.translation: 朝向 / 远离某事物的趋势
collocations.example: In education there is a growing movement towards project-based learning, where curiosity, rather than the textbook, drives the classroom. （议论文·教育改革）

synonyms.example: The gentle rocking motion of the boat soon lulled the exhausted sailors to sleep. （读后续写·海上·平静）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：motion 更强调物理上连续的运动状态或过程，多用于科学、机械语境，且 in motion（运动中）为固定搭配；movement 既可指具体动作，也可指社会/艺术运动，涵盖面更广

synonyms.example: Our recycling campaign collected over two tonnes of paper in a single week, exceeding everyone's expectations. （应用文·活动总结）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：campaign 指为达成特定短期目标而组织的一系列具体行动，有明确起止和策划，常搭配 launch/run a campaign；movement 指持续更长、参与更广、目标更宏大的社会思潮或潮流

synonyms.example: With a single warm gesture, she waved the shivering stranger inside, and the whole atmosphere of the room seemed to soften. （读后续写·善意·细节）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：gesture 特指手、头或身体表达含义的姿势动作，还可引申为象征性的表示（a gesture of goodwill）；movement 泛指任何身体位置的改变，不必带表意功能

advancedExpressions.expression: range of movement 活动幅度 / freedom of movement 行动自由 / a social (political) movement 社会（政治）运动 / make a movement 做出动作 / the movement towards sth 朝……的趋势
advancedExpressions.example: The tai chi master's every movement flowed into the next, as smooth as water. 太极大师的每个动作都行云流水般连贯。

advancedExpressions.expression: 动词 + 名词后缀 -ment 构成抽象名词：move → movement, develop → development, achieve → achievement, argue → argument（注意去 e）。
advancedExpressions.example: The slow movement of the crowd showed their reluctance to leave. 人群缓慢的移动显示出他们不愿离去。

advancedExpressions.expression: with a single ... movement, sb. did ...
advancedExpressions.example: With a single, deliberate movement, he slid the letter across the table — and in that gesture lay years of unspoken apology. （用动作外化情感,以细节收束段落）

advancedExpressions.expression: join / be part of a movement that ...
advancedExpressions.example: By taking part in this clean-energy movement, each of us becomes not a bystander but an author of a greener tomorrow. （对比 bystander/author 增强号召力）

advancedExpressions.expression: every great movement begins with ...
advancedExpressions.example: Every great movement begins not with a crowd, but with a single conscience refusing to stay silent — history has proved this time and again. （否定对比 + 抽象名词升华论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She saw something move and got scared.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A faint movement at the edge of the clearing caught her eye; before her mind could name the shape, her body had already gone rigid with primal fear, every muscle poised between fight and flight. （读后续写·恐惧·环境+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词作主语(A faint movement...caught her eye) + before从句制造时间差 + 身体化描写(gone rigid, every muscle poised) + 术语化短语(fight and flight)

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What began as a handful of volunteers picking up litter has swelled into a nationwide movement, proving that even the smallest act, when multiplied by millions of willing hands, can reshape the fate of a planet. （议论文·环保）

classPractice.note: 课文原句；move v. → movement n.，range of movement 活动幅度

classPractice.note: '社会运动'用 movement；motion 多指物理运动状态

original_sentence: Above all, choose activities you enjoy because, in this way, you're more likely to stick with them.
readingExamples: Above all, choose activities you enjoy because, in this way, you're more likely to stick with them.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to continue doing something or using something, especially when it is difficult, rather than changing to something else
(2) phr. v. to stay close to someone and not leave them
(3) phr. v. (of a memory, feeling or idea) to remain in your mind for a long time
(4) phr. v. to continue to support or remain loyal to someone during difficult times

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 坚持（做某事），持续使用（尤指困难时不换、不放弃；= stick to）
uncommonMeanings.example: Choose activities you enjoy, and you're more likely to stick with them. 选你喜欢的活动，你更可能坚持下去。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对（某人）不离不弃，忠于（尤指困境中）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the whole village turned its back on him, only his old friend stuck with him. 当全村都背弃他时，只有老友对他不离不弃。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （记忆、话语等）长久留在脑海中，难以忘怀
uncommonMeanings.example: Long after the applause had faded, one line of her speech stuck with him — 'Failure is only the tuition you pay for success' — and it quietly rewrote the course of his life. （读后续写·启发·主题升华）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 紧跟着（某人），不离开
uncommonMeanings.example: 'Stick with me and you won't get lost,' the old guide whispered, and the frightened children clutched at his coat as the fog swallowed the mountain path. （读后续写·登山·信任）

posExamples.sentence: Everyone told her the diet was too strict to keep up, but she stuck with it week after week, and when the mirror finally showed the person she had fought so hard to become, she could not stop the tears. （读后续写·坚持·蜕变）
Above all, choose an activity you truly enjoy, for only then are you likely to stick with it long enough to reap the rewards that a healthy body brings. （应用文·健康建议信）
In an age of endless distractions, those who succeed are rarely the most gifted; they are simply the ones who stick with a single goal long after others have drifted away. （议论文·毅力与专注）
When the whole village turned its back on him, only his childhood friend stuck with him, sharing his hardship without a word of complaint. （读后续写·忠诚·友情）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：①stick 为不规则动词，stick-stuck-stuck，过去式过去分词均为 stuck。②stick with 为不及物短语动词，后须直接接宾语（人/物），代词宾语放于短语后：stick with them（√ 课文），不可拆分。③近义辨析：stick with 侧重'相伴不换'，stick to 侧重'恪守规则/路线'。

idioms.example: 'I know it's hard now,' the coach said, gripping the boy's shoulder, 'but stick with it — champions are made in exactly these moments.' （读后续写·教练·激励）

idioms.idiom: stick with sb through thick and thin
idioms.translation: 与某人同甘共苦，患难与共
idioms.example: Through every failure and every fresh start, his wife stuck with him through thick and thin. 无论失败还是重新开始，妻子始终与他患难与共。

collocations.translation: 【课件】坚持（计划、活动、路线等）（= stick to）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（话语、记忆等）长久留在某人心中，难以忘怀

collocations.phrase: most important of all（= Above all）

collocations.phrase: you're more likely to stick with them
collocations.translation: 你更有可能坚持下去（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Above all, choose activities you enjoy because, in this way, you're more likely to stick with them. 最重要的是，选择你喜欢的活动，因为这样你更有可能坚持下去。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 坚持（做某事）；对某人不离不弃（=stick to；宾语多为人、活动、选择）
collocations.example: If you stick with it, you'll see results. 只要坚持下去，你就会看到成效。

collocations.translation: 坚持某个计划 / 决定
collocations.example: Once she had made up her mind to study abroad, she stuck with the decision despite every doubt her relatives poured on her. （读后续写·抉择·坚定）
Rather than chasing fancy techniques, the wise coach advised the beginners to stick with the basics until each movement became second nature. （应用文·训练指导）

collocations.translation: 坚持某个习惯 / 日常
collocations.example: If you can stick with a simple morning routine for just three weeks, you will be astonished at how much calmer and more focused your days become. （应用文·习惯养成）

collocations.phrase: stick with sb through thick and thin
collocations.example: A true friend is not the one who cheers your triumphs, but the one who sticks with you through thick and thin. （议论文·友谊本质）
Feeling overwhelmed by the crowd, he decided to stick with what he knew and simply told his own honest story on stage. （读后续写·演讲·从容）

collocations.translation: 坚守一份工作 / 职业
collocations.example: Despite the low pay, she stuck with teaching for thirty years, and the letters from grateful students now fill an entire drawer. （读后续写·奉献·人物）

collocations.translation: 专注于某个学科 / 话题
collocations.example: If you stick with one subject long enough to truly master it, you will find that curiosity, not pressure, becomes your fuel. （议论文·学习方法）

synonyms.translation: 遵守，坚持（原则、路线、事实）
synonyms.example: No matter how the others tried to tempt him, he stuck to his principles and refused the bribe. （议论文·诚信）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：stick to 更常搭配抽象的规则、承诺、路线、事实（stick to the rules / facts / point / plan）；stick with 更常搭配人、活动、选择，含相伴、不离弃之意。二者在'坚持某计划/活动'时常可互换

synonyms.example: Even as sponsors withdrew one by one, the young inventor persisted with her project, convinced that the world simply was not ready yet. （读后续写·坚持·励志）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：persist with 更正式书面，常暗含面对反对或困难仍执意坚持，略带固执；句法上也可 persist in doing sth。stick with 更口语、更中性，强调不轻易改变、保持忠诚

synonyms.example: 'Keep at it,' her mentor urged, 'and one day the door that seems locked forever will suddenly swing open.' （读后续写·鼓励·希望）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：keep at 强调持续努力、反复投入某项艰难任务的过程，动作感强，宾语多为事/it；stick with 更强调不放弃、不更换的选择与忠诚，状态感强

advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】stick with (to) 坚持（人/计划/路线） / stick out (vt.) 伸出、探出，(vi.) 醒目、显眼 / stick to 坚持、信守（to 为介词） / be (get) stuck in 陷入、困在……中
advancedExpressions.example: Once you make a decision, stick to it; and however hard things get, don't let yourself get stuck in doubt. 一旦做了决定就坚持；无论多难，也别让自己困在犹疑里。（PPT stick 短语群一句串记）

advancedExpressions.expression: stick with 坚持（人/活动）= stick to（规则/路线） / stick with it 坚持下去 / stick with sb through thick and thin 患难与共 / stick out 突出，坚持到底 / stick together 团结一致
advancedExpressions.example: Choose an activity you love and stick with it — that is the secret of every lifelong exerciser. 选一项你热爱的运动并坚持下去，这就是每个终身健身者的秘诀。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·坚持不放弃（供替换升级）

advancedExpressions.expression: however hard it grew, sb. refused to ... and stuck with ...
advancedExpressions.example: However hard the training grew, she refused to quit and stuck with it, until the very obstacle that had once broken her became the ladder that raised her up. （让步状语 + 隐喻转折,续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: if you stick with ..., you will find that ...

advancedExpressions.expression: success rarely belongs to the gifted; it belongs to those who stick with ...
advancedExpressions.example: Success rarely belongs to the most gifted; more often, it belongs to those who stick with a single goal long after applause and enthusiasm have faded away. （对比句式 + 时间状语强化毅力主题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She didn't give up and kept doing it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Where others surrendered at the first sign of pain, she gritted her teeth and stuck with it, driven by a quiet conviction that the summit rewards only those who refuse to turn back. （读后续写·坚持·对比+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Where-引导对比状语从句 + 动作细节(gritted her teeth) + driven by过去分词状语揭示动机 + 隐喻(summit rewards)升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should stick with our goals.
