original_sentence: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
readingExamples: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
definitionEn:
(1) n. (British English) a liquid fuel obtained from petroleum, used mainly for powering engines in cars, motorcycles and similar vehicles (American English: gasoline / gas)
(2) n. this fuel considered as a commodity whose price affects transport and daily life

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 汽油（英式英语，不可数；美式英语作 gasoline / gas）
uncommonMeanings.example: The car runs on petrol. 这辆车以汽油为燃料。

posExamples.sentence: The tank ran dry on the loneliest stretch of the highway; as the last drops of petrol were used up, the engine coughed, spluttered and died, leaving them stranded beneath a vast and indifferent sky. （读后续写·公路·困境）
To reduce our school's carbon footprint, I suggest that we encourage teachers to cycle to work instead of driving, thereby cutting both petrol costs and harmful emissions. （应用文·环保倡议书）
As the price of petrol continues to soar, more and more families are being pushed towards public transport — a shift that may, ironically, prove a blessing for our choking cities. （议论文·能源与环境）
Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy, so skipping breakfast before a workout is like setting off on a long journey with an empty tank. （应用文·健康科普·类比）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：①petrol 为不可数名词，不加 s，'一些汽油'用 some petrol，不用 a petrol。②英美差异：英 petrol = 美 gasoline / gas；英 petrol station = 美 gas station。③固定搭配 run on petrol'以汽油为动力'，run on 后接能源，是本课的比喻源（人 run on carbohydrates）。

collocations.translation: 以汽油为燃料的汽车（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy. 就像以汽油为燃料的汽车一样，你的身体燃烧碳水化合物来获取能量。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 以汽油为燃料（run on + 燃料）
collocations.example: Most older cars still run on petrol, but the streets are slowly filling with the near-silent hum of electric vehicles. （议论文·科技变革）

collocations.translation: 加油站（英式；美式 gas station）
collocations.example: The dim petrol station on the edge of town was the last sign of human life before the road plunged into endless forest. （读后续写·公路·氛围）
They ran out of petrol miles from the nearest town, and the only sound was the wind rattling through the empty desert. （读后续写·公路·孤立无援）
Before the long drive home, her father pulled into the station to fill up with petrol, humming an old song she would remember for the rest of her life. （读后续写·父女·温情）
Rising petrol prices have forced many commuters to rethink their daily habits, and cycling lanes across the city have never been busier. （议论文·经济与生活）
Compared with a petrol engine, an electric motor releases no exhaust fumes, offering city dwellers a rare breath of cleaner air. （议论文·环保科技）
The mechanic reminded her to use only unleaded petrol, warning that the wrong fuel could quietly ruin the engine over time. （应用文·说明·提示）

synonyms.translation: 汽油（美式英语，常缩写 gas）
synonyms.example: In America they call it gasoline, or simply 'gas', and the price on the roadside signboards is a topic of endless conversation. （应用文·文化说明）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：gasoline（缩写 gas）是美式英语用词，与英式 petrol 完全同义；二者均不可数。高考写作以英式为主时用 petrol，涉及美国背景语篇可用 gasoline/gas。注意 gas 在英式里另指'煤气/气体'

synonyms.example: As fossil fuel reserves dwindle, scientists are racing to develop cleaner alternatives before it is too late. （议论文·能源）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：fuel 是燃料的统称，涵盖汽油、柴油、天然气、煤等一切能源，作可数或不可数；petrol 只是 fuel 中专供内燃机使用的一种液体燃料，范围窄得多

synonyms.example: Heavy lorries usually run on diesel rather than petrol, which is why their engines sound so much deeper and heavier. （应用文·科普说明）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：diesel（柴油）与 petrol（汽油）是两种不同的液体燃料，燃烧方式和适用车型不同，不可混用；卡车、公交多用 diesel，普通轿车多用 petrol

advancedExpressions.expression: run on petrol 以汽油为燃料 / a petrol station 加油站 / run out of petrol 汽油耗尽 / fill up with petrol 加满油 / a petrol engine 汽油发动机 / petrol prices 油价
advancedExpressions.example: The car ran out of petrol far from any petrol station. 汽车在远离任何加油站的地方没油了。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·英美用词对照（供替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: petrol（英）= gasoline / gas（美）汽油；petrol station（英）= gas station（美）加油站；lorry（英）= truck（美）卡车
advancedExpressions.example: Fill the tank with petrol before the journey. 出发前把油箱加满汽油。

advancedExpressions.expression: as the last of the petrol ..., sb. realized ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the last of the petrol drained away and the engine fell silent, she realized that help, if it came at all, would have to come from within herself. （环境细节外化心理绝境,续写转折段）

advancedExpressions.expression: by cutting our reliance on petrol, we can ...
advancedExpressions.example: By cutting our reliance on petrol and embracing greener transport, we can hand the next generation a city where the air is worth breathing. （by+动名词手段状语,倡议信呼吁段）

advancedExpressions.expression: the age of petrol is giving way to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The age of petrol is quietly giving way to an era of clean energy — not because oil has run out, but because humanity has, at last, learned to look further ahead. （give way to 隐喻时代更替 + not because...but 深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The car had no petrol, so it stopped.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Starved of petrol, the old car shuddered, gave one final cough and rolled to a halt at the roadside, stranding them in a silence so deep they could hear their own hearts pounding. （读后续写·抛锚·感官描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作状语(Starved of petrol) + 拟人化连续动词(shuddered, coughed, rolled) + 结果状语渲染(a silence so deep...) + 感官细节(hear their own hearts)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We use too much petrol and it pollutes the air.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Our stubborn dependence on petrol not only drains a finite resource but also thickens the very air our children must breathe — a debt, one fears, that future generations will be left to repay. （议论文·环保）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象名词短语作主语(Our stubborn dependence) + not only...but also 递进 + the very...强调 + 破折号引出隐喻(a debt...to repay)升华

classPractice.question: Like cars that ____ ____ petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；run on + 燃料，'以……为动力'

classPractice.note: 英式汽油为 petrol，美式为 gasoline/gas；diesel 是柴油，fuel 是统称

classPractice.note: run out of petrol 汽油耗尽；petrol station 加油站（英式）

original_sentence: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
readingExamples: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of several substances, such as sugar or starch, that consist of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen and provide the body with energy
(2) n. (usually plural) foods such as bread, rice, pasta and potatoes that are high in this substance and are a major source of energy in the diet

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 碳水化合物（由碳、氢、氧构成、为人体供能的物质，如糖、淀粉；口语缩写 carb）
uncommonMeanings.example: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrates. 米饭和面包富含碳水化合物。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用复数）碳水食物（如面包、米饭、面食、土豆，饮食中的主要能量来源）
uncommonMeanings.example: Runners often eat plenty of carbohydrates before a race. 跑步者常在比赛前大量摄入碳水食物。

posExamples.sentence: Halfway up the final slope, her legs turned to lead; the coach thrust a banana into her hand, urging her to take in some quick carbohydrates before her body simply refused to go on. （读后续写·长跑·体能极限）

To keep your energy steady throughout the exam, I would advise you to eat slow-release carbohydrates such as oats for breakfast rather than sugary snacks that leave you crashing an hour later. （应用文·备考建议信）
While many dieters demonise carbohydrates as the enemy, nutritionists insist that the real problem lies not in the nutrient itself but in the excess and the poor choices we make. （议论文·健康饮食）
Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy, which is why a marathon runner loads up on pasta the night before the big race. （应用文·科普·类比）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：①作'碳水食物'讲时常用复数 carbohydrates（burn carbohydrates 课文）。②口语缩写为 carb / carbs（low-carb diet 低碳饮食）。③构词：carbo-（碳）+ hydrate（含水化合物），故重音在 -hy-：/ˌkɑːbəʊˈhaɪdreɪt/。

collocations.phrase: your body burns carbohydrates for energy
collocations.translation: 你的身体燃烧碳水化合物来获取能量（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy. 就像以汽油为燃料的汽车一样，你的身体燃烧碳水化合物来获取能量。（课文原句）
During intense exercise the body burns carbohydrates far faster than fat, which is why endurance athletes must keep refuelling on the move. （应用文·运动科普）

collocations.translation: 复合 / 简单碳水化合物
collocations.example: Complex carbohydrates, unlike their simple cousins, release energy slowly and steadily, keeping hunger and fatigue at bay for hours. （议论文·科学饮食）
Foods rich in carbohydrates, from rice to sweet potatoes, have fuelled human labour and endurance for thousands of years. （应用文·营养说明）
Whole grains are an excellent source of carbohydrates, offering both lasting energy and the fibre your body needs. （应用文·健康指南）
Determined to lose weight for the marathon, he cut down on carbohydrates too drastically and soon found himself dizzy and drained at every training session. （读后续写·减肥·教训）

collocations.translation: 将碳水化合物储存为能量
collocations.example: The body cleverly stores surplus carbohydrates as energy reserves, ready to be called upon the moment demand suddenly rises. （议论文·人体科学）
By carefully balancing her carbohydrate intake with her training load, the young cyclist gradually transformed from an amateur into a national contender. （读后续写·成长·自律）

synonyms.example: 'Load up on carbs the night before,' the veteran runner grinned, 'and your legs will thank you at the twentieth mile.' （读后续写·跑步·对话）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：carbs 是 carbohydrates 的非正式口语缩写，多用于对话、健身、日常语境；正式科普、说明文或书面写作中仍应使用完整词 carbohydrate

synonyms.example: Potatoes are packed with starch, a form of carbohydrate that has kept whole nations fed through hard winters. （应用文·科普）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：starch（淀粉）是复合碳水化合物的一种具体形式，存在于米、面、土豆中，多不可数；carbohydrate 是上位概念，还包括糖类等其他成分，范围更大

synonyms.example: Too much added sugar spikes your energy briefly, then drops it just as fast, leaving you hungrier than before. （议论文·饮食健康）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：sugar（糖）是简单碳水化合物，吸收快、供能快但不持久；carbohydrate 涵盖糖与淀粉等全部类型，复合碳水供能更缓慢平稳，营养价值上二者不能等同

advancedExpressions.expression: burn carbohydrates for energy 燃烧碳水供能 / rich in carbohydrates 富含碳水 / a source of carbohydrates 碳水来源 / cut down on carbohydrates 减少碳水摄入 / complex (simple) carbohydrates 复合（简单）碳水 / carbohydrate intake 碳水摄入量
advancedExpressions.example: Athletes load up on complex carbohydrates to burn for energy during long races. 运动员摄入大量复合碳水，以在长距离比赛中燃烧供能。

advancedExpressions.expression: carbo-（碳，源自 carbon）+ hydrate（水合物）合成为 carbohydrate 碳水化合物；同源 carbon（碳）、carbon dioxide（二氧化碳）、hydrogen（氢）。口语缩写 carb。
advancedExpressions.example: Carbohydrates are made of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen. 碳水化合物由碳、氢、氧组成。

advancedExpressions.expression: with the last of her carbohydrates ..., sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the last of her carbohydrates spent, her legs screamed in protest, yet somehow she willed one trembling step after another towards the finish line. （生理细节外化意志力,续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: choosing the right carbohydrates can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Choosing the right carbohydrates — whole grains over refined sugar — can steady your energy, sharpen your focus and carry you through even the longest school day. （动名词主语 + 破折号举例,建议信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: carbohydrates are neither villain nor hero; the truth lies in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Carbohydrates are neither villain nor hero; the truth, as so often in science, lies not in the nutrient itself but in the wisdom and moderation of how we use it. （neither...nor 破除偏见 + not in...but in 深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She ate some carbohydrates to get energy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Sensing her strength ebbing away, she reached for a handful of dried dates, letting the sweet carbohydrates flood her weary muscles with a fresh, urgent surge of energy. （读后续写·补能·感官描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语揭示动机(Sensing her strength ebbing) + 具体细节(a handful of dried dates) + 拟人化动词(flood, surge) + 术语自然融入(carbohydrates)

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a...misconception that...形式主语破除误解 + yet 转折限定语 + in reality 转折论证 + the very...强调 + since从句拉长时间纵深

original_sentence: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
readingExamples: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the physical and mental strength that allows you to be active and to do things
(2) n. the power that comes from sources such as electricity, coal or oil and is used to make machines work and produce heat
(3) n. (in physics) the ability of matter or radiation to do work, existing in various forms such as heat, light and motion
(4) n. (usually plural: energies) your enthusiasm and effort directed towards a particular activity or purpose

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 精力，体力（使人活跃做事的身心力量；不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: The children are always full of energy. 孩子们总是精力充沛。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 能源（来自电、煤、油等的动力，供机器运转、产生热量）
uncommonMeanings.example: We should develop clean energy. 我们应当开发清洁能源。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 能量（物理学：物质做功的能力，如热能、光能、动能）
uncommonMeanings.example: The body burns carbohydrates for energy. 身体燃烧碳水化合物来获取能量。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数 energies）精力，心力（投入某事的努力）
uncommonMeanings.example: For three long years she poured all her energies into a single invention, sacrificing sleep, friendships and comfort, until the world finally caught up with her vision. （读后续写·奋斗·执着）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人或场合散发的）气场，活力氛围
uncommonMeanings.example: The moment the new teacher walked in, the whole classroom shifted; there was an energy about her that made even the sleepiest students sit up and lean forward. （读后续写·人物出场·感染力）

posExamples.sentence: By the last mile her energy was almost gone, yet the sight of her little brother waving frantically at the finish line sent a sudden, electric surge through her aching limbs. （读后续写·比赛·意志）
I am writing to propose that our school switch to solar energy, a clean and renewable source that would not only cut costs but also set a powerful example for the whole community. （应用文·建议信）
As the world's demand for energy soars, the question is no longer whether we can afford to invest in renewables, but whether we can afford not to. （议论文·能源与未来）
Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy, so a balanced breakfast is the surest way to power through a demanding morning. （应用文·健康科普·类比）

wordForms.other: 小贴士：①energy 作'能量、精力、能源'讲通常不可数（a lot of energy）；表'（投入某事的）精力'可用复数 energies（devote one's energies to）。②词族：energy n. → energetic adj.（精力充沛的）→ energetically adv. → energize v.（使充满活力）。③形近搭配 be full of energy = be energetic 精力充沛。

idioms.idiom: throw / pour one's energy into sth
idioms.example: Instead of mourning what he had lost, he threw all his energy into rebuilding the shelter, and in that furious labour he slowly found his way back to hope. （读后续写·重建·心理转折）

collocations.translation: 燃烧碳水化合物来获取能量（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Like cars that run on petrol, your body burns carbohydrates for energy. 就像以汽油为燃料的汽车一样，你的身体燃烧碳水化合物来获取能量。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 消耗能量（运动/身体供能）
collocations.example: The harder you train, the more energy you burn. 你训练得越努力，消耗的能量就越多。
Fresh from a good night's sleep, the children burst onto the playground full of energy, their laughter echoing off the frosty morning air. （读后续写·童年·清晨）

collocations.translation: 太阳能 / 风能 / 核能
collocations.example: Rows of gleaming panels now harvest solar energy where a barren hillside once stood, powering thousands of homes below. （议论文·科技·环保）
The town's bold shift to renewable energy transformed it, within a single decade, from a smog-choked backwater into a model of green living. （议论文·环保发展）
Halfway through the double shift she felt herself running out of energy, but the thought of her daughter's school fees kept her hands moving. （读后续写·辛劳·亲情）

collocations.translation: 节约能源 / 节省精力
collocations.example: Simply switching off idle lights and unplugging chargers can conserve a surprising amount of energy over the course of a year. （应用文·节能倡议）
Stop wasting your energy on things you cannot change, the wise old fisherman said, and save it for the tide you can. （读后续写·哲理·对话）
His teacher wisely channelled the restless boy's energy into the football team, and the troublemaker soon became the school's proudest captain. （读后续写·转化·成长）

collocations.translation: 一阵爆发的能量 / 精力
collocations.example: A sudden burst of energy carried her over the final wall, and she collapsed on the other side, laughing and gasping at once. （读后续写·突破·画面感）

synonyms.example: Despite his eighty years, the old gardener still tended his roses with a vigour that put men half his age to shame. （读后续写·人物·反差）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：vigour 更书面文雅，强调旺盛的体力与生命力，常带赞赏色彩，多不可数（with vigour）；energy 是最通用的词，既可指人的精力，也可指物理能量、燃料能源

synonyms.example: Marathon training is less about raw speed and more about the stamina to keep going when every fibre begs you to stop. （议论文·毅力）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：stamina 特指长时间维持体力或脑力活动的耐力、持久力，强调'耐久'；energy 强调当下可用的力量和活力，是即时的'能量储备'

synonyms.example: The storm knocked out the town's power for three days, and neighbours who had barely spoken in years suddenly shared candles and stories. （读后续写·停电·人情）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：power 侧重可用于做功或驱动机器的力量，尤指'电力'；energy 是更抽象的科学概念，涵盖热能、光能、动能等各种形式，也可指人的精力

advancedExpressions.expression: burn energy 消耗能量 / for energy 供能 / full of energy 精力充沛 / solar (wind, nuclear) energy 太阳能（风能、核能） / clean (renewable) energy 清洁（可再生）能源 / conserve energy 节约能源
advancedExpressions.example: Regular exercise burns energy and, surprisingly, leaves you full of energy for the rest of the day. 规律运动消耗能量，却出人意料地让你一整天精力充沛。

advancedExpressions.expression: 名词 energy → 形容词 energetic（-etic 精力充沛的）→ 副词 energetically → 动词 energize（-ize 使充满活力）。be full of energy = be energetic。
advancedExpressions.example: The energetic coach energized the whole team with a single rousing speech. 这位精力充沛的教练用一番激昂的讲话激励了整支队伍。

advancedExpressions.expression: summoning the last of her energy, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Summoning the last of her energy, she flung herself forward, and the finish line — once a distant dream — dissolved beneath her feet at last. （现在分词状语外化意志,续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: by embracing clean energy, we can ...
advancedExpressions.example: By embracing clean energy today, we can ensure that the skies our children inherit are as blue as those our grandparents once knew. （by+动名词手段状语 + 代际对比,倡议信升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: the energy crisis is not merely a problem of supply, but of ...
advancedExpressions.example: The energy crisis is not merely a problem of supply, but of imagination — of whether we dare to reinvent the very way we live. （not merely...but 递进 + 破折号同位语深化论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was tired but kept going.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though every last drop of energy seemed to have drained from her body, she clenched her fists, fixed her eyes on the flickering lights ahead, and drove herself onward through sheer, stubborn will. （读后续写·坚持·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Though让步从句 + 夸张隐喻(every last drop of energy...drained) + 连续动作(clenched, fixed, drove) + through sheer...will 揭示驱动力

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use clean energy to protect the planet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time we turned decisively towards clean energy, for the choices we make in this decade will echo across generations, deciding whether our planet remains a home or becomes a warning. （议论文·环保）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time (that) sb. did...虚拟语气强调紧迫 + for引导原因 + echo across generations 隐喻 + whether...or...对比升华论点

classPractice.note: 课文原句；burn sth for energy 燃烧某物供能，介词用 for

classPractice.note: solar energy 太阳能；此处需名词，非形容词

original_sentence: To help your muscles recover and repair themselves after exercise, you need to eat foods rich in protein, such as fish, eggs and milk products.
readingExamples: To help your muscles recover and repair themselves after exercise, you need to eat foods rich in protein, such as fish, eggs and milk products.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of the natural substances found in food such as meat, eggs, fish and beans that is essential for the body to grow and repair itself
(2) n. (in biology) a large, complex molecule made up of amino acids that performs vital functions in living cells
(3) n. food that is a rich source of this substance, considered as part of the diet

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 蛋白质（存在于肉、蛋、鱼、豆中，为身体生长与修复所必需的营养物质；作物质讲多不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: Fish and eggs are rich in protein. 鱼和蛋富含蛋白质。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生物学）蛋白（由氨基酸构成、在细胞中执行重要功能的大分子；指种类时可数，如 a protein / different proteins）
uncommonMeanings.example: The human body contains thousands of different proteins. 人体含有数千种不同的蛋白质。

posExamples.sentence: After the exhausting climb, the guide handed each of them a strip of dried meat, explaining that the protein would help their trembling muscles recover before the descent began. （读后续写·登山·体能恢复）
For students who train hard after school, I strongly recommend a diet rich in protein — lean meat, eggs and beans — to help your growing bodies repair and strengthen. （应用文·健康建议信）
As more people turn to plant-based diets, scientists remind us that protein need not come from meat alone; beans, nuts and soy can nourish the body just as well. （议论文·饮食与环保）
To help your muscles recover after exercise, you need to eat foods rich in protein, for it is this humble nutrient that quietly rebuilds every fibre you have torn in training. （应用文·运动科普）

wordForms.adjective: protein (作定语，如 protein shake / protein intake)
wordForms.other: 小贴士：①protein 作'蛋白质（这类营养）'讲不可数（rich in protein 课文）；指'某种/多种蛋白'时可数（a protein, proteins）。②近义拓展 rich in = high in = full of，'富含'。③营养三兄弟辨析：carbohydrate 供能、protein 修复肌肉、fat 储能，勿混。

collocations.translation: 富含蛋白质的食物（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: To help your muscles recover and repair themselves after exercise, you need to eat foods rich in protein, such as fish, eggs and milk products. 为了帮助运动后肌肉恢复和自我修复，你需要吃富含蛋白质的食物，如鱼、蛋和奶制品。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: rich in protein / high in protein
collocations.example: Foods rich in protein, such as fish and eggs, give the body the raw material it needs to heal and grow stronger. （应用文·营养说明）
For millions of families across the world, beans remain the cheapest and most reliable source of protein on the table. （议论文·全球饮食）
You cannot build muscle on willpower alone; without enough protein, even the hardest training will leave your body starved and stalled. （读后续写·健身·教训）
Switching part of our animal protein for plant protein can lighten both our waistlines and the burden we place on the planet. （议论文·可持续饮食）
The team doctor carefully monitored each player's protein intake, convinced that recovery was won at the dinner table as much as in the gym. （读后续写·运动·科学训练）
After every workout he gulped down a protein shake, a small ritual that made the aching hours feel worthwhile. （读后续写·健身·日常）
In regions gripped by famine, protein deficiency silently stunts the growth of countless children before they ever reach school age. （议论文·全球健康）

synonyms.example: A balanced meal supplies the full range of nutrients — proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins — that a growing body craves. （应用文·营养科普）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：nutrient 是营养物质的统称，涵盖蛋白质、碳水、脂肪、维生素等一切，可数；protein 只是众多 nutrients 中的一种，范围窄，功能专一（修复、生长）

synonyms.example: When we digest protein, the body breaks it down into amino acids, the tiny building blocks from which it constructs everything from muscle to hormones. （议论文·人体科学）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：amino acids（氨基酸）是构成 protein（蛋白质）的基本单位，属更微观层面，常用复数；protein 是由许多氨基酸连接而成的大分子，二者是'零件'与'成品'的关系

advancedExpressions.expression: rich in (high in) protein 富含蛋白质 / a source of protein 蛋白质来源 / build muscle with protein 靠蛋白质增肌 / plant (animal) protein 植物（动物）蛋白 / protein intake 蛋白质摄入量 / protein deficiency 蛋白质缺乏
advancedExpressions.example: After exercise, eat foods rich in protein to help your muscles recover. 运动后，吃富含蛋白质的食物帮助肌肉恢复。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·rich in protein 后置定语 + such as 举例
advancedExpressions.expression: foods (which are) rich in protein 富含蛋白质的食物（形容词短语 rich in sth 作后置定语，省略 which are）；such as + 名词并列，举例说明。
advancedExpressions.example: You need to eat foods rich in protein, such as fish, eggs and milk products. 你需要吃富含蛋白质的食物，如鱼、蛋和奶制品。（课文原句）

advancedExpressions.expression: the protein slowly did its quiet work, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: As she slept, the protein from that simple meal slowly did its quiet work, knitting together the muscles she had torn, so that by dawn a new strength stirred within her. （拟人化科学过程,续写恢复段）

advancedExpressions.expression: make protein the foundation of ...
advancedExpressions.example: If you truly wish to grow stronger, make protein the foundation of every meal, and let vegetables and grains build upon it. （祈使句 + 建筑隐喻(foundation/build upon),建议信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: the future of protein may lie not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The future of protein may lie not in the crowded feedlots of today, but in the plant fields and laboratories of tomorrow — a shift as kind to the planet as to ourselves. （not...but 对比 + 破折号同位语升华论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He ate protein so his muscles would recover.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Aching in every joint, he forced down the plate of eggs and fish, trusting that the protein would silently rebuild, cell by cell, the body he had pushed to its very limit that afternoon. （读后续写·恢复·细节）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语描写状态(Aching in every joint) + 动作细节(forced down) + trusting分词状语揭示信念 + cell by cell 节奏化副词短语 + which/that省略从句

sentenceUpgrade.original: Protein is important for health, so we should eat enough.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a luxury reserved for athletes, protein is the very scaffolding of a healthy life, and a diet that neglects it quietly undermines the strength on which everything else depends. （议论文·营养）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being...破除误解开头 + the very scaffolding of 建筑隐喻 + and 引出对比结果 + on which定语从句收束论点

classPractice.note: 课文原句；repair themselves 反身代词，主语 muscles；rich in protein 富含蛋白质

classPractice.note: 蛋白质（鱼、蛋）修复肌肉；碳水（米、面）供能，勿混

classPractice.question: Beans are a cheap and reliable ____ ____ protein for families around the world.
classPractice.note: a source of protein 蛋白质的来源

translation: 平均水平，平均数；平均的
original_sentence: In general, you should have your meal an average of 1.5 to 2.5 hours before exercising.
readingExamples: In general, you should have your meal an average of 1.5 to 2.5 hours before exercising.
When you exercise, aim for the daily average of 30 to 60 minutes.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the result you get by adding several amounts together and then dividing the total by the number of amounts
(2) adj. calculated by working out the average of several amounts; ordinary and not special in any way
(3) n. the usual or normal standard, amount, or quality
(4) vt. to be or do something as an average amount over a period of time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】典型的；正常的（无比较级；a fairly average working week 相当正常的）
uncommonMeanings.example: 40 hours is a fairly average working week for most people. 对大多数人来说，一周工作40小时是相当正常的。（PPT原句，义2 typical or normal）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 平均数，平均水平（本义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The average of 4, 6 and 8 is 6. （说明·数据）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 平均的（用平均算出的）
uncommonMeanings.example: The average temperature in July is about 30 degrees. （说明·气候）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 普普通通的，一般般的（含轻微贬义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The critics dismissed his debut novel as painfully average — competent, forgettable, and utterly devoid of the spark that separates a good writer from a great one. （读后续写·人物受挫·被低估）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 平均达到，平均算下来为
uncommonMeanings.example: Throughout that punishing training season, she averaged fifteen kilometres a day, her sneakers wearing thin long before her determination did. （读后续写·励志·坚持训练）

posExamples.sentence: Looking back, that summer had been anything but average: every dawn found us on the track, every dusk left us breathless yet triumphant, chasing a version of ourselves we had only dreamed of. （读后续写·成长回忆·热血夏天）
I am writing to suggest that the sports centre extend its opening hours, since the average student here trains for at least an hour after class and often finds the gym already closed. （应用文·建议信·校园设施）

Statistics reveal that teenagers today spend, on average, over seven hours a day staring at screens — a figure that should alarm every parent and educator concerned about our children's health. （议论文·科技与健康）
It is a dangerous myth that only the naturally gifted succeed; countless average performers, through sheer persistence, have far surpassed those who relied on talent alone. （议论文·努力与天赋）

wordForms.other: averagely (adv. 一般地)

idioms.example: On average, students who exercise regularly report lower levels of anxiety and sharper concentration in class. （议论文·运动益处）

idioms.translation: 高于 / 低于平均水平
idioms.example: Her marks had always hovered below average, so when the teacher read her name as the top scorer, a stunned silence swept the classroom. （读后续写·逆袭·出人意料）

idioms.translation: 平均律（凡事总会趋于平均的规律）
idioms.example: He kept telling himself that, by the law of averages, his luck simply had to turn — yet luck, he would soon learn, favours the diligent, not the hopeful. （读后续写·哲思·顿悟）

collocations.phrase: an average of + 数字（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In general, you should have your meal an average of 1.5 to 2.5 hours before exercising. 一般来说，你应该在运动前平均1.5到2.5小时进餐。（课文/PPT原句）
On average, we receive five letters each day. 我们平均每天会收到5封信。（PPT原句）
These marks are well above average. 这些分数远在平均水平以上。（PPT原句）

collocations.phrase: an average of 10 weeks（n. 一般水平／平均标准）
collocations.translation: 【课件】平均十周（average 作名词，指一般水平、平均标准）
collocations.example: The programme lasts an average of 10 weeks. 这个项目平均持续十周。（PPT归纳，an average of + 数字）

collocations.phrase: the average earnings / an average working week (adj. 平均的/典型的)
collocations.translation: 【课件】平均收入／相当正常的一周工作时间（average 作形容词，无比较级；义2 典型、正常）
collocations.example: The average earnings have increased dramatically in the past ten years. 平均收入在过去十年里大幅增长。40 hours is a fairly average working week for most people. 对大多数人来说，一周工作40小时是相当正常的。（PPT原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】一个普通的学生（average 作形容词，义3 普通、平常、一般）
collocations.example: I was just an average sort of student. 我只是一个普通的学生。（PPT原句）
When you exercise, aim for the daily average of 30 to 60 minutes. 当你锻炼时，目标每天平均30-60分钟。（课文/PPT原句）

collocations.translation: 平均而言，通常（副词性短语，常作插入语）
collocations.example: On average, teenagers sleep fewer than eight hours a night. （议论文·数据）

collocations.translation: 高于 / 低于平均水平
collocations.example: Her performance was well above average. （应用文·评价）

collocations.translation: 普通人 / 一般学生（adj. 普通的）
collocations.example: The average person walks about 7,000 steps a day. （议论文·常识）

collocations.translation: 日 / 周 / 年平均值
collocations.example: When you exercise, aim for the daily average of 30 to 60 minutes recommended by fitness experts. （应用文·健康建议）
Although some days I ran further and others barely at all, it averaged out to a respectable ten kilometres a week. （读后续写·日常坚持）
The survey showed that our school's reading rate stood proudly above the national average, a fruit of years of reading promotion. （应用文·调查报告）

collocations.translation: 普通人 / 一般学生 / 平常的一天
collocations.example: It began as an average day — until a frantic cry for help shattered the quiet and turned an ordinary afternoon into an unforgettable one. （读后续写·平凡日子的转折）
By keeping a detailed error notebook, he lifted his average score by twenty points within a single term. （应用文·学习经验分享）
The temperatures that week averaged out at a pleasant twenty degrees, perfect for our outdoor training camp. （读后续写·夏令营）

collocations.translation: 远高于 / 远低于平均
collocations.example: Her stamina was well above average, allowing her to keep a steady pace long after the others had collapsed onto the grass. （读后续写·体育竞赛）

collocations.translation: 平均律（凡事总会趋于平均的规律）
collocations.example: He kept telling himself that, by the law of averages, his luck simply had to turn — yet luck, he would soon learn, favours the diligent, not the hopeful. （读后续写·哲思·顿悟）

synonyms.example: He seemed an ordinary boy at first glance, yet behind those quiet eyes burned an ambition that would one day astonish us all. （读后续写·人物伏笔）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：ordinary 强调'不特殊、寻常'，侧重性质普通；average 更强调'处于平均水平'，可含数量或标准的比较意味。句法/搭配：两者均可作定语（an ordinary / average day）。

synonyms.example: A typical beginner tends to push too hard on the first day and pay the price with aching muscles for a week. （应用文·健身提醒）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：typical 强调'具有代表性、符合某类特征'；average 强调'居中、不突出'。搭配：'普通一天'常用 average day，'典型例子'用 typical example。

synonyms.example: To find the mean, add up all the scores and divide by the number of tests. （说明·数据分析）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：mean 是数学术语，特指算术平均数，为不可数名词；average 更口语、更常用，日常语境两者常互换，但学术统计中 mean 更精确。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示'平均/通常'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: on average = on the whole = as a rule = generally speaking

advancedExpressions.expression: an average of + 数字 / on average / above ~ below average / the average person

advancedExpressions.expression: average (n./adj./v.) → averagely (adv. 一般地)

advancedExpressions.expression: what had begun as an average ... turned into ...

advancedExpressions.expression: on average, ... , which suggests that ...

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: by every measure 强调平凡 + 破折号插入具象环境细节(grey sky, weary faces) + until 引导剧情突转 + hurled/relive 强动词渲染冲击。

original_sentence: Remember to drink throughout exercise to make up for water lost to sweat.
readingExamples: Remember to drink throughout exercise to make up for water lost to sweat.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. in every part of a place or thing
(2) prep. during the whole of a period of time; from the beginning to the end of something
(3) adv. in or through the whole of something; during the whole of a period; in every part

posExamples.sentence: Throughout that endless night, she sat by her father's hospital bed, gripping his cold hand and whispering the promises she was too frightened to say aloud in daylight. （读后续写·亲情·守夜）
I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to every volunteer who supported us throughout the charity marathon, from the first drop of rain to the final cheer at the finish line. （应用文·感谢信）
The lecture on climate change was gripping from start to finish; the audience remained silent and attentive throughout, hanging on the professor's every word. （议论文·说明·学术场景）
Regular hydration matters at every stage of training: remember to drink throughout exercise to make up for the water lost to sweat and to keep your body performing at its best. （应用文·健身指南）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（在）整个运动过程中；贯穿运动全程
collocations.example: Remember to drink throughout exercise to make up for water lost to sweat. 记得在整个运动过程中都要喝水，以弥补随汗水流失的水分。（课件·Reading 原句）

collocations.translation: （在）整个运动过程中（课文原句）

Our reading club holds engaging events throughout the year. （应用文·社团宣传）

collocations.translation: 一整天 / 一整夜（时间'贯穿'）

Throughout history, it has been the dreamers and the doers, not the doubters, who have pushed civilisation forward. （议论文·历史论证）

collocations.translation: 一生中 / 整个职业生涯
collocations.example: Throughout her life, my grandmother rose before dawn, and it was from her that I learned discipline is a quiet, daily choice. （读后续写·长辈影响）
Our teacher guided us patiently throughout the process, turning what seemed an impossible project into a triumph we all shared. （应用文·活动感悟）
A wave of relief spread throughout the crowd the instant the trapped miners emerged, blinking, into the sunlight. （读后续写·营救成功·群情）

collocations.translation: 自始至终保持冷静 / 一致（throughout 作副词，句末）
collocations.example: Despite the mounting pressure, the captain remained calm throughout, and his steady voice held the panicked passengers together. （读后续写·危机·领导力）

synonyms.example: During the storm, we huddled in the cabin, listening to the wind howl like a wounded beast. （读后续写·风暴）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：during 指'在某段时间之内'，不强调贯穿始终；throughout 强调'从头到尾、每一刻'，语气更完整、更绝对。句法：两者均为介词后接名词，不接句子。

synonyms.example: The joyful news travelled all over the small town within an hour. （读后续写·喜讯传播）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：all over 偏口语，多指'空间上到处'；throughout 既可指空间'遍及'也可指时间'贯穿'，更书面、更正式。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·throughout 一词两性（prep. & adv.）
advancedExpressions.expression: throughout + 名词（介词） / 句末单独用 throughout（副词）

advancedExpressions.expression: throughout ..., sb. did ..., never once ...

advancedExpressions.expression: throughout the whole ..., your ... meant the world to us

advancedExpressions.expression: throughout history, ... has proven that ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: She stayed with him all night.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Throughout that long, sleepless night, she never left his side, her fingers laced through his as if her grip alone could anchor him to the world. （读后续写·守护·心理描写）

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: throughout the nation 替代'everywhere'更凝练 + rippled 比喻传播如涟漪 + uniting...in a chorus 拟人化+抽象具象化，气势更足。

classPractice.question: Remember to drink ____ exercise to make up for water lost to sweat. （在整个运动过程中，课件·Reading 原句）

original_sentence: Remember to drink throughout exercise to make up for water lost to sweat.

definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to replace something that has been lost, or to provide something good so that something bad seems less important
(2) phr. v. to do something in order to correct a bad situation or to compensate for a mistake or shortcoming
(3) phr. v. to compensate for a deficiency or loss of time, money, or opportunity

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·make up 多义】编造（故事、借口）；make up a story / an excuse
uncommonMeanings.example: I think it's very unkind of you to make up stories about him. 我觉得你编造关于他的故事很不厚道。（课件原题）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·make up 多义】化妆；打扮成（make sb up as...）
uncommonMeanings.example: She spent too much time making herself up. 她花太多时间化妆了。（课件原题）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·make up 多义】构成，形成；be made up of 由……构成
uncommonMeanings.example: North Africans make up the largest and poorest immigrant group in the country. 北非人构成了该国最大也最贫穷的移民群体。（课件原题）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·make up 多义】（与某人）和解，言归于好（make up with sb）

posExamples.sentence: No apology could ever make up for the years he had missed, yet as he pulled his daughter into a trembling embrace, he silently vowed to spend every remaining day earning back her trust. （读后续写·父女·弥补遗憾）

collocations.translation: 【课件】有道理，有意义 / 理解，弄懂

synonyms.usage: 语义差别：compensate for 更正式、书面，常用于赔偿、抵偿正式损失；make up for 更口语、更常用。句法：均为'及物短语 + for + 宾语'结构，宾语可为名词或 doing。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'防止/阻止'（辨用可替换）

advancedExpressions.example: Nothing could prevent / stop / keep him from chasing his dream. （三者均接 from doing，keep/stop 的 from 不可省）

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing could prevent sb from doing ...
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing could prevent him from plunging into the freezing river, for the drowning child's cry had drowned out every thought of his own safety. （'nothing could prevent'强调义无反顾，续写高潮渲染无畏）

advancedExpressions.expression: to prevent ..., we should take measures such as ...
advancedExpressions.example: To prevent such accidents, we should take practical measures such as installing warning signs and organising regular safety drills. （倡议信提出对策，条理清晰）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is far wiser to prevent ... than to cure ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is far wiser to prevent a problem at its root than to scramble for a cure once the damage is done. （对比论证句式，突出'防重于治'的观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He ran to stop the boy from falling off the bridge.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a second's hesitation, he lunged forward and seized the boy's collar, preventing him from tumbling over the crumbling edge of the bridge into the churning water below. （读后续写·舍身相救）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Without a second's hesitation 状语渲染当机立断 + lunged/seized 强动词 + preventing...from 分词短语承接结果 + churning water below 环境烘托危险。

sentenceUpgrade.original: We must do something to stop these accidents.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than lamenting each tragedy after it strikes, we must act now — enforcing stricter rules and raising awareness — to prevent such accidents from ever claiming another life. （议论文·呼吁行动）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than 对比立论 + act now 破折号插入具体措施(enforcing, raising) + prevent...from claiming another life 拟人化+悲情收束，强化呼吁力度。

classPractice.note: 还原课文原句：不定式 To prevent... 作目的状语置于句首。

classPractice.question: This simple warm-up will prevent you ____ getting hurt during intense training.
classPractice.note: prevent sb from doing sth；主动语态中 from 虽可省，但含 sb 宾语时高考多要求补出 from。

original_sentence: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and equipment when exercising.
readingExamples: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and equipment when exercising.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the mass of cells that form the body of a plant, animal, or human, or a particular type of such cells
(2) n. a piece of soft thin paper used especially for blowing your nose
(3) n. soft thin paper used for wrapping or protecting delicate objects
(4) n. (formal) a series of connected false statements or events forming a whole

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生物）组织（细胞的集合，此义不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: Exercise strengthens the muscle tissue over time. （说明·健康）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 纸巾，面巾纸（此义可数，a tissue / tissues）
uncommonMeanings.example: She handed him a tissue to wipe his tears. （日常·安慰）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】一套（谎言、废话等）；编织物（a tissue of lies）
uncommonMeanings.example: His explanation, once she examined it in the cold light of morning, turned out to be nothing but a tissue of lies, each thread pulling loose the moment she tugged at it. （读后续写·真相揭露·信任崩塌）

posExamples.sentence: When the old man finally broke down, she wordlessly pressed a tissue into his trembling hand, and in that small gesture he felt, for the first time in years, that someone truly understood his grief. （读后续写·情感·无声的安慰）
To prevent soft tissue injury during our upcoming charity marathon, we strongly advise all participants to warm up thoroughly and wear supportive footwear before setting off. （应用文·活动通知）
Regular moderate exercise strengthens not only the muscles but also the deeper connective tissue, which many young people neglect until an injury forces them to reconsider their habits. （议论文·健康与运动）

idioms.example: The confident smile faded from his face as the detective, one calm question at a time, unravelled the entire tissue of lies he had spent weeks constructing. （读后续写·揭穿·心理反转）

collocations.example: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and equipment when exercising. （课文原句）
She kept a box of tissues on the windowsill, half-expecting the tears that always came when autumn rain streaked down the glass. （读后续写·环境+心理）
As the final scene of the film unfolded, half the audience reached for a tissue, moved by a reunion that felt achingly real. （读后续写·观影·共情）
He wrapped the fragile porcelain figure in tissue paper as tenderly as if it were a sleeping child. （读后续写·细节·珍视）

collocations.translation: 脑 / 肌肉 / 肺组织（组织义，不可数）
collocations.example: The documentary explained how sustained physical activity increases the oxygen supply to brain tissue, sharpening both memory and concentration. （议论文·科普说明）
Stretching before exercise keeps the connective tissue supple and dramatically reduces the risk of painful tears. （应用文·健身指南）
Given enough rest and proper nutrition, the body has a remarkable capacity to repair damaged tissue on its own. （议论文·自愈能力）

synonyms.example: The gentleman offered her his clean linen handkerchief, an old-fashioned courtesy that made her smile through her tears. （读后续写·人物·绅士风度）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：handkerchief 指可重复使用的布手帕，带旧时代/正式意味；tissue（纸巾义）指一次性纸巾，更日常。句法：均为可数名词。

synonyms.example: Small acts of kindness, repeated day after day, quietly strengthen the very fabric of a community. （议论文·社会）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：fabric 作'结构、根基'讲（the fabric of society）比 tissue 更常用、更正式；tissue 的抽象义几乎只用于 a tissue of lies。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·tissue 的可数性随义变化
advancedExpressions.expression: 组织义 → 不可数（muscle tissue）；纸巾义 → 可数（a tissue / two tissues）
advancedExpressions.example: Passing him a tissue (可数), she explained how exercise repairs muscle tissue (不可数). （同词两义，可数性不同，易错点）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·tissue 高频搭配与习语
advancedExpressions.expression: soft tissue（软组织）/ a box of tissues（一盒纸巾）/ a tissue of lies（一派谎言）
advancedExpressions.example: The nurse treated his soft tissue bruise, unaware that his whole story was a tissue of lies. （一句串联三义）

advancedExpressions.expression: press a tissue into sb.'s hand, and in that gesture ...
advancedExpressions.example: She pressed a tissue into his hand, and in that simple gesture lay all the comfort that words had failed to give. （以小动作承载大情感，续写'以物寄情'技法）

advancedExpressions.expression: to prevent ... injury, make sure that ...
advancedExpressions.example: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you warm up properly and never push your body beyond its limits. （倡议/须知类应用文标准句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as ... tissue needs ..., so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as living tissue needs both exertion and rest to grow stronger, so the mind requires both challenge and repose to flourish. （just as...so 类比，把生理规律迁移到抽象观点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She gave him a tissue.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Without a word, she slid a tissue across the table and rested her hand briefly over his, letting the silence say what neither of them could bring themselves to speak aloud. （读后续写·动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Without a word 状语前置定基调 + 连续动作(slid, rested)白描 + letting the silence say... 拟人化留白

sentenceUpgrade.original: His story was full of lies.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: His story, plausible on the surface, proved on closer inspection to be a mere tissue of lies, unravelling thread by thread the instant anyone dared to question it. （读后续写/议论文·揭露）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语(plausible on the surface)先扬后抑 + a tissue of lies 习语替换直白表达 + unravelling thread by thread 延续"织物"隐喻

classPractice.question: To prevent soft ____ injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and equipment when exercising. （软组织，课文原句）
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句词块 soft tissue injury；此处 tissue'（生物）组织'义，不可数。

classPractice.question: Moved to tears by the film, she reached for a ____ (tissue / handkerchief) from the box beside her.（一次性纸巾）
classPractice.note: box + 一次性纸巾用 tissue（纸巾义可数）；handkerchief 是可重复使用的布手帕，语境不合。

classPractice.note: 熟词僻义习语 a tissue of lies'一派谎言'，tissue 此处指'（谎言的）编织物、一套'。

original_sentence: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and equipment when exercising.
readingExamples: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and equipment when exercising.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the tools, machines, clothing, etc. that you need to do a particular job or activity
(2) n. the process of supplying someone or something with what is needed
(3) n. the mental or physical qualities needed for a particular task

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 设备，装备，器材（本义，不可数！不加 s，不用 an equipment）
uncommonMeanings.example: All the equipment is checked before each flight. （谓语用单数 is）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生理/心理上的）天赋能力，内在素质
uncommonMeanings.example: For all his lack of experience, the young man's calm nerves and quick mind were exactly the mental equipment the crisis demanded, and one by one his older colleagues turned to him for direction. （读后续写·危机·后生可畏）

posExamples.sentence: The camping equipment lay scattered across the wet grass, and as the first drops of rain began to fall, the exhausted hikers scrambled to pitch their tents before darkness swallowed the valley. （读后续写·户外·突发状况）
I am writing to inform you that the sports equipment donated by our alumni has finally arrived, and I sincerely invite every club member to join the assembly session this Saturday. （应用文·通知信）

It is short-sighted to claim that expensive equipment alone makes an athlete great; discipline, resilience and countless hours of quiet practice matter far more than any gear money can buy. （议论文·成功要素）

collocations.translation: 【课件】一件设备（equipment 不可数，用 a piece of 计量）
collocations.example: a useful piece of equipment for the kitchen 一件有用的厨房设备。（课件·Reading 原例）

collocations.translation: 【课件】新设备 / 新器材（不可数，谓语用单数）
collocations.example: some new equipment for the sports club 体育俱乐部的一些新器材。（课件·Reading 原例）

collocations.translation: 【课件】给某人/某物配备……（equip vt. 核心句型）
collocations.example: The project aims to equip children with the skills necessary for conducting a survey. 这个项目的目的是让孩子们具备开展调查所必需的技能。（课件·equip vt. 原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】为……装备齐全；适合做某事
collocations.example: The centre is well equipped for canoeing and mountaineering. 这个中心为划独木舟和登山配备齐全。（课件·equip vt. 原句）

collocations.phrase: proper clothes and equipment（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 合适的衣物和装备（课文原句）
collocations.example: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and equipment when exercising. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 运动 / 野营 / 安全装备
collocations.example: Before the mountain trek, the guide checked every piece of safety equipment twice, refusing to let a single careless mistake endanger the group. （读后续写·冒险·责任心）

collocations.translation: 现代 / 最先进的设备
collocations.example: Our newly renovated laboratory is now fitted with state-of-the-art equipment, giving students access to resources they could once only read about. （应用文·校园介绍）

collocations.translation: 安装 / 操作 / 维护设备
collocations.example: Only trained staff are permitted to operate the new equipment, and all users must report any fault immediately. （应用文·安全须知）

collocations.translation: 电气 / 医疗 / 办公设备
collocations.example: The charity shipped a container of medical equipment to the flood-stricken region, where doctors had been working with almost nothing for days. （议论文/应用文·公益）
The workers who refused to put on their protective equipment learned a bitter lesson the day the scaffolding gave way. （读后续写·安全·代价）

collocations.translation: 一件设备（equipment 不可数，用 a piece of 计量）
collocations.example: The old telescope, though just one dusty piece of equipment among many, was the very thing that first kindled her lifelong love of the stars. （读后续写·启蒙·情怀）

collocations.translation: 为某人/某物配备……（动词 equip 的核心搭配）
collocations.example: The school has equipped every classroom with a smart screen. （应用文·校园设施）

synonyms.example: He slung his climbing gear over his shoulder and set off up the trail before dawn, determined to reach the summit by noon. （读后续写·登山·决心）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：gear 更口语，多指某项活动的整套随身装备（fishing / diving gear）；equipment 更中性正式，涵盖机器、器材、工具。句法：两者均为不可数名词。

synonyms.example: The gymnasts moved from one piece of apparatus to the next with a grace that made the impossible look effortless. （读后续写·体操·惊艳）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：apparatus 偏指结构复杂的专用器械/装置（体育器械、实验装置），比 equipment 更书面、更具体；亦为不可数（a piece of apparatus）。

synonyms.example: The community centre boasts excellent sports facilities, from an indoor pool to a fully-equipped gym. （应用文·场所介绍）
synonyms.usage: 语义差别：facilities 指为使用者提供的成套设施/场馆（building-level，常用复数）；equipment 指具体的器材、机器，不可数。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·equipment 不可数（高考高频考点）
advancedExpressions.expression: equipment 不可数：不加 s、不用 an、谓语用单数；计量用 a piece of / two pieces of equipment
advancedExpressions.example: Much of the equipment was damaged. — Three pieces of equipment were missing. （much 修饰、a piece of 计量，切勿写 equipments / an equipment）

advancedExpressions.expression: equip (vt. 配备：equip sb with sth / be equipped for sth) → equipment (n. 设备，不可数) / equipped (adj. 装备好的) / well-equipped (adj. 设备齐全的)
advancedExpressions.example: The gym is well-equipped, having been equipped with the latest equipment last year. 这家健身房设备齐全，去年刚配备了最新的器材。（课件·equip vt. 核心句型 equip sb/sth with sth）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'装备/设备'（辨用可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: equipment（正式，机器器材）/ gear（口语，随身装备）/ apparatus（专用器械）/ facilities（成套设施）
advancedExpressions.example: He packed his diving gear, checked the safety equipment, and headed for the well-equipped centre. （按场合选词，语体各异）

advancedExpressions.expression: with all the equipment ..., sb. felt ready to ...
advancedExpressions.example: With all his equipment finally in place, he drew a deep breath, felt his heartbeat steady, and stepped to the very edge of the cliff. （用装备的'就绪'外化人物的心理准备，推动情节）

advancedExpressions.expression: equipped with ..., we are now able to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Equipped with modern facilities and a passionate team, we are now able to offer free coaching to every child in the neighbourhood. （equipped with 独立主格开头，凸显条件优势）

advancedExpressions.expression: no amount of equipment can substitute for ...
advancedExpressions.example: No amount of expensive equipment can substitute for the perseverance and self-discipline that truly separate the great from the good. （no amount of...can substitute for 强调核心因素）

advancedExpressions.expression: equip (vt. 配备) → equipment (n. 设备) / equipped (adj. 装备好的) / well-equipped (adj. 设备齐全的)
advancedExpressions.example: The gym is well-equipped, having been equipped with the latest equipment last year. （动词→名词→形容词一线记忆；核心句型 equip sb/sth with sth）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He packed his equipment and left.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One by one he checked each piece of equipment, packed it with practised care, and shouldered the heavy bag, his eyes already fixed on the misty peak that had haunted his dreams for years. （读后续写·动作+目标）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: One by one 铺排动作节奏 + 三个并列谓语(checked, packed, shouldered) + his eyes already fixed on... 独立主格点明动机

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good equipment is not the most important thing.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While cutting-edge equipment can undoubtedly sharpen an athlete's edge, it is grit, focus and the willingness to fail a hundred times that ultimately forge a champion. （议论文·让步论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While 让步从句先退一步 + it is...that 强调句突出真正要素 + 三名词并列(grit, focus, willingness)增强气势

classPractice.type: 用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: The machine ____ (equip) with security cameras and alarms looks like a mini shop. （配备有摄像头和警报的机器，课件·Reading 原题）
classPractice.note: 课件·Reading 原题：the machine 与 equip 是被动关系，用过去分词 equipped 作后置定语（= which is equipped with...）。

classPractice.type: 用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: They were not provided with adequate ____ (equip). 他们没有配备足够的设备。（课件·Reading 原题）
classPractice.note: 课件·Reading 原题：equip 的名词形式 equipment'设备'，不可数、不加 s。

classPractice.question: To prevent soft tissue injury, make sure that you wear proper clothes and ____ when exercising. （装备，课文原句）
classPractice.note: 还原课文原句词块 proper clothes and equipment；equipment 不可数，不加 s。

classPractice.question: Before the trek, the guide checked every ____ (piece) of safety equipment twice.
classPractice.note: equipment 不可数，计量'一件设备'用 a piece of equipment；every 后接单数 piece。

classPractice.question: The school gave every classroom a smart screen. → The school has ____ every classroom ____ a smart screen. （用 equip 改写）
classPractice.note: 动词 equip 的核心句型 equip sb/sth with sth'为……配备……'。

original_sentence: Others work out for hours at the weekend to make up for their lack of exercise during the weekdays.
readingExamples: Others work out for hours at the weekend to make up for their lack of exercise during the weekdays.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the state of not having something, or not having enough of something
(2) vt. to not have something, or not have enough of something
(3) vi. (lack for) to be without enough of something (usually in the negative)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 缺乏，不足（后常接 of；a lack of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Their failure came from a lack of preparation, not a lack of talent. 他们的失败源于准备不足，而非天赋不够。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 缺乏，没有（直接接宾语，不加介词）
uncommonMeanings.example: The little town lacks a proper hospital. 这个小镇缺一家像样的医院。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 缺少（lack for sth，多用于否定句 never lack for）
uncommonMeanings.example: A kind-hearted person never lacks for friends. 心地善良的人从不缺朋友。

posExamples.sentence: It was not talent she lacked, but confidence; and the moment her trembling hands finally struck the right chord, a lack of self-belief that had haunted her for years quietly melted away. （读后续写·突破·自我怀疑）
I am writing to draw your attention to the serious lack of recycling bins on our campus, a problem that undermines even the most enthusiastic efforts to go green. （应用文·建议信）
Many students today do not lack information; what they truly lack is the patience to sit with a difficult idea long enough to understand it. （议论文·学习态度）

wordForms.other: 同形贴士：lack 名词与动词同形；作动词时 vt. 后不加介词（lack sth），但名词短语要用 a lack of sth；形容词 lacking 用 in 引出所缺内容（be lacking in sth）——三种搭配切勿混用

collocations.translation: 【课件】缺乏（lack 作名词，后接 of；(a) lack of food/money）
collocations.example: Our project had to be cancelled for lack of money. 由于缺钱，我们的项目不得不取消。（课件·Reading 原例）
The plants died for lack of water. 这些植物因缺水而死。（课件·Reading 搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】缺乏某物（lack 作动词，直接接宾语：lack creativity / confidence / money）
collocations.example: He lacks the courage to admit his mistake. 他缺乏承认错误的勇气。（课件·Reading 搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】在……方面欠缺（lacking 作形容词，接 in）
collocations.example: She is lacking in the ability to keep everything in her work in good order. = She lacks the ability... 她缺乏把工作中一切都安排得井井有条的能力。（课件·Reading 原句）

collocations.translation: 运动量不足（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Others work out for hours at the weekend to make up for their lack of exercise during the weekdays. 有些人周末锻炼数小时，以弥补工作日运动量的不足。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make up for one's lack of exercise
collocations.translation: 弥补运动量的不足（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Others work out for hours at the weekend to make up for their lack of exercise during the weekdays. 有些人周末锻炼数小时，以弥补工作日运动量的不足。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make up for one's lack of
collocations.example: Others work out for hours at the weekend to make up for their lack of exercise during the weekdays. （议论文·生活习惯）
Though he lacked experience, his boundless enthusiasm won over the sceptical committee within minutes. （读后续写·面试·逆转）
Surrounded by loyal friends, she never lacked for encouragement, even in her darkest hours. （读后续写·友情·支撑）
Much conflict between generations springs from a simple lack of understanding rather than any real difference of values. （议论文·代沟）
Hard work can, to a great extent, compensate for a lack of natural talent. （议论文·努力与天赋）
The essay was well-researched but somewhat lacking in original insight. （应用文·评语）

collocations.translation: 缺乏某物（lack 作名词，后接 of）
collocations.example: A lack of sleep, not a lack of ability, caused her grades to slip. 是睡眠不足而非能力不足使她成绩下滑。

collocations.translation: 缺乏某物（lack 作动词，直接接宾语）
collocations.example: He lacks the courage to admit his mistake. 他缺乏承认错误的勇气。

collocations.translation: 在……方面欠缺（lacking 作形容词，接 in）
collocations.example: The plan was bold but lacking in detail. 这个计划很大胆，但细节欠缺。
The plants died for lack of water. 这些植物因缺水而死。
The brilliant plan was abandoned, not for lack of vision, but for lack of the courage to see it through. （议论文·失败归因）

synonyms.example: A severe shortage of clean water forced the villagers to walk miles each morning, jars balanced carefully on their heads. （读后续写·困境·画面）
synonyms.usage: shortage 特指数量上的"短缺"(供不应求),多用于资源/物资(water/food/staff),常搭配 a shortage of;lack 更宽泛,可指品质、能力等抽象事物的缺乏,兼作名词与动词

synonyms.example: In the absence of any adult, the frightened children clung to one another and waited for the storm to pass. （读后续写·无助·环境）
synonyms.usage: absence 强调"完全没有/不在场",语气更绝对,常用 in the absence of;lack 常指"不够、不足",程度较轻

synonyms.example: The doctor traced her constant fatigue to a simple vitamin deficiency, easily corrected with a change of diet. （应用文/说明·健康）
synonyms.usage: deficiency 偏专业书面,多指营养、技术、制度上的"缺陷/不足";lack 更通用日常,句法上 lack 可直接作动词,deficiency 只作名词

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·lack 三大句法（课件·Reading，务必分清）
advancedExpressions.expression: a lack of sth（名词，接 of）/ lack sth（动词 vt.，后不加介词）/ be lacking in sth（形容词，接 in）
advancedExpressions.example: He does not lack ability; what he lacks is confidence, and in courage he is sadly lacking. 他不缺能力，缺的是自信，而在勇气上他也很欠缺。（课件·三种搭配一句串联）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"缺乏/不足"（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: a lack of / a shortage of / an absence of / a deficiency of / be short of / be in short supply 缺乏，不足
advancedExpressions.example: A lack of / shortage of volunteers nearly forced the event to be cancelled. 志愿者不足几乎迫使活动取消。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·后缀 -ing 构形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: lack + -ing → lacking（欠缺的），反义可用 lacking 前加 not（not lacking in 不乏）
advancedExpressions.example: The team was not lacking in talent, only in teamwork. 这支队伍不乏天赋，缺的只是团队配合。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was not ... she lacked, but ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was not strength she lacked, but the belief that she was allowed to be strong. （not...but... 精准点出人物真正的心结,为转变蓄势）

advancedExpressions.expression: draw your attention to the lack of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to draw your attention to the lack of adequate lighting along the school path, which poses a real danger after dark. （建议信中礼貌而有力地提出问题）

advancedExpressions.expression: not for lack of ..., but for lack of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Many dreams die not for lack of ability, but for lack of the persistence to pursue them through repeated failure. （not for lack of A, but for lack of B 双重否定式归因,句式工整）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She lacked confidence, so she failed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It was not ability that held her back, but a quiet lack of confidence — a small, stubborn voice whispering that she was not good enough, until at last she found the courage to silence it. （读后续写·心理·转折）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It was not...but... 强调句先抑 + 破折号补充解释 + 拟人化的 voice whispering 具象化抽象的"不自信" + until 引出转机

sentenceUpgrade.original: The city has a water shortage.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The city's chronic lack of clean water is no accident of nature but the direct consequence of years of neglect and short-sighted planning. （议论文·归因）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: chronic(慢性的)提升程度 + is no...but... 否定+对比结构点明本质 + 双名词并列(neglect and short-sighted planning)增强批判力度

classPractice.type: 用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: What is ____ (lack) today is the conflict between adolescents' desire for autonomy and their understanding of an unsafe world. （课件·Reading 原题）
classPractice.note: 课件·Reading 原题：What is lacking'所欠缺的'，be lacking 表'欠缺、不足'，用现在分词形容词 lacking。

classPractice.question: The difference in physical education programmes is partly due to ____ ____ ____ a national standard. 体育项目具有差异，部分是因为缺乏国家标准。（课件·Reading 原题）
classPractice.note: 课件·Reading 原题：due to 后接名词短语 a lack of sth'缺乏……'，lack 此处作名词接 of。

classPractice.question: Others work out for hours at the weekend to make up for their ____ of exercise during the weekdays.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；a lack of sth 缺乏某物，lack 此处作名词接 of。

classPractice.question: The proposal was interesting but ____ (lack / lacking) in practical detail.
classPractice.note: be lacking in sth 在某方面欠缺；此处需形容词形式，且接介词 in。

classPractice.question: 他不缺才华，缺的是耐心。He does not ____ talent; what he ____ is patience.
classPractice.note: lack 作动词 vt.，后直接接宾语，不加 of；主语 what 从句谓语用第三人称 lacks。

original_sentence: Habits like these put stress on the body, and if they are maintained over the long term, can become a serious health risk.
readingExamples: Habits like these put stress on the body, and if they are maintained over the long term, can become a serious health risk.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make something continue in the same way or at the same standard as before
(2) vt. to keep a building, machine, road, etc. in good condition by regularly checking and repairing it
(3) vt. to strongly express your belief that something is true
(4) vt. to provide someone with money and the things they need to live

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】保养，维修（使道路、机器、设备等处于良好状态）；maintain the road / equipment
uncommonMeanings.example: It costs a lot to maintain the road and the fitness equipment in good condition. 把道路和健身器材保养得完好花费很大。（课件·Reading，保养义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 保持，维持（使某状态/水平持续不变）
uncommonMeanings.example: Regular exercise helps you maintain a healthy weight. 规律锻炼有助于你保持健康体重。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 坚称,坚持认为(观点为真);maintain that + 从句
uncommonMeanings.example: Even as the evidence mounted against him, the old fisherman stubbornly maintained that he had seen the ship vanish into the fog, and something in his steady gaze made them doubt their own certainty. （读后续写·悬疑·坚称）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 供养,赡养(某人)
uncommonMeanings.example: For twenty years she had quietly maintained her ageing parents on a teacher's modest salary, never once complaining of the weight she carried. （读后续写·亲情·担当）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 保养，维修（使建筑、机器等处于良好状态）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old bridge is carefully maintained by the local government. 这座老桥由当地政府精心保养。

posExamples.sentence: Even as the storm battered the little boat, the old sailor maintained an almost unnatural calm, his weathered hands steady on the wheel while the younger men trembled around him. （读后续写·危难·沉着）
I would like to remind all residents that it is our shared duty to maintain the cleanliness of our neighbourhood park for the enjoyment of future generations. （应用文·倡议书）
Habits like skipping breakfast put stress on the body, and if they are maintained over the long term, they can quietly develop into a serious health risk. （议论文·健康习惯）

wordForms.noun: maintenance（维持；保养，n. 注意拼写 -tenance）
wordForms.adjective: well-maintained（维护良好的，合成形容词）
wordForms.other: 拼写贴士：动词 maintain 变名词 maintenance，注意 -tain → -tenance 的拼写变化（对比 contain→content, retain→retention）；car / road / building maintenance 车辆/道路/建筑养护

collocations.translation: 【课件】保持平衡（maintain a balance / standards / prices）
collocations.example: Learning to maintain a balance between study and rest is a skill that lasts a lifetime. 学会在学习与休息之间保持平衡是一项受用终身的本领。（课件·Reading 搭配）
She ate a little every few hours to maintain her strength through the long climb. 她每隔几小时吃一点东西，以在漫长的攀登中保持体力。（课件·Reading 搭配）

collocations.phrase: maintain friendly relations / contacts with sb
collocations.translation: 【课件】与某人维持友好关系/联系
collocations.example: The two countries have maintained friendly relations with each other for decades. 这两个国家几十年来一直保持友好关系。（课件·Reading 搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】养护道路 / 房屋（保养、维修义）
collocations.example: It costs a great deal to maintain the old house in good condition. 把这座老房子保养得完好如初花费很大。（课件·Reading 搭配，保养义）
Only trained staff are allowed to maintain the equipment in the fitness centre. 只有受过培训的员工才可维护健身中心的设备。（课件·Reading 搭配，保养义）

collocations.phrase: be maintained over the long term
collocations.translation: 长期保持下去（课文原句词块，被动语态）
collocations.example: Habits like these put stress on the body, and if they are maintained over the long term, can become a serious health risk. 这类习惯会给身体带来压力，若长期保持，会变成严重的健康隐患。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 坚持认为，坚称（观点为真）
collocations.example: She maintained that she had done nothing wrong. 她坚称自己没做错任何事。
The young teacher struggled to maintain order in the noisy classroom until, one quiet word at a time, she finally earned the children's respect. （读后续写·成长·教师）
Despite the thousands of miles between them, the two friends maintained their friendship through weekly letters for over half a century. （读后续写·友情·坚守）
The small bakery has maintained the same high standards for three generations, refusing to cut a single corner. （应用文·介绍）
I sincerely hope we can maintain contact after the exchange programme ends, and I look forward to your reply. （应用文·书信结尾）
Regular exercise and a balanced diet are the twin pillars of maintaining a healthy lifestyle. （议论文·健康）
The well-maintained trails wound gently through the forest, inviting even the most cautious visitors to explore. （读后续写·环境）
Somehow she maintained her composure as she walked to the podium, though her heart was pounding like a drum. （读后续写·演讲·紧张）
Tai Chi helps the elderly maintain their balance and avoid falls. 太极拳帮助老人保持平衡、避免摔倒。
Learning to maintain a healthy balance between study and rest is a skill that will serve students far beyond their school years. （议论文·平衡）

synonyms.example: The whole village worked together to preserve the ancient bridge that generations had crossed. （读后续写·传统·守护）
synonyms.usage: preserve 强调防止损坏、消失,常用于文物、自然、传统;maintain 强调让某状态"持续下去"(标准、关系、秩序),二者都接名词宾语但语义侧重不同

synonyms.example: It was her mother's quiet faith that sustained her through those long months of failure. （读后续写·精神·支撑）
synonyms.usage: sustain 侧重"供给能量使之不衰竭、支撑住",常搭配 life/effort/growth;maintain 侧重"保持原有水平不变",搭配 standard/order/balance

synonyms.example: Keep up the good work, and you will be amazed at how far consistent effort can take you. （应用文·鼓励）
synonyms.usage: keep up 更口语,是短语动词,常用于"保持进度/势头/水平";maintain 更正式书面,单个及物动词直接接宾语

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·虚拟条件句倒装（were it true / should you... / had I known）
advancedExpressions.expression: 虚拟条件从句省去 if，把 were / should / had 提到主语前构成倒装：were + 主语（现在/一般虚拟）；should + 主语（对将来）；had + 主语 + done（对过去）
advancedExpressions.example: (1) He would still not excuse their action were it all true. 即使这都是事实，他也不会原谅他们的行动。 (2) No one would blame you should you change your mind. 万一你改变主意，谁也不会怪你。 (3) I would have written before had I known your address. 我要是知道你的地址早就写信了。 (4) How different his life would have been, had he not met Louisa. 如果没遇到路易莎，他的人生会多么不同。（课件·Reading 倒装句原句）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·maintain 多义速记（课件·Reading）
advancedExpressions.expression: maintain a balance / one's strength 保持（平衡/体力）/ maintain friendly relations with sb 维持关系 / maintain the road / equipment 保养 / maintain that... 坚称 / maintain one's parents 赡养；名词 maintenance /ˈmeɪntənəns/
advancedExpressions.example: He maintains that regular maintenance is the best way to maintain both the equipment and a healthy balance in the gym. 他坚称定期保养是同时维护设备和维持健身房良好平衡的最佳方式。（课件·多义一句串联）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"维持/保持"（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: maintain / keep / preserve / sustain / keep up / hold on to 保持，维持
advancedExpressions.example: It takes real discipline to maintain / keep up a healthy routine. 保持健康的作息需要真正的自律。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-tain 词根家族（hold 握持）
advancedExpressions.expression: main-（手/持续）+ tain（握）→ maintain 维持；同根 contain 容纳 / obtain 获得 / retain 保留
advancedExpressions.example: To maintain good health, retain the good habits you already have. 要保持健康，就保留你已有的好习惯。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·maintain that 后从句用陈述语气
advancedExpressions.expression: maintain that + 主语 + (无需 should/虚拟)；直接用陈述句表"坚称某事属实"
advancedExpressions.example: Scientists maintain that regular exercise slows down ageing. 科学家坚称规律锻炼能延缓衰老。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. maintained a ... calm / composure, even as ...
advancedExpressions.example: He maintained an outward calm even as his world quietly crumbled, and only his clenched fists betrayed the storm within. （用"维持镇定"与内心风暴的反差刻画坚强人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is our shared duty to maintain ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is our shared duty to maintain the beauty of this campus, for it is a home we all have the privilege to share. （倡议书中唤起集体责任感）

advancedExpressions.expression: some maintain that ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: Some maintain that talent alone determines success, yet history repeatedly proves that perseverance is the truer measure. （用 maintain 引出待反驳的观点,句式凝练）

advancedExpressions.expression: maintain a balance 保持平衡 / maintain order 维持秩序 / maintain that... 坚称 / maintain one's parents 赡养
advancedExpressions.example: He maintains that keeping fit is the best way to maintain both health and a good mood. 他坚称健身是保持健康与好心情的最佳方式。

sentenceUpgrade.original: He stayed calm during the crisis.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Throughout the chaos, he maintained a composure so steady that those around him drew strength from his very presence, their panic slowly giving way to resolve. （读后续写·人物+群体反应）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Throughout the chaos 时间状语铺垫 + so...that... 结果状语从句延伸影响 + their panic giving way to resolve 独立主格写出感染力

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should keep our city clean.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is incumbent upon every one of us to maintain the cleanliness of our city, not merely for its appearance, but as a lasting gift to the generations who will call it home. （应用文·倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is incumbent upon sb. to... 正式句式提升责任感 + not merely...but... 递进升华意义 + who will call it home 定语从句延伸到未来

classPractice.type: 用所给词的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: 汽车保养 car ____ ；例行维护 routine ____ （maintain 的名词形式，/ˈmeɪntənəns/，课件·Reading 原题）
classPractice.note: 课件·Reading 原题：maintain 的名词是 maintenance /ˈmeɪntənəns/'维持；保养'，注意 -tain → -tenance 拼写变化；car maintenance 汽车保养，routine maintenance 例行维护。

classPractice.question: Habits like these put stress on the body, and if they are ____ (maintain) over the long term, can become a serious health risk.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；条件状语从句中主语 they 与 maintain 是被动关系，用 are maintained。

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（含蓄条件·倒装）
classPractice.question: He would still not excuse their action ____ it all true. （即使这都是事实……，还原课件·倒装句原句）
classPractice.note: 课件·倒装句原句 were it all true = if it were all true；虚拟条件从句省 if，把 were 提前构成倒装。

classPractice.question: 尽管证据不利于他，他仍坚称自己是清白的。Though the evidence was against him, he ____ ____ he was innocent.
classPractice.note: maintain that + 从句 表"坚称、坚持认为"；从句用陈述语气，不用虚拟。

classPractice.question: Practising Tai Chi every morning helps elderly people ____ their balance. (maintain 的适当形式)
classPractice.note: help sb do sth，help 后接省略 to 的动词原形；maintain balance 保持平衡。

original_sentence: We are happy to announce that the Community Sports Centre will soon be open to the public once again!
readingExamples: We are happy to announce that the Community Sports Centre will soon be open to the public once again!
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to officially tell people about something, especially about a plan or a decision
(2) vt. to tell people something in a loud and confident way
(3) vt. to make known the arrival or presence of someone or something
(4) vt. to read the news or introduce programmes on the radio or television

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 宣布，公布（正式告知计划或决定）；announce that / announce sth to sb
uncommonMeanings.example: The government announced new measures to encourage exercise. 政府宣布了鼓励锻炼的新措施。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 预示,表明……即将到来
uncommonMeanings.example: A sudden hush announced the arrival of the headmaster, and every whispering student fell silent as though a switch had been flicked. （读后续写·场景·气氛转变）

posExamples.sentence: She burst through the door, breathless and beaming, and announced that she had won the national writing competition — the news the whole family had been praying for all week. （读后续写·喜讯·高潮）
We are happy to announce that the Community Sports Centre will soon be open to the public once again, and we warmly welcome every resident to join the grand reopening this Saturday. （应用文·通知）
When a government announces an ambitious environmental target, it must be prepared to back its words with concrete action, or public trust will inevitably erode. （议论文·政策与诚信）

wordForms.noun: announcement（公告，通知）；announcer（播音员/宣告者）
wordForms.other: announcer (n. 播音员/宣告者)；构词贴士：announce + -ment → announcement（名词，make an announcement），announce + -er → announcer（施动者）

collocations.translation: 【课件】宣布……（tell people publicly，公开告知）
collocations.example: We are happy to announce that the Community Sports Centre will soon be open to the public once again! 我们很高兴地宣布，社区体育中心即将再次向公众开放！（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: announce a plan / a decision / an intention
collocations.translation: 【课件】宣布一项计划／决定／意图
collocations.example: The government announced a decision to build more public sports centres. 政府宣布了一项修建更多公共体育中心的决定。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】向某人宣布某事（announce 不接双宾，须用 to 引出对象）
collocations.example: The headmaster announced the good news to the whole school. 校长向全校宣布了这个好消息。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】据宣布……（it 作形式主语）
collocations.example: It is announced that this company will lay off 10% of the staff. 据宣布这家公司将裁员 10%。（课件例句）
The loudspeaker announced that our flight would be delayed. 广播通知我们的航班将会延误。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】发布通知／公告（announcement 名词；announcer 广播员）
collocations.example: The captain made an announcement over the loudspeaker; the announcer's calm voice reassured everyone. 机长通过广播发布了通知；广播员镇定的声音安抚了每个人。（课件拓展）

collocations.translation: 很高兴宣布……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We are happy to announce that the Community Sports Centre will soon be open to the public once again! 我们很高兴地宣布，社区体育中心即将再次向公众开放！（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 发布公告（announcement 为名词形式）
collocations.example: The captain made an important announcement over the loudspeaker. 机长通过广播发布了一则重要通知。
With a trembling voice, the captain announced that the rescue ship was finally in sight, and a ragged cheer rose from the exhausted crew. （读后续写·获救·激动）

collocations.phrase: be happy / pleased / proud to announce
collocations.example: We are proud to announce that our school choir has been invited to perform at the provincial festival. （应用文·喜讯通知）
The moment the judges announced the result, the gymnasium erupted into thunderous applause. （读后续写·比赛·揭晓）
The mayor publicly announced a new campaign to plant ten thousand trees across the city within a year. （议论文/应用文·公共事务）
A crackle of static came over the loudspeaker as the host prepared to announce the winner of the grand prize. （读后续写·悬念·揭晓）
The principal made a brief but stirring announcement that would change the direction of the whole school year. （读后续写·转折）

collocations.phrase: announce one's intention to do sth
collocations.example: When she announced her intention to study abroad alone, her parents fell silent, torn between pride and worry. （读后续写·抉择·家庭）

collocations.translation: 向某人宣布某事（announce 后不能直接接双宾）
collocations.example: The headmaster announced the good news to the whole school. 校长向全校宣布了这个好消息。

synonyms.example: Rising to his feet, the old chairman declared the meeting closed, his few words carrying the weight of forty years' authority. （读后续写·正式场合）
synonyms.usage: declare 更庄重正式,常用于战争、独立、结果、立场等重大声明,可接 declare sth + adj.(declare it open);announce 侧重"公开告知消息",常接 that 从句,语气可喜可正式

synonyms.example: The banner across the square proudly proclaimed the city's victory in the national contest. （读后续写·庆典·气势）
synonyms.usage: proclaim 带有"高调、公开而正式地宣告"意味,多用于重大/值得骄傲之事;announce 更中性通用,日常与正式场合皆可

synonyms.example: With a mischievous smile, she finally revealed the secret she had been keeping all evening. （读后续写·揭秘·悬念）

original_sentence: The finishing touches are now being put to a new swimming pool and our workout rooms have been updated with modern equipment.

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to add the final small details or improvements that complete a piece of work and make it perfect
(2) phr. to do the last small things needed to finish something (also: put the finishing touches on)

posExamples.sentence: Long after midnight, the young painter was still putting the finishing touches to her masterpiece, adding a single stroke of gold that suddenly made the whole canvas come alive. （读后续写·艺术·执着）
Our volunteers are now putting the finishing touches to the charity fair, and we sincerely invite every family in the neighbourhood to come and share the joy this weekend. （应用文·活动通知）
True craftsmanship lies not in rushing to the end, but in the patience to put the finishing touches to a piece of work long after others would have called it done. （议论文·工匠精神）

collocations.example: Grandma put the finishing touches to the dumplings with a sprinkle of chopped coriander, and the whole kitchen filled with the smell of home. （读后续写·亲情·温暖）

collocations.translation: 给演讲/文章做最后润色

synonyms.example: The committee met one last time to finalize the arrangements for the graduation ceremony. （应用文·筹备）

synonyms.example: One final signature was all it took to complete the long and difficult negotiation. （应用文/叙事·收束）
