original_sentence: The finishing touches are now being put to a new swimming pool and our workout rooms have been updated with modern equipment.
readingExamples: The finishing touches are now being put to a new swimming pool and our workout rooms have been updated with modern equipment.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to add the most recent information to something, or to change it so that it includes the latest facts
(2) vt. to make something more modern by adding new features or replacing old parts
(3) n. a report or piece of news giving the most recent information about a situation
(4) n. a new or improved version of a piece of software, a product or a document

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 更新（信息）；使现代化（设备）；update sth with sth
uncommonMeanings.example: We update the website every day. 我们每天更新网站。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 最新消息，最新进展；an update on sth
uncommonMeanings.example: Here is the latest update on the flight. 这是关于航班的最新消息。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （软件、产品的）更新版本，升级
uncommonMeanings.example: The app released a new update last night. 这款应用昨晚发布了一个新的更新版本。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（人）了解最新情况；向……通报进展（update sb on sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Before hanging up, the anxious mother begged the nurse to update her the moment there was any change in her son's condition, however small. （读后续写·医院守候·牵挂）

posExamples.sentence: As the storm swept across the valley, the young volunteer crouched over her phone, fingers trembling, and updated the rescue map every few minutes so that the teams below would never lose their way in the dark. （读后续写·灾难救援）

I am writing to inform you that the school library has recently updated its entire collection with hundreds of English readers, and I warmly encourage every student to explore these newly arrived treasures. （应用文·通知）
In an age when a single tap brings us a constant flood of updates, the real challenge is no longer finding information but learning which pieces of it genuinely deserve our attention. （议论文·信息时代）
The moment the coach posted an update on the team notice-board, a cheer rippled through the changing room — the injured captain would, after all, be fit to play in the final. （读后续写·球队·喜讯）

wordForms.noun: update（更新，最新消息）；updating（更新过程）

collocations.translation: 【课件】最新新闻报道（update 作名词）

collocations.translation: 被更新为现代化设备（课文原句词块，被动语态）

collocations.translation: 关于某事的最新消息（update 作名词）
collocations.example: Could you give me an update on the match? 你能告诉我比赛的最新进展吗？
Our workout rooms have been updated with modern equipment, so members can now train exactly as professional athletes do. （应用文·场馆介绍）

collocations.translation: 让某人随时了解最新情况
collocations.example: I promise to keep you updated on the progress of our charity sale, so that no volunteer is ever left wondering how the plans are unfolding. （应用文·倡议书）
Throughout the expedition, the leader sent a daily update to base camp, each message a fragile thread linking the climbers to the world they had left behind. （读后续写·探险）
In a rapidly changing world, those who refuse to update their knowledge will inevitably find themselves left behind by the very progress they once celebrated. （议论文·终身学习）

collocations.phrase: give sb an update on sth

A single overlooked software update can leave an entire network exposed, which is why cyber-security experts urge constant vigilance. （议论文·网络安全）

collocations.translation: 就某事向某人通报最新情况
collocations.example: The moment he stepped off the train, his brother rushed forward to update him on everything that had happened during his long months abroad. （读后续写·久别重逢）

synonyms.example: A week among the mountains was enough to renew her weary spirit and send her back to the city with fresh determination. （读后续写·心灵重整）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：renew 侧重"使重新有效/焕然一新"，常用于续订（合同、证件）或恢复精力、决心；update 侧重把旧信息或旧设备"更新到最新状态"，重在"最新"，兼作动词与名词。

synonyms.example: The council's bold plan to modernize the old sports centre transformed a crumbling hall into a facility the whole town could be proud of. （应用文·改造报告）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·keep sb updated 复合宾语

original_sentence: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
readingExamples: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. as a reaction or reply to something that has been said, asked, or done
(2) phr. as a result of, or in order to deal with, a particular situation, demand or event
(3) phr. (in formal or written contexts) written or acting with reference to a previous letter, request or complaint

posExamples.sentence: In response to the little girl's tearful plea, the gruff old fisherman set down his net, waded into the icy shallows, and gently lifted the stranded seabird into the safety of his weathered hands. （读后续写·善举·情感转折）
In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun new options, and I sincerely hope every member will find a course that suits their taste. （应用文·通知）

In response to the growing concern over screen addiction, some argue that schools should ban phones outright; yet a wiser course, I believe, lies in teaching students to govern the technology rather than fear it. （议论文·观点论证）
In response to your letter of 12 June, I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude for the warm hospitality your family showed me during my stay in London. （应用文·感谢信）

wordForms.noun: response（回应，反应，n. 短语核心词）
wordForms.other: 短语结构贴士：in response to 是固定介词短语，to 是介词，后接名词/动名词，不接从句；同根动词 respond to sth，名词 make a response to sth；不要漏掉冠词写成 in response（应写全 in response to）

idioms.example: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options. 应公众的兴趣，有氧操课已被换成了几种有趣的选择。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】作为对……的反应／响应（后接名词/动名词）
collocations.example: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options. 应公众的兴趣，有氧操课已被换成了几种有趣的选择。（课件例句/课文原句）

collocations.phrase: make a / no response to sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】对……作出／没有作出回应（response 名词）
collocations.example: He made no response to my repeated questions. 他对我反复的提问没有作出任何回应。（课件搭配）
Her immediate response was to reach out and steady the falling child. 她的第一反应就是伸手扶住摔倒的孩子。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】以……回应某人（respond 动词形式）
collocations.example: He responded to me with a phone call. 他打电话回复了我。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……有不同的反应（responses 名词复数）
collocations.example: Men and women have quite different biological and behavioural responses to stress. 男性和女性对压力有着截然不同的生理和行为反应。（课件填空 responses）

collocations.translation: 应公众的兴趣（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance. 应公众的兴趣，我们的有氧操课已换成了几种有趣的选择，包括现代舞。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: in response to sth（后接名词/动名词）
collocations.example: In response to the fire alarm, everyone left the building at once. 一听到火警，所有人立刻离开了大楼。

collocations.phrase: in response to public interest / demand
collocations.example: In response to overwhelming demand, the organisers added an extra evening session so that no eager fan would be turned away at the door. （应用文·活动通知）

collocations.phrase: in response to a question / request
collocations.translation: 作为对问题／请求的回应
collocations.example: In response to my nervous question, the interviewer merely smiled and gestured for me to take a seat, and at once my racing heart began to settle. （读后续写·面试）

collocations.phrase: in response to a letter / an email
collocations.example: In response to your kind email, I would be more than happy to share the reading list that helped me fall in love with English literature. （应用文·回复信）
In response to mounting criticism, the school revised its policy overnight, proving that a genuine willingness to listen can turn anger into trust. （议论文·善于倾听）

collocations.phrase: in response to a crisis / an emergency
collocations.example: In response to the sudden flood, hundreds of ordinary citizens formed a human chain along the riverbank, passing sandbags from hand to hand deep into the night. （读后续写·抗洪）

collocations.phrase: act / change / be replaced in response to sth
collocations.translation: 为回应某事而行动／改变／被替换
collocations.example: The old timetable was replaced in response to countless complaints from tired commuters who could no longer bear the endless waiting. （议论文·公共服务）

synonyms.example: In reply to your enquiry about our summer camp, I am delighted to enclose a detailed brochure describing all the activities on offer. （应用文·回复信）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in reply to 专指对"具体的问题、来信、请求"的直接答复，多用于书信；in response to 范围更广，既可回应言语，也可回应形势、需求、事件，后均接名词。

synonyms.example: In reaction to the shocking news, the whole classroom fell into a stunned, disbelieving silence. （读后续写·突发消息）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：in reaction to 强调"情绪或本能式的反应"，常带自发、即时色彩；in response to 更中性，可指经过考虑后的应对或答复，正式度略高。

synonyms.example: As a result of years of patient training, the once-clumsy boy stood on the podium, a national champion at last. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：as a result of 单纯表"因果"，不含"回应"之意；in response to 隐含"针对某刺激而作出回应/应对"的主动性，二者不可随意互换。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·in response to 及同根表达
advancedExpressions.expression: in response to sth 回应… / respond to sth 对…作出回应 / make a response to sth 作出回应 / in reply to 答复…
advancedExpressions.example: In response to public demand, the centre responded to every suggestion with real changes. 应公众要求，中心以实际改变回应了每一条建议。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"回应/针对"（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: in response to / in reply to / in reaction to / in answer to 作为对…的回应
advancedExpressions.example: In response to / In reply to your letter, I am writing to express my thanks. 作为对您来信的回复，我写信表达谢意。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ive 形容词后缀
advancedExpressions.expression: respond（v.）→ response（n.）→ responsive（adj. 反应积极的，-ive 表"有…性质的"）
advancedExpressions.example: A responsive teacher adjusts quickly in response to students' needs. 反应敏锐的老师能针对学生的需求迅速调整。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·in response to + 名词/动名词
advancedExpressions.expression: to 为介词，后接名词或动名词，不接句子（若表原因引导从句应改用 because / as）
advancedExpressions.example: In response to being criticised, he improved his attitude. 面对批评，他改善了态度。

advancedExpressions.expression: in response to ..., sb. did sth, and everything changed
advancedExpressions.example: In response to the stranger's quiet kindness, she finally lowered her guard, and in that single fragile moment everything between them changed. （回应+转折落点，续写情感升温的关键句）

advancedExpressions.expression: in response to your ..., I am writing to ...
advancedExpressions.example: In response to your recent letter, I am writing to offer both my apologies for the delay and my sincere thanks for your patience. （标准应用文开头，回复/致歉信）

advancedExpressions.expression: in response to ..., some argue ...; yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: In response to the pressures of the digital age, some argue that we should switch off entirely; yet retreat, I contend, is no substitute for wisdom. （引出对立观点+转折立论，议论文起承）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The class was changed because people wanted it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to the enthusiasm voiced by so many members, our familiar aerobics class has been transformed into a whole range of fresh, exciting options — a change born entirely of your own suggestions. （应用文·通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in response to状语前置显因果 + 被动语态(has been transformed)客观 + 破折号补充说明 + a change born of...过去分词短语呼应

sentenceUpgrade.original: She helped the bird because the girl asked her to.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In response to the child's trembling plea, she knelt in the freezing mud without a word, cupped the shivering bird in her palms, and felt something long frozen inside her quietly begin to thaw. （读后续写·善良觉醒）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: in response to引出回应动机 + 三个连贯动作(knelt, cupped, felt) + 感官细节(trembling, freezing, shivering) + 隐喻(frozen...thaw)完成内心升华

classPractice.note: 课件填空；response 此处为可数名词，与主语 men and women 的复数反应对应，用复数 responses，接介词 to

original_sentence: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
readingExamples: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to take the place of someone or something, or to do the job that they used to do
(2) vt. to remove someone or something and put a new person or thing in their place
(3) vt. to provide a new one to take the place of one that is old, broken, or lost
(4) vt. to put something back in the place where it was before

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 取代，替换（replace A with/by B）；接替某人（replace sb as ...）
uncommonMeanings.example: A young player was sent on to replace the injured captain. 一名年轻队员被派上场接替受伤的队长。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 更换（换掉旧的、坏的、丢的，换上新的）
uncommonMeanings.example: The company promised to replace the faulty heater. 公司承诺更换有故障的暖气。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把……放回原处
uncommonMeanings.example: With almost religious care she replaced the faded photograph on the mantelpiece, smoothing its edge as though the smallest crease might disturb the memory it held. （读后续写·睹物思人·怀旧）

posExamples.sentence: When the veteran goalkeeper limped off the pitch, a nervous fifteen-year-old was sent on to replace him, and with that single trembling step his ordinary schoolboy life was left forever behind. （读后续写·临危受命）
In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance, so that every member can find a style they truly enjoy. （应用文·通知）
No matter how sophisticated artificial intelligence becomes, it can never truly replace the warmth of a teacher who notices the quiet child at the back of the room. （议论文·科技与人文）
The company promised to replace the faulty heater free of charge, and their swift, courteous response turned an angry customer into a lifelong supporter. （应用文·投诉回复）

wordForms.adjective: replaceable（可替代的）/ irreplaceable（无可替代的，ir- 否定前缀）
wordForms.other: 搭配辨析贴士：replace A with/by B（换掉A、用上B，A为旧）与 substitute B for A（同义但A、B位置颠倒）——这是高考最易混语序；名词 replacement 用 a replacement for sth（某物的替代品）

collocations.translation: 【课件】用 B 替换 A（B 为新的、留下的；be replaced with/by B 为被动式）
collocations.example: Our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options. 我们的有氧操课已被换成了几种有趣的选择。Teachers will never be completely replaced by computers in the classroom. 老师永远不会被教室里的电脑完全取代。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: take the place of A / take A's place / in place of A
collocations.translation: 【课件】代替 A（replace 的同义表达）
collocations.example: No computer can take the place of a caring teacher, nor stand in place of a warm human voice. 没有电脑能代替一位有爱心的老师，也无法取代温暖的人声。（课件同义短语）

collocations.phrase: replace the old and damaged equipment
collocations.translation: 【课件】更换老旧和破损的设备
collocations.example: The fitness centre does not have enough money to replace the old and damaged equipment. 健身中心没有足够的钱更换老旧和破损的健身器材。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】可替换的／（价值高）不可替代的、独一无二的
collocations.example: Machine parts are replaceable, but true friendship is irreplaceable. 机器零件可以替换，但真正的友谊无可替代。（课件构词 adj.）

collocations.phrase: find a replacement for sb / sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】为某人／某物找到接替者／替代品（replacement 名词 C/U）
collocations.example: The company is trying to find a replacement for the resigned secretary. 公司正设法为辞职的秘书找一位接替的人。The replacement of the broken parts took a whole week. 更换损坏的零件花了整整一周。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 被……取代（课文原句词块，replace A with B 的被动式）
collocations.example: In response to public interest, our aerobics class has been replaced with several fun options, including modern dance. 应公众的兴趣，我们的有氧操课已被换成了几种有趣的选择，包括现代舞。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 用 B 取代/替换 A（B 是新的、留下的）
collocations.example: We should replace bad habits with good ones. 我们应当用好习惯取代坏习惯。

collocations.translation: 用 B 替代 A（多用于被动 be replaced by）
collocations.example: Rote learning has been replaced by tasks that reward understanding. 死记硬背已被奖励理解的任务所替代。
When their beloved captain graduated, no one imagined that the shy new girl would replace her as the very heart of the team. （读后续写·校园）
The crumbling wooden bridge was at last replaced by a sturdy stone one, and the villagers' long years of anxious waiting came to an end. （读后续写·乡村变迁）
A screen full of friends can never replace the simple comfort of a hand resting warmly on your shoulder. （议论文·真实交往）

collocations.phrase: replace a lost / broken / damaged item
collocations.example: I am writing to ask whether it would be possible to replace the damaged book, as I am truly ashamed to return it in such a state. （应用文·致歉信）
In that quiet moment she understood that some things — a mother's patience, a childhood home — are simply irreplaceable. （读后续写·亲情感悟）
Scientists are racing to develop a clean, affordable replacement for fossil fuels before it is too late. （议论文·能源危机）

synonyms.example: With their star striker injured, the coach had no choice but to substitute a raw newcomer, and the whole stadium held its breath. （读后续写·比赛）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：substitute 强调"暂时或临时性地用B顶替A的位置"，尤指体育替补或成分替换；关键在语序——substitute B for A（用B替换A）与 replace A with B 的 A、B 位置相反，最易错；replace 更中性，可指永久取代或更换。

synonyms.example: The two friends quietly swapped seats so that the shy new student would not have to sit alone. （读后续写·同学情谊）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：swap 口语化，强调"互相交换"，双方各得其一；replace 是单向的"取代/更换"，被换掉的一方通常被移除或废弃。

synonyms.example: As electric cars steadily supersede their petrol-driven ancestors, the roar of the engine may one day become a sound from history. （议论文·技术更迭）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：supersede 正式且书面，指新事物因更先进而"淘汰、取代"旧事物，含"过时"之意；replace 更普通、日常，适用范围广得多。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·replace A with B 的被动转换（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: 主动 replace A with B → 被动 A be replaced with / by B（主语是被换掉的旧事物 A）；同义 take the place of A / take A's place / in place of A
advancedExpressions.example: The aerobics class has been replaced with new options. 有氧操课已被换成了新的选择。Teachers will never be replaced by computers. 老师永远不会被电脑取代。（课件语法点）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·后缀 -able / -ment 与前缀 ir-（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: replace + -able → replaceable 可替换的；ir- + replaceable → irreplaceable（价值高）不可替代的；replace + -ment → replacement（n. C/U 更换；接替者），find a replacement for sth
advancedExpressions.example: Some memories are simply irreplaceable, and no replacement will ever do. 有些回忆无可替代，任何替代品都无济于事。（课件构词）

advancedExpressions.expression: replace A with B 用B取代A / be replaced with/by B 被B取代 / replace sb as... 接替某人 / a replacement for sth 替代品
advancedExpressions.example: The old machines have been replaced with modern ones. 旧机器已被换成了现代化的机器。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表"取代/替换"（供替换升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: replace / substitute / take the place of / stand in for / supersede 取代，替换
advancedExpressions.example: Nothing can replace / take the place of a mother's love. 没有什么能取代母爱。

advancedExpressions.expression: nothing could ever replace ...
advancedExpressions.example: Medals would come and go, she realised, but nothing could ever replace the quiet pride in her old coach's eyes. （否定强调+价值对比，续写点明真正珍贵之物）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., replacing the outdated ... with ...
advancedExpressions.example: The centre has been thoroughly renovated, replacing the outdated machines with modern, professionally recommended equipment. （现在分词状语说明改进措施，通知/报告）

advancedExpressions.expression: however advanced ... may be, it can never replace ...
advancedExpressions.example: However advanced our machines may become, they can never replace the human capacity for empathy, imagination and moral judgement. （让步状语+never replace，议论文守住人文底线）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·后缀 -ment / 前缀 ir-
advancedExpressions.expression: replace + -ment → replacement（名词）；ir- + replaceable → irreplaceable（无可替代的，ir- 用于 r 开头词前）
advancedExpressions.example: Some memories are simply irreplaceable, and no replacement will ever do. 有些回忆无可替代，任何替代品都无济于事。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·replace A with B 的被动转换
advancedExpressions.expression: 主动 replace A with B → 被动 A be replaced with/by B（主语是被换掉的旧事物 A）
advancedExpressions.example: The aerobics class has been replaced with new options. 有氧操课已被换成了新的选择。

original_sentence: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches.
readingExamples: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone who competes in sports, especially in running, jumping or throwing events, or in the Olympic Games
(2) n. a person who is very good at sports or physical exercise, or who is trained in physical activities
(3) n. someone whose profession or main occupation is competing in sports

posExamples.sentence: As the final whistle blew, the exhausted young athlete collapsed onto the track, her chest heaving and her legs trembling, yet through the blur of tears she was already smiling — she had beaten no one but her own weaker self. （读后续写·运动会·自我超越）
We are honoured to announce that professional athletes have been invited to serve as our coaches, so that every member of our sports centre can learn from the very best. （应用文·通知）
A true athlete is remembered not merely for the medals hanging around the neck, but for the discipline, humility and grace displayed long after the cheering crowds have gone home. （议论文·体育精神）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua as our student athlete of the year, for behind his effortless victories lie countless dawns of solitary, uncomplaining training. （应用文·推荐信）

wordForms.noun: athlete（运动员）/ athletics（田径运动；单复数看语境，作"田径"视为单数）/ athleticism（运动天赋）
wordForms.other: 构词：athlete(n.运动员) → athletic(adj.运动的) → athletically(adv.)；athletics(n.田径运动)。贴士：athletic 强调"体格健壮/擅长运动"，an athletic build 健壮的体格；an athletics meeting 田径运动会。

collocations.phrase: invite professional athletes (to be our coaches)
collocations.translation: 邀请职业运动员（做教练）（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches. 我们将邀请职业运动员做我们的教练。（课文原句）
A professional athlete trains hard every single day. 职业运动员每天都刻苦训练。
We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches, giving ordinary members the rare chance to train under champions. （应用文·活动介绍）
What sets an elite athlete apart is not raw talent alone but the quiet refusal to give up on the days when no one is watching. （议论文·成功要素）
Though a gifted athlete, she never let praise go to her head, treating each new race as if she still had everything to prove. （读后续写·人物品格）
For six long years he trained as an athlete before dawn, trading warm blankets for cold tracks and easy dreams for a single burning goal. （读后续写·苦练）
The thought that a world-class athlete had once stood exactly where he now stood sent a shiver of determination down his spine. （读后续写·励志）
The spirit of an athlete lies less in winning than in rising, again and again, from every fall. （议论文·体育精神）
Both athletes and coaches gathered in the hall, their faces glowing with the pride of a season hard-won. （读后续写·颁奖）

synonyms.translation: 运动员（不分性别的通称）
synonyms.example: As a devoted sportsperson, she believed that fair play mattered far more than any trophy. （议论文·体育道德）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：sportsperson（及 sportsman/sportswoman）泛指“从事体育运动的人”，也常含“讲体育道德的人”之意；athlete 更偏田径或高水平竞技，专业色彩更浓。

synonyms.example: The young player dribbled past three defenders before slotting the ball calmly into the net. （读后续写·球赛）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：player 侧重“球类、棋类等具体项目的参与者/选手”；athlete 强调体能型竞技者，尤指田径、奥运项目，不用于棋牌类。

synonyms.example: Only ten competitors remained on the track, each one hungry for the single place that led to the finals. （读后续写·比赛）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：competitor 强调“参加比赛、与他人竞争”的身份，中性且宽泛；athlete 强调其“运动员”的职业或专长身份，二者角度不同。

advancedExpressions.expression: athlete(n.运动员) / athletic(adj.运动的、健壮的) / athletics(n.田径)
advancedExpressions.example: The athletic girl (adj.) dreamed of becoming a professional athlete (n.) and winning gold in athletics (n.). 这个健壮的女孩梦想成为职业运动员，在田径项目上夺金。（一句串起三个词形）

advancedExpressions.expression: a professional / amateur / elite / world-class athlete；train as an athlete
advancedExpressions.example: From an amateur to a world-class athlete, she never stopped training. 从业余选手到世界级运动员，她从未停止训练。

advancedExpressions.expression: like a seasoned athlete, sb. did sth with ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like a seasoned athlete pacing herself for the long climb, she pushed down her panic and moved with slow, deliberate calm. （明喻+比拟，续写用运动员气质刻画人物沉着）

advancedExpressions.expression: invite professional athletes to ..., so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: We will invite professional athletes to be our coaches, so that every member, however inexperienced, may learn from the very finest. （目的状语从句，通知/宣传信亮点句）

advancedExpressions.expression: a true athlete is remembered not for ... but for ...
advancedExpressions.example: A true athlete is remembered not for the medals won but for the courage shown in defeat and the grace shown in victory. （not...but...对比结构，议论文升华体育精神）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The athlete was very tired but happy after the race.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 生理细节(lungs burning, legs like water) + 情感对比(exhausted yet joyful) + 破折号引出主题 + not...but...揭示成长内核

sentenceUpgrade.original: We will invite professional athletes to coach us.

sub_section: B2: Review of the sports centre
original_sentence: A whole new range of courses have been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing!
readingExamples: A whole new range of courses have been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing!
definitionEn:
(1) n. the sport of fighting with the fists, usually wearing thick leather gloves, in a roped square called a ring
(2) n. the activity of training with boxing techniques for fitness, self-defence or competition
(3) n. (as a modifier) relating to the sport of boxing, e.g. boxing gloves, a boxing match, a boxing ring

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （Boxing Day，圣诞次日）节礼日（12月26日，英式）
uncommonMeanings.example: On Boxing Day the whole family squeezed onto the sofa, plates of leftover turkey balanced on their knees, and for once no one was in any hurry to go anywhere at all. （读后续写·英国家庭·节日温情）

posExamples.sentence: The first time he stepped into the boxing ring, the roar of the crowd faded to a distant hum, and there was nothing left in the world but his pounding heart, his aching fists, and the towering opponent in front of him. （读后续写·首次上场）
A whole new range of courses has been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing, and I sincerely encourage everyone to try a sport that once seemed beyond their reach. （应用文·通知）
Far from being mere violence, boxing at its best teaches discipline, respect and self-control — qualities that serve a young person far beyond the ropes of any ring. （议论文·体育价值）
I would strongly recommend our new boxing class to any member who longs to build both physical strength and inner confidence in a single hour a week. （应用文·推荐信）

wordForms.noun: boxing（拳击）/ boxer（拳击手）/ box（盒子）
wordForms.other: 构词：box(v.打拳) + -ing → boxing(n.拳击运动)；box(v.) → boxer(n.拳击手)。贴士：box 作动词是"拳击"，作名词是"盒子"，属熟词多义；Boxing Day 是英国的"节礼日"(12月26日)，与拳击无关。

collocations.translation: 包括太极和拳击（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: A whole new range of courses have been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing! 我们为各年龄段的人设计了全新的课程，包括太极和拳击！（课文原句）
They watched a boxing match on TV last night. 他们昨晚看了一场拳击比赛。
He does boxing twice a week to keep fit. 他每周练两次拳击来保持健康。
The whole town crowded into the hall to watch the boxing match, their cheers shaking the rafters with every thundering blow. （读后续写·比赛现场）
Stepping into the boxing ring for the first time, she felt her knees weaken, yet somewhere deep inside a small, stubborn voice refused to let her turn back. （读后续写·勇气）
He laced up his worn boxing gloves with trembling fingers, each strap a silent promise that tonight he would not disappoint his late father. （读后续写·传承）
The coach, who had once been a boxing champion, was as patient with beginners as he was fierce in the ring. （读后续写·人物）
After years of being bullied, the timid boy quietly took up boxing, and month by month the fear in his eyes gave way to a quiet, unshakable calm. （读后续写·蜕变）
Our new boxing class has proved so popular that we have added a second evening session in response to overwhelming demand. （应用文·通知）
Every morning before dawn the old man practised shadow boxing in the empty park, his slow, precise movements a kind of moving meditation. （读后续写·晨练）

synonyms.example: Unlike boxing, wrestling relies less on striking than on grip, balance and the patient art of throwing an opponent off his feet. （议论文·运动比较）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：wrestling（摔跤）靠抓握、摔投取胜，不用拳击打；boxing（拳击）以拳头击打为核心。二者同为格斗项目但规则、技术截然不同。

synonyms.example: In their evening sparring sessions the two friends learned as much about trust as about technique. （读后续写·训练）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：sparring 特指拳击/格斗中“戴护具的对练、试打”，是训练环节；boxing 是整个运动项目，sparring 是其中的一部分。

advancedExpressions.expression: box(v.打拳) / boxing(n.拳击运动) / boxer(n.拳击手)
advancedExpressions.example: The young boxer (n.) had boxed (v.) since childhood, and boxing (n.) gave his restless life a purpose. 这位年轻拳击手从小练拳，拳击给了他躁动的人生一个目标。（一句串起三个词形）

advancedExpressions.expression: a boxing match / ring / champion / class；take up boxing；shadow boxing
advancedExpressions.example: After watching a boxing match, the shy boy decided to take up boxing himself. 看完一场拳击比赛后，这个害羞的男孩决定自己也去练拳击。

advancedExpressions.expression: stepping into the boxing ring, sb. felt ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: Stepping into the boxing ring at last, she felt her whole body shake, yet with the first bell something braver than fear rose up to meet the fight. （分词状语+yet转折，续写恐惧到勇气的转变）

advancedExpressions.expression: a whole new range of courses ..., including ... and boxing
advancedExpressions.example: A whole new range of courses has been designed for people of all ages, including tai chi and boxing, so that no one need feel too old or too young to begin. （列举+目的状语，通知/宣传信）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being mere ..., boxing teaches ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being mere aggression, boxing at its best teaches discipline, respect and the mastery of one's own fear. （far from驳斥偏见+列举品质，议论文正名）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was scared the first time he did boxing.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The first time he climbed through the ropes into the boxing ring, his mouth ran dry and his gloved hands would not stop shaking — yet the moment the bell rang, all his fear dissolved into pure, roaring instinct. （读后续写·首战）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 具体动作(climbed through the ropes) + 生理细节(mouth ran dry, hands shaking) + 破折号转折 + 抽象具象化(fear dissolved into instinct)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Boxing is not just fighting; it teaches good things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being the brutal spectacle its critics imagine, boxing, when properly taught, instils in the young a rare blend of discipline, humility and courage — lessons that echo far beyond the narrow square of the ring. （议论文·体育价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: far from驳斥前置 + 插入语(when properly taught)限定 + 三词并列(discipline, humility, courage) + 破折号升华(echo beyond the ring)

sub_section: B2: Review of the sports centre
original_sentence: The coach, who was a boxing champion, was patient and professional.
readingExamples: The coach, who was a boxing champion, was patient and professional.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person, team or animal that has won a competition, especially in sport
(2) n. someone who publicly fights for, defends or supports a group of people, a belief or a cause
(3) vt. to publicly support, defend or fight for a person, principle or cause that you strongly believe in
(4) adj. (informal) excellent; the best of its kind

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某事业/群体的）拥护者，捍卫者，斗士
uncommonMeanings.example: Long before the world had a name for her cause, she had made herself the tireless champion of every voiceless child in the crowded slums. （议论文·社会正义·人物）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 捍卫，声援，为……而奋斗
uncommonMeanings.example: Rising to her feet before the silent hall, she vowed to champion the rights of the forgotten, whatever the cost to herself. （读后续写·挺身而出·信念）

posExamples.sentence: As the final bell rang and the referee lifted her exhausted arm, the new champion stood swaying in the centre of the ring, unable to believe that the years of lonely, aching training had led at last to this. （读后续写·夺冠瞬间）
The coach, who had once been a boxing champion, guided every beginner with a patience that made even the clumsiest of us believe we might one day be great. （读后续写·恩师）
I am writing to urge our school to champion the cause of environmental protection, for it is our generation that will inherit whatever planet we choose to leave behind. （应用文·倡议书）
A true champion, history reminds us, is measured not only by the titles won but by the courage to stand up for what is right when it is easiest to stay silent. （议论文·英雄品质）

wordForms.noun: champion（冠军；拥护者）/ championship（锦标赛；冠军称号）
wordForms.verb: champion（vt. 拥护，捍卫，为……而奋斗）
wordForms.other: 构词：champion + -ship → championship(锦标赛/冠军头衔)。贴士：champion 一词三用——① n.冠军 a boxing champion；② n.拥护者 a champion of the poor；③ vt.拥护 champion a cause。别只记"冠军"！

collocations.translation: 拳击冠军（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The coach, who was a boxing champion, was patient and professional. 这位教练曾是拳击冠军，既有耐心又很专业。（课文原句）
The Olympic champion returned home to a hero's welcome. 这位奥运冠军回国时受到英雄般的欢迎。

collocations.translation: 拥护／捍卫某项事业、理念（vt.熟词僻义）
collocations.example: She spent her life championing the rights of women. 她毕生捍卫女性的权利。
To think that a shy village girl would one day become a national champion was, for everyone but her mother, quite unthinkable. （读后续写·励志）
The defending champion walked to the starting line with a calm that unsettled every rival on the track. （读后续写·比赛）

collocations.phrase: a champion of sth / a cause
collocations.example: She spent her whole life as a champion of the poor, asking for herself nothing that she did not first wish for others. （议论文·奉献）
The moment he was crowned champion, he sank to his knees and pointed silently at the sky, where he knew his grandfather was watching. （读后续写·夺冠·情感）
Great reformers are often those willing to champion an unpopular idea long before the world is ready to accept it. （议论文·改革先驱）

collocations.translation: 拳击／游泳／国际象棋冠军
collocations.example: The coach, who was a boxing champion, was patient and professional, treating each nervous newcomer as a future champion in the making. （读后续写·教练）
The whole nation embraced the shy, stammering boy as an unlikely champion whose humility moved them even more than his skill. （读后续写·平民英雄）
After three heartbreaking near-misses, the team finally won the championship, and grown men wept openly in the stands. （读后续写·团队夺冠）

synonyms.example: The winner of the essay contest was announced, and to her utter astonishment the quiet girl in the corner heard her own name. （读后续写·意外获奖）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：winner 泛指“任何一次比赛/评选的获胜者”，范围最广；champion 特指“通过整届赛事夺得的冠军”，头衔感更强，且可引申为“拥护者”，winner 无此义。

synonyms.example: As the smoke cleared, the exhausted victor surveyed the ruined field, feeling no triumph, only a heavy, sobering silence. （读后续写·惨胜）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：victor 正式、带文学色彩，多用于战斗、竞赛的“胜利者”，语气庄重；champion 更常用于体育冠军，且含“最高水平”的荣誉意味。

synonyms.example: As a lifelong advocate of clean energy, she never tired of reminding the young that the earth was borrowed, not inherited. （议论文·环保倡导）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析：作“拥护者”解时，advocate 侧重“公开倡导、主张”某观点或政策，语气中性正式；champion 更强调“挺身捍卫、为之奋斗”，带有斗士般的热情与力量。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·who引导非限制性定语从句

advancedExpressions.example: The coach, who was a boxing champion, was patient and professional. 这位教练曾是拳击冠军，既有耐心又专业。（课文原句：who 补充说明先行词 the coach，逗号隔开不可用 that）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·冠军(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: champion / winner / victor / title-holder
advancedExpressions.example: As the champion / the winner, she lifted the trophy high above her head. 作为冠军，她把奖杯高举过头。（一般语境四者可换，champion 头衔感最强）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·拥护者(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: champion of sth / advocate of sth / supporter of sth / defender of sth
advancedExpressions.example: He was a lifelong champion / advocate of equal education. 他毕生拥护教育平等。（表"拥护者"时四者可换，champion 最有斗士色彩）

advancedExpressions.expression: champion(n.冠军) + -ship → championship(n.锦标赛；冠军头衔)
advancedExpressions.example: The champion (n.) defended his title and won the championship (n.) again. 这位冠军卫冕成功，再次赢得锦标赛。

advancedExpressions.expression: as ..., the new champion could hardly believe that ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the crowd erupted around her, the new champion could hardly believe that the lonely years of pre-dawn training had finally borne such glorious fruit. （高潮渲染+因果回望，续写夺冠升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I urge us all to champion the cause of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely urge us all to champion the cause of a greener campus, for small daily choices, multiplied by every student, can reshape the world we live in. （倡议主句+因果论证，倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: a true champion is measured not by ... but by ...
advancedExpressions.example: A true champion is measured not by the trophies on the shelf but by the courage to defend the weak when silence would be far more convenient. （not...but...对比+价值升华，议论文点题）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She won and became the champion.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the referee finally raised her trembling arm, the roar of the crowd washed over her like a wave — she was the champion at last, and the endless, uncomplaining dawns of training suddenly felt worth every single one. （读后续写·夺冠瞬间）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 具体场景(referee raised her arm) + 明喻(like a wave) + 破折号点明结果 + 尾句情感回望(dawns of training worth it)升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should support environmental protection.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that our school should proudly champion the cause of environmental protection, transforming scattered good intentions into a movement that no student can watch from the sidelines. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that正式主句 + champion the cause of有力谓语 + transforming现在分词状语 + 隐喻(a movement...from the sidelines)增强号召力

classPractice.note: 课文原句；非限制性定语从句指人作主语用 who，不用 that

classPractice.note: championship n. 锦标赛/冠军头衔；win the championship 赢得锦标赛冠军

classPractice.question: 她毕生拥护穷人的权利。
classPractice.answer: She championed the rights of the poor all her life. / She was a lifelong champion of the poor.

sub_section: B2: Review of the sports centre
original_sentence: Despite all these improvements, I have also found something that still needs to be done: so far no basketball court has been built.
readingExamples: Despite all these improvements, I have also found something that still needs to be done: so far no basketball court has been built.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an area marked out for playing tennis, basketball, badminton and similar games
(2) n. the place where legal cases are heard and decided; the judge and officials who hear a case
(3) n. the official home and staff of a king or queen; a royal residence
(4) v. to try to gain the support or favour of someone; to behave so as to make something (often bad) likely to happen

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 法庭；法院（也指审案的法官及官员）
uncommonMeanings.example: The case will be heard in court next Monday. 此案下周一将在法庭审理。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 招致，自找（麻烦、危险等）
uncommonMeanings.example: By ignoring every warning his coach had given him, the reckless young driver was courting disaster, and the whole grandstand held its breath as his car screamed into the final bend. （读后续写·赛车/冒险·埋伏笔）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （尤指旧时）追求，向……求爱
uncommonMeanings.example: For three long summers he had courted her in silence, leaving a single white rose on her doorstep each dawn and never once daring to speak his name. （读后续写·怀旧爱情·含蓄深情）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 宫廷；王室
uncommonMeanings.example: The young painter arrived at court a nobody, yet within a year the queen herself was seeking his portraits. （读后续写·历史/宫廷）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the final whistle blew, Ben sank to his knees in the middle of the court, tears mixing with sweat, for the trophy he had chased since childhood was finally, unbelievably, his. （读后续写·体育夺冠·情感爆发）

I am writing to propose that a multi-purpose court be constructed on the vacant land behind the library, so that students may enjoy basketball, badminton and volleyball after a long day of study. （应用文·建议信）
When a dispute cannot be settled through reason and mutual respect, taking the matter to court should be regarded as the last resort rather than the first impulse. （议论文·法治与理性）
Politicians who court public opinion merely to win votes, while quietly abandoning their promises afterwards, do lasting damage to the trust on which democracy depends. （议论文·诚信与公信力）

wordForms.other: courtier (n. 廷臣)

idioms.idiom: the ball is in one's court
idioms.translation: 轮到某人做决定（该由某人行动了）
idioms.example: "I've done everything I possibly can to help you," the old teacher said gently; "now the ball is in your court." （读后续写·师生对话·点题）

idioms.translation: 众星捧月般高谈阔论；被众人簇拥
idioms.example: At every reunion Grandpa would hold court by the fireplace, and we children would gather at his feet, spellbound by tales of his seafaring youth. （读后续写·家庭温情）

collocations.translation: 【课件】网球场／羽毛球场（球场义；足球用 field）
collocations.example: They booked a tennis court for Saturday, while the soccer team practised on a nearby field. 他们订了周六的网球场，足球队则在附近的场地训练。（课件搭配）
The players were already warming up on court when the coach arrived. 教练到达时，队员们已经在球场上热身了。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】起诉某人，把某人告上法庭
collocations.example: She was taken to court for not paying the bill on time. 她因未按时付账单而被起诉。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】维多利亚女王的宫廷（court 宫廷义）
collocations.example: The young painter arrived at the court of Queen Victoria a nobody, yet within a year he was famous. 这位年轻画家初到维多利亚女王的宫廷时默默无闻，但一年之内便声名鹊起。（课件搭配）
Despite all these improvements, I have also found something that still needs to be done: so far no basketball court has been built. 尽管有这些改进，我还是发现有件事仍需要做：到目前为止还没有建篮球场。（课文原句）
They booked a tennis court for Saturday morning. 他们订了周六上午的网球场。
The two sides finally went to court over the money. 双方最终为这笔钱对簿公堂。
So far no basketball court has been built, which is a real pity given how many students long to play after class. （应用文·反馈报告）
Rather than going to court over such a trivial misunderstanding, the two neighbours chose to sit down over a pot of tea and talk it through. （读后续写·邻里和解）
The company threatened to take the young inventor to court, but public sympathy was firmly on his side. （议论文·维权）
On the morning he was to appear in court, his hands trembled so violently that he could barely knot his tie. （读后续写·紧张心理）
In a court of law, it is evidence, not emotion, that ultimately decides where the truth lies. （议论文·理性与法治）
The two parties wisely settled the matter out of court, sparing both families years of bitter conflict. （议论文·社会成本）
Climbing that cliff without a rope was courting danger, and even his boldest friends begged him to turn back. （读后续写·冒险警示）
On court she was a fierce competitor; off court, the gentlest soul you could ever hope to meet. （读后续写·人物反差）
As soon as the buzzer sounded, the referees cleared the court so the medical team could rush to the fallen player. （读后续写·突发事件）

synonyms.example: The special tribunal was set up to hear cases that ordinary courts had failed to resolve. （议论文·司法制度）
synonyms.usage: 指为特定案件设立的专门审判机构，比 court 更正式、更具体，多用于书面或制度语境

synonyms.example: He pursued her friendship with a patience that finally won her heart. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: 作"追求"讲时可替换 court 的"求爱/争取"义，但 pursue 更中性、目标更宽泛（可追求事业、真理），court 隐含讨好、示好

synonyms.example: Careless words often invite trouble that a moment's silence would have avoided. （议论文·言行）
synonyms.usage: invite disaster / criticism 与 court disaster 义近，但 court 更强调"主动做出危险举动"，语气更书面、更有画面感

advancedExpressions.expression: court = ① 球场 a tennis court ② 法庭 go to court ③ 宫廷 the royal court ④ vt.招致 court disaster ⑤ vt.<旧>求爱
advancedExpressions.example: On the tennis court (球场) he was fearless; in a court of law (法庭) he was nervous. 在网球场上他无所畏惧，在法庭上却很紧张。（同一个词，两种语境两种意思）

advancedExpressions.expression: go to court / take sb to court / appear in court / a court of law / settle out of court
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than take him to court, they settled the dispute out of court. 他们没有起诉他，而是庭外和解了纠纷。

advancedExpressions.expression: little did sb know that ... was courting disaster
advancedExpressions.example: Little did the boastful climbers know that, in mocking the mountain's warnings, they were courting a disaster none of them would ever forget. （倒装 little did + court disaster，续写中段制造悬念与转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest that a ... court be built so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would strongly suggest that a well-equipped basketball court be built on the empty ground, so that every student can unwind and stay fit after class. （虚拟语气 suggest that + should be done + so that 目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: true justice is served not in the court of law alone, but in the court of ...
advancedExpressions.example: True justice is served not in the court of law alone, but in the court of conscience, where each of us must answer to ourselves. （court 一词双关 + not ... but ... 对比结构，深化立意）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He played basketball on the court.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Under the flickering lamp of the deserted court, he dribbled alone late into the night, each thud of the ball against the concrete echoing his stubborn refusal to give up on the dream everyone else had abandoned. （读后续写·环境+动作+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境烘托(flickering lamp / deserted court) + 拟声动作(each thud ... echoing) + 心理升华(stubborn refusal to give up)

sentenceUpgrade.original: If you break the rules, you may get into trouble.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Those who bend the rules for short-term gain are, whether they realise it or not, courting a kind of trouble that no clever excuse can later talk away. （议论文·警示）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 定语从句(Those who...) + 插入语(whether they realise it or not) + court trouble 高级动词替换 get into trouble + that 定语从句收束

original_sentence: I've been feeling a bit under the weather recently: generally tired and not myself.
readingExamples: I've been feeling a bit under the weather recently: generally tired and not myself.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. (informal) feeling slightly ill or unwell, though not seriously sick
(2) phr. (informal) low in spirits; feeling down or out of sorts

posExamples.sentence: Grandma had been under the weather all week, so I tiptoed into her room each morning with a bowl of warm porridge and stayed until the colour slowly returned to her cheeks. （读后续写·亲情照护·细节动人）
I'm afraid I have to postpone our meeting, as I've been feeling rather under the weather these past few days and would not want to pass anything on to you. （应用文·请假/致歉邮件）
When a friend seems under the weather, a single sincere message asking how they are can mean far more than a dozen cheerful clichés. （议论文·人际关怀）

idioms.translation: 感觉身体不适／不在状态
idioms.example: "You've been feeling under the weather lately, haven't you?" she asked softly, and something in her gentle tone made me want to tell her everything. （读后续写·关切对话）

collocations.translation: （感觉）有点身体不适（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I've been feeling a bit under the weather recently: generally tired and not myself. 我最近感觉有点不舒服：总是很累，也不像平时的自己。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 感觉身体不适／不在状态
collocations.example: If you feel under the weather, take the day off. 如果你感觉不舒服，就请一天假吧。

collocations.phrase: be / feel a bit under the weather
collocations.example: I've been feeling a bit under the weather recently: generally tired and not myself. （应用文·邮件倾诉）
You look a little under the weather this morning — why don't you go home and get some proper rest? （读后续写·同事关怀）
Though still slightly under the weather, she insisted on standing on the stage she had dreamed of for so long. （读后续写·坚持梦想）

collocations.phrase: a bit / rather / slightly under the weather
collocations.example: He seemed rather under the weather, yet not once did he let his students see how much effort each lesson now cost him. （读后续写·敬业教师）

synonyms.example: Feeling unwell, she asked to be excused from the afternoon rehearsal. （应用文·请假）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、书面，直接说明身体状况；under the weather 更口语、更委婉，适合日常对话与非正式邮件

synonyms.translation: 气色不好，身体欠佳（英式口语）
synonyms.example: You've been looking a bit off colour — is everything all right at home? （读后续写·体贴询问）
synonyms.usage: 与 under the weather 几乎同义，同为口语委婉说法，off colour 更侧重"脸色/状态"上的不佳

synonyms.example: Months of overwork had left him thoroughly run-down, jumping at every cold that went around. （议论文·健康代价）
synonyms.usage: 强调因劳累、压力导致的长期虚弱；under the weather 多指暂时的、轻微的不适

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·身体不适(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: under the weather / unwell / off colour / out of sorts / not oneself
advancedExpressions.example: She's been under the weather / not quite herself all week. 她整整一周都不太舒服。（口语委婉表"身体/状态欠佳"，可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: feel / be / look a bit under the weather；still under the weather
advancedExpressions.example: You look a bit under the weather — why not go home and rest? 你看起来不太舒服，何不回家休息？

advancedExpressions.expression: though sb had been under the weather, sb refused to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though she had been under the weather for days, she refused to miss her little brother's first performance, forcing a warm smile past her fever. （让步状语 though + refused to 突出意志，为下文情感升华蓄势）

advancedExpressions.expression: I regret that, feeling under the weather, I am unable to ...
advancedExpressions.example: I regret to inform you that, feeling rather under the weather, I am unable to attend tomorrow's gathering, and I do hope you will understand. （I regret that 正式致歉 + 现在分词状语 feeling ...，礼貌得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: when someone is under the weather, what they need is not ... but ...
advancedExpressions.example: When someone is under the weather, what they truly need is not a list of remedies, but the quiet reassurance that they are not facing it alone. （not ... but ... 对比 + 名词化 reassurance，凸显情感价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I feel a little ill today.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A heavy dullness had settled over me since dawn — nothing I could name, just that vague, sinking sense of being under the weather that makes even sunlight feel too bright. （读后续写·身体感受具象化）

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步倒装(Under the weather though she was) + 状语前置强调 + unwilling to 现在分词 + 抽象化"承诺"升华动机

classPractice.question: 我最近感觉有点不舒服。I've been feeling a bit ____ ____ ____ recently.

classPractice.question: 如果你感觉身体不适，就早点回家休息。
classPractice.answer: If you feel under the weather, go home and rest early.

classPractice.question: He is feeling a little ill today. → He is feeling a little ____ ____ ____ today.
classPractice.note: under the weather = slightly ill/unwell，口语替换 ill

original_sentence: I have so much schoolwork. Plus I take part in a lot of after-school activities.
readingExamples: I have so much schoolwork. Plus I take part in a lot of after-school activities.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. used to show that one number or amount is added to another; with the addition of
(2) conj. (informal) and also; and what is more (used to add a further point)
(3) n. an advantage or a positive feature of a situation
(4) adj. (of a grade) slightly above the standard marked; (of an amount) or more, above zero

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优点，好处，有利因素
uncommonMeanings.example: "Being able to speak three languages is a real plus in this job," the interviewer remarked, and for the first time that morning Mia allowed herself a hopeful smile. （读后续写·面试/求职·转折希望）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （成绩）略高一档的（如 B plus）；正的，以上的
uncommonMeanings.example: Her essay earned a B plus, but the note in the margin — "you write with a rare honesty" — meant far more to her than the grade itself. （读后续写·师生鼓励）

posExamples.sentence: I have so much schoolwork these days. Plus, I've signed up for the debating club, so my evenings are stretched thinner than ever. （应用文·邮件倾诉）
The volunteer programme not only lets us help others; a further plus is that it teaches patience and teamwork we could never learn from a textbook. （议论文·实践的价值）
By the time we reached the summit, our reward was the whole valley spread beneath us, plus a sunrise so golden that no photograph could ever do it justice. （读后续写·登顶·景色升华）
The trip will cost around two hundred yuan plus, so I would advise everyone to bring a little extra just in case. （应用文·活动通知）

wordForms.other: plus (prep./conj.)

idioms.translation: 上下浮动，正负（误差范围）
idioms.example: The forecast promised a temperature of twenty degrees, plus or minus two, so we packed a light jacket just to be safe. （应用文·出行提示）
Her calmness under pressure was a real plus point that the coach valued above raw talent. （议论文·品质）

collocations.translation: 而且，另外（补充理由，课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I have so much schoolwork. Plus I take part in a lot of after-school activities. 我有那么多作业。而且我还参加很多课外活动。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一个优点／有利因素（熟词 n.）
collocations.example: Being good at English is a real plus in this job. 英语好在这份工作中是个很大的优势。
Three plus four equals seven. 三加四等于七。
I really can't afford those gym classes. Plus, I'd probably give up within a week without someone to push me along. （应用文·邮件）
Living close to the library was a big plus, saving me an hour of travelling every single day. （读后续写·生活便利）
The training was exhausting; on the plus side, I had never felt so alive, so certain of who I wanted to become. （读后续写·先抑后扬）
Before making my decision, I sat down and honestly weighed the plus points and minus points of studying abroad. （议论文·权衡）

collocations.translation: A 加／B 加（成绩等级）
collocations.example: When the paper came back marked with a bright red A plus, she pressed it to her chest and ran all the way home. （读后续写·喜悦）

collocations.translation: 五以上／一百多（数量以上）
collocations.example: A hundred plus students had already signed up before the sun even rose over the campus. （读后续写·踊跃报名）
The workshop welcomes all readers aged twelve plus, regardless of their reading level. （应用文·招募通知）

synonyms.example: The plan is affordable; moreover, it can be carried out immediately without any special equipment. （议论文·递进论证）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面连接词，用于议论文/应用文加强论点；plus 作"而且"讲更口语、更随意，多见于日常对话和非正式邮件

synonyms.example: One clear advantage of early rising is the quiet, unhurried start it gives to the whole day. （议论文·习惯）
synonyms.usage: 名词"优点"义可替换 plus (n.)，但 advantage 更正式、更常用于书面；a plus 更口语、更轻快

synonyms.example: I don't feel like going out tonight. Besides, it's already pouring with rain. （读后续写·口语补充）
synonyms.usage: 口语补充理由时与 plus 高度重合，besides 略带"再说、况且"的辩解意味，plus 更中性地"再加一条"

advancedExpressions.expression: plus = ① prep.加上 3 plus 4 ② conj.而且 Plus, ... ③ n.优点 a real plus ④ adj.略高一档 B plus
advancedExpressions.example: The job pays well; plus (conj.), the free lunch is a nice plus (n.). 这份工作薪水不错，而且免费午餐也是个不错的加分项。（同句展示 conj. 与 n. 两种用法）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·而且(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: plus / besides / moreover / what's more / in addition
advancedExpressions.example: It's cheap; plus / besides, it's easy to use. 它很便宜，而且好用。（口语补充理由，plus/besides 更随意）

advancedExpressions.expression: a big / real plus；on the plus side；plus points and minus points
advancedExpressions.example: The pay was low, but on the plus side the work was meaningful. 薪水不高，但从好的方面看，工作很有意义。

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., but on the plus side, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The road had been long and lonely; but on the plus side, every hardship along the way had quietly turned a timid boy into a man who feared nothing. （on the plus side 转折 + 抽象升华 turned a boy into a man）

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., plus it would ...
advancedExpressions.example: Setting up a reading corner would enrich our lunch breaks, plus it would encourage even the shyest students to share the books they love. （plus 口语连接补充第二理由，语气亲切自然）

advancedExpressions.expression: weighing the pluses against the minuses, one must conclude that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Weighing the pluses against the minuses, one must conclude that the benefits of this reform far outweigh its temporary inconveniences. （pluses against minuses 平行对比 + far outweigh 强化结论）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I am busy, and I also have many activities.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: My days are already crammed with homework from dawn till dusk — plus, between the choir and the volleyball team, I scarcely have a spare hour to call my own. （应用文·邮件·口语真实感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 夸张状语(from dawn till dusk) + plus 口语连接 + between ... and ... 列举 + scarcely 倒装意味的强调

sentenceUpgrade.original: The plan has some good points.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Setting aside its obvious appeal, the plan carries a quieter plus few had noticed: it gently draws even the loneliest students back into the warmth of a community. （议论文·深挖优点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Setting aside...) + a quieter plus 名词化优点 + 冒号解释 + 情感化收束(warmth of a community)

classPractice.question: I have so much schoolwork. ____ I take part in a lot of after-school activities.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；plus conj. 句首表"而且、另外"，补充理由

classPractice.question: 填 plus 的词性(prep./conj./n.)：Being able to drive is a real plus when you apply for this job.____
