original_sentence: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym.
readingExamples: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. located a short distance away; not far off; close at hand
(2) adv. close to a particular place; not far away; in the immediate area

posExamples.sentence: As the storm broke, we scrambled towards a nearby barn, its old wooden door groaning on rusty hinges as if reluctant to let strangers in. （读后续写·避雨·环境渲染）
She sat quietly by the window, and somewhere nearby a lark was singing, its clear notes weaving through the still morning air. （读后续写·宁静氛围·听觉描写）
I would suggest we hold the charity sale at the nearby community centre, since its central location will surely attract more passers-by and raise more funds. （应用文·活动建议）
Rather than travelling far in search of beauty, we often overlook the wonders lying nearby — a blossoming tree, a familiar street, a friend's kind smile. （议论文·珍惜身边·哲思）

wordForms.adjective: nearby（附近的，作定语）/ near（近的）
wordForms.adverb: nearby（在附近）/ near（近，接近）/ nearly（几乎，差点）
wordForms.other: 辨析：nearby 既是形容词(a nearby gym)又是副词(live nearby)，作形容词一般作前置定语；near 可作形容词/副词/介词(near the school)；nearly=almost 几乎，词义完全不同，别混！

collocations.translation: 附近的健身房（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym. 我实在负担不起在附近健身房报班。（课文原句）
They moved to a nearby town last year. 去年他们搬到了附近的一个城镇。
My grandparents live nearby, so we visit them often. 我祖父母住在附近，所以我们常去看他们。

collocations.phrase: a nearby town / village / gym / shop
collocations.translation: 附近的城镇／村庄／健身房／商店
collocations.example: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym, however tempting the shiny new machines look. （应用文·邮件）
Knowing that Grandma lived nearby, I would drop in after school just to hear her stories and steal a warm dumpling or two. （读后续写·亲情）
A stream must have run somewhere nearby, for we could hear its gentle murmur long before we saw it. （读后续写·寻找水源）
From a nearby table, an elderly man watched the lonely boy for a while, then quietly paid for his meal. （读后续写·陌生人善意）
A crowd had gathered nearby, whispering anxiously, none of them daring to step forward and help. （读后续写·围观时刻）
Volunteers rushed the injured hiker to a nearby hospital, and the whole team waited outside until the doctor finally smiled. （读后续写·救援）

synonyms.example: Students from the neighbouring village walked two hours each day just to reach our tiny school. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: 多修饰地区、国家、村镇等较大范围的"相邻"，比 nearby 更正式、更书面；nearby 泛指"附近的"，范围更小更日常

synonyms.example: Our classroom is adjacent to the library, so slipping in for a quick book is wonderfully easy. （应用文·介绍）
synonyms.usage: 强调"紧挨着、直接相邻"，比 nearby 距离更近、更正式，常用于书面描述空间关系

synonyms.example: Help was close by, though in that terrifying moment it felt a world away. （读后续写·危急）
synonyms.usage: 口语色彩浓，作状语与 nearby 几乎同义；close by 更强调"就在手边、触手可及"的心理距离

advancedExpressions.expression: near(近的/介词) / nearby(附近的；在附近) / nearly(几乎)
advancedExpressions.example: A nearby shop was nearly empty because the new mall opened near the station. 附近一家商店几乎空无一人，因为新商场在车站附近开业了。（一句区分三词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·nearby作形容词与副词
advancedExpressions.expression: a nearby + n.（定语）；v. + nearby（状语）
advancedExpressions.example: She sat at a nearby table (adj.) while her dog waited nearby (adv.). 她坐在旁边一张桌子旁，狗则在附近等着。

advancedExpressions.expression: somewhere nearby, ... could be heard / seen
advancedExpressions.example: Somewhere nearby, the faint laughter of children could be heard, a warm reminder that safety and home were not so far away after all. （somewhere nearby 引出听觉细节 + 情感投射 warm reminder，营造画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: held at the nearby ..., which is convenient for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The event will be held at the nearby sports centre, which is easily reached on foot and convenient for students from every corner of the campus. （nearby + which 非限制定语从句说明便利，条理清晰）

advancedExpressions.expression: the beauty we seek afar often lies nearby, waiting to be noticed
advancedExpressions.example: The happiness we chase across distant lands often lies nearby all along, waiting patiently to be noticed by eyes too busy to look. （afar 与 nearby 对照 + waiting to be noticed 拟人升华，点明哲理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was a house near us, so we went there.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Spotting a nearby cottage half-hidden among the pines, we quickened our steps, and the sight of smoke curling from its chimney sent a rush of warmth through our frozen limbs. （读后续写·寻得庇护·希望）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Spotting a nearby cottage...) + 环境细节(smoke curling from its chimney) + 生理反应写心理(a rush of warmth through frozen limbs)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use the gym near our school.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Making full use of the nearby gym would spare us the long, tiring commute, and, just as importantly, allow more students to fit exercise into their crowded timetables. （应用文·建议·双重理由）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动名词主语(Making full use of...) + spare sb sth 句型 + and just as importantly 插入语递进第二理由

classPractice.question: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the ____ (near) gym.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；nearby adj. 附近的，作前置定语修饰 gym

classPractice.question: 填 nearby / nearly：It was ____ midnight when they finally reached home.
classPractice.note: nearly=almost 几乎；nearby=附近，两词别混

classPractice.question: 我的祖父母住在附近，所以我常去看他们。My grandparents live ____, so I often visit them.
classPractice.note: nearby adv. 在附近，作状语修饰 live

original_sentence: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym.
readingExamples: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym.
definitionEn:
(1) n. (informal, short for gymnasium) a room or building with equipment for doing physical exercise, often part of a club
(2) n. a club where you go to exercise, keep fit or train; membership of such a club
(3) n. (informal, short for gymnastics) exercises and sports done indoors, especially as a school subject

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （学校的）体操课，体育课（gymnastics 的缩略）
uncommonMeanings.example: Ever since he sprained his ankle, gym had become an hour of quiet dread, and he would linger in the changing room until the very last possible moment. （读后续写·校园·自卑心理）

posExamples.sentence: The first time she pushed open the heavy doors of the gym, the clang of iron and the smell of sweat and determination told her she had finally found where she belonged. （读后续写·健身房初体验·归属感）
I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym, so I was wondering whether we might work out together in the school playground instead. （应用文·邮件请求）
Building a well-equipped gym on campus would do more than strengthen students' bodies; it would teach them discipline, resilience and the quiet pride that comes from steady effort. （议论文·体育育人）
To promote a healthier lifestyle, our school gym will now open every evening, and all students are warmly welcome to come and stretch away the stress of a long day. （应用文·通知）

wordForms.noun: gym（健身房；体育馆）/ gymnasium（体育馆，全称）/ gymnast（体操运动员）/ gymnastics（体操）
wordForms.other: 构词：gym 是 gymnasium（体育馆）的缩略，也可是 gymnastics（体操课）的缩略。贴士：go to the gym 去健身房；the school gym 学校体育馆；gym class 体育课。

collocations.phrase: sign up for classes in the (nearby) gym
collocations.translation: 在（附近的）健身房报班（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym. 我实在负担不起在附近健身房报班。（课文原句）
She goes to the gym three times a week. 她每周去健身房三次。
Every dawn, rain or shine, the old man went to the gym, and his quiet persistence slowly shamed the rest of us into showing up too. （读后续写·榜样力量）

collocations.phrase: join / sign up for a gym
collocations.example: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby gym, however much I long to get fit. （应用文·邮件）
Working out at the gym after each exam became my way of shaking off pressure and clearing my crowded mind. （读后续写·减压）
For my birthday, my parents surprised me with a gym membership, a gift that quietly told me they believed in the athlete I dreamed of becoming. （读后续写·家庭支持）
The graduation ceremony was held in the school gym, its walls still echoing with a thousand cheerful memories. （读后续写·毕业·怀旧）
Whenever life felt overwhelming, she would hit the gym, letting each drop of sweat wash a little of the worry away. （读后续写·情绪出口）

collocations.phrase: a gym class / a gym instructor
collocations.example: The gym instructor never once mocked my clumsy first attempts; instead, he cheered every small step I made. （读后续写·鼓励）

synonyms.translation: 体育馆，健身房（正式全称）
synonyms.example: The newly built gymnasium could seat two thousand spectators for the inter-school championships. （应用文·设施介绍）
synonyms.usage: gym 的正式全称，多用于书面或正式语境；日常口语几乎都用缩略的 gym

synonyms.example: The modern fitness centre offered everything from yoga to weightlifting under one roof. （应用文·介绍）
synonyms.usage: 指设施更全面的商业健身场所，涵盖多种运动项目；gym 更泛指、更口语，可大可小

synonyms.translation: 健身，锻炼（名词，指一次锻炼）
synonyms.example: A short morning workout left him energised for the whole day ahead. （议论文·习惯）
synonyms.usage: 指"一次锻炼活动"本身，是行为；gym 指"锻炼的场所"，两者常搭配使用(a workout at the gym)

advancedExpressions.expression: gym = gymnasium(体育馆) 或 gymnastics(体操) 的缩略；相关词 gymnast(体操运动员)
advancedExpressions.example: The gym (=gymnasium) was full of young gymnasts practising gymnastics. 体育馆里满是练体操的年轻体操运动员。（一句串起缩略与词族）

advancedExpressions.expression: go to / hit the gym；join / sign up for a gym；work out at the gym；a gym membership
advancedExpressions.example: Whenever she felt stressed, she would hit the gym and work out. 每当感到压力，她就去健身房锻炼。

advancedExpressions.expression: the gym became more than ...; it became ...
advancedExpressions.example: Little by little, the gym became more than a place to lift weights; it became the one corner of the world where I could rebuild the confidence life had chipped away. （more than ...; it became ... 递进 + 抽象化空间意义，突出内心成长）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would like to propose that our school gym ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to propose that our school gym stay open at weekends, so that students burdened with study can still find a healthy way to release their stress. （propose that + should-omitted 虚拟语气 + so that 目的从句，倡议规范）

advancedExpressions.expression: a gym trains not only the body but also the ...
advancedExpressions.example: A gym trains not only the body but also the will, teaching us that real strength is measured by how many times we rise after falling. （not only ... but also ... 平行 + 格言式收束，升华体育的精神价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He went to the gym every day to get stronger.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Day after day he returned to the dim little gym, and with every rep, every drop of sweat, he was not merely building muscle but forging the iron will that would one day carry him far beyond that cramped basement room. （读后续写·励志·苦练）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语前置(Day after day) + 平行细节(every rep, every drop of sweat) + not merely ... but ... 递进 + 隐喻(forging the iron will)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our school should build a gym for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that equipping our campus with a proper gym would not only safeguard students' health but also cultivate the perseverance that no examination can ever measure. （应用文/议论·建议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + not only ... but also 平行 + safeguard / cultivate 高级动词 + 抽象升华(no examination can measure)

classPractice.question: I just can't afford to sign up for classes in the nearby ____ (gym).
classPractice.note: 课文原句；gym n. 健身房，sign up for classes in the gym 在健身房报班

classPractice.question: 她每周去健身房三次来保持健康。She ____ ____ ____ ____ three times a week to keep fit.
classPractice.note: go to the gym 去健身房；固定搭配加定冠词 the

classPractice.question: 填 gym / gymnastics：The little girl practises ____ every afternoon, hoping to compete one day.
classPractice.note: gymnastics n. 体操（运动项目）；gym 是其缩略，此处正式项目名用全称更佳

original_sentence: I'm pretty sure I would soon give up without a partner.
readingExamples: I'm pretty sure I would soon give up without a partner.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of two or more people who work, play or dance together, or share an activity
(2) n. the person you are married to or have a long-term romantic relationship with
(3) n. a person or organisation that jointly owns or runs a business and shares its profits and risks
(4) v. to be the partner of someone in a game, dance or activity; to join with someone as a partner

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 与……搭档，做……的搭档
uncommonMeanings.example: When the shy new boy was left without a group, our teacher gently asked me to partner him, and that small act of kindness grew into a friendship that lasted a lifetime. （读后续写·校园友善·善意生根）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （企业的）合伙人，股东
uncommonMeanings.example: At just twenty-six, she was made a partner in the firm, yet she never forgot the mentor who had once believed in a girl with nothing but ambition. （读后续写·事业成功·不忘初心）

posExamples.sentence: The moment my knees began to buckle halfway up the cliff, my climbing partner gripped my wrist and roared, "I've got you — don't you dare let go!" （读后续写·登山·患难与共）
I'm pretty sure I would soon give up without a partner, so I was hoping you might be willing to train alongside me and keep each other going. （应用文·邮件邀约）
A good partner does not simply share your triumphs; he stands firmest beside you in the moments when everyone else has quietly walked away. （议论文·真正的伙伴）
For the final round, each experienced player was asked to partner a beginner, so that skill and courage might be passed from one hand to another. （应用文·活动安排）

wordForms.other: 构词法：partner + -ship → partnership（n. 合伙关系，抽象名词后缀 -ship 表"状态/关系"，比较 friendship, membership）。贴士：partner 既是名词"搭档/伙伴/伴侣/合伙人"，也可作及物动词 partner sb = 与某人搭档；口语常说 partner up (with sb)。表"配偶/伴侣"时中性，不点明性别，比 husband/wife 更委婉包容。

idioms.translation: （常戏谑）狼狈为奸的同伙；一起淘气的搭档
idioms.example: From kindergarten onwards the two of them were partners in crime, forever plotting some harmless mischief that left the whole class in stitches. （读后续写·童年友谊·诙谐）

collocations.translation: 没有搭档（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I would soon give up without a partner. 没有搭档，我很快就会放弃。
She partnered a beginner in the final round. 决赛轮她与一名新手搭档。
Honesty turns a stranger into a trusted business partner. 诚信让陌生人变成可信的生意伙伴。
Honesty, my grandfather always said, is what turns a stranger into a trusted business partner. （议论文·诚信经营）

collocations.translation: 舞伴／训练搭档／学习伙伴
collocations.example: Without a training partner to push me on those bitter winter mornings, I'm pretty sure I would soon have given up. （应用文·邮件）
In sickness and in health they had been each other's life partner for fifty years, and their hands still found each other in the dark. （读后续写·相守·温情）
Our school works in partnership with a local charity to bring warm meals to children in need. （应用文·合作介绍）

collocations.phrase: a partner in a firm / a senior partner
collocations.translation: 公司合伙人／高级合伙人
collocations.example: After years of quiet dedication, she rose to become a senior partner, the youngest the firm had ever known. （议论文·奋斗）
Finding the right partner for the science project turned out to matter far more than I had ever imagined. （读后续写·合作）
"Why don't we partner up?" she offered with a smile, and just like that, my loneliest term became my happiest. （读后续写·主动示好）

collocations.translation: 可靠的／值得信赖的伙伴
collocations.example: Through thick and thin, he had proved himself a reliable partner on whom the whole team could lean. （议论文·信任）

synonyms.example: The old dog had been her faithful companion through every lonely evening of that long, cold winter. （读后续写·陪伴）
synonyms.usage: 侧重"作伴、陪伴"的情感联系，未必共同做事；partner 强调"共同参与某活动/合作"，更具协作意味

synonyms.example: In a classroom where she felt like an outsider, one kind teacher became her greatest ally. （读后续写·支持）
synonyms.usage: 强调在竞争或对抗中"站在同一边、互相支持"，带立场色彩；partner 更中性，指日常合作或搭档关系

synonyms.example: Her teammates lifted her onto their shoulders, chanting her name into the floodlit night. （读后续写·团队荣誉）
synonyms.usage: 特指同一队伍中的成员，范围较窄；partner 可指两人搭档或商业、生活各类合作关系，涵盖更广

advancedExpressions.expression: without a partner ｜ partner (with) sb ｜ partner up with sb ｜ work in partnership with sb
advancedExpressions.example: Since none of us wished to train without a partner, we agreed to partner up and work in close partnership all winter. （一句串起四个短语，示范搭档主题）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"合作伙伴"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: partner ｜ companion ｜ teammate ｜ ally ｜ collaborator
advancedExpressions.example: 更中性广义用 partner；作伴陪伴用 companion；同队用 teammate；同一阵营/立场用 ally；共同创作用 collaborator。（只列可替换项，据语境选词）

advancedExpressions.expression: partner → partnership（合伙关系）
advancedExpressions.example: The two schools signed a lasting partnership. 两校缔结了长久的合作关系。（-ship 表"关系/身份"，同类 friendship, leadership）

advancedExpressions.expression: a true partner is one who ... when ...
advancedExpressions.example: A true partner, I came to understand that night, is one who tightens his grip on your hand precisely when your own strength begins to fail. （a true partner is one who 定义式框架 + precisely when 强调时机，深化情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would be grateful if you could be my partner in ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would be truly grateful if you could be my partner in this fitness challenge, for I know that with someone by my side I am far less likely to give up. （I would be grateful if 礼貌请求 + for 引导原因，诚恳得体）

advancedExpressions.expression: great achievements are seldom the work of one, but of partners who ...
advancedExpressions.example: Great achievements are seldom the work of one lone genius, but of partners who lift each other higher than either could ever climb alone. （not ... but ... 对比 + 比喻(lift each other higher)，论证合作的力量）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I don't want to exercise alone, so I need a partner.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The thought of pounding the empty track alone, morning after morning, drained me of all resolve — I knew that without a partner to share the ache and the small victories, I would surely give up before long. （应用文/叙事·倾诉）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象心理具象化(drained me of all resolve) + 时间状语(morning after morning) + without 条件状语 + 平行(the ache and the small victories)

sentenceUpgrade.original: A good partner helps you when you are in trouble.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The truest measure of a partner lies not in the cheers he offers when you soar, but in the steady hand he extends when you stumble and the world falls silent. （议论文·格言式）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The truest measure of ... lies not in ... but in ... 对比框架 + when 状语并列 + 意象对照(cheers when you soar / steady hand when you stumble)

classPractice.question:
我很确定，没有搭档我很快就会放弃。（partner）
I'm pretty sure I would soon give up ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；without + 名词表"没有……的条件下"，冠词 a 不可漏。

classPractice.question: The two companies have worked in ____ (partner) for over a decade, sharing both profits and risks.
classPractice.note: 考构词：介词 in 后需名词，partner + -ship → partnership"合伙关系"。

classPractice.question: In the group dance, each experienced dancer was asked to ____ (partner / companion / teammate) a nervous beginner.
classPractice.note: 此处需及物动词"给……做搭档"，只有 partner 能作动词；另两词均为名词。

original_sentence: What would you do in my position?
readingExamples: What would you do in my position?
definitionEn:
(1) n. the situation that someone is in, especially when it affects what they can and cannot do
(2) n. the particular place where someone or something is, in relation to other things
(3) n. a job, especially an important one in a large organization
(4) n. an opinion or attitude towards a particular subject

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】处境，境况（尤指对你能做什么有影响的局面）——in a difficult/awkward position 即此义
uncommonMeanings.example: She was in a position of having to lie to her friend. 她处境艰难，不得不向朋友撒谎。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】观点，立场（对某议题的看法）——one's position on sth
uncommonMeanings.example: He once more stated his position on educational fairness. 他再次阐明了自己在教育公平问题上的观点。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 处境，境况（尤指对你能做什么有影响的局面）——课文 in my position 即此义
uncommonMeanings.example: What would you do in my position? 换作你，处在我这个处境会怎么办？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 立场，态度（对某议题的看法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The school took a firm position on the phone ban. 学校对禁手机一事立场坚定。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 职位，岗位（尤指大机构中的重要职位）
uncommonMeanings.example: I am writing to apply for the position of volunteer. 我写信申请志愿者一职。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 姿势，姿态（身体所处的姿态）
uncommonMeanings.example: He held the tai chi position for a full minute. 他把这个太极姿势保持了整整一分钟。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把……放在（合适的）位置；使处于（某状态）
uncommonMeanings.example: She positioned herself by the door, ready to slip out the moment the applause died down — a girl who had learned never to be trapped in a room she could not leave. （读后续写·人物性格·警觉）

posExamples.sentence: Frozen halfway up the cliff, I could feel my fingers slipping and my heart pounding; from where I clung, there was no position more terrifying, and no choice but to keep climbing toward the ledge above. （读后续写·冒险脱险）

I am writing to apply for the position of student volunteer at the upcoming International Reading Festival, as I believe my organizing experience makes me a suitable candidate for this role. （应用文·申请信）

While many people take a firm position against allowing phones in classrooms, we should recognize that, when used wisely, such devices can transform passive listeners into active learners. （议论文·科技与教育）
The guide carefully positioned the lantern at the mouth of the cave, and its trembling light drove the darkness back just far enough for us to find our footing. （读后续写·探险场景）

wordForms.other: 构词法：来自拉丁 pos-（放置，同 pose, compose, expose, deposit）+ -ition 名词后缀。一词多义要靠搭配区分：in one's position=处境；a position on sth=立场；the position of...=职位；hold a position 兼有"任职/持立场"两义，看语境。高频固定短语 be in a position to do sth=有能力/条件做某事（否定 be in no position to do=没资格/没能力做）。

idioms.idiom: be in a position to do sth
idioms.example: Only after years of quiet study was she finally in a position to help the very children who, like her younger self, had once been told they would never amount to anything. （读后续写·成长回馈）

idioms.idiom: be in no position to do sth
idioms.translation: 没有资格/没有能力做某事
idioms.example: Having broken the rule myself, I was in no position to blame him for doing the same. 自己都违了规，我没资格因他做同样的事而责怪他。

idioms.idiom: put sb in an awkward position
idioms.example: His careless promise put me in an awkward position, for I now had to choose between disappointing my closest friend and breaking my word to the whole team. （读后续写·两难抉择）

collocations.example: She was in a position of having to lie to her friend. 她处境艰难，不得不向朋友撒谎。
If you were in the same position, you would understand my choice. 如果你处于同样的处境，就会理解我的选择。
He applied for the position of manager. 他申请了经理一职。
Let me sit in a comfortable position. 让我坐个舒服的姿势。

collocations.translation: 【课件】某人对某事的观点／立场
collocations.example: He once more stated his position on educational fairness. 他再次阐明了自己在教育公平问题上的观点。

collocations.translation: 【课件】处在我的处境（做某事）——课文原句词块，此处=处境
collocations.example: What would you do in my position? 换作你，处在我这个处境会怎么做？

collocations.translation: 处在我的处境（课文原句词块，此处=处境）
collocations.example: What would you do in my position? 换作你，处在我的处境会怎么做？

collocations.phrase: be in a position to do sth
collocations.example: After years of study she was finally in a position to help others. 多年学习后她终于有能力帮助别人了。
Each speaker took a clear position on the issue. 每位发言者对该议题都表明了明确立场。
In my position, torn between loyalty and honesty, what would any of us truly have done? （读后续写·内心独白）
Encouraged by my teacher, I decided to apply for the position of class monitor, though my hands were shaking as I raised them to volunteer. （读后续写·校园成长）

collocations.translation: 负有责任/掌握权力的职位
collocations.example: Being elected to a position of responsibility taught me that leadership is less about giving orders and more about listening carefully. （议论文·领导力）
She has held the position of team captain for three years, guiding the squad through both crushing defeats and unexpected triumphs. （读后续写·体育励志）

collocations.phrase: be in a strong / weak position
collocations.example: Having practised every single day, our choir was in a strong position to win the city competition. （读后续写·比赛准备）
Faced with the new evidence, the committee had the courage to reverse its position and support the students' proposal. （应用文·会议纪要）

collocations.translation: 使自己处于（某位置/状态）
collocations.example: By volunteering abroad, she positioned herself to gain the cross-cultural experience that no textbook could offer. （议论文·个人发展）

synonyms.example: In such a desperate situation, staying calm was the only thing that stood between us and panic. （读后续写·危机时刻）
synonyms.usage: 泛指所处的整体环境或局面，比 position 更中性宽泛；position 更强调这一处境对你能做什么的限制或影响。

synonyms.example: He was offered the post of head coach, an honour he had dreamed of since childhood. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 特指具体的工作岗位，常用于正式或军事/官方语境；position 的职位义更通用，还可指立场、位置。

synonyms.example: The government's firm stance on protecting wildlife won admiration from young environmentalists. （议论文·环保）
synonyms.usage: 专指对某议题的公开态度或立场，比 position 更书面、更强调坚定性；不用于表示地点或职位。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·without引导含蓄非真实条件(would/would have)
advancedExpressions.expression: without + 名词 = if ... (didn't have / hadn't) ...，主句用 would / would have + 过去分词（含蓄的虚拟条件）
advancedExpressions.example: I would give up without a partner. = I would give up if I didn't have a partner. 没有搭档我会放弃。（without a partner 相当于"如果我没有搭档"，主句用 would 表非真实条件）

advancedExpressions.expression: in my position（处境）｜ take a position on sth（立场）｜ apply for / hold the position of...（职位）｜ be in a position to do sth（有能力）
advancedExpressions.example: In my difficult position, I was in no position to take a public position on the matter, let alone apply for the position of spokesperson. （一句演示四种义项，靠搭配辨义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"处境/职位/立场"，据义可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: 处境: position ≈ situation ｜ 职位: position ≈ post / job ｜ 立场: position ≈ stance / attitude
advancedExpressions.example: 同一个 position，换 situation 强调整体局面，换 post 强调具体岗位，换 stance 强调对议题的坚定态度。（只列可替换项，选词看侧重）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be in a position to do 高频句式
advancedExpressions.expression: be in a (strong/good/no) position to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: Having saved for years, we are now in a strong position to help. 存了多年钱，如今我们完全有能力施以援手。（后接不定式，否定用 in no position to do）

advancedExpressions.expression: torn between ... and ..., I found myself in an impossible position
advancedExpressions.example: Torn between telling the truth and shielding my friend, I found myself in an impossible position, my conscience pulling one way and my loyalty the other. （对照结构+心理拉扯，续写冲突段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am writing to apply for the position of ..., convinced that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am writing to apply for the position of exchange-programme representative, convinced that my passion for cross-cultural exchange makes me an ideal fit. （申请信开门见山+自信收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: while some take the position that ..., I would argue that ...
advancedExpressions.example: While some take the position that competition harms young learners, I would argue that healthy rivalry, properly guided, sharpens both skill and character. （让步+反驳，观点段开篇）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I didn't know what to do in that situation.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Caught in a position I had never imagined myself in — the whole class watching, the clock ticking, the answer stubbornly out of reach — I stood frozen, uncertain whether to speak or simply sink into my seat. （读后续写·尴尬心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作状语(Caught in...)开头 + 三个并列独立主格(the class watching / the clock ticking / the answer out of reach)营造画面 + 破折号插入细节 + 选择疑问收尾表现犹豫

sentenceUpgrade.original: Our school should support this plan.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that our school, being in a unique position to shape young minds, should not only support but wholeheartedly champion this reading initiative. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...正式主句 + being in a position to...现在分词作插入语说明理由 + not only...but wholeheartedly...递进强调

classPractice.question:
她处境艰难，不得不向朋友撒谎。（position）
She was ____ ____ ____ of having to lie to her friend.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】be in a position of doing sth 表"处于……的处境"；此处 position=处境，不是位置。

classPractice.question: Without air, we ____ not live on the Earth.（现在）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】without 引导含蓄非真实条件，指现在，主句用 would + 动词原形（=If there were no air, we would not live...）。

classPractice.question: Without your help, I ____ not have finished my work on time.（过去）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】without 引导含蓄非真实条件，指过去，主句用 would + have + 过去分词（=If you hadn't helped me, I would not have finished...）。

classPractice.question: Without permission from the authority, we ____ not have the gathering in the park tomorrow.（将来）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】without 引导含蓄非真实条件，指将来，主句用 would + 动词原形（=If we didn't get permission, we would not have the gathering tomorrow）。

classPractice.question:
换作你，处在我的处境会怎么做？（position）
What would you do ____ ____ ____?
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；in one's position 此处指"处境"，不是"位置"。

classPractice.question: Having trained hard for years, our team is now in a strong ____ (position) to compete for the national title.
classPractice.note: 固定句式 be in a position to do sth"有能力做某事"；此处 position 作名词，前有形容词 strong 修饰。

classPractice.question:
The government refused to change its ____ (position / situation) on protecting wildlife, insisting the ban must stay.
（表"立场"）
classPractice.note: 表"对某议题的立场/态度"用 position（≈stance）；situation 只指"局面、情况"，不表立场。

classPractice.question:
自己都迟到了，我没资格责怪他。（be in no position to）
____
classPractice.answer: Having been late myself, I was in no position to blame him. / As I was late myself, I am in no position to blame him.
classPractice.note: be in no position to do sth="没资格/没能力做"，to 后接动词原形。

original_sentence: When my friend first suggested that we join the new Tai Chi Club at school, I hesitated.
readingExamples: When my friend first suggested that we join the new Tai Chi Club at school, I hesitated.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to pause before you do or say something, often because you are uncertain or nervous
(2) vi. to be unwilling to do something because you are not sure it is right or good
(3) vi. to stop briefly in the middle of an action out of doubt or reluctance

posExamples.sentence: My hand hovered over the doorbell; I hesitated, wondering whether an apology three years too late could possibly mean anything at all, then pressed it before my courage could fail me. （读后续写·和解）
If you have any questions about the charity sale or wish to lend a hand, please do not hesitate to contact me at any time — we would be delighted to have you on board. （应用文·倡议书结尾）
When it comes to standing up for what is right, we should never hesitate, for silence in the face of injustice is itself a kind of consent. （议论文·社会责任）
Seeing the old man slip on the icy pavement, she did not hesitate for a second but rushed forward, catching him just before he hit the ground. （读后续写·助人瞬间）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：hesitate (v.) → hesitation (n. 犹豫) → hesitant (adj. 犹豫的) → hesitantly (adv. 犹豫地)。贴士：hesitate 是不及物动词，不直接跟宾语，常见搭配 hesitate to do / about sth / over sth。名词短语 without (a moment's) hesitation 与 after a moment's hesitation 是续写高分表达。礼貌套语 Please don't hesitate to contact/ask... 用于应用文结尾。

idioms.translation: 尽管去做（某事）；别不好意思做
idioms.example: Should you ever find yourself struggling with the coursework, don't hesitate to knock on my door — no question is too small. （应用文·帮扶信）
When the coach asked who would take the final, decisive penalty, Tom stepped forward without hesitation, though his legs were trembling. （读后续写·关键时刻）
Remembering the old saying that he who hesitates is lost, I raised my hand and volunteered before doubt could talk me out of it. （读后续写·抓住机会）

collocations.translation: 【课件】迟疑做某事；不愿做某事
collocations.example: Don't hesitate to contact me if you need any more information. 若需要更多信息，请尽管与我联系。
He hesitates about nothing. 他对什么事都毫不迟疑。

collocations.phrase: hesitate (about) wh- 从句 / wh- + to do sth
collocations.example: She hesitated about whether to join the club. 她对要不要加入俱乐部犹豫不决。

collocations.translation: 【课件】毫不犹豫（hesitation n. 犹豫）
collocations.example: The boy followed without hesitation. 那男孩毫不犹豫地跟了上去。

collocations.phrase: have no hesitation in doing sth
collocations.example: I would have no hesitation in recommending Philip for the position. 我会毫不犹豫地推荐菲利普担任这个职位。
The boy followed without hesitation. 那男孩毫不犹豫地跟了上去。

collocations.translation: 犹豫（要不要做某事）——课文中单独作动词
collocations.example: When my friend suggested we join the club, I hesitated. 朋友提议我们加入俱乐部时，我犹豫了。

collocations.translation: 尽管去做；别不好意思做（书信礼貌套语）
collocations.example: If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask me. 若有任何疑问，尽管问我。
He stepped forward without hesitation. 他毫不犹豫地站了出来。
For a long moment she hesitated to open the letter, afraid of the news it might carry. （读后续写·忐忑）
He hesitated over the two paths for so long that the sun had begun to set before he finally chose. （读后续写·抉择）
She hesitated for a moment, her pen hovering above the answer sheet, before crossing out her first choice. （读后续写·考试心理）
When his teammate fell, he did not hesitate for a second to give up his own chance and help her across the line. （读后续写·体育精神）
They never hesitated in offering shelter to travellers lost in the storm. （读后续写·善良）
After a moment's hesitation, the shy boy walked up to the microphone and began, in a voice that grew steadier with every word. （读后续写·突破自我）
Without a moment's hesitation, the firefighter plunged back into the smoke to search for the trapped child. （读后续写·英雄）
With some hesitation, I finally confessed to my mother that I had failed the exam. （读后续写·坦白）

synonyms.example: Her determination never wavered, even when everyone around her urged her to give up. （读后续写·坚定）
synonyms.usage: 强调在决心或信念上的动摇、摇摆不定，可以是较长时间的反复；hesitate 更多指行动前短暂的停顿迟疑。

synonyms.example: He paused at the threshold, drew a deep breath, and stepped into the exam hall. （读后续写·蓄势）
synonyms.usage: 中性词，仅指动作或说话的短暂停顿，不一定含犹豫之意；hesitate 的停顿必带不确定或不情愿的心理。

synonyms.example: Her voice faltered as she read out the names of those who had not survived. （读后续写·哀伤）
synonyms.usage: 既可指声音因情绪而颤抖中断，也可指脚步或决心的动摇，情感色彩更浓；hesitate 更中性，主要指理性上的迟疑。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·hesitate 犹豫(动词+名词全搭配)
advancedExpressions.expression: hesitate to do sth ｜ hesitate about/at/over sth ｜ hesitate (about) wh-从句 ｜ without hesitation ｜ have no hesitation in doing sth ｜ do sth without hesitation
advancedExpressions.example: I hesitated to speak and hesitated over every word, yet when help was needed I had no hesitation in acting and did so without hesitation. （一句串起动词与名词全部搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: hesitate to do sth ｜ hesitate about/over sth ｜ don't hesitate to do sth ｜ without (a moment's) hesitation
advancedExpressions.example: I hesitated to speak and hesitated over every word, yet when help was needed I acted without a moment's hesitation. （一句串起动词与名词搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"犹豫/停顿"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: hesitate ｜ waver ｜ pause ｜ falter ｜ think twice
advancedExpressions.example: 行动前理性迟疑用 hesitate；决心动摇用 waver；单纯停顿用 pause；因胆怯支吾/蹒跚用 falter；"三思"口语用 think twice。（只列可替换项，据侧重选词）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·hesitate 不及物 + to do
advancedExpressions.expression: sb hesitate to do sth（后接不定式，不接 that 从句作宾语）
advancedExpressions.example: She hesitated to tell the truth. 她迟迟不肯说出真相。（注意：不说 hesitate telling；否定礼貌式 Don't hesitate to...）

advancedExpressions.expression: without a moment's hesitation, sb. + 强动词
advancedExpressions.example: Without a moment's hesitation, she flung open the door and dashed into the rain, her mother's medicine clutched tightly to her chest. （零犹豫开头+强动作动词，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: please do not hesitate to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Should you require any further information about the volunteer programme, please do not hesitate to reach out to me. （书信礼貌收尾套语）

advancedExpressions.expression: we must not hesitate when ...
advancedExpressions.example: We must not hesitate when the chance to protect our environment presents itself, for hesitation today may cost us the very future we hope to save. （呼吁段+因果论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was not sure whether to knock, so I waited.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I hesitated at the door, my knuckles an inch from the wood, torn between the fear of rejection and the desperate hope that this time, at last, she might forgive me. （读后续写·和解心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: hesitate 替代 wait 精准表现犹豫 + 独立主格(my knuckles an inch from the wood)定格画面 + torn between A and B 展现矛盾心理 + at last 递进强化渴望

sentenceUpgrade.original: If you need help, contact us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Should you encounter any difficulty along the way, please do not hesitate to turn to us, for no member of our community should ever have to struggle alone. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Should引导的省略倒装条件句(=If you should...) + do not hesitate to...礼貌套语 + for引导原因分句升华人文关怀

classPractice.question:
他对什么事都毫不迟疑。（hesitate）
He ____ ____ ____ nothing.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】hesitate about/over sth"对……犹豫不决"；主语 He 单数，一般现在时用 hesitates；三空可填 hesitates about 或 hesitates over。

classPractice.question:
他毫不犹豫地跟了上去。（hesitation）
He followed ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】without hesitation"毫不犹豫"；hesitation 此处不可数，不加冠词。

classPractice.question: When my friend first suggested that we join the new Tai Chi Club, I ____ (hesitate), unsure whether it would suit me.
classPractice.note: 课文原句语境；叙述过去用一般过去时 hesitated。

classPractice.question:
如有任何疑问，请尽管联系我。（hesitate）
If you have any questions, please ____ ____ ____ contact me.
classPractice.note: 书信礼貌套语 don't hesitate to do sth；to 后接动词原形。

classPractice.question:
看到老人滑倒，她毫不犹豫地冲上前去。（hesitation）
Seeing the old man slip, she rushed forward ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: hesitation 此处不可数，不能说 without a hesitation；三空填 without any hesitation="毫不犹豫"（两空时可用 without hesitation，或 without a moment's hesitation）。hesitate 为不及物动词，此处需用名词形式。

original_sentence: After the first class, however, I had to admit that I had been wrong about tai chi.
readingExamples: After the first class, however, I had to admit that I had been wrong about tai chi.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to agree, often unwillingly, that something is true
(2) vt. to allow someone to enter a place, or to become a member of a school, club, or organization
(3) vt. to accept someone into a hospital for treatment
(4) vt. to confess that you have done something wrong

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（常勉强地）承认……属实，招认——to agree that sth is true, especially unwillingly；课文 admit that... 即此义
uncommonMeanings.example: I had to admit that I had been wrong about tai chi. 我不得不承认，我之前看错了太极。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】允许……进入（公共场所）——to allow sb to enter a public place
uncommonMeanings.example: The society admits all US citizens over 21. 该协会接纳所有 21 岁以上的美国公民。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】准许……加入（组织、俱乐部等）——to allow sb to join an organization, club etc.
uncommonMeanings.example: If you leave the club, you will not be admitted into it again. 你若退会，就不会再被准许加入。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常勉强地）承认……属实——课文 admit that... 即此义
uncommonMeanings.example: I had to admit that I had been wrong about tai chi. 我不得不承认我之前看错了太极。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 准许……进入（某地方/组织/学校）
uncommonMeanings.example: Only ticket holders will be admitted to the hall. 只有持票者才准入场。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 接纳……入院（送医院治疗）
uncommonMeanings.example: The boy was rushed to the county hospital and admitted at once, his pulse so faint that the nurse dared not leave his side. （读后续写·急救场景）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 准予入学/入会；接纳为成员
uncommonMeanings.example: The letter announcing that she had been admitted to her dream university slipped from her trembling fingers as tears blurred every golden word. （读后续写·梦想成真）

posExamples.sentence: Staring at the shattered vase, I lowered my head and admitted, in a voice barely above a whisper, that it was I who had broken it and lied all afternoon. （读后续写·认错）
I must admit that our first proposal had its flaws; however, after listening to everyone's feedback, we have revised the plan to make it fairer for all classes. （应用文·会议发言/回复信）
Even those who once doubted the value of online learning now admit to its remarkable power to bring quality education to remote villages. （议论文·教育公平）
The security guard checked our tickets carefully before admitting us to the concert hall, where the orchestra was already tuning their instruments. （读后续写·入场场景）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：admit (v.) → admission (n. 承认/准入/录取，常用) / admittance (n. 准许进入，多用于"No admittance 禁止入内"告示) → admissible (adj. 可接受的) / admitted (adj. 公认的) → admittedly (adv. 诚然，插入语)。特例拼写：admit 重读闭音节，加 -ing/-ed/-ance 要双写 t → admitting, admitted, admittance。句法：admit 后接 that 从句或 doing（承认做过），不接 to do；"承认做"绝不能说 admit to do sth。

idioms.example: Even when her legs gave way on the final lap, she refused to admit defeat, dragging herself across the finish line on sheer willpower. （读后续写·永不言弃）
Admittedly, I had underestimated my grandmother's strength; the frail woman I pitied had, in truth, weathered storms I could scarcely imagine. （读后续写·认知转变）

collocations.example: After questioning, he admitted to the murder. 经过审问，他承认了谋杀罪行。

collocations.phrase: admit doing sth / having done sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】承认做了某事（后接动名词，不接不定式）
collocations.example: Greene admitted causing death by reckless driving. 格林承认因鲁莽驾驶导致他人死亡。

collocations.translation: 【课件】承认（某事实）——课文即此结构
collocations.example: I had to admit that I had been wrong about tai chi. 我不得不承认，我之前看错了太极。
Everyone admitted the plan to be a great success. 大家都承认这个计划非常成功。
The society admits all US citizens over 21. 该协会接纳所有 21 岁以上的美国公民。

collocations.phrase: be admitted to / into (a school / hospital)
collocations.translation: 【课件】被（学校录取／医院收治）；获准进入
collocations.example: Only after you meet these requests will you be admitted to our school. 只有你达到这些要求后才会被我们学校录取。

collocations.translation: 【课件】作为……被接受（as 后接表示成员身份的名词）
collocations.example: He was admitted as a full member of the club. 他作为正式会员被俱乐部接纳。

collocations.phrase: admission n. 准许进入；承认；入场费
collocations.translation: 【课件·拓展】admission（准许进入／承认／入场费）
collocations.example: Admission to the exhibition is free for students. 学生免费入场参观展览。

collocations.translation: 承认（某事实）——课文即此结构
collocations.example: I had to admit that I had been wrong about tai chi. 我不得不承认，我之前看错了太极。

collocations.translation: 承认做过某事（后接动名词，不接不定式）
collocations.example: He admitted taking the money. 他承认拿了那笔钱。

collocations.phrase: admit sb to / into a place
collocations.translation: 准许某人进入（某处/某组织）
collocations.example: The guard admitted us to the concert hall. 保安放我们进了音乐厅。
She would never admit to feeling afraid, though her clenched fists told a different story. （读后续写·倔强）
After months of sleepless nights, he was at last admitted to the medical school he had always dreamed of. （读后续写·励志）
It takes real courage to admit one's mistake and greater courage still to make it right. （议论文·品格）
Thousands of hopeful students compete each year to gain admission to the country's top universities. （议论文·教育竞争）
The poster proudly announced free admission to the school art exhibition for all family members. （应用文·海报）

synonyms.example: With tears streaming down his cheeks, the boy confessed that he had been hiding the truth for weeks. （读后续写·坦白）
synonyms.usage: 语气更重，多指承认较严重的错误、罪行或隐藏已久的秘密，常含情感释放；admit 更中性，可承认任何事实（大到罪行，小到观点）。

synonyms.example: Even his rivals acknowledged that his performance was flawless. （议论文·客观评价）
synonyms.usage: 偏书面正式，强调对事实、贡献或他人价值的公开认可，不一定含'不情愿'；admit 常暗含勉强或对自身不利的承认。

synonyms.example: After a heated debate, she finally conceded that her opponent had a valid point. （议论文·辩论）
synonyms.usage: 多用于争论、竞赛中被迫承认对方正确或认输，带'退让'意味；admit 适用面更广，不限于争辩语境。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·admit doing / that，不接 to do
advancedExpressions.expression: admit (having) done sth ｜ admit that + 从句（承认做过用动名词或 that 从句，绝不接不定式 to do）
advancedExpressions.example: Greene admitted causing death by reckless driving. = Greene admitted that he had caused death by reckless driving. 格林承认因鲁莽驾驶致人死亡。（不能说 admitted to cause）

advancedExpressions.expression: admit that ... ｜ admit (having) done sth ｜ admit one's mistake ｜ be admitted to (a school/hospital) ｜ admit sb to/into a place
advancedExpressions.example: I had to admit that I was wrong and admit having judged him too soon; only then was I admitted into their circle of trust. （一句演示"承认"与"接纳"两大义群）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"承认"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: admit ｜ confess ｜ acknowledge ｜ concede ｜ own up (to)
advancedExpressions.example: 中性承认用 admit；坦白严重错误/罪行用 confess；正式认可事实或价值用 acknowledge；争辩中被迫退让承认用 concede；口语"主动坦白"用 own up to。（只列可替换项）

advancedExpressions.expression: admit → admission（承认/准入/录取）/ admittance（准许进入）
advancedExpressions.example: gain admission to a university 被大学录取；No admittance 禁止入内。（admission 义更广，admittance 专指"进入的许可"）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was then that I had to admit ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was then that I had to admit, however painful the truth, that my stubbornness had cost us far more than the prize we lost. （强调句+让步插入，续写觉醒段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I must admit that ..., yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: I must admit that our original schedule was too crowded; yet with your kind suggestions, we have arranged the events far more sensibly. （书信中先坦承再补救）

advancedExpressions.expression: admittedly, ...; nevertheless, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Admittedly, technology brings certain risks; nevertheless, its power to connect and empower far outweighs the dangers when handled responsibly. （让步-反驳结构，观点段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I told him that I was wrong.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Swallowing my pride, I looked him in the eye and admitted that I had been wrong all along — three words that felt heavier than any I had ever spoken, yet lighter, somehow, the moment they left my lips. （读后续写·认错心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Swallowing my pride 分词状语显心理 + admit 精准替代 tell + 破折号引出评论 + heavier...yet lighter 矛盾修辞刻画释然

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone now agrees that reading is important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Even the harshest critics of traditional books now readily admit that few habits shape a young mind as profoundly as reading widely and reflecting deeply. （议论文·阅读价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Even the harshest critics 让步主语增强说服力 + readily admit 显示态度转变 + few...as...as 比较级隐性强调 + reading widely and reflecting deeply 动名词并列升华

classPractice.question:
只有你达到这些要求后你才会被我们学校录取。（admit）
Only after you meet these requests ____ ____ ____ ____ our school.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】Only + 状语置于句首，主句部分倒装 will you...；被动 be admitted to"被……录取/获准进入"。

classPractice.question:
当警察审问乔治时，他承认偷了那辆车。（admit）
When the police questioned George, he ____ ____ the car.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】admit (having) done sth"承认做过某事"，后接动名词；发生在"审问"之前，用 having stolen 更强调先后，admitted stealing 亦可。

classPractice.question: If you leave the club, you will not ____ (admit) into the club again.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】admit sb into a place 表"允许进入"，主语 you 是被允许者，用被动 will not be admitted into。

classPractice.question:
然而，上完第一节课后，我不得不承认我之前看错了太极。（admit）
After the first class, however, I had to ____ ____ I had been wrong about tai chi.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；admit 后接 that 从句表"承认某事实"。

classPractice.question: The boy finally admitted ____ (take) the money, and relief washed over his guilty face.
classPractice.note: admit doing/having done sth"承认做过某事"，后接动名词，不能用不定式 to take。

classPractice.question: After months of hard work, she was at last ____ (admit) to the university of her dreams.
classPractice.note: 考"准予入学"义与被动 be admitted to；注意 admit 双写 t → admitted。

classPractice.question:
After a long debate, he was forced to ____ (admit / confess) that his rival's argument was stronger.
（争辩中被迫退让承认）
classPractice.note: 此处非坦白罪行，而是争辩中承认对方有理，用 admit（≈concede）；confess 语气过重，多指坦白错误或罪行。

original_sentence: Just as importantly, practising tai chi has inspired me to explore the Chinese culture behind it.
readingExamples: Just as importantly, practising tai chi has inspired me to explore the Chinese culture behind it.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something
(2) vt. to give someone the idea for a book, film, work of art, etc.
(3) vt. to make someone have a particular feeling or reaction
(4) vt. to fill someone with the ability or urge to do or create something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】启发思考，使产生（感觉或情感）——give new ideas and enthusiasm
uncommonMeanings.example: Jimi Hendrix inspired a generation of guitarists. 吉米·亨德里克斯启发了一代吉他手。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】激起，唤起（某种强烈情感或反应）——inspire sb with sth
uncommonMeanings.example: The captain's heroic effort inspired them with determination. 队长英勇的付出激起了他们的决心。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使产生（某种情感/反应）；激起
uncommonMeanings.example: The old lighthouse keeper's quiet devotion inspired in me a respect I had never felt for any hero on a screen. （读后续写·敬意油然而生）

posExamples.sentence: As I watched my grandmother patiently teach a stray child to read by candlelight, something stirred within me — she inspired me to believe that even the smallest act of kindness could light up another's world. （读后续写·榜样感召）
We sincerely hope that this charity run will inspire more students to care about the elderly in our community and to turn their compassion into real action. （应用文·倡议书）
Great teachers do far more than transfer knowledge; they inspire their students to think independently, to question boldly, and to pursue truth for its own sake. （议论文·教育的意义）
The sight of the first climbers reaching the summit inspired the exhausted team to push on, and one by one they rose to their feet and began the final ascent. （读后续写·团队登顶）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：inspire (v.) → inspiration (n. 灵感/激励) → inspiring (adj. 令人振奋的，修饰给人鼓舞的事物/人) / inspired (adj. 深受启发的；有灵感的，形容人或作品) / inspirational (adj. 鼓舞人心的) → inspiringly (adv.)。辨析要点：an inspiring teacher 一位鼓舞人的老师（主动给人鼓舞）vs. an inspired performance 一场充满灵感的演出（被赋予灵感）。核心句型 inspire sb to do sth；高级搭配 inspire + 抽象名词 + in sb（inspire confidence/hope in sb）。

collocations.translation: 【课件】激励某人做某事——课文即此结构
collocations.example: We should inspire the children to think. 我们应当激励孩子去思考。
Our first sight of the poet did inspire us with much confidence. 初次见到这位诗人便激起了我们极大的信心。
His confident leadership inspired his followers. 他自信的领导激励了追随者。
Jimi Hendrix inspired a generation of guitarists. 吉米·亨德里克斯启发了一代吉他手。
The captain's heroic effort inspired them with determination. 队长英勇的付出激起了他们的决心。

collocations.phrase: inspiration n. 启示；灵感；启发灵感的人
collocations.translation: 【课件·拓展】inspiration（启示／灵感／激励他人的人）
collocations.example: She was an inspiration to all of us. 她是我们所有人的激励榜样。

collocations.phrase: inspiring adj. 鼓舞人的；吸引人的
collocations.translation: 【课件·辨析】inspiring（令人鼓舞的，修饰给人鼓舞的事物/人）
collocations.example: Her inspiring speech yesterday made us encouraged. 她昨天鼓舞人心的演讲让我们深受激励。

collocations.phrase: inspired adj. 卓越的；激动人心的；受启发的
collocations.translation: 【课件·辨析】inspired（卓越的、充满灵感的；受鼓舞的）
collocations.example: She was one of the most inspired people I've met. 她是我见过的最有灵感/最卓越的人之一。

collocations.translation: 激励某人做某事——课文即此结构
collocations.example: Tai chi has inspired me to explore the culture behind it. 太极激励我去探索背后的文化。

collocations.phrase: inspire sb with sth / inspire sth in sb
collocations.translation: 用某物激励某人／在某人心中激起某种情感
collocations.example: The coach inspired the players with a stirring speech. 教练用一番激励人心的话鼓舞了队员。
Inspired by the young volunteer, dozens signed up. 受那位年轻志愿者感召，数十人报了名。
A leader who admits his own doubts, paradoxically, inspires the deepest confidence in his followers. （议论文·领导力）
For generations of readers, her quiet perseverance has remained a source of inspiration. （议论文·榜样）
The young painter drew inspiration from the misty mountains outside her window. （读后续写·创作）
The scientist who never gave up despite countless failures stands as an inspiring example to us all. （议论文·科学精神）
Open-ended questions inspire creativity far more effectively than rote memorization ever could. （议论文·教育方法）

synonyms.example: The promise of a trip to the coast motivated the whole class to finish their project early. （应用文·活动）
synonyms.usage: 偏重提供具体动机或目标去驱动行动，常与实际利益或明确目标相关；inspire 更侧重从内心点燃热情、信念或灵感，情感层次更高。

synonyms.example: My teacher's warm smile encouraged me to keep trying even after I stumbled. （读后续写·鼓励）
synonyms.usage: 指通过言语或态度给予支持、增强信心，较日常温和；inspire 的感染力更强，往往带来深层的思想或情感触动。

synonyms.example: The old song stirred memories she had long buried. （读后续写·触景生情）
synonyms.usage: 强调激起、搅动内心的情感或回忆，多与感情有关；inspire 除了触动情感，还能激发行动力与创造力。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·inspiring / inspired 辨析(-ing修饰施动，-ed修饰受动)
advancedExpressions.expression: inspiring adj.（令人鼓舞的，修饰"给人鼓舞"的事物/人）｜ inspired adj.（受鼓舞的、有灵感的、卓越的，修饰"被赋予灵感"的人/作品）
advancedExpressions.example: All of the students were inspired by the inspiring speech given by the headmaster. 所有学生都被校长鼓舞人心的演讲所激励。（speech 令人鼓舞→inspiring；students 受激励→inspired）

advancedExpressions.expression: inspire sb to do sth ｜ inspire sth in sb / inspire sb with sth ｜ be inspired by ｜ draw inspiration from ｜ a source of inspiration
advancedExpressions.example: Inspired by her mentor, she drew inspiration from every setback, and in turn inspired hope in others, urging them to do the same. （一句串起动词与名词搭配）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"激励/鼓舞"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: inspire ｜ motivate ｜ encourage ｜ stir ｜ spur (sb on)
advancedExpressions.example: 从内心点燃热情/灵感用 inspire；给予具体动机驱动用 motivate；言语支持增强信心用 encourage；激起情感回忆用 stir；"鞭策/激励前进"用 spur sb on。（只列可替换项，据情感层次选词）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ation 名词 & -ing/-ed 形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: inspire → inspiration (n.) ｜ inspiring (令人鼓舞的) / inspired (受鼓舞的、有灵感的)
advancedExpressions.example: Her inspiring story inspired an inspired response from every listener. 她鼓舞人心的故事激起了每位听众充满灵感的回应。（-ing 修饰施动方，-ed 修饰受动方）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was sb. who inspired me to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was that frail old teacher, more than any medal or prize, who inspired me to believe that greatness lies in perseverance, not applause. （强调句+对比，续写主旨升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: we hope this ... will inspire more people to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We sincerely hope this exhibition will inspire more young people to treasure and pass on our traditional culture. （倡议信呼吁段）

advancedExpressions.expression: what truly inspires ... is not ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: What truly inspires a generation is not fleeting fame, but the quiet, relentless pursuit of a worthy dream. （否定-肯定对比，观点段升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: My teacher made me want to work harder.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The way she stayed behind every evening, patiently guiding the slowest of us through each problem, inspired in me a determination I had never known I possessed — and from that day on, I studied not out of duty, but out of gratitude. （读后续写·师恩感召）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The way she... 名词化主语具象化 + inspired in sb. a determination 高级搭配 + 破折号引出结果 + not out of duty, but out of gratitude 对比升华动机

sentenceUpgrade.original: This activity can encourage students to help others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is our earnest hope that this volunteer programme will not merely occupy an afternoon, but inspire in every participant a lifelong commitment to serving those in need. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is our earnest hope that... 正式主句 + not merely...but inspire... 递进对比 + inspire in sb. a commitment 高级搭配 + those in need 抽象名词化收束

classPractice.question: The painter had a sudden ____.（用 inspire 的适当形式）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】此处需名词"灵感"，用 inspiration；a sudden inspiration=突然的灵感。

classPractice.question: She was one of the most ____ people I've ever met.（用 inspire 的适当形式）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】inspired adj."卓越的、有灵感的"，修饰"人"表其才华出众；the most inspired people=最有灵感/最卓越的人。

classPractice.question: All of the students were ____ by the ____ speech given by the headmaster.（用 inspire 的适当形式）
classPractice.note: 【课件原题·辨析】students 是受激励方，用 -ed 的 inspired；speech 令人鼓舞，用 -ing 的 inspiring。（注意主语 students 复数，系动词应为 were）

classPractice.question:
同样重要的是，练太极激励我去探索背后的中华文化。（inspire）
Just as importantly, practising tai chi has inspired me ____ ____ the Chinese culture behind it.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；核心句型 inspire sb to do sth，后接不定式。

classPractice.question: The young volunteer's story was so ____ (inspire) that dozens of classmates signed up on the spot.
classPractice.note: 修饰"故事"这一给人鼓舞的事物，用 -ing 形容词 inspiring；若说人"深受鼓舞"才用 inspired。

classPractice.question: ____ (inspire) by her coach's words, she trained harder than ever before.
classPractice.note: 句首过去分词作状语，表"她被激励"，用 -ed 形式 Inspired by...。

classPractice.question:
我们真诚地希望这次活动能激励更多学生去帮助他人。（inspire）
____
classPractice.answer: We sincerely hope (that) this activity will inspire more students to help others.
classPractice.note: inspire sb to do sth；hope 后可省 that，主句将来时 will inspire。

original_sentence: Just as importantly, practising tai chi has inspired me to explore the Chinese culture behind it.
readingExamples: Just as importantly, practising tai chi has inspired me to explore the Chinese culture behind it.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to travel through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it
(2) vt. to examine or discuss a subject or idea carefully in order to understand it better
(3) vt. to investigate a possibility, option, or opportunity thoroughly
(4) vt. to search a place carefully in order to find something

posExamples.sentence: Torch in hand, we crept deeper into the abandoned mine to explore the winding tunnels, every echo of dripping water sending a shiver down my spine. （读后续写·探险场景）
During the winter camp, students will have the chance to explore the rich history of our hometown through visits, interviews and hands-on workshops. （应用文·活动通知）
Rather than accepting others' opinions blindly, we should explore every issue from multiple angles before forming a judgement of our own. （议论文·独立思考）
Practising tai chi did more than strengthen my body; it inspired me to explore the profound philosophy hidden within each slow, deliberate movement. （读后续写·文化探索）

wordForms.other: 词族全家桶：explore (v. 探索) → exploration (n. 探索/勘探，抽象过程) / explorer (n. 探险家，指人) → exploratory (adj. 探索性的，如 exploratory talks 试探性会谈)。贴士：explore 兼作及物与不及物，既可 explore a place（探索某地）也可 explore an idea（探讨观点），义域从"实地勘探"到"抽象探究"皆可；不及物常见 go exploring。高频搭配 explore the possibility of doing sth。

collocations.translation: 探索某事物背后的文化（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Tai chi inspired me to explore the Chinese culture behind it. 太极激励我去探索它背后的中华文化。
Our club is exploring the possibility of setting up a tutoring service. 我们社团正在探讨开设辅导服务的可能性。

collocations.translation: 探讨某个想法/问题/话题
collocations.example: The essay explores the relationship between freedom and responsibility. 这篇文章探讨了自由与责任的关系。
We spent the whole afternoon exploring the ancient town, losing ourselves happily in its maze of narrow lanes. （读后续写·游历）
Before deciding on a major, she wisely took time to explore all her options. （议论文·人生规划）
A curious mind never stops longing to explore the unknown, whatever the risks may be. （议论文·好奇心）
Faced with the old problem, the team began to explore entirely new ways of teaching. （应用文·报告）
Learning calligraphy inspired me to explore my own cultural roots more deeply. （读后续写·文化认同）
The moment the rain stopped, the children ran off to go exploring in the woods behind the house. （读后续写·童年）

synonyms.example: The young journalist was determined to investigate the truth behind the mysterious closure. （议论文·求真）
synonyms.usage: 强调有目的、系统地调查以查明真相或事实，常用于问题、案件、现象；explore 更偏开放式地探索、发现，可指地方也可指想法。

synonyms.example: We must examine the evidence carefully before drawing any conclusion. （议论文·论证）
synonyms.usage: 侧重对具体事物或细节的仔细审查、检验；explore 范围更广、更具探索性和未知感，不局限于既有对象。

synonyms.example: Deep in the cave, they discovered paintings left by people thousands of years ago. （读后续写·发现）
synonyms.usage: 强调探索的'结果'——找到或意识到之前未知的东西；explore 强调探索的'过程与行为'，两者常前后相承。

synonyms.example: The article probes the deeper causes of teenage anxiety. 这篇文章深入探究青少年焦虑的深层原因。
synonyms.usage: 指对隐蔽、深层的问题刨根问底地探查，语气比 explore 更深入尖锐；explore 更中性开放，可指实地也可指话题。

advancedExpressions.expression: explore the culture behind sth ｜ explore an idea/issue ｜ explore the possibility of doing sth ｜ explore one's options ｜ go exploring

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能(表"探索/探究"，可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: explore ｜ investigate ｜ examine ｜ probe ｜ look into
advancedExpressions.example: 开放式探索/发现用 explore；系统调查真相用 investigate；仔细审视细节用 examine；深层刨根问底用 probe；口语"调查一下"用 look into。（只列可替换项，据侧重选词）

advancedExpressions.expression: explore → exploration (n. 探索) / explorer (n. 探险家) / exploratory (adj. 探索性的)
advancedExpressions.example: The explorer's exploration opened up a whole new field for exploratory research. 那位探险家的探索为试探性研究开辟了一片全新领域。（-ation 表过程，-er 指人，-ory 表性质）

advancedExpressions.expression: the more I explored ..., the more I realized ...
advancedExpressions.example: The more I explored the ancient art, the more I realized how little I truly knew — and how much there still was to learn. （比较级递进+对比，续写升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: the programme offers a rare chance to explore ...
advancedExpressions.example: The summer programme offers a rare chance to explore the wonders of marine biology at first hand. （通知/邀请信亮点介绍）

advancedExpressions.expression: only by exploring ... can we truly ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only by exploring an issue from every angle can we truly free ourselves from prejudice and reach a fair conclusion. （倒装+条件，观点段升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We walked around the old town and looked at everything.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We wandered off to explore the old town on our own, and with every twisting alley we turned down, a new surprise unfolded — a hidden teahouse here, a mossy stone bridge there, each whispering stories of centuries past. （读后续写·游历）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: explore 替代 look at 提升画面 + with every...动词短语递进 + 破折号列举具象细节 + whispering stories 拟人收束意境

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students should learn about different subjects.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than confining themselves to textbooks, students should be encouraged to explore a wide range of fields, for it is often at the crossroads of disciplines that true creativity is born. （议论文·跨学科学习）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than confining... 分词短语作让步 + explore a wide range of fields 高级搭配 + for引导原因 + at the crossroads of disciplines 隐喻升华

original_sentence: The first few tai chi classes were fun and easy, and the moves really caught my imagination, with descriptive names like "white crane spreading its wings" and "golden rooster standing on one leg".
readingExamples: The first few tai chi classes were fun and easy, and the moves really caught my imagination, with descriptive names like "white crane spreading its wings" and "golden rooster standing on one leg".
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large tall machine with a long arm, used for lifting and moving heavy objects
(2) n. a large tall bird with long legs and a long neck that lives near water
(3) vt. & vi. to stretch out your neck in order to see something better

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①鹤（大型涉禽，长颈长腿，课文义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The tai chi move "white crane spreading its wings" imitates a crane opening its graceful wings. （课文相关·招式意象）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②起重机，吊车（长臂机械，用于吊起重物）
uncommonMeanings.example: A giant crane lifted the steel beams high into the air. 一台巨型起重机把钢梁高高吊起。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③伸长（脖子）以看得更清楚
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole crowd craned their necks toward the finish line, holding their breath as the two runners sprinted neck and neck. （读后续写·比赛冲刺）

posExamples.sentence: At dawn, a single white crane rose from the misty lake, its wings unfolding like silk against the pale sky, and for a moment the whole valley seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·自然意境）
Visitors to the construction exhibition can watch a giant crane lift steel beams high into the air, a striking display of modern engineering. （应用文·展览介绍）
Standing on tiptoe, the little boy craned his neck over the sea of heads, desperate to catch a glimpse of the passing parade. （读后续写·人群中的孩子）
In Chinese culture, the crane has long been a symbol of longevity and grace, reminding us that some values are worth cherishing across the ages. （议论文·传统文化）

collocations.translation: 白鹤亮翅（课文原句·太极招式名）
collocations.example: The moves had descriptive names like "white crane spreading its wings". 招式有"白鹤亮翅"这样形象的名字。（课文原句）
I craned my neck to see over the fence. 我伸长脖子想越过篱笆看清楚。
The tai chi move called 'white crane spreading its wings' looked as effortless as a real crane taking flight. （读后续写·太极意象）
A towering crane loomed over the half-built stadium, its long arm swinging slowly against the evening sky. （读后续写·工地场景）
It takes years of training to operate such a massive crane safely. （应用文·说明）
A flock of cranes flew south in a perfect V, their cries fading into the autumn dusk. （读后续写·季节意境）
Everyone craned forward as the magician slowly lifted the silk cloth. （读后续写·悬念时刻）

synonyms.example: She stretched her neck to peer at the notice pinned high on the board. （读后续写·张望）
synonyms.usage: 泛指身体任何部位的伸展，用途宽泛；crane 专指为看清而伸长脖子，动作更具体、更有画面感。

synonyms.example: He peered into the thick fog, straining to make out the shape ahead. （读后续写·迷雾探路）
synonyms.usage: 强调因看不清而努力细看的'看'的动作；crane 强调伸长脖子的'身体姿态'，两者常搭配使用(craned his neck and peered)。

advancedExpressions.expression: crane one's neck 伸长脖子 / crane forward 身体前倾伸头看 / a tower crane 塔吊 / a flock of cranes 一群鹤
advancedExpressions.example: Standing on tiptoe, the boy craned his neck and craned forward to see over the crowd. 男孩踮起脚，伸长脖子、身体前倾，越过人群张望。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"伸长脖子看"
advancedExpressions.expression: crane one's neck ≈ stretch one's neck ≈ crane forward ≈ peer over（越过……费力地看）
advancedExpressions.example: He craned his neck / stretched his neck / peered over the wall to catch a glimpse. 他伸长脖子/越过墙头想瞥一眼。（可互换，crane 更有画面感）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. craned their necks, holding their breath as ...
advancedExpressions.example: The spectators craned their necks, holding their breath as the gymnast launched into her final, breathtaking leap. （伸颈+屏息+as从句同步，续写高潮）

advancedExpressions.expression: like a crane taking flight, ...
advancedExpressions.example: She raised her arms slowly, gracefully, like a crane taking flight over a still morning lake. （明喻+太极/舞蹈意境，续写画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as the crane symbolizes ..., so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as the crane symbolizes longevity and purity in our culture, so do these enduring values deserve to be passed on to every new generation. （as...so...对比结构，文化论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone looked forward to see the winner.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The entire stand craned their necks toward the track, a thousand eyes fixed on the two figures flying shoulder to shoulder, no one daring to blink lest they miss the moment of victory. （读后续写·比赛冲刺）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: craned their necks 精准动作替代 looked + 独立主格(a thousand eyes fixed on...) + no one daring to... 现在分词 + lest they miss 引导目的状语从句显紧张

sentenceUpgrade.original: A crane flew over the lake in the morning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: At first light, a lone crane lifted from the mirror-still lake, its snow-white wings tracing a slow arc across the rosy sky, as if the dawn itself had taken shape and risen into flight. （读后续写·自然意境）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: At first light 时间状语营造氛围 + mirror-still 复合形容词 + its wings tracing... 独立主格 + as if... 虚拟明喻升华意境

original_sentence: The first few tai chi classes were fun and easy, and the moves really caught my imagination, with descriptive names like "white crane spreading its wings" and "golden rooster standing on one leg".
readingExamples: The first few tai chi classes were fun and easy, and the moves really caught my imagination, with descriptive names like "white crane spreading its wings" and "golden rooster standing on one leg".
definitionEn:
(1) n. an adult male chicken (chiefly North American English; British English usually 'cock')
(2) n. (informal) a proud, confident or self-important person, especially a man who likes to show off
(3) n. (Rooster) one of the twelve animals of the Chinese zodiac

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 趾高气扬、爱炫耀的人（喻指像公鸡般好斗自负者）
uncommonMeanings.example: The new manager strutted about the office like a rooster, crowing over every small victory as though he alone had built the company from nothing. （读后续写·人物性格·傲慢者）

posExamples.sentence: Long before the first grey light crept over the hills, a rooster shattered the silence with its piercing crow, and Grandpa, stiff yet smiling, rose to feed the animals as he had done for sixty years. （读后续写·乡村清晨·祖辈）
I am writing to invite you to our school's 'Rural Culture Week', where students will paint traditional roosters on red paper — a symbol of courage and good fortune in Chinese folk art. （应用文·邀请信·文化活动）

In many cultures the rooster is far more than a farmyard bird; heralding the dawn with unfailing punctuality, it has come to embody diligence, vigilance and the promise of a fresh beginning. （议论文·文化象征）

wordForms.other: cockerel (小公鸡); hen (母鸡)

collocations.phrase: golden rooster standing on one leg
collocations.translation: 金鸡独立（课文原句·太极招式名）
collocations.example: The moves had names like "golden rooster standing on one leg". 招式有"金鸡独立"这样的名字。（课文原句）
A crowing rooster served as the only alarm clock the mountain village had ever needed. （读后续写·乡村生活）
At the rooster's first crow, the fishermen pushed their boats into the misty sea, hoping for a generous catch. （读后续写·渔村破晓）
Balancing on one leg in the pose called 'golden rooster standing on one leg', I finally understood how stillness could contain such power. （读后续写·太极体验）
The proud bird tossed its head, its bright red rooster's comb trembling in the morning breeze. （读后续写·环境细节）
Born in the Year of the Rooster, she liked to joke that punctuality was simply written into her nature. （应用文·个人介绍）
The old man's fighting rooster had never once backed away from a rival — a stubborn courage the whole village secretly admired. （读后续写·人物象征）

synonyms.example: In the still countryside, only the distant cock could be heard announcing the arrival of another day. （读后续写·乡村清晨）
synonyms.usage: 英式英语用 cock 指公鸡，美式英语多用 rooster；正式写作或涉及美国语境时优先 rooster

synonyms.translation: 小公鸡，未满一岁的雄鸡
synonyms.example: The young cockerel practised its shaky crow each dawn, as if rehearsing for the day it would rule the yard. （读后续写·成长隐喻）
synonyms.usage: cockerel 特指年幼的公鸡，带成长意味；泛指成年公鸡仍用 rooster/cock

advancedExpressions.expression: rooster（美）公鸡 = cock（英）公鸡；cockerel 小公鸡；hen 母鸡；chick 小鸡；crow (v.) 打鸣
advancedExpressions.example: The rooster (AmE) / cock (BrE) began to crow, waking the hens and chicks in the yard. 公鸡开始打鸣，唤醒了院里的母鸡和小鸡。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"破晓/鸡鸣时分"
advancedExpressions.expression: at the rooster's crow ≈ at cockcrow ≈ at daybreak ≈ at first light ≈ at dawn
advancedExpressions.example: At the rooster's crow / at cockcrow / at dawn, the whole village stirred to life. 鸡鸣时分/破晓时，整个村子苏醒过来。

advancedExpressions.expression: no sooner had the rooster crowed than ...
advancedExpressions.example: No sooner had the rooster crowed than the whole household stirred to life, and the smell of fresh porridge began to drift from the kitchen. （no sooner...than 倒装+嗅觉描写，开篇渲染晨景）

advancedExpressions.expression: the rooster stands for / symbolises ...
advancedExpressions.example: In Chinese tradition the rooster stands for courage, honesty and a fresh start — qualities we hope every visitor will carry home. （对外文化介绍，象征义提炼）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a rooster faithfully greets each dawn, so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a rooster faithfully greets each dawn, so should we meet every new challenge with unwavering diligence rather than dread. （类比论证，以物喻理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A rooster crowed and I woke up.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant...主从句表瞬时 + 动作特写(eyes flew open) + 多感官描写(scent/damp/earthy) + 情感铺垫(had almost forgotten)

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rooster is a symbol of a new start.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Heralding the dawn with a voice no darkness can silence, the rooster has, across countless cultures, become a living emblem of vigilance, courage and the eternal promise of renewal. （议论文·文化象征）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词短语作状语开头(Heralding...) + 插入语(across countless cultures) + 三名词并列升华(vigilance, courage, promise)

translation: 灵感；鼓舞人心的人或事
original_sentence: Zhang Sanfeng, a 13th-century Taoist, was said to have invented tai chi after drawing inspiration from a fight between a snake and a bird.
readingExamples: Zhang Sanfeng, a 13th-century Taoist, was said to have invented tai chi after drawing inspiration from a fight between a snake and a bird.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the process of being mentally stimulated to do or feel something, especially to be creative
(2) n. a person, thing or experience that gives someone ideas for creating something
(3) n. a sudden good idea about what to do; a brilliant thought
(4) n. (formal/medical) the act of breathing in; inhalation

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 吸气（医学/正式用法，与 expiration 呼气相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctor placed the cold stethoscope on his chest and murmured, 'Take a deep inspiration and hold it' — the boy obeyed, terrified of what the silence might reveal. （读后续写·医院场景·紧张心理）

posExamples.sentence: Watching her grandmother turn scraps of worn cloth into a dazzling quilt, the girl felt a sudden rush of inspiration, and her fingers began to itch for a needle of her own. （读后续写·祖孙传承·创作冲动）

I am writing to nominate Mr Li for the 'Teacher of the Year' award, because to hundreds of struggling students he has been a lasting inspiration, proving that patience can move even the most reluctant heart. （应用文·推荐信）

True inspiration seldom arrives in a flash of lightning; more often it is quietly earned through years of disciplined practice, so that when the moment finally comes, the prepared mind is ready to seize it. （议论文·勤奋与灵感）

collocations.translation: 从……汲取灵感（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He was said to have invented tai chi after drawing inspiration from a fight between a snake and a bird. 据说他从蛇鸟相斗中汲取灵感后发明了太极。（课文原句）
For generations of readers, the quiet courage of ordinary people has remained an endless source of inspiration. （议论文·文学价值）
Despite losing his sight, the marathon runner became an inspiration to everyone who had ever thought of giving up. （读后续写·励志人物）
Whenever her writing stalled, she would walk along the river, seeking inspiration in the rhythm of the flowing water. （读后续写·写作困境）

collocations.translation: 灵光一闪，突如其来的灵感
collocations.example: In a sudden flash of inspiration, he realised that the very obstacle blocking his path could be turned into a bridge. （读后续写·顿悟时刻）
The exhibition of student inventions gave younger children fresh inspiration to dream beyond the classroom. （应用文·活动报道）
Taking inspiration from her late mother's diaries, she at last found the courage to tell their family story. （读后续写·情感升华）

synonyms.example: The teacher's challenging question acted as a stimulus, waking curiosity that had long lain dormant. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: stimulus 强调外部触发作用，较中性、偏客观；inspiration 更带创造性与情感激励色彩

synonyms.example: Her sole motivation was to lift her family out of poverty, and that goal kept her studying long past midnight. （读后续写·奋斗）
synonyms.usage: motivation 指驱使行动的内在原因/动力；inspiration 指激发创意或情感的启迪，侧重灵感来源

synonyms.translation: （艺术家的）灵感女神，创作灵感来源
synonyms.example: The bustling old town became his muse, filling sketchbook after sketchbook with life. （读后续写·艺术家）
synonyms.usage: muse 多用于文学/艺术语境，指具体的灵感对象或人格化的灵感；日常表达用 inspiration 更普遍

advancedExpressions.expression: inspire (v.) 激发/鼓舞 → inspiration (n.) 灵感/鼓舞 → inspiring/inspirational (adj. 鼓舞人心的) → inspired (adj. 受启发的) → inspiringly (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: The inspiring teacher inspired the boy, and that inspiration became the inspiration of his whole life. 那位鼓舞人心的老师激励了男孩，那份鼓舞成了他一生的灵感来源。

advancedExpressions.expression: draw / take inspiration from sth 从……汲取灵感；a source of inspiration 灵感源泉；be an inspiration to sb 是某人的榜样；a flash of inspiration 灵光一闪
advancedExpressions.example: She drew inspiration from nature and became a source of inspiration to others. 她从自然汲取灵感，又成了别人的榜样。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"激发灵感/给予启发"
advancedExpressions.expression: draw inspiration from ≈ take inspiration from ≈ be inspired by ≈ get ideas from
advancedExpressions.example: He drew inspiration from / was inspired by / got ideas from a fight between a snake and a bird. 他从蛇鸟相斗中获得了灵感。（可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was from ... that she drew the inspiration to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was from her grandmother's weathered yet gentle hands that she drew the inspiration to keep the family craft alive. （强调句 It was...that + 细节意象，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. has been a constant source of inspiration to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Throughout these three years, our headmaster has been a constant source of inspiration to every one of us, teaching by example rather than by words. （推荐/感谢信，正式赞誉）

advancedExpressions.expression: inspiration favours the prepared mind
advancedExpressions.example: As Pasteur reminds us, inspiration favours the prepared mind; the spark of genius rarely lands on those who have not first done the patient work. （引名言+对比论证，说明灵感与努力的关系）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The story gave her inspiration to write.
