sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 让步插入语(rough...though it was) + 动词升级(kindled a spark) + 程度状语从句(so fierce that...) + 画面收束(blank page)

sentenceUpgrade.original: He inspires many students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To countless students who once believed themselves ordinary, he has become a lasting inspiration — living proof that determination, not talent alone, decides how far one can go. （议论文/推荐信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 状语前置(To countless students...) + 破折号补充说明 + 同位语升华(living proof that...) + 对比强调(not talent alone)

classPractice.question: 据说张三丰从蛇鸟相斗中汲取灵感后发明了太极。Zhang Sanfeng was said to have invented tai chi after ____ ____ from a fight between a snake and a bird.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块 draw inspiration from sth；介词 after 后用动名词 drawing

classPractice.question: Her devoted grandmother has always been a great ____ (inspire) to the whole family.
classPractice.note: be an inspiration to sb；形容词 great 后接名词 inspiration

classPractice.question: The young designer ____ (inspiration) millions with her bold, original works.
classPractice.note: 名词 inspiration → 动词 inspire；此处作谓语用过去式 inspired

original_sentence: However, nowadays people tend to believe that Chen Wangting, a 17th-century master of Chinese martial arts, developed tai chi based on martial arts skills.
readingExamples: However, nowadays people tend to believe that Chen Wangting, a 17th-century master of Chinese martial arts, developed tai chi based on martial arts skills.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. at the present time, in contrast to the past; these days
(2) adv. in modern times generally, as opposed to some earlier period

posExamples.sentence: Nowadays she rarely climbed the hill behind the house, yet standing there once more, she felt the years fall away and half expected to hear her childhood friends calling her name. （读后续写·今昔对比·怀旧）
As you can see from our survey, nowadays more and more students choose to spend their pocket money on experiences such as travel rather than on material goods. （应用文·调查报告）
Nowadays, with information available at the touch of a screen, the real challenge is no longer finding knowledge but judging which knowledge deserves our trust. （议论文·信息时代）

collocations.phrase: nowadays people tend to believe that ...
collocations.translation: 如今人们往往认为……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Nowadays people tend to believe that Chen Wangting developed tai chi. 如今人们往往认为陈王廷创立了太极。（课文原句）
Nowadays people tend to measure success by wealth, forgetting that inner peace can never be bought. （议论文·价值观）
More and more young people nowadays are rediscovering the quiet joy of reading paper books. （应用文·现象描述）
Unlike in the past, nowadays a single village teacher can bring the whole world into a mountain classroom through the Internet. （议论文·今昔对比）
It is common nowadays to see elderly people practising tai chi in the park at dawn. （读后续写·公园清晨）
Nowadays it seems that everyone is in a hurry, yet few can say exactly where they are rushing to. （议论文·现代生活反思）
Even nowadays, in an age of machines, a handwritten letter carries a warmth no email can match. （议论文·传统价值）

synonyms.example: These days he prefers a quiet evening at home to the noisy gatherings he once loved. （读后续写·心境变化）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析①：these days 更口语随意，与 nowadays 意思几乎相同，多置于句首/句尾；nowadays 略更书面，议论文常用；两者都用一般现在时

synonyms.example: The library is currently closed for renovation and will reopen next month. （应用文·通知）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析②：currently 强调此刻正在进行的特定状态，常与进行时连用，多用于具体事务；nowadays 指整个当代、泛指现今风气，与过去对比

synonyms.example: At present, no one can predict exactly how artificial intelligence will reshape our jobs. （议论文·正式）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：at present 较正式，指当下这个时间点，可置句首或句尾；nowadays 侧重与过去对比的"现代"整体时段，不指单一瞬间

synonyms.example: Today, many traditional crafts are struggling to survive in a machine-made world. （议论文·传统）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：today 作副词可指"当今这个时代"，语气中性通用，句首常带逗号；nowadays 语义相同但更强调与旧时代的对照，不会被误读为"今天这一天"

advancedExpressions.expression: nowadays 是副词，句首/句中/句尾均可，句子用一般现在时；≠ present-day (adj.)，不能作定语，不加 the
advancedExpressions.example: Nowadays people prefer online shopping. / People nowadays prefer online shopping. 如今人们更爱网购。（副词位置灵活，谓语用现在时）

advancedExpressions.expression: nowadays ≈ these days ≈ today ≈ at present ≈ in this day and age（均表"当今"，可替换开篇）
advancedExpressions.example: Nowadays / These days / Today, life moves faster than ever. 如今，生活的节奏比以往任何时候都快。

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... that had once ... was, nowadays, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The narrow lane that had once echoed with children's laughter was, nowadays, silent but for the wind. （今昔对照，用 nowadays 插入强化时间落差，营造怀旧）

advancedExpressions.expression: nowadays, it is not uncommon for sb. to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Nowadays, it is not uncommon for students to feel overwhelmed by endless online information, which is exactly why I am proposing a 'digital detox' week. （应用文开头引出现象与倡议）

advancedExpressions.expression: nowadays, as ..., an increasing number of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Nowadays, as life grows ever faster, an increasing number of people are turning to traditional exercises like tai chi to reclaim a sense of inner calm. （议论文开篇背景句，用 as 从句铺陈时代背景）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Nowadays people are busier than before.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Nowadays, caught in a whirl of deadlines and notifications, people rush from one task to the next, seldom pausing long enough to ask whether all this haste truly leads anywhere. （议论文·现代生活反思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作状语(caught in a whirl...) + 隐喻(whirl) + 尾句设问引发思考(whether...anywhere)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Things are different nowadays.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: How different everything felt nowadays — the same streets, the same worn benches, yet a strange emptiness had settled where laughter used to live. （读后续写·今昔对比·感伤）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: How + 形容词感叹句倒装 + 重复对比(same...same...) + 拟人化收尾(where laughter used to live)

classPractice.question: ____, people tend to believe that Chen Wangting developed tai chi.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；nowadays 作副词置于句首，句子用一般现在时

classPractice.question: The museum is ____ closed for repairs and will reopen in June. (nowadays / currently)
classPractice.note: 指此刻特定状态、具体事务用 currently；nowadays 指与过去对比的"当代"

classPractice.question: 如今越来越多的年轻人喜欢在公园里打太极。____ more and more young people enjoy practising tai chi in the park.
classPractice.note: nowadays 句首引出"当今现象"，与 more and more 搭配，谓语用现在时

original_sentence: However, nowadays people tend to believe that Chen Wangting, a 17th-century master of Chinese martial arts, developed tai chi based on martial arts skills.
readingExamples: However, nowadays people tend to believe that Chen Wangting, a 17th-century master of Chinese martial arts, developed tai chi based on martial arts skills.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a person who is highly skilled in a particular art, craft or profession; an expert
(2) n. a person who has control or authority over others, animals or a situation
(3) vt. to learn a skill or subject thoroughly so that you can do or use it well
(4) vt. to gain control of a strong feeling, difficulty or situation
(5) n. (BrE) a male teacher, especially in a private school

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①大师，高手，能手（a master of sth；课文义 a master of Chinese martial arts 武术大师）
uncommonMeanings.example: Chen Wangting was a master of Chinese martial arts. 陈王廷是一位中国武术大师。（课文相关）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②主人；主宰者（对人、动物或局面有控制权者；be one's own master 自己做主）
uncommonMeanings.example: The loyal dog waited by the gate for its master to return. 忠犬守在门口等主人归来。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③精通，掌握（彻底学会一门技能/语言）
uncommonMeanings.example: With daily practice, any beginner can master the basic tai chi movements. 每天练习，任何初学者都能掌握太极的基本动作。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④控制，克服（情绪、困难）
uncommonMeanings.example: She took a deep breath and finally mastered her fear. 她深吸一口气，终于控制住了恐惧。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤硕士（a master's degree 硕士学位）；（英）男教师
uncommonMeanings.example: After earning his master's degree, he returned home to teach. 拿到硕士学位后，他回乡教书。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑥原件；母带/母版（可据以复制的正本）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old sound engineer guarded the studio's only master of that legendary recording as if it were a living thing, knowing that once it perished, the music could never truly be reborn. （读后续写·录音室·守护记忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑦主要的；总的（如 master plan 总方案、master key 万能钥匙）
uncommonMeanings.example: Only the caretaker held the master key that opened every door in the ancient manor, and with it, every secret the family had buried for a century. （读后续写·悬疑/老宅）

posExamples.sentence: The old master watched in silence as the boy repeated the same brushstroke a hundred times, and only when a single perfect line finally appeared did the faintest smile touch his lips. （读后续写·师徒·匠心传承）
I assure you that with two weeks of daily practice, any beginner can master the basic tai chi movements well enough to enjoy their calming rhythm. （应用文·活动介绍）
To master a foreign language is never merely to memorise words; it is to master, little by little, an entirely new way of seeing the world. （议论文·语言学习）

wordForms.other: mastermind (v./n. 策划; 智囊); masterclass (大师课)

idioms.example: The day he opened his own small workshop, he felt for the first time that he was truly his own master, answerable to no one but his conscience. （读后续写·独立成长）

idioms.idiom: a jack of all trades and master of none
idioms.translation: 样样通、样样松；博而不精
idioms.example: Chasing every new hobby, he ended up a jack of all trades and master of none, a lesson he later shared with his students. （议论文·专注的价值）

idioms.idiom: no man can serve two masters
idioms.translation: 一仆不能事二主（不能同时追求两个目标）
idioms.example: No man can serve two masters, the coach reminded her; she had to choose between two dreams and pursue one with all her heart. （读后续写·抉择）

collocations.phrase: a master of Chinese martial arts
collocations.translation: 中国武术大师（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Chen Wangting, a 17th-century master of Chinese martial arts, developed tai chi. 17世纪的中国武术大师陈王廷创立了太极。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 掌握一门技能/语言/技巧
collocations.example: It took her three patient years to master the delicate art of paper-cutting, but the wait was worth every cut. （读后续写·技艺习得）
A true master of storytelling can make even a single glance carry a thousand unspoken words. （议论文·艺术）
Standing at the edge of the diving board, she took a deep breath and finally mastered her fear, then leapt into the shimmering blue. （读后续写·克服恐惧）
Every joint of the wooden bridge revealed the touch of a master craftsman who needed not a single nail. （读后续写·工艺）
After earning his master's degree abroad, he chose to return and teach in his home village. （应用文·个人经历）

collocations.translation: （尤指文艺复兴时期的）绘画大师；名作
collocations.example: The gallery's collection of old masters drew art lovers from across the country. （应用文·展览介绍）
The city's master plan promised more green spaces within every neighbourhood. （议论文·城市发展）
In his eyes, art should serve no master but truth itself. （议论文·艺术理念）

synonyms.example: The village elder, an expert in reading the sky, warned the farmers a storm was coming long before a single cloud appeared. （读后续写·经验）
synonyms.usage: expert 侧重某领域的专业知识与判断力，较中性通用；master 更强调技艺登峰造极、可为人师的高度

synonyms.translation: 策划者，幕后主脑（也作动词）
synonyms.example: She quietly masterminded the whole surprise, arranging every detail without letting slip a word. （读后续写·策划）
synonyms.usage: mastermind 强调策划、谋划整件事的核心人物或行为；master 侧重技艺掌握，二者含义不同勿混用

synonyms.example: Bit by bit, he conquered the shyness that had silenced him for years. （读后续写·成长）
synonyms.usage: 在‘控制/克服’义上 conquer 语气更强，含彻底战胜之意；master 更中性，指逐步驾驭并达到掌控

advancedExpressions.expression: master (n./v.) → mastery (n. 精通/掌控) → masterful/masterly (adj. 娴熟的) → masterpiece (n. 杰作) → mastermind (n./v. 智囊/策划) → masterclass (大师课)
advancedExpressions.example: The master painted his masterpiece with masterly skill, a mastery gained over fifty years. 大师以娴熟技艺画出杰作，那份精湛是五十年磨出来的。

advancedExpressions.expression: a master of sth ……的大师；master a skill/language 精通；master one's emotions 控制情绪；a master's degree 硕士学位；master plan 总体规划
advancedExpressions.example: To master a skill and earn a master's degree, one must first master one's own laziness. 要精通技能、拿到硕士学位，先得战胜自己的懒惰。

advancedExpressions.expression: master a skill ≈ have a good command of ≈ be proficient in ≈ get a firm grasp of（均表"熟练掌握"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: She has mastered / has a good command of / is proficient in three languages. 她精通三门语言。

advancedExpressions.expression: not until ... did sb. truly master ...
advancedExpressions.example: Not until he had failed a hundred times did he truly master the art of standing up one more time than he fell. （not until 倒装 + 数字对比，续写励志升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: under the guidance of a master, you will ...
advancedExpressions.example: Under the guidance of a master calligrapher, you will discover that every stroke carries the breath of a thousand years. （招募/邀请信，突出师资吸引力）

advancedExpressions.expression: to master ... is, in essence, to master oneself
advancedExpressions.example: To master any craft is, in essence, to master oneself — to tame impatience, to embrace repetition, and to find joy in slow, unseen progress. （破折号排比，深化"掌握技艺即修炼自我"的论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: After years of practice, he became a master.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Years of quiet, stubborn practice had transformed the clumsy apprentice into a master whose hands seemed to move of their own accord, guided by an instinct that no textbook could ever teach. （读后续写·师徒/技艺）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 抽象主语拟人(practice had transformed) + 前后身份对比(apprentice→master) + 定语从句渲染(whose hands...) + 收束升华(no textbook could teach)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should master a skill well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that to master a skill is not to memorise a set of rules, but to internalise them so deeply that they become second nature — the very definition of true expertise. （议论文·观点句）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...正式主句 + not...but...对比结构 + so...that 结果状语 + 同位语点题(the very definition...)

classPractice.question: Chen Wangting, a 17th-century ____ of Chinese martial arts, developed tai chi. (master / imitation)
classPractice.note: 课文原句 a master of sth ……的大师；此处指"武术大师"

classPractice.question: It took years of daily practice to ____ the delicate technique of paper-cutting. (master / imitate)
classPractice.note: master a skill/technique 精通、彻底掌握；imitate 只是模仿，程度不同

classPractice.question: 在国外拿到硕士学位后，他选择回乡教书。After earning his ____ ____ abroad, he chose to teach in his home village.
classPractice.note: master's degree 硕士学位；注意所有格 master's（重点熟词僻义）

original_sentence: No wonder some tai chi moves are named after animals – Chinese martial arts have a long-standing practice of imitating animals.
readingExamples: No wonder some tai chi moves are named after animals – Chinese martial arts have a long-standing practice of imitating animals.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. it is not surprising (that ...); used to say that something is easy to understand or expected given the circumstances
(2) phr. (as 'it is no wonder / small wonder that ...') there is little cause for surprise

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 惊奇；奇观；奇人；奇迹（【课件】wonder 作名词）
uncommonMeanings.example: The children stared up at the fireworks in silent wonder. 孩子们默默地仰望焰火，满心惊奇。／ The pyramids remain one of the greatest wonders of the ancient world. 金字塔至今仍是古代最伟大的奇观之一。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 感到惊讶；想知道（【课件】wonder 作及物动词，后接 wh-从句或 if/whether 从句）
uncommonMeanings.example: I wonder whether she will ever forgive me for what I said that night. 我想知道，那晚我说的话她是否会原谅我。

posExamples.sentence: No wonder her eyes had been so red all morning — the letter lying open on the desk told a story of loss that no words of comfort could truly reach. （读后续写·情感揭示·转折）
Our club offers free lessons, patient coaches and a warm community, so it is no wonder that membership has doubled within a single term. （应用文·社团宣传）

Given how relentlessly modern life bombards us with screens and noise, it is no wonder that so many people are turning to quiet, traditional practices like tai chi to restore a sense of balance. （议论文·现代生活）

idioms.translation: 难怪，不足为奇（与 no wonder 同义，语气略正式）
idioms.example: She had practised until her fingers bled; small wonder that her performance moved the whole hall to tears. （读后续写·苦练回报）

collocations.translation: 难怪；并不奇怪；当然……（【课件】It's no wonder + that 的省略形式：it 是形式主语，that 从句是真正主语，no wonder 作表语）
collocations.example: It's no wonder you're hungry; you didn't have any breakfast. 难怪你饿了——你没吃早饭。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: no wonder + (that) 从句（课文原句）【课件】
collocations.translation: 难怪……，不足为奇（【课件】置于句首表"难怪"，that 常省略）
collocations.example: No wonder some tai chi moves are named after animals. 难怪有些太极招式以动物命名。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 令人惊奇的是……；……真是奇迹（【课件】与 no wonder 相反，表"惊奇"。注：课件写作 It's wonder (that)，系漏字，正确须加不定冠词 a，即 It's a wonder that…）
collocations.example: It's a wonder that no one was hurt in such a serious crash. 如此严重的撞车竟无人受伤，真是奇迹。

collocations.phrase: no wonder + 从句（课文原句）
collocations.example: No wonder some tai chi moves are named after animals. 难怪有些太极招式以动物命名。（课文原句）
No wonder the old dog refused to leave the doorstep — some part of him was still waiting for a master who would never return. （读后续写·忠诚·感伤）
The exhibits were interactive, colourful and free, so it is no wonder that children begged to stay longer. （应用文·活动反馈）
The team had trained through rain and snow; no wonder, then, that they lifted the trophy with such fierce pride. （读后续写·团队夺冠）

collocations.translation: 这也难怪；不足为奇（后置）
collocations.example: The children adored their new teacher, and no wonder — she treated every question as a treasure rather than a nuisance. （读后续写·师生）
It was no wonder at all that the shy boy blossomed once someone finally believed in him. （议论文·教育关怀）

synonyms.example: It is not surprising that people who read widely tend to write with greater ease. （议论文·正式）
synonyms.usage: 完整从句结构，语气最中性、最正式，适合议论文；no wonder 更简洁口语，常置于句首

synonyms.example: She had rehearsed for weeks, so naturally she stepped onto the stage without a trace of fear. （读后续写·从容）
synonyms.usage: naturally 作副词，强调‘顺理成章’；no wonder 强调对某结果‘不感到意外’，二者语气侧重不同

synonyms.example: Understandably nervous before her first flight, she gripped the armrest until her knuckles turned white. （读后续写·心理描写）
synonyms.usage: understandably 表示某反应情有可原，含共情色彩；no wonder 侧重‘结果不出所料’的因果判断

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·It's no wonder (that)（省略结构）
advancedExpressions.expression: It's no/little/small wonder (that) + 从句 = No/Little/Small wonder (that) + 从句：难怪/并不奇怪/当然。【课件】it 是形式主语，that 从句才是真正的主语，no wonder 作表语；that 常省略，句首可直接用 No wonder…
advancedExpressions.example: It's no wonder (that) you're hungry; you didn't have any breakfast. = No wonder you're hungry… 难怪你饿了——你没吃早饭。（课件原句）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·wonder 的词性与义项（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】wonder n. 惊奇；奇观；奇人；奇迹　vt. 感到惊讶；想知道。对比：(It's) no/little/small wonder… 难怪；It's a wonder (that)… 令人惊奇的是……（课件原文漏字作 It's wonder，正确须加 a）
advancedExpressions.example: The Great Wall is one of the wonders of the world. 长城是世界奇观之一。／ I wonder why she left so early. 我想知道她为何这么早离开。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·no wonder 用法要点
advancedExpressions.expression: No wonder + (that) 从句，置于句首表"难怪"；that 常省略；正式可写 It is no wonder that.../ small wonder that...；后面直接跟结果句，不用逗号断开
advancedExpressions.example: No wonder (that) she is tired — she has worked all night. 难怪她累了——她工作了一整夜。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·"难怪/不足为奇"
advancedExpressions.expression: no wonder (that) ≈ it is no wonder that ≈ small wonder that ≈ it is not surprising that ≈ understandably（均表"不出所料"，可替换）
advancedExpressions.example: No wonder / It is not surprising that he passed — he studied so hard. 难怪他通过了——他学得那么用功。

advancedExpressions.expression: no wonder ... — only then did sb. understand ...
advancedExpressions.example: No wonder the room had felt so cold — only then did she notice the window that had stood open all through the storm. （no wonder 揭示原因 + only then 倒装点破真相，续写转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: with ..., it is no wonder that ...
advancedExpressions.example: With such dedicated volunteers and generous donations, it is no wonder that our charity sale raised a record sum this year. （应用文，以条件引出理所当然的好结果）

advancedExpressions.expression: given ..., it is small wonder that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Given the pressures young people face today, it is small wonder that mental health has become a topic no school can afford to ignore. （given 引出前提 + small wonder 收束因果，论证顺理成章）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was tired, so it was no wonder she fell asleep.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She had been on her feet since dawn, tending the sick without a single break; no wonder, the moment she sank into the chair, sleep claimed her like a gentle tide. （读后续写·奉献·疲惫）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去完成进行时铺垫(had been...since dawn) + 分号连接因果 + 明喻收尾(like a gentle tide)拟人化睡意

sentenceUpgrade.original: The film was good, so many people liked it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Blending breathtaking visuals with a story that spoke straight to the heart, the film touched audiences of every age — small wonder, then, that it swept every major award that season. （议论文/影评）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词短语开头(Blending...) + 破折号衔接 + small wonder 后置因果 + 动词升级(swept every award)

classPractice.question: 难怪你的妻子和孩子们都在埋怨你。你真的在工作上花费太多时间了。____________ your wife and children are complaining about you. You really have spent too much time on your work.
classPractice.note: 【课件·语境应用】置于句首 It's no/little/small wonder (that)，或直接用 No/Little/Small wonder (that)；that 可省

classPractice.question: 由于有这么大的压力，难怪每当有考试时，现在的学生都感到紧张。With so much pressure, ____________ whenever there is an exam.
classPractice.answer: (it's) no/little/small wonder (that) the students nowadays feel nervous
classPractice.note: 【课件·语境应用】(it's) no/little/small wonder (that) + 从句；主语 the students nowadays，动词用 feel

classPractice.question: 难怪有些太极招式以动物命名。____ ____ some tai chi moves are named after animals.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；No wonder 置于句首，后接完整句子表"难怪"

classPractice.question: She had trained through rain and snow; no wonder ____ she lifted the trophy with such pride.
classPractice.note: no wonder (that) + 从句，that 可省，此处填 that 亦成立；考查固定句式

classPractice.question: It is not surprising that the children love the new teacher. → ____ ____ the children love the new teacher.
classPractice.note: it is not surprising that = no wonder 难怪、不足为奇

original_sentence: No wonder some tai chi moves are named after animals – Chinese martial arts have a long-standing practice of imitating animals.
readingExamples: No wonder some tai chi moves are named after animals – Chinese martial arts have a long-standing practice of imitating animals.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to copy the way someone behaves, speaks, moves, etc., especially deliberately or in order to learn
(2) vt. to reproduce or resemble the appearance, sound or effect of something
(3) vt. to mimic someone in an amusing or mocking way
(4) vt. to follow something as a model or example

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （材料/物品）仿制，仿造……的外观
uncommonMeanings.example: The cheap tiles had been made to imitate marble so cleverly that, from across the dim hall, even the old architect was fooled for a moment. （读后续写·以假乱真·细节观察）

posExamples.sentence: Perched on the fence, the small boy tried to imitate his grandfather's slow, graceful tai chi movements, and though his balance wobbled, his determination did not. （读后续写·祖孙·学艺）
In our English corner, we encourage newcomers to imitate native speakers' intonation aloud, for confidence often grows faster than perfect grammar. （应用文·社团倡议）
While it is natural for the young to imitate those they admire, true growth begins only when one dares to move beyond imitation and find a voice of one's own. （议论文·模仿与创新）

idioms.idiom: imitation is the sincerest form of flattery
idioms.example: When the younger students began copying her style of note-taking, her teacher smiled: imitation, after all, is the sincerest form of flattery. （议论文/读后续写·榜样力量）

collocations.phrase: a long-standing practice of imitating animals
collocations.translation: 模仿动物的悠久传统（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Chinese martial arts have a long-standing practice of imitating animals. 中国武术有模仿动物的悠久传统。（课文原句）
The talented parrot could imitate the doorbell so perfectly that the family kept rushing to answer a door no one had knocked on. （读后续写·趣味场景）

collocations.phrase: imitate the way sb does sth
collocations.translation: 模仿某人做某事的方式
collocations.example: She imitated the way her mother hummed while cooking, and suddenly the empty kitchen felt a little less lonely. （读后续写·思念·情感）
Children learn to speak largely by imitating the sounds and rhythms of those around them. （议论文·语言习得）
Rather than blindly imitating famous writers, he studied their craft and then forged a style entirely his own. （议论文·创作）
Many tai chi moves imitate animals — a crane spreading its wings, a rooster standing on one leg — turning the natural world into living art. （读后续写·太极文化）
Younger pupils are quick to imitate whatever their idols do, which is why role models matter so much. （议论文·榜样责任）
The young comedian could imitate the headmaster to perfection, right down to his squeaky cough. （读后续写·校园趣事）

synonyms.translation: （尤指为取乐地）模仿，学……的样子
synonyms.example: He mimicked the teacher's every gesture, and the whole class struggled to keep from laughing. （读后续写·校园趣事）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析①：mimic 多指为取乐或嘲弄而惟妙惟肖地模仿动作/声音/表情，vt.；imitate 更中性，可指学习性的正经模仿

synonyms.example: Instead of copying the answer, she worked through the problem until she truly understood it. （议论文·学习方法）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析②：copy 强调原样照搬、缺乏创造，略带贬义，宾语可为答案/风格/文件；imitate 可含学习、致敬之意，语气更中性甚至积极，侧重模仿"方式、行为"

synonyms.translation: 努力赶超，效法（含积极追赶之意）
synonyms.example: She hoped one day to emulate the great scientists whose biographies had inspired her childhood. （议论文·励志）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：emulate 强调以榜样为目标努力超越，褒义、正式；imitate 只强调模仿动作或方式，不必然含"赶超"之意

synonyms.translation: 扮演，冒充（模仿他人身份/言行）
synonyms.example: The actor impersonated the famous singer so convincingly that fans burst into applause. （读后续写·舞台）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：impersonate 特指模仿并"扮演/冒充"某个特定人物（表演或欺骗），对象是具体的人；imitate 泛指模仿动作、声音、方式，对象可为人、动物或自然

advancedExpressions.expression: imitate (v.) → imitation (n. 模仿/仿制品) → imitator (n. 模仿者) → imitative (adj. 模仿的) → imitation (adj. 仿制的，如 imitation leather 人造革)
advancedExpressions.example: The clever imitator's imitation was so lifelike that no one could tell it from the original. 那个聪明模仿者的仿制品几可乱真。

advancedExpressions.expression: imitate sb/sth 模仿；imitate the way sb does sth 模仿……的方式；learn by imitating 通过模仿学习；imitate animals 模仿动物；imitate...to perfection 模仿得惟妙惟肖
advancedExpressions.example: Tai chi imitates animals, and beginners learn by imitating the master's every move. 太极模仿动物，初学者通过模仿师父的每个动作来学习。

advancedExpressions.expression: imitate（中性/学习）≈ mimic（取乐嘲弄）≈ copy（照搬贬义）≈ emulate（赶超褒义）— 按语气/目的选词
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of merely copying, imitate to learn and then emulate to surpass. 别只照搬，先模仿以学习，再效法以超越。

advancedExpressions.expression: at first sb. merely imitated ..., but in time ...
advancedExpressions.example: At first he merely imitated his master's every move, but in time the borrowed gestures grew into something unmistakably his own. （at first...but in time 时间对比，展现从模仿到成熟的蜕变）

advancedExpressions.expression: one effective way to ... is to imitate ...
advancedExpressions.example: One effective way to improve your spoken English is to imitate short clips aloud, again and again, until the rhythm feels natural. （建议信/倡议，给出可操作方法）

advancedExpressions.expression: imitation may be the beginning of learning, but it must never be the end
advancedExpressions.example: Imitation may be the beginning of learning, but it must never be the end; a culture that only copies will, sooner or later, forget how to create. （对比递进句式，论证模仿与创新的关系）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The boy imitated the old man's tai chi moves.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Holding his breath, the boy imitated the old man's every unhurried gesture — the sweep of an arm, the slow shift of weight — as if trying to borrow, movement by movement, the calm that had taken a lifetime to earn. （读后续写·师徒·太极）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词短语开头(Holding his breath) + 破折号细节列举 + as if 比喻从句 + 收束升华(the calm...a lifetime to earn)

sentenceUpgrade.original: Children learn language by imitating others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Long before they can grasp a single rule of grammar, children learn to speak by tirelessly imitating the voices around them, proving that language is caught far more than it is taught. （议论文·语言习得）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句前置(Long before...) + 副词升级(tirelessly) + 现在分词状语点题(proving that...) + 对偶警句(caught...than...taught)

classPractice.question: 中国武术有模仿动物的悠久传统。Chinese martial arts have a long-standing practice of ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句词块；practice of doing sth，介词 of 后用动名词 imitating

classPractice.question: Rather than blindly ____ the answer, she worked it out herself. (imitating / copying)
classPractice.note: 照搬答案、缺乏创造用 copy（略贬）；imitate 侧重模仿方式/动作，语气更中性

classPractice.question: The vase was a clever ____ (imitate) of a Ming-dynasty original, yet the colours gave it away.
classPractice.note: 动词 imitate → 名词 imitation 仿制品；an imitation of sth ……的仿制品

original_sentence: After a few classes, I found myself bored and aching from doing the same moves over and over again.
readingExamples: After a few classes, I found myself bored and aching from doing the same moves over and over again.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to feel a continuous, dull pain in a part of your body
(2) n. a continuous, dull pain in a part of your body
(3) vi. to feel a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for
(4) vi. to feel great sympathy, sadness or pity for someone

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①（身体）持续隐隐地疼痛；疼痛感（课文义：aching from doing the same moves 因反复动作而酸痛）
uncommonMeanings.example: After the class my muscles ached, and a dull ache lingered in my legs. 下课后我肌肉酸痛，腿里还留着隐隐的痛。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②渴望，热望（熟词僻义：ache to do sth / ache for sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Standing at the airport gate, she ached to run into her father's arms, yet her legs refused to move, weighed down by years of unspoken longing. （读后续写·久别重逢·心理描写）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（因同情、悲伤而）心痛，隐隐作痛（one's heart aches / ache with grief）
uncommonMeanings.example: His heart ached as he watched the stray dog shiver in the freezing rain, its eyes silently pleading for a warmth no one seemed willing to give. （读后续写·悲悯情感）

posExamples.sentence: After a whole afternoon of scrubbing floors and hauling boxes, every muscle in my body ached, yet a strange warmth spread through my chest as I looked at the tidy shelter we had transformed. （读后续写·志愿劳动·苦中有甜）
I am writing to remind all participants that a dull ache in the legs after the first day of hiking is perfectly normal, so please stretch thoroughly and rest well before we set off again. （应用文·通知）
Modern life, for all its comforts, has left many young people with a peculiar ache of loneliness — a hollowness that no amount of scrolling through screens can ever truly fill. （议论文·社会现象）
As the final note of the anthem faded, my whole heart ached with a pride so fierce that tears blurred the flag rising before my eyes. （读后续写·家国情怀·情感升华）

idioms.translation: （身体各处的）大小疼痛，浑身酸痛
idioms.example: Grandma dismissed her aches and pains with a laugh, insisting that a lifetime of hard work had simply 'seasoned' her bones. （读后续写·长辈形象·乐观坚韧）

collocations.phrase: find oneself aching from doing sth
collocations.translation: 发觉自己因做某事而酸痛（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I found myself bored and aching from doing the same moves over and over. 我发觉自己厌倦了，还因反复做同样的动作而酸痛。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 隐隐的 / 剧烈的疼痛
collocations.example: A dull ache spread across her shoulders, but she gritted her teeth and pressed on, unwilling to let the marathon defeat her. （读后续写·坚持不懈）
By the time the rescue team reached the summit, they ached all over, yet the sight of the trapped climber alive made every step worthwhile. （读后续写·救援）

collocations.translation: 胃痛 / 头痛 / 牙痛
collocations.example: Halfway through the exam, a splitting headache struck him, and he had to steady his breathing before the words on the paper stopped swimming. （读后续写·考场）
Far from home, the exchange student ached for the familiar taste of his mother's dumplings on that cold winter night. （读后续写·思乡）

collocations.translation: 极想做某事（熟词僻义·渴望）
collocations.example: The rookie player ached to prove himself, his fingers twitching restlessly as he waited on the bench for a chance that might never come. （读后续写·渴望机会）
My heart ached to see the once-lively old man sitting alone by the window, staring at photographs of a family that rarely visited. （读后续写·孤独老人）

collocations.translation: 肌肉 / 腿 / 脚酸痛
collocations.example: My legs ached fiercely after the charity walk, but knowing each step had raised money for the orphanage, I would gladly do it all again. （应用文·活动感悟）

collocations.translation: 因思念 / 悲伤而隐隐作痛
collocations.example: Her whole being ached with longing as the train carrying her best friend pulled slowly out of the station. （读后续写·离别）

synonyms.example: My knee hurt so badly that I could barely climb the last flight of stairs to the classroom. （读后续写·日常）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析①：hurt 最口语、最通用，指任何程度的疼痛或伤害，可及物（hurt sb）也可不及物（it hurts）；ache 特指持续的、钝性的隐痛，且能引申为"渴望""心痛"

synonyms.example: His wounded arm throbbed with each heartbeat, a rhythmic reminder of the fall that had nearly ended his climbing career. （读后续写·受伤）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析②：throb 强调随脉搏一跳一跳的抽痛，画面感和节奏感更强；ache 更平缓、持续、不剧烈

synonyms.example: She longed for the day when her hard work would finally be recognised. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：表"渴望"时与 ache for/ache to do 近义，但 long 更中性通用（long for sth / long to do sth）；ache for 带有近乎身体上的酸楚感，情感更浓烈

synonyms.example: After the first day of training, my whole body felt sore. （读后续写·训练）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：sore 是形容词，多指肌肉运动后或发炎处的酸痛（a sore throat 嗓子疼），常作表语；ache 是动词/名词，强调持续隐痛的动作或感觉本身（my muscles ache）

advancedExpressions.expression: muscles/legs ache 肌肉/腿酸痛；a dull ache 隐隐作痛；aches and pains 浑身酸痛；ache all over 浑身疼；a headache/toothache 头痛/牙痛
advancedExpressions.example: After the hike my legs ached, my feet ached — I ached all over. 徒步后我腿疼、脚疼——浑身都疼。

advancedExpressions.expression: ache（持续隐痛/动词名词）≈ hurt（通用）≈ throb（抽痛）≈ sore（酸痛·形容词）— 按疼法/词性选词
advancedExpressions.example: My arm hurt, then began to throb; by night the dull ache made it feel sore all over. 我胳膊先是疼，接着抽痛；到夜里隐痛让它整条都发酸。

advancedExpressions.type: 熟词僻义·ache = 渴望/心痛
advancedExpressions.expression: be aching to do sth 渴望做某事；ache for sb/sth 渴望/为……心痛；one's heart aches 心痛不已；ache with longing/grief 因思念/悲伤而痛
advancedExpressions.example: Far from home, she was aching to return, her heart aching with longing. 远离家乡，她渴望归去，心因思念而痛。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s heart ached with + 抽象名词 (longing / pride / pity)
advancedExpressions.example: Her heart ached with a longing so deep that words failed her entirely — she could only press her palm against the cold windowpane and watch the plane disappear into the clouds. （抽象名词具象化 + 动作收尾，续写情感段）

advancedExpressions.expression: though every muscle ached, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though every muscle ached and my hands were blistered, the gratitude in the villagers' eyes made this the most rewarding week of my summer. （让步状语开头 + 苦乐对比，倡议信/感谢信结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: behind the glittering surface lies an ache of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Behind the glittering surface of urban prosperity lies an ache of isolation that we, as a society, can no longer afford to ignore. （倒装 + 表象与本质对比，引出论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: My body ached, but I kept going.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Every fibre of my body ached in protest, each step sending a fresh wave of pain up my legs; yet something stubborn deep within refused to surrender, driving me onward toward the finish line that shimmered like a mirage in the distance. （读后续写·心理+环境描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 夸张扩写(Every fibre...) + 分号并列递进 + 拟人(refused to surrender) + 明喻(like a mirage) 收束画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: People today feel lonely.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is a bitter irony of our age that, more connected than ever through screens, countless young people are left aching with a loneliness that no notification can soothe. （议论文·辩证观点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is a bitter irony that...评价性主句 + 让步对比(more connected...yet) + 现在分词状语(aching with) 收紧论点

classPractice.question: After a few classes, I found myself bored and ____ (ache) from doing the same moves over and over again.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；find oneself + 现在分词，表状态；ache 此处作现在分词 aching

classPractice.question: The rookie player ____ ____ prove himself, waiting restlessly on the bench for a chance.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义 ache to do sth 极想/渴望做某事；此处叙述过去用 ached

classPractice.question: After the marathon my legs ____ for days, and the dull pain reminded me of every step. (ached / hurt)
classPractice.note: 持续钝性隐痛优选 ache；hurt 亦通用可及物不及物均可，两解皆通

original_sentence: With these requirements of tai chi in mind, I found to my satisfaction that my balance and flexibility slowly improved, that I was able to do more difficult moves, and that my love for tai chi returned stronger than ever.
readingExamples: With these requirements of tai chi in mind, I found to my satisfaction that my balance and flexibility slowly improved, that I was able to do more difficult moves, and that my love for tai chi returned stronger than ever.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a pleasant feeling that you get when you obtain or achieve something you wanted, or when things happen as you want them to
(2) n. the act of fulfilling a need, desire, demand or expectation
(3) n. a feeling of contentment or gratification with a situation
(4) n. (formal) the payment of money to settle a debt, claim, or to make amends for a wrong

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （要求、疑问等的）满足，解答；令人信服的答复
uncommonMeanings.example: The detective refused to leave until every troubling detail of the case had been explained to his complete satisfaction. （读后续写·推理·执着）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对损害、冒犯的）补偿，赔礼；雪耻
uncommonMeanings.example: Wronged before the whole class, the boy demanded satisfaction — not with fists, but with a public apology that would restore his dignity. （读后续写·自尊·冲突）

posExamples.sentence: As the last brick settled into place, a deep satisfaction washed over the volunteers, and they stood back to admire the little library they had built with their own weary hands. （读后续写·志愿建设·成就感）

It is with great satisfaction that I report a record turnout at this year's charity fair, and I would like to extend my heartfelt thanks to every student who made the event such a resounding success. （应用文·报告/致谢信）
True satisfaction, many philosophers argue, springs not from the ceaseless pursuit of material possessions but from meaningful contribution to the lives of others. （议论文·人生价值）
To my great satisfaction, the shy girl who had never dared speak in public finally raised her hand and delivered an answer that left the whole classroom applauding. （读后续写·成长突破）

wordForms.other: dissatisfaction (n. 不满)

collocations.translation: 令我满意的是（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I found to my satisfaction that my balance slowly improved. 令我满意的是，我发现自己的平衡力慢慢变好了。
She nodded with satisfaction at the tidy room. 她满意地朝整洁的房间点了点头。
To my great satisfaction, the tomatoes I had nurtured for months finally ripened into a dazzling red, rewarding every drop of sweat I had poured into that tiny garden. （读后续写·耕耘与收获）
There is a quiet sense of satisfaction in finishing a difficult book, a private triumph that no praise from others can quite replace. （议论文·读书之乐）
She nodded with satisfaction as she surveyed the spotless kitchen, every dish gleaming under the warm evening light. （读后续写·细节描写）

collocations.translation: 工作满意度 / 顾客满意度
collocations.example: Our survey reveals that job satisfaction depends far less on salary than on whether employees feel their efforts are genuinely valued. （应用文·调查报告）
The old teacher derived immense satisfaction from watching his former students grow into confident, caring adults. （读后续写·师者情怀）
It gave her immense satisfaction to know that her small act of kindness had brightened a stranger's entire day. （读后续写·善举）
The workshop promised satisfaction guaranteed, and indeed, not a single participant left without a new skill and a broad smile. （应用文·宣传）
Much to the coach's satisfaction, the team he had once written off fought their way to an unexpected victory. （读后续写·逆袭）

synonyms.example: After years of chasing success, he finally found a quiet contentment in the simple rhythm of country life. （读后续写·心境转变）
synonyms.usage: 强调一种平静、持久、不再渴求更多的满足状态；satisfaction 更多因'达成某事/满足某种需求'而生，带有结果感

synonyms.example: Teaching in the remote mountain school gave her a sense of fulfilment she had never known in the city. （议论文·人生意义）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·满意地/令人满意

original_sentence: I discovered that tai chi is deeply rooted in the Chinese philosophy of yin and yang, which are believed to form the unity of opposites.
readingExamples: I discovered that tai chi is deeply rooted in the Chinese philosophy of yin and yang, which are believed to form the unity of opposites.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the part of a plant that grows under the ground and takes in water and food
(2) n. the main cause or origin of something, such as a problem or feeling
(3) n. (plural) the place, culture or family that a person originally comes from and feels connected to
(4) vi./vt. to become firmly fixed in the ground and grow; to make or become firmly established

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 根源，根本原因（the root of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: We must find the root of the problem, not just treat its symptoms. 我们必须找到问题的根源，而不只是治标。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用复数 roots）根源，出身，血统，故土
uncommonMeanings.example: No matter how far he travelled, he never lost touch with his roots. 无论走多远，他都没和自己的根断了联系。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （+ for）为……加油，支持（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole village turned out that afternoon, rooting for the underdog runner as if his victory were their own. （读后续写·家乡·集体支持）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （+ out）根除，彻底铲除
uncommonMeanings.example: The new principal was determined to root out bullying, vowing that no child in his school would ever again dread the sound of the morning bell. （读后续写·校园·正义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （动物用鼻子）拱土觅食；（人）翻找
uncommonMeanings.example: She rooted frantically through the dusty attic boxes, desperate to find the faded letter that held the last words of her grandmother. （读后续写·寻找·急切）

posExamples.sentence: The ancient oak had sunk its roots so deep into the hillside that not even the fiercest storm could tear it loose — a silent lesson, the old man said, in the strength of holding firm. （读后续写·自然象征·人生哲理）
I firmly believe that the root of our school's littering problem lies not in a lack of bins but in a lack of awareness, and I therefore propose a term-long environmental education campaign. （应用文·建议信）
To tackle poverty effectively, governments must address its roots — unequal access to education and opportunity — rather than merely treating its visible symptoms. （议论文·社会问题）
No matter how far she travelled, her love for her hometown remained firmly rooted in her heart, tugging her homewards every Spring Festival. （读后续写·乡愁）

wordForms.other: uproot (vt. 连根拔起；使背井离乡)

idioms.example: The greedy merchant learned too late that the love of money, so often called the root of all evil, had cost him the only friends he ever had. （读后续写·警世·因果）
After years of wandering from city to city, the young couple finally decided to put down roots in the quiet coastal town where they had first met. （读后续写·安定）
The idea of protecting the environment gradually took root in the children's minds, blossoming into habits that would last a lifetime. （议论文·观念养成）
The committee vowed to reform the outdated system root and branch, leaving no corner of it untouched. （应用文·改革倡议）

The habit of reading gradually took root in him. 读书的习惯渐渐在他身上扎下了根。

collocations.translation: 根源，血统，故土（常用复数）
collocations.example: He never forgot his roots in the countryside. 他从未忘记自己在乡下的根。
The whole class was rooting for her. 全班都在为她加油。
Her unshakeable calm was rooted in years of practising tai chi at dawn, when the world was still and her mind grew clear. （读后续写·人物·修养）
Identifying the root cause of a student's anxiety is the first and most crucial step toward genuinely helping them. （议论文·教育）
Once the seed of self-belief takes root, no amount of criticism can easily uproot it. （读后续写·励志）
We must root out the habit of procrastination before it silently sabotages all our ambitions. （议论文·自我管理）
Studying abroad taught him to cherish his roots, and he came home determined to give back to the community that had raised him. （读后续写·成长）
Even as she trailed hopelessly behind, her classmates never stopped rooting for her, their cheers carrying her across the finish line. （读后续写·团结）
Deep-rooted prejudices cannot be swept away overnight; they must be patiently challenged, one honest conversation at a time. （议论文·社会）
The wise counsellor gently coaxed the boy to talk until she finally got to the root of his sudden silence. （读后续写·关怀）
The willow by the river spread its roots wide, drinking deeply from the soil until it towered over every other tree. （读后续写·自然）

synonyms.example: Few of the students knew the true origin of the festival they celebrated so joyfully each year. （议论文·文化）
synonyms.usage: 中性，指事物开始的地方或时间；root 更强调'深层的、根本的'原因，且带有'牢固扎根'的比喻色彩

synonyms.example: Curiosity, not fear, should be the source of our questions. （议论文）
synonyms.usage: 指某物产生或流出之处（如信息源、河源）；root 强调'根本原因'和'难以撼动的根基'，语气更深

synonyms.example: Careless driving is a leading cause of traffic accidents. （议论文·安全）
synonyms.usage: 泛指导致某结果的原因；root cause 特指'最根本、最深层'的那个原因，比一般 cause 更强调追根溯源

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·根本原因（可替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: unless we tackle the roots rather than the symptoms, ...

original_sentence: I discovered that tai chi is deeply rooted in the Chinese philosophy of yin and yang, which are believed to form the unity of opposites.

definitionEn:
(1) phr. to be firmly based on or derived from something; to have one's origin in something
(2) phr. to be strongly influenced by or connected to a particular culture, belief or tradition
(3) phr. (literal) to be firmly fixed in the ground by roots

posExamples.sentence: As the master demonstrated each slow, flowing movement, I came to understand that tai chi is rooted in a philosophy far older than the art itself — a wisdom that teaches balance in both body and mind. （读后续写·文化体验·顿悟）
I would like to remind everyone that our school's proud tradition of volunteering is rooted in the simple belief that no act of kindness, however small, is ever wasted. （应用文·演讲/倡议）
Genuine confidence is not rooted in the praise of others but in a quiet, unshakeable belief in one's own worth and effort. （议论文·成长/心理）
Her calm under pressure was rooted in years of discipline, and even as chaos erupted around her, she moved with the steady grace of one who had rehearsed this moment a thousand times. （读后续写·人物·沉稳）

collocations.phrase: be deeply rooted in（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Tai chi is deeply rooted in the Chinese philosophy of yin and yang. 太极深深植根于中国的阴阳哲学。
The festival is rooted in ancient culture. 这个节日植根于古老的文化。

collocations.phrase: be rooted in the belief that
collocations.example: Our work is rooted in the belief that everyone matters. 我们的工作基于'人人都重要'这一信念。
The custom of honouring one's elders is deeply rooted in Chinese culture, passed down faithfully through countless generations. （议论文·文化传承）
His unwavering optimism was firmly rooted in a childhood surrounded by love, and no hardship in adulthood could ever fully dim it. （读后续写·人物背景）

collocations.phrase: be rooted in tradition / culture / history
collocations.translation: 植根于传统 / 文化 / 历史
collocations.example: The festival, rooted in centuries of history, still fills the town square with lanterns and laughter every autumn. （读后续写·节日）
A good argument must be rooted in fact rather than in emotion if it is to persuade a thoughtful reader. （议论文·写作原则）

collocations.phrase: be rooted in the belief that（写作向）
collocations.example: Our recycling campaign is rooted in the belief that every student, by changing one small habit, can help protect the planet we share. （应用文·倡议书）
However modern the city grew, its spirit remained rooted in the warmth and neighbourliness of its earliest days. （议论文·城市与人文）

synonyms.example: Much of his fear stemmed from a single humiliating failure years earlier. （读后续写·心理溯源）
synonyms.usage: 强调'从……产生、发端'，侧重因果起点；be rooted in 更强调'牢固地建立在……之上'，带有稳固、根深蒂固之意

synonyms.example: The tradition is said to originate from an ancient harvest ritual. （议论文·文化）

synonyms.example: Her advice was always grounded in real experience rather than empty theory. （议论文）
synonyms.usage: 与 be rooted in 极为接近，都强调'牢固的基础'；be grounded in 更偏'理性依据、事实基础'，be rooted in 更偏'情感、文化、传统的根源'

advancedExpressions.expression: only then did sb. realise that ... is rooted in ...

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is rooted in the simple belief that ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: Tai chi comes from old Chinese philosophy.

original_sentence: I discovered that tai chi is deeply rooted in the Chinese philosophy of yin and yang, which are believed to form the unity of opposites.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （面对困难时的）达观，冷静豁达的人生态度

collocations.phrase: the Chinese philosophy of ...（课文原句词块）

synonyms.example: Travelling broadened her outlook and taught her to see the world through others' eyes. （议论文·视野）
synonyms.usage: 指对生活或世界的总体看法、态度，较口语；philosophy（作'人生态度'解时）更正式、更成体系、更有思辨色彩

advancedExpressions.expression: a philosophy of life（人生观）/ the philosophy behind sth（背后理念）/ guiding philosophy（指导思想）/ share a philosophy（秉持理念）
advancedExpressions.example: her philosophy of life 她的人生观；the philosophy behind the reform 改革背后的理念；our guiding philosophy 我们的指导思想。

advancedExpressions.expression: philosophy(n.哲学/人生观)→philosopher(n.哲学家)→philosophical(adj.哲学的；豁达的)→philosophically(adv.)→philosophize(v.空谈哲理)
advancedExpressions.example: a great philosopher 伟大的哲学家；a philosophical attitude 豁达的态度；shrug philosophically 豁达地耸耸肩。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·可数性与不可数
advancedExpressions.expression: 作'哲学学科'不可数（study philosophy）；作'一套理念/人生观'可数（a philosophy of life）
advancedExpressions.example: He studies philosophy.（学科，不加 a）/ He has a clear philosophy of life.（一套理念，加 a）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was then that sb. grasped the philosophy of ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was then, kneeling in the quiet garden, that I finally grasped the philosophy my grandfather had lived by — that patience is not weakness, but the deepest form of strength. （强调句+破折号点题，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let this simple philosophy guide us: ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let this simple philosophy guide us in the year ahead: give more than we take, and leave every place a little brighter than we found it. （祈使句+冒号引出信条，演讲号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: a sound philosophy of ... rests not on ... but on ...
advancedExpressions.example: A sound philosophy of education rests not on cramming facts into passive minds but on awakening the courage to think for oneself. （not...but 对比+抽象名词化，凝练教育论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Tai chi teaches you to stay calm and balanced.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath its gentle, unhurried movements, tai chi carries an ancient philosophy — that harmony is found not by conquering the forces around us, but by learning, patiently, to move in step with them. （读后续写·文化哲理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 介词短语开头(Beneath...) + 破折号引出核心理念 + not...but 对比 + 副词插入(patiently)控制节奏

sentenceUpgrade.original: Education should teach students how to think.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The true philosophy of education, I firmly believe, should not be to pour knowledge into empty vessels, but to light a fire of curiosity that will burn brightly long after the last lesson has ended. （议论文·教育理念）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入语(I firmly believe) + not...but 对比 + 比喻(pour into vessels / light a fire)使抽象理念形象化

original_sentence: I discovered that tai chi is deeply rooted in the Chinese philosophy of yin and yang, which are believed to form the unity of opposites.
readingExamples: I discovered that tai chi is deeply rooted in the Chinese philosophy of yin and yang, which are believed to form the unity of opposites.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the state of being joined together to form a single unit or whole; oneness
(2) n. a situation in which a group of people agree with each other or work together harmoniously; solidarity
(3) n. (in art, music, writing) the quality of forming a single, harmonious and complete whole
(4) n. (maths) the number one

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （艺术、文学、音乐中的）和谐统一，整体感
uncommonMeanings.example: What struck me most about the painting was its unity — every brushstroke, however wild, somehow belonged to the same silent story. （读后续写·艺术欣赏·细腻观察）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （数学中的）'一'，单位一
uncommonMeanings.example: In the equation, the variable finally reduced to unity, and the whole tangled problem collapsed into elegant simplicity. （读后续写·解题·豁然开朗）

posExamples.sentence: As the final chord faded and the whole choir bowed as one, I felt a profound sense of unity binding us together — strangers an hour ago, now a single voice, a single heartbeat. （读后续写·合唱·集体归属）
I sincerely hope this sports meeting will strengthen the unity of our class, reminding every one of us that we rise or fall not as individuals, but as a team. （应用文·倡议/演讲）
History teaches us again and again that a nation's true strength is rooted in the unity of its people, for no external force can defeat those who stand firmly together. （议论文·家国/团结）
In the ancient philosophy of yin and yang, opposites are not enemies but partners, forming a delicate unity in which each depends upon the other for meaning. （议论文·文化哲理）

wordForms.other: reunion (n. 重聚); disunity (n. 不团结)

idioms.example: 'Unity is strength,' the coach reminded us before the final round, and those three words seemed to knit our scattered courage into an unbreakable bond. （读后续写·团队激励）
When the flood struck, the whole village worked in unity through the night, passing sandbags hand to hand until the first light of dawn. （读后续写·灾难·众志成城）

collocations.phrase: form the unity of opposites（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 构成对立的统一（课文原句）
collocations.example: Yin and yang are believed to form the unity of opposites. 人们相信阴阳构成对立的统一。
The whole village worked in unity through the night. 全村人齐心协力干了一夜。
The trip gave us a real sense of unity. 这次旅行给了我们真正的一体感。
The shared hardship of the training camp forged a deep sense of unity among us that no medal could ever measure. （读后续写·集体）
The reunion dinner is far more than a meal; it is a cherished ritual that renews family unity across the generations. （议论文·传统文化）
Yin and yang embody the unity of opposites, teaching us that light and shadow are two halves of the same whole. （议论文·哲学）
The class outing was organised to strengthen unity, and by nightfall even the shyest students were laughing together around the campfire. （读后续写·班级活动）
Facing the sudden crisis, the whole community stood in unity, and their combined resolve turned despair into hope. （读后续写·危机）
A truly great class is marked not by uniformity but by unity and harmony among students of very different characters. （议论文·集体）
In her closing speech, the head girl called for unity, urging every classmate to set aside small differences for the greater good. （应用文·演讲）
Maintaining unity within a large team demands constant communication, mutual respect, and a shared, unwavering goal. （议论文·合作）

synonyms.example: The workers marched in solidarity, their linked arms a living wall of shared determination. （读后续写·抗争）
synonyms.usage: 特指为共同利益或信念而结成的团结、声援，常用于社会、政治语境，情感更激昂；unity 更中性、更通用，也可指'整体、统一'

synonyms.example: The two cultures coexisted in remarkable harmony, each enriching the other. （议论文·多元共存）
synonyms.usage: 强调彼此协调、无冲突的和睦状态，侧重'关系融洽'；unity 侧重'合为一体、目标一致'，可以有分歧但仍团结

synonyms.example: Meditating by the still lake, she felt a strange oneness with the mountains and the silent sky. （读后续写·天人合一）
synonyms.usage: 偏文学、哲学色彩，强调'浑然一体、不可分割'的深层合一感；unity 更常用、更具体，可指群体团结

advancedExpressions.expression: the unity of opposites（对立统一）/ in unity（团结一致地）/ a sense of unity（一体感）/ strengthen unity（加强团结）/ call for unity（呼吁团结）
advancedExpressions.example: form the unity of opposites 构成对立统一；work in unity 齐心协力；strengthen class unity 增强班级团结。

advancedExpressions.expression: unity(n.团结/统一)→unite(v.联合，团结)/unify(v.统一)→united(adj.联合的)/unified(adj.统一的)→union(n.联盟)/reunion(n.重聚)→disunity(n.不团结)
advancedExpressions.example: unite as one 团结一心；a unified country 一个统一的国家；the United Nations 联合国；a family reunion 家庭重聚。

advancedExpressions.expression: unite v.（unite sb. / be united）→ 名词化 unity；in unity 中 unity 不可数
advancedExpressions.example: We must unite to win. → Only in unity can we win.（动词 unite ↔ 名词 unity 的转换）

advancedExpressions.expression: a profound sense of unity bound sb. together as ...
advancedExpressions.example: A profound sense of unity bound us together as we crossed the finish line hand in hand — no longer twelve tired runners, but one unbreakable team. （破折号+否定重构(no longer...but)，续写高潮升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us stand in unity, for only then can we ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us stand in unity, for only then can we turn our modest individual efforts into a force powerful enough to change our community. （祈使句+for only then 倒装，演讲号召升格）

advancedExpressions.expression: the strength of ... lies in its unity, not in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The strength of a nation lies in the unity of its people, not in the might of its weapons; history has proved, time and again, that a divided house cannot stand. （对比+分号引证，凝练家国论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The whole team worked together and won.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Bound by a unity forged through months of shared sweat and setbacks, the team moved as a single body, and when the final whistle blew, their victory felt less like a triumph of eleven players than of one indivisible spirit. （读后续写·团队夺冠）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语开头(Bound by...) + 隐喻(moved as a single body) + less...than 比较结构升华主旨

sentenceUpgrade.original: A country becomes strong when its people are united.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: History bears unmistakable witness to a timeless truth: a nation flourishes only when its people are bound together in unity, for a house divided against itself can never withstand the storms of adversity. （议论文·家国团结）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: History bears witness to...拟人化引证 + 冒号引出核心命题 + for 引导原因 + 谚语化比喻(a house divided)增强说服力

classPractice.note: in unity 团结一致地（不可数，前不加 a）

original_sentence: Neither can exist independent of the other; for example, there is no shadow without light.
readingExamples: Neither can exist independent of the other; for example, there is no shadow without light.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to be real, to be present in the world as a physical or abstract thing
(2) vi. to be found in a particular place or situation; to occur
(3) vi. to manage to live, especially with very little money or in difficult conditions
(4) vi. to continue to live or be present over a period of time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （+ on）靠……生存/维生
uncommonMeanings.example: For weeks the trapped miners existed on nothing but a few biscuits and the hope that rescue would come. （读后续写·困境·求生）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 勉强维持生活;艰难度日(强调仅够生存,毫无生活质量)
uncommonMeanings.example: For three long winters the family did not so much live as merely exist, sharing one thin blanket and counting every grain of rice, yet the mother's quiet songs at dusk kept a stubborn warmth alive in that cold room. （读后续写·贫困·苦中有光）

posExamples.sentence: As the mist lifted from the valley, the old man stared at the ruins where his childhood home had once stood, unable to believe that the whole world of his boyhood no longer existed except in the fading photographs of his memory. （读后续写·物是人非·怀旧）

I am writing to remind every member that a great gap still exists between our recycling target and our current habits, and I sincerely hope each of us will take small daily actions to close it. （应用文·倡议信）

Some argue that genuine friendship can no longer exist in an age of screens and likes, yet history suggests that human beings will always find ways to forge real bonds, however the technology around them changes. （议论文·科技与人际·辩证）

Neither light nor shadow can exist independent of the other; remove one and the very meaning of the other quietly dissolves, a truth the ancient philosophers grasped long before modern science confirmed it. （议论文·哲理·对立统一）

collocations.translation: 靠……生活/生存（【课件】exist 义项：to live, or to live in difficult conditions 生存、生活）
collocations.example: The custom of arranged marriages still exists in many countries. 包办婚姻的习俗在许多国家依然存在。（课件原句，示 exist 的"存在"义）／ The patient has had to exist on milk ever since. 那位病人此后不得不靠牛奶维生。
A deep respect for nature still exists in these mountain villages. 对自然的敬畏依然存在于这些山村之中。

collocations.translation: 某地有……；存在……（【课件】there be 句型的变体，谓语用 exist，随主语单复数变化）
collocations.example: There exists a strong bond between the old master and his students. 老师父与弟子之间存在着深厚的情谊。（there exists = there is 的正式变体）

collocations.phrase: come into existence / in existence【课件】
collocations.translation: 产生；成立；开始存在／存在（【课件】existence n. 存在；生存）
collocations.example: The organization has been in existence for 25 years. 这个组织已经存在了 25 年。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: existing adj.（仅用于名词前）【课件】
collocations.translation: 目前的；现存的（【课件】existing 只作前置定语）
collocations.example: The existing system needs to be changed. 现行的制度需要变革。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: exist independent of（课文原句词块）
collocations.translation: 独立于……而存在（课文原句）
collocations.example: Neither can exist independent of the other. 两者都不能脱离对方而独立存在。
The refugees existed on bread and water for weeks. 难民们靠面包和水熬过了数周。
The ancient city ceased to exist after the war. 那座古城在战后不复存在。

collocations.phrase: exist independent of / independently of（写作向）
collocations.example: The two forces, like yin and yang, cannot exist independent of each other, for each draws its very meaning from its opposite. （议论文·太极哲理）

collocations.translation: 存在某种问题/差距/差异
collocations.example: A worrying gap exists between what students claim to know about healthy eating and what they actually put on their plates each day. （议论文·健康观念）
Once the last speaker dies, an entire language, along with the centuries of wisdom stored within it, quietly ceases to exist. （议论文·文化保护）
The film shows how a small mountain village learned to exist in harmony with the wild animals that had once been seen as enemies. （读后续写·人与自然）
No one could have predicted that so many life-changing inventions would come into existence within a single generation. （议论文·科技发展）
The old fisherman refused to believe in the existence of the sea monster until, one misty dawn, something vast and dark rose silently beside his boat. （读后续写·悬疑·海上）
Traditions that no longer exist in the crowded cities still quietly survive in the remote villages of the mountains. （读后续写·文化传承）
In the drought-stricken land, even the toughest plants could barely exist, their withered stems bent low over the cracked earth. （读后续写·环境·荒芜）

synonyms.example: Against every expectation, the tiny seedling survived the frost, pushing its pale green shoot through the frozen soil toward the returning sun. （读后续写·生命·顽强）
synonyms.usage: survive 强调在危险/困境中存活下来,含"劫后余生"意味;exist 只是客观地"存在/生存",不含度过危机的过程

synonyms.example: Such reckless behaviour occurs far more often among teenagers who feel unseen at home than among those who feel truly listened to. （议论文·青少年心理）
synonyms.usage: occur 侧重"发生、出现"这一事件;exist 侧重状态上的"存在"。谈现象是否存在时二者可近似,但 occur 更强调频次/发生

synonyms.example: Though the old master had long passed away, his teachings remained, whispered from one generation of students to the next. （读后续写·传承）
synonyms.usage: remain 强调"经过变化后仍留存",含"剩下、依旧"义;exist 只客观说明存在与否,不含前后对比

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·exist 不及物·无被动·无进行时（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件·注意】exist 是不及物动词，没有被动语态，也没有进行时；接宾语须借介词：exist on（靠…生存）/ exist in（存在于…中）/ exist independent of（独立于…）。there exists/existed… 是 there be 句型的变体。
advancedExpressions.example: The custom still exists in many countries. 这一习俗在许多国家依然存在。（不说 is existed / is existing）／ There exists a wide gap between town and country. 城乡之间存在着巨大差距。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·with 复合结构（六种形式）
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】with + 宾语(名词/代词) + 宾语补足语，作状语表伴随/方式/原因/条件。六种补足语：①+形容词(with the windows open) ②+副词(with the light on) ③+介词短语(with a book in his hand) ④+不定式 to do(表未进行, with many problems to settle) ⑤+现在分词 doing(表主动/进行, with his eyes looking up) ⑥+过去分词 done(表被动/完成, with his homework done)。
advancedExpressions.example: With winter coming near, the weather is becoming colder. 随着冬天临近，天气越来越冷。（with+名词+doing）／ With his homework done, he went out to play. 作业做完后，他出去玩了。（with+名词+done）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·bring about 导致（=cause）与 bring 短语群
advancedExpressions.expression: 【课件】bring about 导致；引起（= cause）。bring 短语群：bring up 抚养/提出/呕吐；bring forward 提出；bring back 送回/使回想起；bring down 降低/击倒；bring out 显示出来/出版/生产。
advancedExpressions.example: Eventually, tai chi brings about a state of physical balance and mental peace. 太极最终带来身心平衡与内心宁静。（课文原句）／ Many new changes will be brought about in China's industry. 中国工业将迎来许多新变化。

advancedExpressions.expression: exist independent of（独立存在）/ exist on sth（靠…维生）/ cease to exist（不复存在）/ exist in harmony with（和谐共存）/ a gap exists between（存在差距）
advancedExpressions.example: cannot exist independent of each other 无法脱离彼此存在；exist on bread 靠面包维生；a gap exists between words and deeds 言行之间存在差距。

advancedExpressions.expression: exist(vi.存在)→existence(n.存在/生存)→existing(adj.现有的，现存的)/existent(adj.存在的)/non-existent(adj.不存在的)→existential(adj.存在主义的)
advancedExpressions.example: come into existence 产生；the existing rules 现行规则；a non-existent problem 子虚乌有的问题。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·exist 不及物 + 介词
advancedExpressions.expression: exist 为不及物动词，接宾语须借介词：exist on（靠…）/ exist in（存在于）/ exist independent(ly) of（独立于）
advancedExpressions.example: Fish cannot exist out of water. 鱼离开水无法存活。（exist 后不直接跟宾语，靠介词衔接）

advancedExpressions.expression: not ... so much live as merely exist
advancedExpressions.example: In those grey years she did not so much live as merely exist, until a single act of kindness reminded her what it felt like to be truly alive. （not so much A as B 精准对比,凸显"活着"与"存在"之别,升华段用）

advancedExpressions.expression: a gap still exists between ..., and it is up to us to ...
advancedExpressions.example: A wide gap still exists between our awareness and our actions, and it is up to each of us to bridge it, one small choice at a time. （倡议信标准句式,先陈述差距再号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: A cannot exist independent of B; the two define each other
advancedExpressions.example: Courage cannot exist independent of fear; the two define each other, for only the person who has known dread can truly be called brave. （借对立统一说理,句式凝练有哲思）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The village still exists today.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Tucked away where the map itself seems to forget it, the little village still exists today, its stone bridges and smoking chimneys unchanged, as though the restless century roaring past had somehow agreed to leave this one quiet corner alone. （读后续写·环境+拟人）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 地点状语前置(Tucked away...)营造画面 + 细节白描(stone bridges, smoking chimneys) + as though 拟人化时代(the century agreed to leave...) 赋予场景以温度

sentenceUpgrade.original: There is a big difference between what we say and what we do.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A striking gap exists between the ideals we proclaim so loudly and the choices we quietly make each day, and it is precisely in that gap that a person's true character is revealed. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: A gap exists between... 替换 there is a difference 提升正式度 + proclaim so loudly / quietly make 对比反衬 + it is precisely in that gap that... 强调句收束点题

classPractice.question: 用适当的副词填空：(1) I know it happened, but I cannot bring it ____ to my mind. (2) She brought ____ her children to be considerate of others. (3) With one shot he brought ____ the tiger. (4) Our teacher will bring a new book ____ next month.
classPractice.note: 【课件·bring 短语群】bring back 使回想起；bring up 抚养；bring down 击倒/降低；bring out 出版/生产。与 bring about 导致 同族记忆

classPractice.question: 两者都不能脱离对方而独立存在；例如，没有光就没有影。Neither can ____ ____ ____ the other; there is no shadow without light.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；exist independent of 独立于……而存在

classPractice.question: A huge gap still ____ (exist) between what we say and what we actually do.
classPractice.note: exist 不及物动词，主语 gap 第三人称单数，用 exists

classPractice.question: 从 exist on / cease to exist / come into existence 选一个：Trapped by the storm, the climbers had to ____ melted snow and a handful of nuts for three days.
